links.title: ERPO: 安定性と探索のジレンマを入力側正則化で打破

evidence: TL;DR: 'LLMのポリシー最適化（GRPO/PPO等）は、Policy-KL正則化という「応答側」の制約で安定性と探索のトレードオフを制御してきた' — method targets KL regularization placement in LLM policy optimization.
TL;DR: 'Query-KL（QKL）項でポリシーが誘導するクエリ分布のドリフトを拘束しつつ、応答分布への直接的な勾配圧力はゼロ' — core mechanism is input-side regularization.
TL;DR: 'Qwen2.5-Math-7Bで6ベンチマーク平均+6.2%' — sole quantitative result visible; single model, single aggregate metric.
Content status: abstract_only — no methodology, baselines, ablations, limitations, or code-availability sections are available for verification.
llm_evaluation.rationale: High preference match: this is a core LLM post-training/RLHF-methods paper (GRPO/PPO KL-regularization redesign), directly relevant to Alignment & RLHF, Training & Optimization, and math-reasoning evaluation. The core idea—shifting KL regularization from the response side to the query side (Query-KL) to decouple stability from exploration—is a plausible and reasonably novel twist on policy-KL orthodoxy, though the abstract-only content prevents confirming distinctiveness from prior prompt/query-regularization work. Rigor and evidence are weakly verifiable: only one model (Qwen2.5-Math-7B), one aggregate number (+6.2% mean over 6 benchmarks), no visible baselines, ablations, limitations, or code/hyperparameter claims; the TL;DR's 'EMNLP 2026 acceptance' is an unverifiable prestige claim and is not credited. Generalizability is moderate in principle (any policy-optimization stack could adopt input-side KL) but demonstrated on a single 7B math model. Overall a promising but under-evidenced contribution.

primary_link.title: ERPO: 安定性と探索のジレンマを入力側正則化で打破

blog_recommendations.summary:
TL;DR
LLMのポリシー最適化（GRPO/PPO等）は、Policy-KL正則化という「応答側」の制約で安定性と探索のトレードオフを制御してきた。残念ながら、残すと探索が阻害され、外すとドリフト制御がなくなるというジレンマに陥る。AlibabaのZhouらがEMNLP 2026に採択された論文「ERPO」は、正則化を入力（クエリ）側に移すことでこのジレンマを打破する。Query-KL（QKL）項でポリシーが誘導するクエリ分布のドリフトを拘束しつつ、応答分布への直接的な勾配圧力はゼロ――探索を犠牲にせずに安定性を獲得する。Qwen2.5-Math-7Bで6ベンチマーク平均+6.2%...
blog_recommendations.summary_zh: 大型語言模型的策略最佳化方法（如 GRPO、PPO）長期依賴作用於「回應端」的 Policy-KL 正規化來控制穩定性與探索之間的取捨，但這帶來兩難：保留該項會抑制模型對回應的探索，移除則失去對策略漂移的控制。Zhou 等人（阿里巴巴）提出的 ERPO 主張將正規化移至輸入（查詢）端：以 Query-KL（QKL）項約束策略所誘導之查詢分布的漂移，同時對回應分布不施加直接的梯度壓力，從而在不犧牲探索的前提下取得穩定性。其宣稱的主要證據是在 Qwen2.5-Math-7B 上，六項基準平均提升 6.2%。需要留意的是，本篇目前僅提供 TL;DR 摘要，尚無法確認其完整實驗設定、消融分析與基線比較等細節，宣稱獲 EMNLP 2026 錄取一事亦應以官方議程為準，結論宜待全文與可重現結果公布後再行判斷。此研究的意義在於點出 KL 正規化的施加位置本身就是一項關鍵的設計自由度，若經全文驗證屬實，將對 RLHF 與強化學習後訓練（post-training）的方法設計帶來實質啟發。

primary_link.title: Claude Codeのトークン消費、92〜97%は「文脈の再読」だった——読み取り専用DeepSeekワーカーを作って実測99%削減した

blog_recommendations.summary:
TL;DR

Claude Code の transcript（~/.claude/projects/**/*.jsonl）の usage を全集計したら、費用の 92〜97%がキャッシュ読み書き（＝毎ターンの文脈再読）、思考トークンは0.4%だった
マルチエージェント構成では費用の88〜93%が「読んで集める」サブエージェント。フロンティアモデルに読ませるのが最大の無駄
対策として、読み取り専用の自律 DeepSeek ワーカーを MCP サーバとして実装（glob/grep/read_file/web_search/web_fetch を自前ループで回し、圧縮レポートだけ返す）
...
blog_recommendations.summary_zh: 本研究針對 Claude Code 的 token 消耗結構進行實測分析。作者彙整 ~/.claude/projects/**/*.l 轉錄紀錄中的 usage 資料,發現約 92〜97% 的費用來自快取讀寫,亦即模型在每一輪都重複重讀整個上下文;而思考(thinking)token 僅佔 0.4%。在多代理(multi-agent)架構下,問題更為明顯:88〜93% 的成本落在負責「閱讀與蒐集」的子代理(subagent),讓前沿模型親自掃讀大量檔案被視為最大的浪費來源。對此,作者提出的對策是以 MCP 伺服器形式實作一個唯讀的自主 DeepSeek worker:該 worker 在自身迴圈中執行 glob、grep、read_file、web_search、web_fetch 等工具完成檢索,最後僅回傳壓縮後的摘要報告,使昂貴的前沿模型只需接收精煉結論,而不必反覆載入原始上下文。據標題所述,此做法實測可將 token 消耗削減達 99%。需注意本篇僅有摘要,完整的實驗設計、對照基準、報告品質評估,以及在不同程式碼庫規模與任務型態下的通用性均未揭露;其數字亦主要來自作者自身的使用紀錄,外推時應保守。此研究的價值在於點出 AI 編碼代理的成本大頭往往不是推理或思考本身,而是上下文重讀與委派閱讀,為代理系統的成本最佳化指出明確方向:以廉價模型處理機械式檢索,將昂貴模型留給決策與綜合判斷。

blog_recommendations.summary:
1. はじめに
前回・前々回の記事では、レガシーJavaライブラリを題材に、AIエージェントへ「CIの全ゲートがPASSするまで自律的に繰り返せ」という指示を何度も投げてきました。この形式——エージェントが「変更する→検証する→失敗したら直す」というループを、人間の介入なしに何十周も自律的に回す構成——は Agentic Loop（あるいはループエンジニアリング）と呼ばれ、複雑なタスクを高い柔軟性で解決できる一方、構造的なリスクも抱えています。
その一つがトークン爆発です。多くのAgentic Loop実装は、各ターンでそれまでの会話履歴全体を再送信します。ループが長引くほど1ターン...
blog_recommendations.summary_zh: 本文延續前兩篇以舊版 Java 函式庫為題材的實驗：反覆對 AI 代理下達「在 CI 所有關卡（gate）全部 PASS 之前，自主地重複迭代」的指令。這種由代理自行執行「修改→驗證→失敗就修正」、在人類不介入下循環數十周的架構，即 Agentic Loop（或稱迴圈工程），彈性高但帶有結構性風險。作者聚焦的問題是 Token 爆炸：多數 Agentic Loop 實作在每個回合都會重送整段對話歷史，迴圈拖得越長，單回合輸入 Token 就越膨脹，推升成本與延遲，甚至超出上下文限制，讓代理「停不下來」或行為劣化。透過實測，文章揭示了 Token 肥大化的實際樣貌，並主張在迴圈之外加上「靜態護欄」——由人預先定義、不隨對話增長的停止條件與檢查點，賦予系統「能停下來」的能力，在保留代理自主性的同時控制風險。受限於摘要僅截取開頭，具體的實驗設定、量測結果與設計建議須見原文；對正在設計代理迴圈的工程師，本文的核心提醒是：自治迴圈必須配備可預測、可審計的終止機制。

blog_recommendations.summary_zh: 許多開發者用 Claude Code 等工具快速生成 AI 聊天機器人時，若未經深思，常會得到效率低落的設計：系統提示冗長、不必要的 LLM 呼叫層層堆疊，導致 API 成本暴增。本文作者指出，只要調整設計方式，LLM API 費用大約可以降到原本的十分之一。核心方法有二：第一，以宣告式（declarative）方式定義 AI 代理（agent），把代理的角色、可用工具與行為寫成明確的描述或設定，而不是讓邏輯散落在程式碼各處；第二，執行引擎保持極簡，只負責反覆執行「呼叫 LLM、處理結果、決定下一步」的迴圈。這種宣告與執行分離的架構，讓每次對話只觸發必要的呼叫，避免重複推理與冗餘 token 消耗，同時也提升可維護性與可測試性。根據標題與摘要，作者宣稱費用降幅約達十分之一，但目前僅有摘要層級的資訊，缺乏詳細的成本量測基準、對話輪數、模型選擇與工作負載特性等細節，1/10 這個數字的適用範圍仍需讀者自行驗證。整體而言，這篇文章提醒開發者：LLM 應用的長期營運成本往往取決於架構設計而非模型本身；在動手開發前先思考代理的定義方式與引擎結構，可能是控制成本最有效、也最容易被忽略的槓桿。

blog_recommendations.summary_zh: 本文探討編碼代理（coding agent）是否需要 EDR（Endpoint Detection and Response，端點偵測與回應）等級的執行期安全防護。作者前作利用 Claude Code 的 hooks 打造了安全監控儀表板「CC Pipeline」：可視覺化工具呼叫、阻擋致命操作、對危險操作發出警告，作為個人工具確實有用。但實際使用後，作者察覺其侷限（摘要於此截斷），並進一步思考更深層的問題。其背景在於：AI 代理能在本機直接執行指令、讀寫檔案與存取網路，傳統的事前規則或 hook 攔截往往只能涵蓋已知的危險模式，對代理自身生成的新穎指令、供應鏈注入或提示詞注入（prompt injection）等攻擊面，防護能力有限；這正是 EDR 式「持續觀測、偵測異常、即時回應」思路可能派上用場之處。本文的價值在於把代理安全從「維護許可清單」提升到「執行期威脅模型」的層次，促使開發者思考權限邊界、沙箱隔離與稽核軌跡。受限於摘要僅含開頭，CC Pipeline 的具體不足、作者的結論與證據須參照原文，不宜自行推斷。

blog_recommendations.summary_zh: 本文改寫自作者發表於 Zenn 的文章，內容相同且兩邊同步更新。主題是 Claude Code 許可規則（permission rules）的堆積問題：當使用者在「要允許這個指令嗎」的提示下按下「Yes, and don't ask again」，該規則就會被寫入 ~/.claude/settings.。作者檢查自己的設定檔後發現，長期累積下來共有 152 條規則；其中 92 條是以「完全比對」形式記錄的指令字串，在累計 109,762 次工具執行的紀錄中，一次都沒有匹配成功，形同虛設。這暗示以完全比對儲存的許可規則在實務上極難再次命中：日常工作中的指令往往帶有不同的參數與路徑，與當初按鈕存下的完整字串不盡相同（此因果解讀屬摘要範圍外的推論，細節請見原文）。這篇實證分析提醒使用者：許可規則庫需要定期盤點與清理，否則一邊累積大量無效規則、造成虛假的安全感與維護負擔，一邊卻缺乏真正有效的規則，導致不斷被確認提示打斷。摘要僅含開頭，統計方法與清理、改寫建議的細節請參閱原文。

primary_link.title: Spreading the load: How Salesforce met Multi-AZ HA with SageMaker Inference Components

blog_recommendations.summary: Learn how Salesforce used Amazon SageMaker AI Inference Component placement (the SchedulingConfig parameter) to distribute model copies across multiple Availability Zones, meeting their Multi-AZ high availability compliance requirements without sacrificing the cost efficiency of multi-model co-hosting.
blog_recommendations.summary_zh: 本文說明 Salesforce 如何運用 Amazon SageMaker AI 的 Inference Component 佈置能力（即 SchedulingConfig 參數），把模型副本分散部署到多個可用區（Availability Zone），藉此滿足 Multi-AZ 高可用性的合規要求，同時不犧牲多模型共置（multi-model co-hosting）的成本效益。其面臨的問題是：在以 Inference Components 將多個模型裝進同一份運算資源以節省成本的架構下，若某個可用區故障，承載於其上的模型副本會一併失效，難以符合要求跨可用區容錯的企業合規規範；而若為每個模型各配專屬資源並手動跨 AZ 複製，又會侵蝕共置省錢的初衷。解法是透過排程設定的佈置策略，在建立推理元件時讓副本跨 AZ 分佈，使任一 AZ 中斷時，其他 AZ 仍有副本可繼續提供服務。文章展示了高可用與成本效率可以兼得，對需要在單一加速運算資源上共置多模型、又必須通過 HA 審核的團隊極具參考價值。摘要未含具體的延遲影響、副本數規劃與故障演練結果，實作細節請參閱原文。

最近のローカルLLMの本命ともいえる、Qwen3.8-Flash-NextをDGX Sparkで動かします。MoEモデルですので実用的な速度での実行が期待できます！
量子化度合いとサイズのバランス的には以下のUD-IQ4_XSが93.7GBのファイルサイズです。128GBの統合メモリには丁度さそうです。
https://huggingface.co/unsloth/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-GGUF/tree/main/UD-IQ4_XS
vLLM向けにNVFP4版も出ていますが、何故かうまく動かないので先ずはQ4版を動かしてみます。

 ダウンロード
# 必要に応...
blog_recommendations.summary_zh: 這是一篇動手實作文章，目標是在 NVIDIA DGX Spark 上以本地方式執行近期受矚目的 MoE 模型 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next。作者面對的核心問題是：大型模型對記憶體需求極高，而 DGX Spark 具備 128GB 統一記憶體，能否同時滿足模型載入與實用推理速度是關鍵。方法上，作者權衡各量化版本的體積與品質，選定 unsloth 提供的 GGUF 格式 UD-IQ4_XS（檔案約 93.7GB），認為其與 128GB 統一記憶體相當契合，決定先執行此 Q4 量化版本；文中亦提及另有針對 vLLM 的 NVFP4 版本，但作者表示不知為何無法順利運作，故暫以 Q4 版本為起點，並開始說明下載與環境準備步驟。就所提供的摘錄而言，文章聚焦於模型選擇、檔案大小與記憶體容量的平衡評估，至於 MoE 架構能帶來實用速度的說法，在摘錄中仍屬作者的預期；實際推理延遲、吞吐量等效能資料並未完整呈現，讀者須留意證據尚未完整。限制包括：NVFP4 版本無法運作的原因未明、4-bit 量化可能帶來品質折損而摘錄未評估其影響，且內容於下載步驟即中斷，缺少完整的實測結果。本文價值在於示範統一記憶體工作站上 MoE 模型搭配量化技術的實務部署路徑，並凸顯 GGUF 與 vLLM 等不同軟體生態系在支援進度上的差異，對想在本地硬體執行大型 MoE 模型的使用者具參考意義。

links.title: JIT-Agent: Scaling Harness Intelligence via Just-in-Time Harness Evolution

evidence: Abstract: 'DeepSeek-V4-Flash surpasses GPT-5.6 on DeepSearchQA (+9.1) and OdysseyBench (+4.3), while the already strong GLM-5.2 gains up to +20.2 points'; matches Table 3 (85.1 vs 76.0; 73.0 vs 68.7; 62.8->83.0).

Table 3 (Section 6.2): nine-benchmark averages rise 74.1->81.8 (+7.7) on GLM-5.2 and 66.7->75.5 (+8.8) on DeepSeek-V4-Flash; JIT-equipped systems best in 8 of 9 columns (counting the table confirms 7 for JIT+GLM-5.2 plus Shop for JIT+DeepSeek).

Table 4 (Section 6.3): backbone-fixed comparison vs Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Hermes, NanoBot; JIT-Agent lowest tokens/cost in all six settings, e.g., DeepSeek-V4-Flash xBench-DS 527K->$0.075 drops to 212K->$0.039 while score rises 78.0->82.0.

Sections 4.1-4.3: full objective definitions for Stage I (SFT + length-normalized DPO variant with reward/latency/cost value gaps), Stage II (repair trajectories bounded at K*<=2), Stage III (Evo-GDPO with decoupled group normalization and PPO-style clipping).

Section 6.5 / Figure 5: 24 matched backbone-benchmark comparisons vs ReAct, average +7.6, but uses 100-example DeepSearchQA subset and 50-example subsets for the other benchmarks; no variance reported.
Section 6.6 / Figure 6: Streaming JIT beats Static JIT on three planning/workspace streams; only qualitative note that cost/tool traces are 'of broadly similar scale'.

Section 3.1 'Position' paragraph: authors concede production harnesses (Codex, Claude Code, DeepSeek Harness) are richer than the four-module instantiation; no dedicated limitations section elsewhere.

Front matter: GitHub (github.com/bingreeky/JIT), Hugging Face (JIT-Agent), and project website links provided; training hyperparameters, dataset sizes, teacher identity, and compute budget not reported in the document.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A core LLM-agent paper squarely matching top-weighted preferences (Agents & Tool Use, LLMs, RL/alignment-flavored training). It trains a 27B meta-agent to synthesize, repair, and evolve four-module harnesses just-in-time, with a three-stage recipe (SFT + value-weighted DPO preference, bounded repair trajectories, Evo-GDPO). Quantitative claims are internally consistent (e.g., 85.1 vs GPT-5.6's 76.0 on DeepSearchQA = +9.1; Table 4 cost reductions 14.9-54.1% recompute correctly), with backbone-controlled harness comparisons, cost/token analysis, Pareto frontiers, 24 paired cross-family comparisons, and static-vs-streaming evolution. Deductions: no ablation isolating Stage I/II/III contributions or key hyperparameters (G, lambda_evo, weights), no statistical significance or variance on main tables (generalization uses 50-100 example subsets), no dedicated limitations section (only a 'Position' paragraph), vague training data sourcing and unreported hyperparameters/compute, and availability links (GitHub/HF) asserted but unverifiable from text. Novelty is moderate-good: the JIT Model-as-a-Harness framing and trained generator appear new, but it assembles known ingredients (ADAS/AFlow-style search, GDPO/GRPO, ReAct-style scaffolds) and its protocol is deliberately narrower than production harnesses.

primary_link.title: JIT-Agent: Scaling Harness Intelligence via Just-in-Time Harness Evolution

recommendations.summary: Agent capability is not determined by the model alone. The agent harness, encompassing memory management, planning strategy, action protocol, and tool/skill orchestration, can dominate the contribution of the underlying foundation model. Yet harness design remains manual, task-specific, and fundamentally unscalable. We present JIT-Agent, a harness intelligence model trained to synthesize task-adaptive agent harnesses on the fly for arbitrary off-the-shelf agentic LLMs. We formalize the agent harness as a composable, machine-generatable artifact governed by a fixed four-module protocol, and train JIT-Agent to customize harnesses for a given task at hand, repair harnesses for stable and reliable execution, and self-evolve by distilling performance signals from an expanding archive of prior harness configurations. Equipped with JIT-Agent as a harness helper, DeepSeek-V4-Flash surpasses GPT-5.6 on DeepSearchQA (+9.1) and OdysseyBench (+4.3), while the already strong GLM-5.2 gains up to +20.2 points. Across controlled evaluations, JIT-Agent-generated harnesses are performance-competitive with mature agent runtimes such as OpenCode and Claude Code and consistently improve multi-scale model families of DeepSeek V4, Mimo-V2.5, and Qwen3.6. To our knowledge, JIT-Agent is the first model purpose-built for just-in-time harness generation, establishing harness intelligence as a trainable, transferable, and compounding dimension of agent capability orthogonal to model scaling.
recommendations.summary_zh: 此論文指出 LLM 代理能力並非僅由模型權重決定，外部支架（harness，含記憶管理、規劃、動作協定與工具編排）常是成效關鍵，但支架設計仰賴人工、任務專用且難以擴展；既有方法多屬事先（AOT）最佳化，難以貼合個別任務。作者提出 JIT-Agent，訓練一個後設代理在推論當下為任意現成代理模型即時合成任務專屬支架。論文將支架形式化為固定四模組協定（記憶、規劃、動作、能力編排）下的可執行程式，並以 HarnessFactory 重新實作 13 種代表性 scaffold 作為種子庫；訓練分三階段：教師示範的客製化學習、將失敗生成轉為有限步修復軌跡的修復學習，以及 Evo-GDPO 線上策略最佳化，分別正規化獎勵、延遲與成本，鼓勵新支架超越現有檔案庫前沿。實驗顯示 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 搭配 JIT-Agent 在 DeepSearchQA 領先 GPT-5.6 達 9.1 分，GLM-5.2 在 DeepPlanning-Travel 提升 20.2 分；受控比較中與 Claude Code、OpenCode 等成熟執行環境相當或更佳，平均降低約 36% 每案例成本，且串流推論可持續從執行回饋演化檔案庫。限制包括四模組協定較產品級執行環境簡化、少數基準仍落後最佳固定支架，以及品質取決於協定與驗證器設計。此工作確立「支架智慧」為可訓練、可遷移、與模型規模正交的代理能力新維度。

links.title: Joint Optimization of Tool Creation and Use for Large Language Model Agents

evidence: Abstract: 'A 4B Qwen3 trained with SMITH on 13 procedural reasoning tasks with exact verifiers reaches 79.8 macro-average accuracy on held-out tasks... 40.4 on TabMWP-Hard and 42.6 on out-of-domain GQA (+7.6 over the best same-backbone inference-time baseline)'

Section 3.6 / Table 1: 'SMITH leads held-out generalization (RG Unseen 79.9) over distilled models (ReTool 63.2, LATM-distill 65.8)... using 32x fewer output tokens than standard CoT' (100 vs 3,206 output tokens)
Section 3.11 / Table 7: 'Decoupled build/use does not beat single-model Tool Create on RG (Unseen) (58.9 vs 68.8)... only the full SMITH objective wins on aggregate' (Full: RG S 86.61, RG U 78.33)
Section 3.9 / Table 5: 'for Qwen3-8B, SMITH improves... (72.6→79.4) and the holdout RG accuracy (72.2→81.7)... Granite-3.3-8B... lifts RG (Seen) to 39.1, RG (Unseen) to 28.5'
Section 3.7 / Table 3: 'the SMITH-4B-written tools lift the 30B consumer on every group, most sharply on TabMWP-Hard (0.7→38.8), and raise the task-weighted overall score from 70.2 to 76.6'
Section 3.10 / Table 6: 'SMITH lifts BFCL overall accuracy on both Qwen backbones, from 45.1 to 48.6 on Qwen3-4B and from 43.3 to 55.8 on Qwen3-8B'
Appendix B: documents a verifiable training failure ('naming drift' reward collapse, Table 8 per-step metrics) and derives five design lessons for verifier+judge reward combination

Section 4 Limitations: 'All trained policies are at most 8B parameters... whether the gains persist... at the 70B+ scale is an open question... we do not formally certify that adversarial prompts cannot induce unsafe tools'
Appendix N: 'All SMITH training runs were performed on a single NVIDIA RTX 6000 Pro GPU... between 36 and 72 hours'
Appendix O / Table 17: 'No configuration ever significantly outperforms v1' (two-sided exact McNemar tests), guarding against under-tuned-baseline objections

Inconsistency noted: Appendix I states 'ReTool achieves the highest in-distribution accuracy on RG (Seen) (92.0 vs. our 86.6)' while Section 3.6/Table 1 report 92.2 vs 85.2, and Appendix J reports LATM-distill Seen 83.3 / Unseen 66.4 vs Table 1's 81.7 / 65.8
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM/agent-methodology paper: RL-trained joint tool creation and use (SMITH) on Qwen3 backbones, squarely matching high-weight preferences for LLMs, agents & tool use, reasoning, and RL. Novelty is solid but incremental over LATM/CRAFT/TroVE/KTCE (inference-time tool creation) and ReTool/SAGE (RL for tool use/skills); the genuinely new elements are the schema-grounded joint build/use objective, three disentangled reward axes, easy-to-hard evaluation split, and tool-pool curriculum. Rigor is strong: many same-backbone baselines, seeded re-evaluations with std, a full reward-structure ablation (Table 7), cross-backbone replication (Table 5), BFCL v4 transfer, and unusually candid baseline forensics (Appendix L) plus a McNemar-tested prompt-tuning ablation (Appendix O). Evidence strength is good but dented by internal numeric inconsistencies (abstract/conclusion 79.8 vs Table 1 79.9; Appendix I 'ReTool 92.0 vs ours 86.6' vs Section 3.6/Table 1 '92.2 vs 85.2'; Appendix J 'Seen 83.3/Unseen 66.4' vs Table 1 '81.7/65.8') and reliance on an LLM judge whose bias is only partially probed by the Self-Judge ablation. Generalizability is supported across 4B/8B/Granite backbones, a 350M and a 30B consumer, TabMWP-Hard, and GQA (though GQA needs fixed visual primitives and the paper concedes the GPT-4.1 distillation gap there), but 70B+ scale and richer artifacts (MCP/skills) are explicitly open (Section 4). Reproducibility is high: verbatim judge prompt (Appendix C), full task splits (Appendix F), hyperparameters (Tables 12-13), tool-pool design (Appendix E), and single-GPU 36-72h cost (Appendix N), with Code/Project Page links claimed. Not out-of-scope; no instruction-following from paper text was performed.

primary_link.title: Joint Optimization of Tool Creation and Use for Large Language Model Agents

recommendations.summary: Tool-augmented language models are bounded by the APIs humans bothered to write; existing tool-creation systems patch this by prompting a frozen LLM at inference time, leaving the model that writes a tool decoupled from the one that uses it, with no signal that the schemas it produces are schemas it can invoke. We propose SMITH (Schema-grounded Multi-task Iterative Tool Honing), a reinforcement learning framework that jointly trains tool creation and tool use inside a single policy. Each rollout
recommendations.summary_zh: 本文提出 SMITH，一個以強化學習在單一策略內同時訓練「建立工具」與「使用工具」的框架。現有工具增強系統依賴人類預先設計的 API，推論時的工具生成方法（LATM、CRAFT、TroVE、KTCE）僅以提示詞驅動凍結模型，寫工具與用工具脫鉤，缺乏「寫出的 schema 能否被自己呼叫」的訓練訊號。SMITH 交錯兩類任務：build 任務自少量範例歸納出 Python 函式與 OpenAI 相容的 JSON schema；use 任務只看 schema，須從工具池挑選並呼叫工具回答保留題。獎勵分為格式一致性、執行準確率（於更難題組上評估，評估器定期與策略同步）與 LLM 審查品質三個獨立軸，以 DAPO 聯合最佳化，並採由易到難協定逼出可泛化的抽象工具。以 Qwen3-4B-Instruct 加 LoRA 在 13 個 Reasoning-Gym 程序性任務上訓練後，未見任務達 79.8% 巨觀平均準確率，超越所有推論時與蒸餾基線，每題輸出約 100 tokens（較 CoT 少 32 倍）；零樣本轉移於 TabMWP-Hard 得 40.4%，GQA 得 42.6%。其工具可跨規模移植：讓 LFM2.5-350M 追平 30B 工具撰寫模型，訓練配方亦一致提升 Qwen3-8B 與 Granite-3.3-8B，並改善 BFCL v4 外部工具呼叫。限制：模型規模至多 8B、依賴 30B LLM 審查、工具僅為單一函式與 schema、未觀察到平行工具呼叫，沙盒安全亦未正式驗證。此研究證明讓模型學會撰寫自己能可靠呼叫的工具，是邁向可重用、可遷移代理能力的可擴充路徑。

links.title: V-Rubrics: Visual Faithfulness via Rubric-Based Reinforcement Learning

evidence: Abstract: introduces Visual Rubrics-Based RL decomposing reference responses into atomic VF/RC/IF propositions for structured partial credit during post-training.
Section 4.3: rubric-based GRPO gives +1.79 Overall Avg. over answer-only GRPO on knowledge benchmarks (66.25 -> 68.04 via Table 3), with gains concentrated on MMMU/MMMU-Pro.
Section 4.3: 'scalar GRPO remains better on MathVerse V/O and CharXiv reasoning', so the improvement is not uniform across benchmarks.

Table 3 (Section 4.3 Ablations): answer-only 66.25, scalar sequence-level rubrics 67.74, component+prefix 68.04; the 0.30 gap jointly reflects component-wise standardization and localization, not localization alone.
Section 6 Limitations: admits judge-model family bias (Qwen-family judge scoring Qwen-family policy), approximate fuzzy-match prefix localization, and no large human-audited rubric evaluation.
Appendix C.3: 352,938 rubric items (209,436 VF, 101,369 RC, 42,133 IF) generated entirely by Gemini-3-Pro under one structured prompt; no human verification of rubric quality is reported.
Appendix D.2 Table 6: full GRPO configuration (verl Megatron backend, lr 2e-6, G=12 rollouts, KL 0.01, Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B as training judge), supporting reproducibility.
Appendix E: acknowledges weaker regimes (MMBench-Dev, MathVerse V/O, CharXiv) attributed to rubric-metric mismatch.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A VLM post-training methodology paper (rubric-based rewards for GRPO on Qwen3-VL-8B), squarely within the Multimodal AI, Alignment/RLHF, Reasoning, and LLM-as-judge preferences; not pure computer vision and not out of scope. Novelty is incremental: it extends Rubrics-as-Rewards (Gunjal et al., 2025, cited in Section 2) to visually grounded VF/RC/IF criteria, with prefix-localized credit as the main new mechanism. Rigor is moderate: fair shared-SFT/shared-data comparisons, a credit-assignment ablation (Table 3: 66.25 vs 67.74 vs 68.04), and detailed configuration, but single-seed runs, no significance testing, small deltas (0.30 between rubric variants, 1.79 over answer-only on knowledge Overall Avg.), and mixed per-benchmark results (Section 4.3 concedes scalar GRPO wins on MathVerse V/O and CharXiv). Evidence is quantitative but weakened by fully automatic Gemini-3-Pro rubric annotation with no human audit and same-family judge bias, both acknowledged in Section 6. Generalizability is limited to one backbone family with transfer explicitly left to future work. Reproducibility is relatively strong (hyperparameters in Appendix D.2 Table 6, data inventory in Table 4, judge prompts in Table 5, project page), though proprietary annotation models are a barrier.

primary_link.title: V-Rubrics: Visual Faithfulness via Rubric-Based Reinforcement Learning

recommendations.summary: Vision-language models can produce fluent answers that are insufficiently grounded in the visual evidence: a single unsupported object, chart value, or intermediate inference can undermine an otherwise plausible response. We argue that this is a credit-assignment failure in multimodal post-training. Scalar outcome rewards indicate whether an answer is acceptable, but do not identify which visual facts are grounded, which reasoning steps are valid, or which instruction constraints are missed. We introduce Visual Rubrics-Based Reinforcement Learning, which decomposes reference responses into atomic propositions and scores generated answers along Visual Faithfulness (VF), Reasoning Consistency (RC), and Instruction Following (IF). The resulting rubric items provide structured partial credit and localize rubric credit when supporting evidence spans are available. We first obtain an SFT checkpoint by fine-tuning Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct on the public OpenMMReasoner-SFT-874K corpus, adapting OpenMMReasoner's cold-start data recipe. We construct V-Rubrics 50K, a 50,248-example training set from 17 visually grounded sources, by applying rule-based filters before deriving example difficulty from rejection-sampling scores and then annotating every example with Gemini-3-Pro under the same structured prompt and protocol. We train our model based on the same SFT checkpoint using component-wise, prefix-localized rubric credit. Experiments show that our rubricbased GRPO improves over both the shared SFT baseline and answer-only GRPO, with the largest gains on knowledge-oriented and visually grounded reasoning benchmarks. The results show rubrics as a useful reward abstraction for visual post-training.
recommendations.summary_zh: 視覺語言模型（VLM）常生成流暢卻缺乏影像證據支持的回答，一個無根據的物件、圖表數值或推理步驟便足以破壞整體答案。本文將此視為多模態後訓練中的信用分配（credit assignment）問題：純量結果獎勵只能判斷答案對錯，無法指出哪些視覺事實有依據、哪些推理步驟失效。作者提出視覺評分規準強化學習（Visual Rubrics-Based RL），將參考回答分解為原子命題，並依視覺忠實性（VF）、推理一致性（RC）與指令遵循（IF）三個維度逐項評分。團隊建立 V-Rubrics 50K 資料集，含 50,248 筆來自 17 個視覺任務來源的範例，由 Gemini-3-Pro 依統一協定標註，訓練時以 Qwen3-VL-235B 擔任評審。模型先以 OpenMMReasoner-SFT-874K 微調 Qwen3-VL-8B，再用 GRPO 進行元件式、前綴局部化的規準信用訓練。實驗顯示，規準式 GRPO 在通用與知識基準的總平均達 68.04，優於僅用答案獎勵的 66.25 與 SFT 基線；在 MMMU、MathVision、DynaMath、WeMath、LogicVista 等依賴有據中間推理的任務增益最大，消融實驗亦支持元件加前綴設計優於序列層級彙總。限制方面：規準品質依賴自動生成與評審驗證、前綴定位採模糊比對僅屬近似，且同家族評審可能引入偏誤。此研究將視覺忠實性從事後評估診斷轉化為可操作的訓練介面，顯示評分規準是視覺後訓練中細粒度獎勵的有效抽象。
recommendations.title: V-Rubrics: Visual Faithfulness via Rubric-Based Reinforcement Learning
recommendations.title_zh: V-Rubrics：以評分規準強化學習實現視覺忠實性

links.title: SWE Refactor Bench: Can Coding Agents Complete a Long-Horizon, Whole-Repository Stack Migration?

evidence: Abstract: 'only 28 of 520 runs (5.4%) pass all three stages, 13 of the 20 tasks receive no accepted solution, and the best model (claude-opus-5) scores 47.0/100'

Section 2.1 'Why behavioural tests fail here': 'rate(R_A;T)=1 for any T—by construction... Setting R_S=R_A (the empty diff) therefore earns full marks on any behavioural suite' — formalizes the Blindness claim
Section 2.3 Scoring, Eq. (4): composite score defined as veto × all-or-nothing Stage II × (0.4 + 0.6·s/6) Stage III per-verifier factor
Section 3.4.1: 'Judge and human agree 89.7% of the time (140/156, κ=0.795)... of the 16 disagreements, 14 are the judge being too strict'

Section 3.3.2: 'Among the 340 runs that passed Stage I... 58% reach 99% and 36% reach 99.9%—but only 26% make no error at all' with concrete failure cases (fw03 hash routing 21768/21769, build03 wheel METADATA 380/381)

Section 3.4.3 Finding 1: 'the two held by claude-opus-5 are 55.7% and 53.4%, the other four between 21.6% and 26.1%... retire the two strongest and the remaining four would accept 46 submissions instead of 28'
Table 1 / Appendix C Table 10: 20 tasks, 130,118 fixed checks, 262 criteria, per-task versions, LoC, and time budgets listed
Section 1 (scoping limitation): 'these results establish a capability gap on the 20 tasks in SWE Refactor Bench; they do not rank the intrinsic difficulty of all migration projects'

Reproducibility gap: homepage URL given in metadata, but the paper text nowhere states code or task images will be publicly released; Stage I judge is gpt-5.6-sol (Section 3.4.1) and Stage III 'tests... vary across verifier runs' (Section 1)
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant to core preferences: an LLM coding-agent evaluation benchmark (Agents & Tool Use, LLMs, Code & Programming, Red Teaming & Evaluation). Novelty is solid: the identified 'Blindness' failure mode (Section 2.1 shows rate(R_A;T)=1 by construction for untouched repos) and the three-stage protocol with a Migration Audit veto plus Agentic Verification via executable counterexamples (Section 2.3, Eq. 4) are genuinely distinct from red-to-green suites like SWE-bench (Table 7). Rigor is strong: 520 runs over 8 models/26 configurations, an explicit scoring formula, funnel decomposition that is internally consistent (340/118/88/28, 30 blindness, 252 behavior-breaking), and a dedicated validity section including human-judge agreement (κ=0.795, Section 3.4.1) and family-bias controls (Section 3.4.3). Evidence is detailed (per-task Tables 9-10, concrete counterexample cases in 3.3.2/3.4.2, cost data in Table 3) but weakened by single-run-per-configuration sampling with no variance estimates and a small task set (20 tasks; platform and toolchain classes have only 3 tasks each, so category-difficulty claims rest on thin counts, acknowledged in Section 1). Generalizability is moderate: conclusions are scoped to these 20 tasks and the verifier panel is explicitly non-stationary ('retire the two strongest and the remaining four would accept 46 submissions instead of 28', Section 3.4.3). Reproducibility is partial: a homepage and a meticulous task catalogue with versions, licences, budgets and a construction procedure (Appendix A-C) are given, but no explicit code/data release statement appears in the text, and both the Stage I judge and verifiers rely on proprietary models with inherently variable Stage III output.

primary_link.title: SWE Refactor Bench: Can Coding Agents Complete a Long-Horizon, Whole-Repository Stack Migration?

recommendations.summary: Modern software systems accumulate technical debt over decades of development, which makes migration expensive and largely manual. As coding agents become increasingly capable at bug fixing, can they autonomously perform such migrations? Existing benchmarks cannot answer this question because they evaluate only behavioural correctness, not whether the migration actually occurred. This leads an easy hack: agents copy the original implementation to make tests pass. We call this Blindness. To address this problem, we introduce SWE Refactor Bench, a benchmark comprising 20 whole-repository migrations, covering 4 kinds of technical debt. A three-stage evaluation protocol measures both migration completeness and behavioural correctness. (1) Migration Audit verifies that the migration occurred. (2) Behavioural Tests measure correctness with a fixed test suite. (3) Agentic Verification uses 6 independent coding agents to generate targeted tests for hidden behavioural differences. Across 520 runs from 8 frontier models and 26 model-effort configurations, only 28 of 520 runs (5.4%) pass all three stages, 13 of the 20 tasks receive no accepted solution, and the best model (claude-opus-5) scores 47.0/100. Migration completeness and behavioural correctness are distinct abilities: a few runs preserve behaviour by skipping the migration and are stopped at Migration Audit; most attempt it and break behaviour, and are stopped at Behavioural Tests. Agents cannot deliver a perfect migration: among the 340 runs that pass Migration Audit, 58% reach 99% of the fixed checks, yet only 26% reach 100%. Agent capability differs across migration categories: agents score 31.4 on build toolchain rewrites but only 5.6 on language rewrites. Together, these findings position SWE Refactor Bench as a rigorous testbed for developing coding agents for reliable whole-repository migrations.
recommendations.summary_zh: 本論文探討編碼代理(coding agents)能否自主完成整個儲存庫的行為保持式技術堆疊遷移。現有基準僅以固定測試衡量行為正確性,但遷移任務起點的測試本就全數通過,代理照抄原實作也能拿滿分,作者稱此漏洞為 Blindness。為此團隊建立 SWE Refactor Bench:20 個取自真實開源基礎設施的整庫遷移任務(如 SQLite、zlib、GraphHopper),涵蓋語言、框架、平台與建置工具鏈四類技術債,並採三階段評測:遷移稽核以三取二多數決驗證遷移是否真的發生並握有否決權;行為測試要求 130,118 項固定檢查全數通過;代理驗證則由六個獨立編碼代理各花一小時搜尋差異,僅接受可執行的反例。在 8 個前沿模型、26 種組態共 520 次執行中,僅 28 次(5.4%)通過全部三階段,20 個任務有 13 個無人解出,最佳的 claude-opus-5 得分 47.0/100。「完成遷移」與「保持行為」是兩種不同能力:30 次執行跳過遷移卻保住行為,252 次完成遷移卻破壞行為;通過稽核的 340 次中僅 26% 全數通過固定檢查,而通過前兩階段的 88 個提交又有 60 個被驗證代理找出反例。類別間能力亦有差異:建置工具鏈改寫得分 31.4,語言改寫僅 5.6。限制上,結論僅針對這 20 個任務,不代表所有遷移專案的內在難度排序;評審與驗證代理的強度也會影響分數,且隨模型進步,同一任務集將被更嚴格評分。此基準為發展可靠的整庫遷移代理提供嚴謹的測試場域,並點出行為測試無法證明遷移確實發生的根本盲點。

links.title: When Context Gets Root: Privilege Escalation in LLM Harnesses

evidence: Abstract: 'With unrestricted action execution, the attacks achieve all 13 objectives on all six harnesses. Under automatic permission review, the attacks achieve all 13 objectives on all three harnesses that provide this mode.'
§5.3 Escalation Definition: formalizes IPE(c)=1 for tool-to-user and tool-to-system escalation via context-construction operations R_delegate and R_install.
§8.2 Table 5: tool-level baselines MCPTox/CoT Forgery/ChatInject reach at most 7/13 (Gemini CLI) and 0/13 on Claude Code and Codex, including under Auto PR.
§8.3 Table 7: success after escalation is 86.7%-100.0% across harnesses and permission regimes; overall attack success rates 31.7%-100%.
§8.4 Table 10: hidden-script variant achieves 65.0%-100% (full access) and 61.9%-76.5% (Auto PR); §8.4 text states 70.0% for Codex Auto PR vs 72.2% in Table 10, a minor inconsistency.
§8.5 Table 12: persistent-goal and scheduled-task paths achieve 13/13 objectives, supporting generality beyond delegation.
No code, dataset, or artifact availability statement appears anywhere in the document; reproducibility rests only on harness versions (Table 4) and included prompt snippets (§7.1).
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-agent security paper: attacks on six coding-agent harnesses (Codex, Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Qwen Code, Kimi, OpenCode) directly match high-weight preferences (Agents & Tool Use 2.5, AI Safety 2.0, Red Teaming & Evaluation 1.8). Novelty is real: 'instruction privilege escalation' differs from prompt injection/role confusion because the harness itself relabels tool-level content as user/system-effective during context reconstruction, formalized in §5.3 with IPE(c)=1 and a clear threat model in §6. Rigor is good but not maximal: 13 objectives, two permission regimes, three baseline attacks (§8.2 Table 5 shows near-zero baseline success, isolating the escalation effect), plus generality tests via goals/scheduled tasks (§8.5); however attempts are capped at 10, sample sizes per cell are modest (13-21, Table 10), the workload is a single TODO-app scenario, there is a minor text/table inconsistency (Codex Auto PR 70.0% in §8.4 text vs 72.2% in Table 10), and no defense or mitigation analysis is offered. Evidence strength is strong internally (abstract's 97.3%/80.3% means reconcile with Tables 7 and 10), but no code, artifact release, or independent verification is stated. Generalizability is demonstrated across mechanisms and harnesses yet confined to coding-agent/repo settings. Reproducibility is limited by proprietary harnesses/models and absence of an artifact-availability claim.

recommendations.summary_zh: 本論文探討 LLM 代理框架的指令安全問題：框架每次呼叫模型時會重建上下文，此過程可能將原本屬於 tool 層級的外部內容，重新標記為 user 或 system-effective 等較高指令層級。作者據此提出新攻擊典範「指令特權提升」（instruction privilege escalation），並以統一指令階層 tool < user < system-effective 進行形式化。與提示注入或角色混淆攻擊不同，此攻擊不靠偽造角色標記欺騙模型，而是利用多代理委派、自訂子代理安裝、持續性目標與排程任務等框架機制，由框架本身把攻擊者控制的內容提升至更高層級，使工作代理與自動權限審查（Auto PR）都將其視為可信的使用者或系統指令。評估涵蓋 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini CLI、Qwen Code、Kimi 與 OpenCode 六種編碼代理框架，以及橫跨機密性、完整性、可用性與遠端程式碼執行的 13 項攻擊目標：在完全存取模式下六個框架全部達成；支援 Auto PR 的三個框架上亦全數繞過審查成功，其中 tool-to-user 提升後平均成功率為 97.3%，tool-to-system 為 80.3%；相形之下，MCPTox、CoT Forgery、ChatInject 等工具層基線攻擊幾乎全數失敗，凸顯層級提升才是關鍵。研究限制包括僅針對編碼代理情境、惡意程式以明文提供而未混淆以隔離變因、部分提升路徑須在完全存取模式下驗證，且 Claude Code 需採間接誘導策略。此研究證明指令階層與權限審查共同依賴的「角色標記忠實反映內容出處」假設並不成立，對代理系統的防禦設計提出重要警示。

links.title: The Handoff Tax: Continuing Non-Native Trajectories in LLM Agents

evidence: Sec. 3.4 'Experimental scale': 58 configurations per family over 500 SWE-bench Verified instances yielding 58,000 agent runs, 2M LLM API calls, and 36B tokens processed.

Tab. 1 (Sec. 4): Raw escalation recovers QRec=47% (Claude) and 36% (GPT) of the LC-HC quality gap; Traj-drop raises QRec to 64% and 84%; Raw downshift retains 80%/14% cost savings at 50%/79% quality recovery.

Appendix A.3 Tab. 8: task-clustered bootstrap 95% CIs (10,000 resamples) show the central reversal excludes zero in both families — escalation Traj-drop−Raw +3.1 [+1.3,+5.0] Claude, +12.2 [+9.2,+15.4] GPT; downshift −4.7 [−7.3,−2.1] and −5.6 [−8.6,−2.6].

Appendix A.1 'Accounting' and 'Pricing and audit': cost reconstruction from provider usage with cache-aware price cards, exact reconciliation audits, and verbatim handoff prompts; switch steps given in Tab. 11.

Limitations section: single episode per task per configuration, interface findings established primarily in the coding setting, hard-stratum cells N̄≈24–27 treated as exploratory, and dollar-cost conclusions dependent on provider pricing and cache rates.
Sec. 5 Tabs. 2–3: extensions show information dynamics modulate the tax — LiC escalation QRec=86%, BrowseComp GPT escalation QRec=95.8% but CSRet=−30.0%, worse than abort+restart (−8.5%).
llm_evaluation.rationale: A large-scale empirical study of mid-trajectory model handoffs in LLM coding agents, directly matching high-weight preferences (LLMs, agents & tool use, code). Novel contribution: systematic characterization of the 'handoff tax' across direction (escalation/downshift), timing, and interface (raw/compact/traj-drop), with a cross-family directional duality finding. Rigor is strong: matched switched subsets, difficulty-calibrated switch percentiles, restart controls, a disclosure ablation, and task-clustered bootstrap CIs for the central reversal. Evidence is quantitatively supported at scale (58,000 runs, 36B tokens), though single-episode-per-task runs, descriptive (non-inferential) cost mechanics, and a small hard-task stratum (N̄≈24–27, self-flagged as exploratory) temper confidence. Generalizability is limited by two model families, one primary benchmark for interface findings (LiC/BrowseComp use Raw only), fixed switch points, and pricing-dependent cost conclusions. Reproducibility benefits from verbatim prompts, calibration tables (Tab. 11), and audit accounting, but rests on commercial models, a pinned local price card, and only a vague artifact-availability claim rather than an explicit public release.

primary_link.title: The Handoff Tax: Continuing Non-Native Trajectories in LLM Agents

recommendations.summary: Coding agents perform long-running tasks spanning dozens of model calls, tool uses, and code edits. As these runs unfold, users face a practical cost-quality trade-off: escalating to a stronger model when a cheaper one struggles, or downshifting once the hard reasoning is complete. Each switch requires the receiver to continue a non-native trajectory produced by another model. We study how this handoff affects quality and cost, and how varying the trajectory information inherited by the receiver changes the outcome. Using pairs of low-cost, low-capability (LC) and high-cost, high-capability (HC) models from the Claude and GPT families, we vary handoff direction, timing, and interface, comparing full-trajectory transfer, compaction, and trajectory removal while preserving the repository state. Across both model families, full-trajectory escalation recovers less than half of the LC-to-HC quality gap while incurring a substantial cost premium. We term this cost-quality penalty the handoff tax. By contrast, downshift offers a favorable cost-quality point. Interestingly, the preferred interface also reverses with direction: reducing LC-model trajectory information improves escalation quality, whereas removing the HC-model trajectory reduces downshift quality.
recommendations.summary_zh: 這篇論文探討長時程編程代理（coding agent）任務中，中途更換模型所付出的「handoff tax」（交接稅）。使用者在便宜模型（LC）卡關時升級到強大模型（HC），或完成艱難推理後降級省錢，但接手模型必須延續另一個模型產生的非原生軌跡。作者在 SWE-bench Verified 上，以 Claude（Haiku 4.5/Opus 4.7）與 GPT-5.6（Luna/Sol）兩組配對，變換切換方向、時機與介面：Raw（完整軌跡）、Compact（摘要壓縮）與 Traj-drop（移除軌跡但保留程式碼編輯），合計每族 58 種設定、58,000 次代理執行與 360 億個 token。核心結果：Raw 升級僅收回不到一半的品質差距且成本高昂，Claude 案例中甚至比重跑 HC 更貴更差；降級則提供有利的成本與品質中間點。軌跡資訊的價值具有方向性：減少 LC 軌跡可提升升級品質（Traj-drop 品質最佳、Compact_pre 最省），移除 HC 軌跡則損害降級品質。機制上，Raw 升級使 HC 每步更貴；Traj-drop 降級使 LC 多走 1.6 至 2 倍步驟以重建遺失脈絡。LiC 與 BrowseComp 延伸實驗顯示資訊動態會翻轉結論，遲到的需求有利於升級。限制：僅兩組模型、單一基準、固定切換點、每任務單次執行，且困難子集樣本小。本研究指出模型交接應視為獨立的推論問題，交接介面需與模型選擇及切換時機共同最佳化，對代理系統的路由與成本管理極具實務意義。

links.title: Large language models simulate intersectional synthetic identities with a budget of one to two dimensions

evidence: Results, 'Two features: collapse, not combination': best single feature beats additive combination in 78.4% of pair cells for GPT-4o-mini (95% CI [77.8, 79.0], wave-cluster bootstrap), 75.3-81.2% across eight models including frontier GPT-5.5 (79.1%) and Claude Sonnet 5 (77.8%) on a two-wave subset (Table 1).

Methods, 'Noise floor and noise corrections': empirical split-half TV floors of 0.079/0.120/0.147 at depths 1/2/3, closed-form multinomial expectation certified within 0-4% down to n=20, and exact squared-distance decomposition for the 2.5x distinctiveness growth claim.

Methods, 'Human additivity contest and contest calibration': calibration endpoints measured rather than assumed (additive-truth 40.3%, collapse-truth 84.3%; depth-3 endpoints 67.2%/6.6%), with self-calibrated indices 0.83-0.95 and a noise-scaling sweep (0.5x unchanged at 0.86; 2x softens to 0.74).

Methods, 'Base-versus-tuned contrast': race deficit -10.8 points and religion -5.3 points present in Llama-3.1-8B base weights, with tuning shifts of +0.6 and -0.6 against minimum detectable effects of 5.9 and 2.7 points; Mistral-7B replicates.

Methods, 'Data/Code availability': all 21.1M simulated records and artifacts on Zenodo (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21267988) with regeneration script run_all_figures.sh on GitHub; snapshots pinned for flagship models, with GPT-4o and Claude Sonnet 5 queried via unversioned aliases flagged as reproducibility caveats that carry no load-bearing result.

Discussion: claims explicitly scoped to 'demographic-feature conditioning and the US English-language ATP context (2017-2021)' with portability elsewhere untested, tempering generalizability despite the eight-model, two-generation replication.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A methodological audit of LLM synthetic survey respondents demonstrating that demographic personas collapse to a one-to-two feature 'identity budget'. Directly in scope: the objects of study are eight LLMs, and the work engages persona prompting, chain-of-thought controls, bias/fairness, and evaluation methodology rather than being a pure domain application. Novelty is high: the compositional question at distribution level against real intersectional ground truth, the near-additivity-plus-growing-distinctiveness characterization, and the measured calibration-endpoint machinery appear genuinely new relative to the cited audits. Rigor is exceptional: human sampling-noise floors, null calibration (random-dimension cosine 0.84), per-model self-calibrated collapse indices, cluster/wild bootstrap, permutation nulls, minimum detectable effects for null contrasts, feature-order and framing controls, three elicitation paradigms, base-vs-tuned decomposition, and a memorization-confound analysis. Evidence is strong with CIs and cross-model replication (75.3-81.2% best-single win rates, Index_self 0.83-0.95), bounded by reliance on measured-noise endpoint modeling (sensitivity-swept) and two-wave coverage for frontier models. Generalizability is explicitly scoped to US English ATP closed-form items 2017-2021. Reproducibility is high: 21.1M records on Zenodo, code with seeds and run_all_figures.sh, pinned snapshots for load-bearing models with two unpinned aliases honestly flagged as non-load-bearing.

primary_link.title: Large language models simulate intersectional synthetic identities with a budget of one to two dimensions

recommendations.summary: Large language models are increasingly used as synthetic survey respondents, promising cheap access to rare intersectional populations. We test standard demographic-persona methods against every real intersectional subgroup across 15 waves of Pew's American Trends Panel -- 21 million simulated response distributions from eight models. In real respondents, subgroup opinion is approximately the additive sum of its single-identity components, yet grows 2.5x more distinctive as identities intersect.
recommendations.summary_zh: 本研究檢視大型語言模型（LLM）作為合成問卷受訪者時，能否真正整合多重人口身分。作者以Pew美國趨勢小組（ATP）15波調查的微資料建立真實交叉次群體基準，讓八個模型（GPT-4o-mini、GPT-5.5、Claude Sonnet 5與開放權重模型等）以一到三個特徵的身分設定模擬回答分布，共約2,100萬筆，並以「組成競賽」檢驗：用餘弦相似度判定模型的誤差向量較貼近兩單一特徵偏誤之和（加法）或單一特徵偏誤（塌縮），搭配以模型自身重複執行雜訊建立的校準端點、人類抽樣雜訊下限與分割樣本複製。結果顯示，真實次群體的方向近似加法，且隨身分交織更趨鮮明（平方距離增至2.5倍）；模型卻在75–82%的雙特徵細格中由最佳單一特徵勝出，塌縮指標達0.83–0.95，第三特徵幾乎無貢獻；保留哪個維度近乎盲目，並系統性捨棄真實意見最強驅動因素種族與宗教，族裔與宗教少數身分最易被丟棄；個別取樣、log-probability讀出與各種提示策略皆無法緩解。限制在於僅涵蓋美國英語封閉式題項（2017–2021）、未預先註冊、僅為行為層次描述而未探究表徵機制，且基礎與微調對比僅限開放權重模型。對欲以矽取樣（silicon sampling）廉價補足稀少交叉人口的應用而言，這是明確警示：準確度缺口主要來自單一特徵校準失準，塌縮則是結構性缺陷；作者建議以雜訊下限、零假校準及多層次回歸事後分層（MRP）為基準，並以實測群體差異進行校準。

links.title: EVOMAL: Self-Poisoning in Self-Evolving Coding Agents

evidence: Abstract/§6.3: 'Across six models on 153 tool-relevant SWE-bench Verified tasks, ASPR ranges from 20.3% to 41.8%' with libraries containing '4.9 to 9.0 times as many malicious skills as were initially planted'.
Table 2: banner ablation on DS-V4 shows full three-layer banner at 41.8% ASPR vs 11.1% no-banner control; layer removals cost 13.0/19.6/30.7 pp.

§6.5/Figure 4b: under the removed condition Qwen3 reaches 68% ASPR at round 5, demonstrating persistence after seed withdrawal; replacement-rate sweep shows critical transition (r=0.25 decay, r=0.75 reaches 60.1% and rising).

Table 5: existing detectors evaluated — Bandit catch falls from 85% to 7% after one-line egress swap, injection classifier has 47% benign FP, name blocklist catches 0 of 275 authored infections; Theorem 1 formalizes submission-side defense limits.

§9.2/Figure 8: counter-prompt reduces headline ASPR to ≤1.8% (worst residual 6.7% on Devstral's 15-task pytest family) with zero callbacks and no statistically significant task-completion drop; Table 7 shows robustness to token renaming and adaptive banners (≤1.3%).

Appendix D.5/Table 11: honest model-fit failure — reproduction-number proxy overshoots observed growth ~10x and misorders DS-V4 and Devstral; post-hoc analysis attributes collapse to in-cascade descendant retrieval (0/765 opportunities for DS-V4 and MiniMax).

Table 12 (Appendix E.1): locked headline configuration (8 planted skills, 232-skill benign pool, top-k=5 BGE-M3/ChromaDB, N=153, 15-step limit) enabling exact reproduction; Appendix E.5 reports pooled two-proportion z-tests with RQ1 lift p<0.001 for all six models.

Open Science section: commits six artifact sets (planted-skill generators, agent integration, sandbox wrapper, defenses, evaluation framework, per-task JSONs) with Zenodo DOI; Ethical Considerations describes env-i sandbox with fake FAKE_* credentials and 127.0.0.1-bound C2.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Near-perfect topical fit for this preference profile: LLM coding agents, agent/tool security, red-teaming and defense evaluation, with retrieval-based skill selection and a prompt-based defense. The core contribution — identifying the unguarded authoring-and-storing ('create-path') by which self-evolving agents re-author planted payloads into their own skill libraries, plus a self-propagating worm demonstration and a counter-prompt/signed-quarantine defense set — is a genuine increment over prior reuse-path poisoning work, though adjacent to concurrent work (SkillJack, OEP) and the banner mechanism is simple. Rigor is high: formal threat model and objective, locked configuration with one-factor ablations, Wilson CIs and two-proportion z-tests (E.5), banner-layer and payload ablations, adaptive-attack robustness tests, and unusually honest reporting of model-fit failures (the branching proxy overshoots ~10x and misorders DS-V4/Devstral, D.5) and small-N family cells. Evidence is instrumented (sandboxed C2 callback logging, per-task logs) and internally consistent across decomposition tables, but all results are synthetic sandbox experiments rather than real deployments, and ASPR is measured by matching the authors' own banner signature. Generalizability is strong within scope (6 models, 2 benchmarks, 3 scaffolds, 3 tool languages, 5 payload classes), though confined to Voyager-style executable-skill loops. Reproducibility support is detailed (locked config, full setup appendix, committed artifact release with per-task JSONs), pending actual availability. Score reflects elite preference alignment with strong but not flawless empirical and external-validity grounding.

primary_link.title: EVOMAL: Self-Poisoning in Self-Evolving Coding Agents

We call this self-poisoning: the agent authors, stores, and runs the resulting malicious skill. We exploit it through EvoMal, an attack that amplifies self-poisoning by wrapping an interchangeable payload in a banner, a set of beni
recommendations.summary_zh: 此論文揭露自我演化 LLM 編碼代理的新型安全弱點:這類代理會把自寫工具存為「技能」,並從共享技能庫擷取相似技能當範本模仿改寫。攻擊者只需在庫中植入外觀正常的惡意技能,無須被代理呼叫;即使不含誘導橫幅,DeepSeek-V4-Pro 仍有 11.1% 的自我污染率,顯示弱點源自模仿式創作本身。EvoMal 以三層「橫幅」結構(逐字複製註解、裝飾器、匯入時註冊)包覆可替換的惡意酬載,誘使代理在改寫新技能時複製酬載並存回庫中,即「自我污染」;新副本再被後續任務擷取與再創作,形成自我傳播的蠕蟲。在 153 個 SWE-bench Verified 工具相關任務上,六種模型的代理自我污染率(ASPR)為 20.3% 至 41.8%,庫中惡意技能增至初始植入的 4.9 至 9.0 倍;僅改寫技能描述鎖定任務族群可將 ASPR 推升至 86.7%。移除植入技能後,Qwen3 第五輪仍達 68%,感染可自我維持。名稱封鎖、程式碼掃描與注入分類器皆難偵測代理自創的惡意技能;作者提出 counter-prompt 防禦,將 ASPR 壓至主要情境 ≤1.8%(個別情況 6.7%)且任務完成率無統計顯著下降,另建議簽章隔離閘門阻斷再擷取,並以分支過程 ρ=c·q·φ 說明傳播需兼具複製意願與技能可及性。限制:counter-prompt 屬軟性、依模型而異的緩解,分支模型預測與實測級聯仍有落差。此研究將安全邊界由攻擊者提交物轉向代理自創技能,對自演化代理的技能庫治理與供應鏈安全極具警示價值。
recommendations.title: EVOMAL: Self-Poisoning in Self-Evolving Coding Agents
recommendations.title_zh: EvoMal:自我演化編碼代理中的自我污染攻擊

links.title: MemToC: Benchmarking Memory-Tool Conflict Resolution in Large Language Models

evidence: §1/§3.3: controlled post-tool-call setting with injected returns of known correctness enables four source-correctness cases plus tool-error and no-tool controls
§3.2: 3,912 sub-questions filtered to 605, then 575 with verified answers, blinded two-annotator QC yields 542 final questions; 542×4×3 = 6,504 episodes
§5.1 (Table 1): instruction-tuned baselines retain verified answers in only 6.5–17.1% of eligible cases vs 86.0–93.1% correct-tool following; incorrect-tool following 78.4–86.0%

§5.2: SFT and DPO meet the asymmetric criterion on the same two of four backbones (Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, gemma-2-9b-it); Mistral SFT gains retention +41.8 but loses correct-tool following −27.6 and abstention −57.7
§5.4: prompting raises retention in 11/12 pooled combinations but every strategy reduces tool-error abstention for every model; abstain-and-flag cuts Llama correct-tool following 88%→24%
§5.4/App. G: tool-choice protocol is a model×protocol interaction; Llama drops 0.992→0.328 under free auto choice, repaired by schema-constrained decoding to 0.992, replicated at T=0.7
App. F.1: OOD transfer to FaithEval/ARC is positive but frame-dependent; abstention leak confirmed on all three transferred arms; disclosed matcher repair flipped one preregistered retention gate
§6: limitations—no proprietary models, single ToolHop core, 426/575 machine-authored distractors from one generator, annotators are authors, forced elicitation makes retention upper bounds
§8: benchmark, code, scoring layer, and per-claim map released Apache-2.0 with a verification script recomputing 180 reported values; two unrecomputable families are named rather than omitted
llm_evaluation.rationale: squarely in-scope LLM work: tool-augmented LLM arbitration between parametric memory and tool returns, evaluated on Llama/Qwen/Gemma/Mistral, mitigated with DPO/SFT and prompting. The controlled design—injecting tool returns of known correctness so arbitration (not mere source preference) is measurable (§1, §3.3)—is a genuine methodological advance over prior conflict benchmarks; the asymmetric success criterion and cross-fitted chain-level splits are thoughtful. Rigor is exceptional: preregistered protocol, Holm-corrected permutation tests with cluster bootstrap (§4.5, App. B), blinded scorer validation (κ=0.806, §4.2) and target validation (κ=0.785, §3.4), disclosed post-hoc matcher repair that flipped one gate (App. F.1), and honest negative results (prompting trade-offs §5.4, 19/20 arms reduce abstention; SAE steering asymmetry App. C). Evidence is strong with CIs, replication at T=0.7, and version provenance, though transfer rests on small verified pools (279/185 episodes) and two of four backbones lack seed replication. Generalizability is limited: only open-weight 7–9B models plus one confounded 70B probe (App. F.2), a single ToolHop-derived core with one distractor realization skewed to biographical domains, and annotators who are also authors (§6). Reproducibility is excellent: Apache-2.0 release with a verification script recomputing 180 values and a per-claim file map (§8), though fine-tuned absolute levels need unreleased training runs. Score reflects top-tier methodological care with moderate external validity.

primary_link.title: MemToC: Benchmarking Memory-Tool Conflict Resolution in Large Language Models

recommendations.summary: Tool-augmented LLMs must arbitrate between two fallible sources when a tool return conflicts with their parametric memory, yet existing evaluations measure source preference without establishing source correctness. We introduce MemToC, a controlled benchmark for post-tool-return arbitration with executable tools. MemToC comprises 6,504 evaluation episodes constructed from 542 quality-controlled factual questions, independently elicited model-specific closed-book answers, and controlled tool retu
recommendations.summary_zh: 工具增強的大型語言模型在工具回傳結果與其參數記憶矛盾時，必須在兩個都可能出錯的來源間仲裁，但既有評測往往只量測來源偏好，未事先確認來源正確性。本文提出 MemToC：自 ToolHop 資料集建構 542 道經品質控管的事實性問題，為每個模型獨立引出閉卷回答，再提供正確性已知的受控工具回傳，形成 6,504 個評測情境，依來源正確性劃分四種案例並設對照組，使仲裁行為而非單純偏好得以量測。在五個開放權重 7–9B 模型上，工具回傳強烈壓倒模型自身答案：四個指令微調模型在記憶正確而工具錯誤時，僅 6.5–17.1% 保留正確答案；工具正確時有 86.0–93.1% 跟隨；兩來源皆錯時仍有 78.4–86.0% 重複錯誤回傳，且排序在三種提示措辭間不穩定。作者以鏈層級交叉切分避免訓練與評測洩漏，比較提示策略與 SFT、DPO 微調，並採非對稱成功準則：正確答案保留率須提升，且正確工具跟隨率不得顯著下降。SFT 與 DPO 僅在相同兩個骨幹（Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct、gemma-2-9b-it）達標，顯示結果取決於骨幹多於最佳化目標；20 個方法—模型組合中有 19 個降低工具錯誤後的棄答率，增益常伴隨對工具的普遍不信任，外部遷移亦不完整且依模型而異。限制包括僅涵蓋 ToolHop 與開放權重模型、干擾答案建構單一、部分模型未做多種子驗證、強制引出使保留率成為上限，人工標記者亦為作者。本文將工具—記憶衝突重新框架為正確性條件化仲裁，凸顯評測須同時檢視正確工具使用、棄答與對措辭的穩健性。
recommendations.title: MemToC: Benchmarking Memory-Tool Conflict Resolution in Large Language Models
recommendations.title_zh: MemToC：評測大型語言模型的記憶—工具衝突解決能力

links.title: AgentSpec: Speculative Decoding for Batch Inference of LLM Agents

evidence: Abstract: proposes AgentSpec with structure-isolated drafting and redundancy-aware budget allocation; claims at most 2.02x speedup over autoregressive decoding for agent batch inference.
Section 3.2 / Table 1: measured average per-request rejection rates of 53.3% (EAGLE-3), 88.7% (NGram), 65.9% (SuffixDecoding) vs 26.4% for AgentSpec on the Reflexion code-generation workflow.
Section 3.2 / Figure 2: FFN latency of Qwen-3-8B grows linearly beyond batch size 256 on A100, motivating the token budget M(b)=AI-b definition.

Section 5.2 / Table 2: goodput results across Qwen-3-8B, GPT-OSS-20B, DeepSeek-Distill-8B on GAIA, SWE-Bench, Deep Research, Code Generation; AgentSpec achieves up to 104% relative gain and 2.02x speedup while several baselines fall below 1.0x.
Section 5.5 / Table 3: on MiMo-7B, MTP reaches only 0.73x speedup on Code Gen (All) while AgentSpec reaches 1.29x.
Section 5.6 / Table 5: execution breakdown shows AgentSpec verification cost 26.11 min (down 21%) and overall 27.85 min (down 19%) vs baselines.

Section 5.7 / Table 6: ablations AgentSpec(S), AgentSpec(R), AgentSpec(N) show structure-isolated drafting contributes more than redundancy-aware budget allocation, and the no-structure variant still outperforms baselines.
Section 5.4 / Table 4: on non-agentic Spec-Bench (Qwen-3-8B), AgentSpec achieves 1.14x overall speedup, smaller than agentic gains.

Section A.1: vLLM v0.12.0 V1 engine, A100 80G, FlashAttention-2, max batch 256, baselines run with official default configs, results averaged over five seeds; API extension with structure/query_id/agent_id fields documented.
Section A.3 / Table 7: H100 speedups (e.g., 2.28x CodeGen) exceed A100, supporting hardware generalization.
Limitation: acknowledges required lightweight interface between agent and serving system and dependence on explicit semantic blocks and repeated generation patterns.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly on-profile: an inference-efficiency method for LLM agents, evaluated on agent benchmarks (SWE-Bench, GAIA, USACO code generation, DeepResearch) in vLLM, matching Agents & Tool Use, LLM, Inference & Serving, and Code & Programming. Novelty is solid but incremental over SuffixDecoding/NGram-style draft-model-free speculation: structure-isolated drafting via a PDA over semantic blocks (Section 4.1) and redundancy-aware budget allocation (Section 4.2, Eq. 1-3) are concrete mechanisms, though budget-allocation ideas exist (AdaSpec, TETRIS). Rigor is good: bottleneck analysis with a cost model and FFN latency measurement (Section 3.2, Figure 2), four models from four families, four agentic workloads plus Spec-Bench, MTP comparison (Table 3), ablations isolating each component (Table 6), batch-size and thinking-mode sweeps (Figure 9), and H100 cross-check (Table 7). Weaknesses: losslessness is asserted in the abstract but no explicit output-equivalence verification is reported; baseline configs use defaults (Section A.1) which may favor the proposed method; no variance/CI despite five-run averaging; rejection-rate analysis concentrates on one Reflexion workload (Table 1). Evidence strength is high for throughput claims (Table 2: up to 104% gain, 2.02x speedup; Table 5: verification -21%), with the caveat above. Generalizability is supported across models, GPUs, and a non-agentic benchmark (1.14x, Table 4), though the method expects semantic-structure metadata from the agent, acknowledged in Limitations. Reproducibility is moderate: engine version, GPU, baseline hyperparameters, API extension example, and pseudocode are given (Section A.1, A.2), but no code-release claim and key hyperparameters (alpha, g_min) values are unspecified.

primary_link.title: AgentSpec: Speculative Decoding for Batch Inference of LLM Agents

recommendations.summary: Large language model (LLM)-based agent applications often incur high response time. Speculative decoding is a promising solution to improve the inference efficiency of LLM agents without impacting generation quality. However, state-of-the-art speculative decoding algorithms exhibit substantial speed degradation under large batch sizes, limiting their effectiveness to deploy in real-world agent applications. In this work, we first present a systematic analysis of speculative decoding for LLM agen
recommendations.summary_zh: 以大型語言模型（LLM）為基礎的代理應用常因多步推理與工具呼叫而推論成本高昂。推測解碼雖可無損加速生成，但在現代推論引擎普遍採用的大批次設定下，現有方法的加速效果會大幅衰退，甚至比自迴歸解碼更慢。作者分析後歸納兩大瓶頸：推測 token 的高拒絕率，以及動態 token 預算的低利用率。據此提出 AgentSpec，一套免草稿模型的推測解碼演算法：其一為結構隔離起草，要求代理提供語意結構識別資訊，透過輕量下推自動機追蹤語意區塊，僅從語意一致的歷史片段擷取草稿，將拒絕率降至約 26%，遠低於 EAGLE-3 的 53% 與 NGram 的 89%；其二為冗餘感知預算分配，以冗餘分數預測各請求的接受可能性，動態分配推測預算以貼近硬體可用上限。團隊在 vLLM 上實作，於 Qwen-3-8B、GPT-OSS-20B、DeepSeek 蒸餾模型與 MiMo-7B，以及程式碼生成、深度研究、SWE-Bench、GAIA 等代理式工作負載評估，最高達 2.02 倍加速，goodput 較最佳基線提升最多 104%，於 Spec-Bench 與對比 MiMo-7B 的 MTP 亦領先。消融實驗顯示兩個元件各有貢獻，其中結構隔離起草影響較大。限制在於需在代理與伺服器間加入輕量介面，且加速程度部分取決於工作負載中重複生成樣式的多寡；即使缺少明確語意結構，仍有穩定加速。此研究讓推測解碼在大批次代理服務場景重新變得實用，有助降低 LLM 代理的部署成本與延遲。
recommendations.title: AgentSpec: Speculative Decoding for Batch Inference of LLM Agents
recommendations.title_zh: AgentSpec：針對 LLM 代理批次推論的推測解碼演算法

links.title: AgentJudgeBench: A Multi-Difficulty Benchmark for Evaluating LLM Judges on Agentic Tool-Calling

evidence: Abstract: 3,808 instances, six DAG topologies, three difficulty tiers; hard without-GT alignment converges to a 77-82% band across all six judges, with GT exposure reducing alignment for GPT-5.4 (-1.5 pp) and Gemini-2.5-Pro (-3.9 pp).
Sec 3.2 / Table 2: full factorial alignment results across five generators, six judges, three difficulties, both GT conditions; QwQ-32B leads with-GT in 10 of 15 cells while never leading without-GT.
Appendix E (Table 10): 95% bootstrap CIs (n=2,000 stratified resamples) with half-widths <=0.3 pp for every cell, supporting robustness of monotone difficulty effects.

Appendix G (Tables 12-13): 120-record human study validates the programmatic scorer at 92.7% overall (82.5% on parameter structure); GPT-OSS-120B is most human-aligned judge (Delta=-2.8 pp) and QwQ-32B drops 1st to 4th under human verdicts.
Appendix N (Table 20): rewrite validation unanimity is 93.9% for hard-vs-medium but only 58.1% for medium-vs-easy, with the paper explicitly downgrading the medium tier to a robustness check.

Sec 4.2 RQ5 (Table 5/26): CoT thinking on/off changes alignment by at most 0.3 pp across 24 paired cells; RQ6 (Table 31): structured prompt advantage of +4.8 to +6.5 pp on one pairing only partially replicates and reverses on hard queries (+3.9/+2.4/-0.8 pp).
Appendix J (Table 1): C3 corrupted-GT control shows Gemini-2.5-Pro anchors to any reference block while QwQ-32B tracks its without-GT score within 0.2 pp.
Appendix O (Table 23): GPT-5.4 self-preference check finds aggregate bias +0.012 within cross-generator range but a localized sequence-accuracy over-credit of +0.172 vs <=+0.008 elsewhere.

Limitations / Appendix B: single-annotator validation, synthetic records with domain-drift risk, non-reproducible GPT-5.4 snapshot, and evaluation-time-only scope are all explicitly acknowledged and partially bounded (ranking shifts <=0.09 pp under generous correction).

Supplementary Material: dataset and all judge verdicts on HuggingFace (ServiceNow-AI/AgentJudgeBench) and pipeline code with reproducibility script via SyGra GitHub; verbatim prompts in Appendix W; GPT-5.4 identifier is a non-versioned Azure snapshot (Appendix M/P).
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly in-scope: a systematic reliability study of LLM-as-judge for agentic tool-calling, directly hitting top-weighted preferences (Agents & Tool Use, LLMs, evaluation/benchmarking, CoT ablation, prompt-format sensitivity). Novelty is solid though incremental in parts: individual ingredients (BFCL-style data, DAG benchmarks, judge models) exist, but the paired with/without-GT protocol with difficulty stratification, per-metric decomposition, and deterministic programmatic reference is a genuinely new combination (Appendix L comparison). Rigor is strong: full 5x6x3x2 factorial (321,648 evaluations, Appendix D), bootstrap CIs <=0.3 pp (Appendix E), corrupted-GT C3 control (Appendix J), 0.5-default C2 ablation (Table 4), CoT and temperature ablations each replicated on a second pairing (Appendix R), scorer human validation (Appendix G), self-preference check (Appendix O), and unusually honest limitations (single annotator, 58.1% medium-tier validation, non-reproducible GPT-5.4 snapshot). Evidence strength is high; key claims are backed by tables with CIs and bounded corrections (Table 15). Generalizability is the weakest axis: synthetic single-shot records, domain drift acknowledged, ceiling partly prompt-dependent for weak generators, and judge rankings are model-version-specific. Reproducibility is good (code, HF dataset, verbatim prompts in Appendix W) but marred by the non-reproducible GPT-5.4 Azure snapshot used as generator, judge, and meta-judge.

primary_link.title: AgentJudgeBench: A Multi-Difficulty Benchmark for Evaluating LLM Judges on Agentic Tool-Calling

recommendations.summary: LLM judges are widely used to evaluate agentic tool-calling systems, yet their reliability on structured, dependency-driven workflows remains largely unexamined. We present AgentJudgeBench, the first benchmark to systematically study LLM-as-a-judge reliability for agentic tool-calling over workflow DAGs, as distinct from the broader LLM-as-a-judge task of open-ended text or preference evaluation. The benchmark comprises 3,808 instances spanning six DAG topologies and three difficulty tiers, eval
recommendations.summary_zh: LLM 裁判已廣泛用於評估代理式工具呼叫系統，但在結構化、依賴驅動工作流程上的可靠性長期未被檢驗。本文提出 AgentJudgeBench，首個針對工作流程 DAG 上 LLM-as-a-judge 可靠性的系統性基準：包含 3,808 筆 BFCL 風格資料，橫跨六種 DAG 拓撲與三個難度層級，每筆均附經程式化驗證的 ground-truth 軌跡。五個生成器（3B–70B 開源模型與 GPT-5.4）產出工具呼叫預測，由六個裁判（20B 至前沿規模）在有／無 ground truth 的配對條件下，就工具選擇、參數結構、序列準確性與查詢覆蓋四項指標評分，合計 321,648 次評估。主要結果：裁判對齊度隨難度單調下降，無 ground truth 時降幅約 1.5 倍；高難度且無參考答案時，六個裁判不論規模皆收斂於 77–82% 窄幅區間，顯示模型容量無法克服的結構性天花板；提供 ground truth 未必有利，GPT-5.4 與 Gemini-2.5-Pro 對齊度反而下降，符合過度錨定；思維鏈推理與取樣溫度影響可忽略，結構化評分準則最多提升 6.5 個百分點但未必通用。有 ground truth 時 QwQ-32B 最貼近程式化參考，GPT-OSS-120B 最貼近人類判斷。限制包括資料為合成生成、程式化評分器在參數結構指標上與人類一致度僅 82.5%，medium 難度未完全校準，且 GPT-5.4 身兼生成器、裁判與改寫驗證的 meta-judge。本研究揭露 LLM 裁判的根本限制，為代理系統評估提供部署指引，警示不宜單一依賴任何裁判。
recommendations.title: AgentJudgeBench: A Multi-Difficulty Benchmark for Evaluating LLM Judges on Agentic Tool-Calling
recommendations.title_zh: AgentJudgeBench：以多難度基準評估 LLM 裁判於代理式工具呼叫的可靠性

links.title: Semantic Overlays: Mitigating Prompt Injection with Annotations Beyond Tokens and Steering Vectors

evidence: Abstract: SEP separation rises from 24.3% to 96.5% with utility unchanged, TensorTrust ASR falls 34.8% to 6.6%, all four PIArena families drop to 0% compliance, marked spans stay readable at 92.5% exact copy rate.
§7 Training: adapter is 50M parameters, base model untouched; training items share SEP's shape so SEP measures in-distribution generalization while TensorTrust and PIArena are zero-shot transfer.

Table 1 (§4): embedding-conditioned shared MLP reaches 99.5% exact span retrieval and 100% refusal-when-absent vs 63.3%/89.7% for a 604M per-overlay MLP, attributed to supervision sharing and state-conditioned writes.

Appendix I, Table I.1: replication on frozen Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct moves SEP 31.0%→96.2%, TensorTrust hijacking 68.9%→4.4%, all PIArena families to 0%, with hyperparameters unchanged and corpus re-derived per Appendix D.

Appendix E: red team of 222 adaptive black-box probes; no direct authority attacks succeeded, but trusted instructions that delegate to marked spans override the overlay, and no instruction hierarchy was trained.

Appendix F: documents SEP witness substring false positives (pen matches 'open'), a TensorTrust harness discarding 606 of 776 rows non-randomly, and substring scoring inflating extraction; main tables lead with the corrected rule and give published-rule numbers in parentheses.
Appendix G.1: three seeds at temperature 0.7 reproduce every SEP number within 0.4 points; run-to-run noise floor measured at ~2 points on a 300-item paired subset.
§8 and Appendix C: held-out instruction embeddings fail 0/120 by nearest-neighbor substitution (codes collapse to effective rank two), while held-out pointer concepts score 95%.

Reproducibility statement: code at github.com/JoshuaSP/semantic-overlays, corpus and adapter checkpoints on HuggingFace, ≈32 GPU-hours per overlay set, Appendix B gives full recipe and hyperparameters.

Appendix J: limitations include one base model at one scale, channel experiments not replicated, binary non-executable overlay, unmeasured agentic multi-turn settings, and unprofiled end-to-end serving latency.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM methodology and safety paper, squarely in scope: a trained span-targeted residual-stream adapter on frozen LLMs (Qwen3.5-9B, Llama-3.1-8B) that defends against prompt injection, directly matching high-weight preferences (LLMs, AI Safety, Red Teaming & Evaluation, Agents security, Interpretability/steering). Novelty is a genuine but incremental advance over prior defenses: unlike ISE/ASIDE/AIR it keeps the base frozen, applies edits only at designated prefill spans across all layers, state-conditioned and multiplexed; position-targeted steering is explicitly named as future work by Rimsky et al. Rigor is above average: four architectures compared on identical data (Table 1), loss ablation (CE vs KL vs hybrid, 93.5/88.5/79.6), Muon multiplier sweep, payload screening, mechanical target validation, a 222-probe adaptive red team, and honest reporting of failure modes (haiku 18% compliance; delegation attacks succeed; novel descriptors fail 0/120). Evidence is strong and specific (SEP 24.3→96.5 with utility ~unchanged on 9,160 items; TensorTrust 34.8→6.6 on all 776 rows; PIArena four families to 0%; replication on a second model family; seeded reruns within 0.4 points), and the authors surface defects in the very benchmarks they use, reporting both corrected and published-rule numbers. Generalizability is capped by single-scale testing (8-9B), channel experiments (§4-6) not replicated across families, single training runs outside the injection benchmarks, binary overlay only, and unmeasured multi-turn/agentic settings. Reproducibility is excellent: full pipeline code, corpus, and adapter checkpoints released, ~32 GPU-hours per set, recipes and harness deviations documented. Self-reported results and reliance on a small LLM judge for some scoring keep it short of the top band.

primary_link.title: Semantic Overlays: Mitigating Prompt Injection with Annotations Beyond Tokens and Steering Vectors

recommendations.summary: Everything a language model sees is tokens. The serving stack knows what each span is -- user input, tool output, instructions -- but the model must keep track of that itself, and it can lose track or be confused: text can be written to read like anything. Prompt injection is a natural exploit of this phenomenon. By scrambling the model's understanding of span identity, an attacker can induce unwanted and potentially dangerous actions. Adding a non-textual channel to the model's input -- a way t

llm_evaluation.rationale: Directly on-scope: security architecture for browser-integrated LLM agents with MCP-style tool calling, prompt-injection defense, and adversarial evaluation maps strongly to the Agents & Tool Use, AI Safety, LLM, and Red Teaming preferences. Strengths: well-specified threat model (same-origin script attacker, extensions explicitly out of scope), a clean four-layer ablation with n=80 per cell, a notable utility-confounder analysis anchoring completion to a no-attack baseline (p=0.48, p=0.003), an honest limitations section, and a white-box adaptive-attacker study showing 15/16 description-layer bypasses via tool-name relocation. primary_link.title: WebMCP-Phalanx: Enforcing and Characterizing Trust Boundaries for Browser-Integrated LLM Agents

recommendations.summary: The emerging W3C WebMCP proposal enables LLM agents to invoke tools exposed by web pages. In multi-party web environments, however, integrating agent execution into a browser security model centered on the Same-Origin Policy (SOP) leaves insufficient provenance and lifecycle guarantees for agent-accessible tools, creating three risks: subject-attribution spoofing, uncontrolled tool lifecycles, and semantic prompt injection. We propose WebMCP-Phalanx, a dual-layer agent runtime architecture. Its
recommendations.summary_zh: 隨著 W3C 推動 WebMCP 標準草案，網頁將能向 LLM 代理人暴露可呼叫的工具，但也使代理執行落入以同源政策（SOP）為中心的瀏覽器安全模型；由於網站主程式、第三方廣告 SDK 與分析腳本共用同一 origin，規範未提供工具來源與生命週期保障，衍生主體歸屬偽冒、生命週期失控與語意提示注入等結構性弱點。作者提出 WebMCP-Phalanx 雙層架構：瀏覽器原生層以不可偽造的能力憑證綁定工具所有權，並結合遙測與生命週期監控產生綠、黃、紅三級信任標籤；多代理層則由不具工具呼叫權限的隔離代理（Q-LLM）先行檢視工具描述、輸入綱要與回傳內容，再交由擁有執行權限的特權代理（P-LLM）使用。真實瀏覽器實驗顯示，所有權機制將撤銷與覆寫攻擊成功率由 100% 降為 0%，雙代理執行環境擋下全部 80 次描述注入，回傳內容注入僅殘留 2 次，且任務效用與無攻擊基線無統計顯著差異。論文亦刻畫限制：同源腳本可自行註冊取得憑證，使來源維度失效；白箱自適應攻擊者能將指令藏於工具名稱並在檢查完成前觸發呼叫，繞過描述層過濾；polyfill 實作的安全假設屬模擬性質，能力憑證屬持有式憑證，仍有混淆代理人問題。作者建議 WebMCP 納入原生腳本來源與宣告式信任拓撲等機制，並新增呼叫時機閘門，盼在規範定型前落實安全設計，對瀏覽器整合代理的安全性與標準制定具直接參考價值。

llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope LLM interpretability/evaluation methodology paper: it audits what CAA/ITI activation steering actually controls by freezing interventions and counterfactually re-encoding MCQ answers, separating semantic-label, extraction-index, and extraction-row following, and localizing the effect to a low-rank output-sensitive subspace. Preference relevance is high (LLMs, interpretability, safety behaviors like hallucination/refusal/sycophancy, evaluation methodology). Novelty is solid: applying verbalizer/selector-remapping logic to attribute steering-induced changes is a genuinely new evaluation framework, though it builds on known MCQ-selection-bias work. Rigor is exceptional: 108-condition factorial audits, L2- and covariance-matched random controls, competence gating, wrong-sign controls, norm-matched layer sweeps, position controls, prespecified positive-gain criteria, cluster bootstrap with Holm correction, and blinded human validation of LLM judges (r=.927). Evidence is strong and quantified with tight CIs (Table 1: 3.00-4.13 extraction-index effects; Table 22: 15.4% energy retaining 96.3% of effect), and limitations are honestly scoped to three three-label tasks and four model families. Generalizability is decent but the paper itself documents reversals (Qwen, SC101), tempering universal claims. Reproducibility is aided by exact templates, locked hyperparameters, seeds, and split audits, though no explicit repository URL is stated. Score ~0.86.

On NormBank, after A/B/C identifiers are reassigned, contrastive activation addition (CAA) induces larger target-versus-source score changes for the ext
recommendations.summary_zh: 這篇論文探討激活導引(activation steering)的根本證據問題:當對比激活加入(CAA)等介入手法在特定答案編碼下提升分數時,它究竟控制了什麼?作者提出「跨編碼導引評估」,在凍結介入方向的前提下,對同一批保留測試項目重新編碼答案(改變標籤對應、識別碼詞彙與列序),藉此區分語意標籤追隨、抽取索引追隨(extraction-index following)與抽取列追隨三種可能。在 NormBank 上,重新指派 A/B/C 後,CAA 對抽取索引的目標分數變化大於對語意標籤者;因子式審計(6 種語意映射、3 種識別碼詞彙、6 種列序,共 108 條件)證實效果追隨索引而非顯示列位置。經範數匹配後,此效果主要在較深層(75% 與 87.5% 深度)出現;一個僅佔方向平方範數 15.4% 的低秩輸出敏感子空間,卻保留了 96.3% 的效果,顯示高度集中。ITI 式方法在 NormBank 的三個模型重現同樣排序;MNLI 整體偏向抽取索引追隨(唯 Qwen 反轉),SC101 則偏向語意標籤追隨,顯示歸因隨模型與任務而異。開放式生成測試亦顯示選擇題分數與生成行為可能得出不同結論:幻覺在兩種評估皆為正,拒答僅在選擇題有增益,諂媚僅在開放式評估有增益。限制包括僅涵蓋三個三標籤任務與四個模型系列,子空間分析屬功能性定位而未找出完整電路。其重要性在於:單一答案編碼下的導引增益無法證明語意控制,導引主張須有與所宣稱控制層級相符的證據。

llm_evaluation.rationale: Core-topic LLM reasoning paper: label-free test-time training via an asymmetric objective (OPSD distillation on majority-vote-agreeing rollouts, GRPO penalties on disagreeing ones) with token-level weighting/masking, evaluated on Qwen3-1.7B/4B/8B across five competition math benchmarks. Strong preference fit (LLMs, chain-of-thought reasoning, RL/GRPO, LoRA fine-tuning). Novelty is moderate: the asymmetric routing and the empirical observation that ~79% of disagreeing rollouts are wrong regardless of pseudo-label correctness are a genuine contribution, but components (TTRL, OPSD, TIP, STAPO token selection) are assembled from prior work. Rigor is good: four baselines including label-free and label-supervised, extensive ablations (Table 3 token selection, Figure 3 update-strategy grid, Table 4 privileged information, Tables 8-10 hyperparameter sweeps), theory appendix (E), and explicit limitations (Appendix F). Deductions: all methods report peak-across-checkpoint accuracy (Section 4.1) which inflates absolute numbers; headline 'matches or exceeds label-supervised OPSD' rests on 0.2-0.9 avg-point margins (Table 1) without error bars or significance tests; the ~85% wrong-pseudo-label rate (Section 3.2) seems internally high given a 37.8 base Avg@12 and K=64 voting, and is not broken down per problem; the surprising 'pseudo-labels beat ground-truth supervision' result (Figure 5) has plausible but unverified explanations. primary_link.title: TTPO: Test-Time Policy Optimization

recommendations.summary: Recent prominent post-training methods, such as Reinforcement Learning (RL) and On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD), have driven rapid progress in mathematical reasoning for large language models, yet their reliance on ground-truth labels precludes test-time training (TTT). Replacing ground truth with majority-vote pseudo-labels is a natural alternative, yet it is fragile: an incorrect vote corrupts the teacher and misleads every token. We observe that this failure mode is asymmetric: rollouts that disagree with the pseudo-label are typically wrong regardless of whether the vote itself is correct. Building on this observation, we propose Test-Time Policy Optimization (TTPO), an asymmetric objective that distills agreeing rollouts via OPSD and penalizes disagreeing rollouts with Grouped RL. Token-level selection further refines both branches: distillation down-weights already-converged positions, while RL penalizes only confident errors. Both updates remain well-grounded even under frequent pseudo-label errors, and majority-vote routing yields tighter self-supervision as the model improves. Without any labels, TTPO matches label-supervised OPSD on five competition-level benchmarks, raises Qwen3-1.7B from 38.0% to 45.2% in TTT, yields +25.2% to +36.4% without thinking, and shows strong cross-task generalization.
recommendations.summary_zh: 這篇論文處理大型語言模型在無標籤情境下進行測試時訓練（TTT）的難題。現行後訓練方法如強化學習（RLVR）與 on-policy 自我蒸餾（OPSD）皆仰賴標準答案；改用多數決虛擬標籤時，錯誤共識會污染教師模型，在每個 token 上誤導訓練——在競賽級題目上虛擬標籤約有 85% 是錯的。作者觀察到關鍵的不對稱性：與虛擬標籤不一致的 rollout 中約 79% 本身也是錯的，因此懲罰「不一致」樣本不論標籤對錯幾乎都正確。據此提出 TTPO 不對稱目標：對一致的正樣本施以前向 KL 為基礎的 OPSD 蒸餾，並以 token 加權聚焦學生尚未掌握的位置；對不一致的負樣本施以 GRPO 懲罰，並以遮罩只懲罰導致失敗的自信錯誤。在 AIME、HMMT、BRUMO 五個競賽級數學基準上，完全不用標籤的 TTPO 即追平或超越使用標準答案的 OPSD；純 TTT 設定下將 Qwen3-1.7B 平均準確率由 38.0% 提升至 45.2%；關閉思考模式時增益達 +25.2 至 +36.4 個百分點，並展現跨基準遷移與自我演進能力。有趣的是，以虛擬標籤訓練反而勝過使用標準答案，因為過難的真實標籤使兩個分支同時缺乏學習訊號。限制包括依賴多數決品質、僅驗證於具可驗證答案的數學領域，以及採用固定的訓練課程。此研究為無標籤的測試時自我改良提供了穩健且有效的新方向。

Existing sequence- and token-level methods penalize target outputs without modeling their context-dependent retrieval paths, which can disrupt linguistic structure or suppress benign knowledge. We present ADU, a fine-grained, training-based framework that shifts unlearning from token erasure t
recommendations.summary_zh: 這篇論文探討大型語言模型(LLM)的機器遺忘(unlearning)問題:模型須依 GDPR 等規範遺忘敏感或私人內容,同時保留一般能力。既有序列級與 token 級方法只懲罰可見輸出,未建模情境相依的內部檢索路徑,容易破壞語言結構,或在無害情境造成過度遺忘。作者提出「生成不平等」概念:局部注意力頭維持短程依賴,全域注意力頭則在語義轉折的前規劃位置回溯檢索遠處持續被關注的錨點。據此提出 ADU 框架:先在原始模型上定位前規劃—錨點路徑並固定,再訓練注意力投影 adapter 抑制這些路徑的注意力質量,並以保留集語言建模與局部注意力保存損失約束副作用;訓練後以雙向激活交換驗證所選路徑的因果中介角色。實驗顯示,ADU 在 WMDP 上將 Llama3.1-8B-Instruct 的 Bio/Cyber 準確率降至 27.32/27.97,MMLU 與 GSM8K 保留 62.84/58.82;TOFU 遺忘品質達 0.93,平均保留 92.9% 效用(基線 81.9%);MUSE 上 ROUGE-L 最低;面對提示框架與適應性恢復等攻擊仍維持最低敏感準確率。消融實驗證實路徑損失與保留損失缺一不可。限制在於路徑識別依賴注意力且僅在原始模型計算一次,錨點自動建構與殘留知識防護仍待改進。此研究將遺忘從擦除 token 轉為抑制情境化檢索路徑,對隱私合規與安全部署深具意義。
recommendations.title: Unlearning Is Not Just Erasing: Temporal Decoupling via Generation Inequality
recommendations.title_zh: 機器遺忘不只是擦除:以生成不平等達成時間解耦

llm_evaluation.rationale: On-topic LLM methodology paper: selective unlearning for fine-tuned language models with privacy/compliance motivation, adversarial recovery-probe evaluation, and safety-adjacent framing, aligning with high-weight LLM, AI Safety, and Red Teaming/Evaluation preferences; no out-of-scope domain trigger. Novelty is solid but incremental: scope expansion beyond forget seeds via related-knowledge removal (UIPE, Wei et al.) and influence-style attribution (Koh & Liang, TRAK) exist; the multi-view support graph with restart-diffusion and graded forgetting strengths (Section 2.3-2.5) is a credible new controller, explicitly separated from the loss. Rigor is strong: matched Seed-Only ablation sharing the same objective (Section 3.3), seven baselines, three deletion settings, two datasets, two backbones (Table 2, Appendix A), local-extractor swap with corruption stress tests (Appendix D), and taxonomy-blind LLM-generated probes with bootstrap CIs and McNemar tests (Appendix F/Table 8). Evidence is weakened by a single training seed (Appendix K), absence of leave-one-view-out or fusion-weight sweeps (Appendix J), self-defined soft-leakage metric with tau=0.85, small models (GPT-2 Medium, Llama-3.2-3B), and a post-hoc PPL<=10 feasibility guardrail, though Appendix B shows Pareto robustness across caps 5-50 and honest reporting of residual partial-deletion leakage (81.67% TOFU). Generalizability is limited to QA-format English unlearning benchmarks; beyond-QA applicability is argued (Appendix A) but not tested, and quadratic candidate retrieval is a scaling bottleneck (Appendix H). Reproducibility is aided by released anonymous code, frozen prompts/manifests, hyperparameter tables, and a validated local extraction path, but full sweeps are not provided. Calculated: 0.85*0.4 + 0.7*0.15 + 0.8*0.15 + 0.77*0.15 + 0.6*0.1 + 0.7*0.05 = 0.77.

primary_link.title: Graph-Guided Selective Unlearning for Language Models: Controlling Support Routes Beyond Forget Seeds

recommendations.summary: Enterprises fine-tune language models on proprietary data that may later require removal due to privacy, contractual, or compliance obligations. Selective unlearning removes requested knowledge while preserving model utility, offering a practical alternative to full retraining, but existing methods treat the explicitly identified forget examples as the complete deletion scope. This is insufficient when target knowledge remains recoverable through paraphrases, aliases, or neighboring training exa
recommendations.summary_zh: 企業常以專有資料微調大型語言模型，但基於隱私、合約或法規義務，事後往往必須刪除特定知識。現有選擇性遺忘方法多半只針對明確標記的遺忘樣本，忽略目標知識仍可透過改寫、別名或相鄰訓練樣本被推論還原的問題。本文提出GraphSU，一個與損失函數無關的圖引導控制器：先以GPT-4.1離線抽取事實三元組，融合實體、關係、尾實體三種符號重疊、語意相似度與答案側梯度對齊共五種視圖，建構加權支援圖；再以個人化圖擴散從遺忘種子傳播刪除壓力，選出高風險支援鄰居並賦予分級遺忘強度，最後結合熵最大化、unlikelihood、表示斥力與保留損失進行更新。在TOFU與PISTOL基準上，以GPT-2 Medium與Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct評估，GraphSU在所有刪除設定下均達到保留困惑度低於10的最低軟性洩漏，相較共用相同遺忘目標的Seed-Only對照組最多降低49.5個百分點，且在736個未見過的自由形式探測提示上維持統計顯著的改善。限制方面：部分刪除仍有大量殘餘洩漏；軟性洩漏僅衡量行為層面的可達性，並非具備正式保證的表徵抹除；實驗僅使用單一訓練種子，亦未完成逐視圖消融分析。整體而言，本研究顯示可靠的知識刪除關鍵在於控制支援路徑，而非只設計遺忘損失函數，對企業部署中的隱私與合規管理具實務價值。
