links.title: PILOT in the Loop: Live Self-Improvement for Long-Horizon Agents

evidence: Abstract: 'PILOT ranks first in five of six configurations'; 'PILOT gains 14.6 points with GLM-5.1 and 12.4 points with Kimi-K2.6; mean output tokens fall by 42.9% and 47.4%'
Section 3.1 Setup: 'We run each configuration twice and report the mean pass rate across the two runs' — no variance, confidence intervals, or significance tests reported anywhere

Section 3.1 Evaluation settings: one-shot setting uses 'a fresh harness state, isolating whether live steering keeps the worker on track'; self-improvement setting uses verifier outcomes only to retain/discard updates, never to create them

Table 2 / Section 4.2: steering-aided successful runs classified by manual trace inspection at 2.3% (GLM-5.1) and 10.6% (Kimi-K2.6) overall, with a stated inclusion criterion but no inter-annotator agreement or second annotator

Appendix A.3: identical self-improvement instruction prepended for every harness with only harness-native [SKILL_PATH]/[MEMORY_PATH] substitutions — a good control against instruction-induced gains

Limitations: 'Iterative self-improvement repeats every task across many iterations... limits the current evaluation to three benchmarks and two open-weight backbones'; supervisor and worker share the same backbone, heterogeneous pairings 'unexplored'

Section 3.3/Figure 3(b): skill library grows from 62 to 83 (GLM-5.1) and 50 to 81 (Kimi-K2.6) over 20 iterations; Figure 3(c) reports token reductions counting all supervisor and worker assistant turns (honest accounting)
llm_evaluation.rationale: A strongly on-topic agentic-LLM paper: a supervisor-worker harness (PILOT) enabling mid-run 'live steering' plus concurrent harness evolution (skills/memory) over frozen LLM backbones (GLM-5.1, Kimi-K2.6), evaluated on Terminal-Bench 2.0, SWE-bench Multilingual, and SWE-bench Pro. Preference relevance is high (agents, LLMs, coding benchmarks, token-efficiency analysis). Novelty is moderate: the framing of 'live' (mid-execution) correction plus concurrent harness updates is a sensible architectural gap relative to post-hoc self-improvement work (Reflexion, ExpeL, ACE, etc.), but the components (supervisor-worker, skill libraries, memory) are well-trodden. Rigor is decent but limited: fixed backbone across harnesses, identical self-improvement instruction across harnesses (Appendix A.3), uniform task exclusions (Appendix A.1), and two settings that partially decompose steering vs. self-evolution; however, only two runs per configuration with no significance testing, no ablations of the channel mechanics or supervisor design, and manual single-pass classification of steering-aided runs (Table 2, 2.3%/10.6%). Evidence includes concrete tables and two trace-grounded case studies (Figure 4), but gains of 4-5 points on 89 tasks are not statistically supported. Generalizability is constrained to two open-weight backbones and adjacent terminal/SWE domains, acknowledged in Limitations. Reproducibility is moderately good: public GitHub claim, pseudocode (A.2), full instruction text (A.3), exclusion lists promised, though supervisor prompts, skill schemas, and update criteria are underspecified.

primary_link.title: PILOT in the Loop: Live Self-Improvement for Long-Horizon Agents

recommendations.summary: Long-horizon agent runs generate experience that can improve both the current run and future work. Most self-improvement methods process this experience only after execution ends, so they cannot redirect the active run or immediately apply and validate lessons learned from it. We argue that self-improvement should instead be live, using emerging experience both to redirect the active run and to update the persistent harness. Existing agent architectures do not fully support this goal. Single-agent self-correction combines task execution and trajectory assessment within one context, while subagent delegation separates execution but typically cannot redirect an active subagent. We present PILOT, a supervisor-worker harness for live self-improvement through two coupled mechanisms: (1) live steering lets a separate supervisor redirect or abort the active worker during execution; and (2) live self-evolution distils procedures and failure modes revealed during execution into reusable skills and memory. Across two frozen backbones and three benchmarks, PILOT ranks first in five of six configurations. On Terminal-Bench 2.0, PILOT outperforms counterpart harnesses by up to 9.8 percentage points. In the self-improvement setting, PILOT gains 14.6 points with GLM-5.1 and 12.4 points with Kimi-K2.6. Mean output tokens fall by 42.9% and 47.4%, while successful evaluations per million output tokens rise by 110.3% and 134.0%, respectively.
recommendations.summary_zh: 長程代理在執行任務時產生的經驗,理應能同時改善當前與未來的表現:成功軌跡可沉澱為可重複使用的程序,失敗軌跡則暴露應避免的失敗模式。然而多數自我改進方法只在執行結束後做事後檢視,既無法導正進行中的執行,也無法立即套用並驗證新學到的知識;單一代理自我修正會讓執行與監督在有限的上下文中互相干擾,子代理委派又通常要等執行結束才能取得結果並介入。對此,作者提出 PILOT,一個監督者—工作者(supervisor–worker)框架,以兩個耦合機制實現「即時自我改進」:(1)即時導引(live steering),監督者透過雙向即時通道接收工作者的通知、提問、結果與錯誤警示,並能在執行中導引或中止工作者;(2)即時自我演化(live self-evolution),將執行中浮現的有效程序、專案慣例與失敗模式沉澱為可重複使用的技能庫與記憶。模型參數全程凍結,僅演化持久化的框架狀態。在 GLM-5.1 與 Kimi-K2.6 兩個凍結骨幹及 Terminal-Bench 2.0、SWE-bench Multilingual、SWE-bench Pro 三項基準上,PILOT 於六種組合中的五種排名第一,Terminal-Bench 2.0 最高領先對手 9.8 個百分點;在自我改進設定下,最佳通過率分別提升 14.6 與 12.4 個百分點,平均輸出 token 減少 42.9% 與 47.4%,每百萬輸出 token 的成功評估數增加 110.3% 與 134.0%,技能庫由 62、50 個成長至 83、81 個,且增益在困難任務上最為顯著。限制方面,迭代式自我改進成本高昂,評估僅涵蓋三項基準與兩個開放權重模型;監督者與工作者共用同一模型,異質配對的取捨尚待探索。本文的價值在於將「導正當前執行」與「累積可重用經驗」整合成單一連續迴路,使代理的自我改進能即時發生並跨任務延續。

links.title: IAPO: Influence-Aware Policy Optimization for Credit Assignment in Multi-Turn Service Agents

evidence: Abstract: 'IAPO represents each rollout as a typed influence-dependency graph... Experiments with Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B demonstrate superior performance over multi-turn RL baselines across three service-agent benchmarks: τ2-Bench, UserBench, and AgentChangeBench.'

Method/Influence-Dependency Graph: support-use (i→+j) and failed-use (i→-j) edges with necessity/explicit-binding/source-priority acceptance criteria; 'user turns and tool returns provide evidence but never receive advantage.'
Properties, Propositions 1-4: mass conservation Σ A_i,ℓ = L Â_τ, uniform fallback, sign preservation, optimization-interface preservation; 'proofs are in Appendix B.'
Table 1 (8B): IAPO 42.18±2.55 vs GRPO 29.61±3.56 on τ2-Bench; UserBench 24.44 vs 19.83; AgentChangeBench 30.44 vs 26.03; BFCL-MT 39.36 vs 39.04.

Experiments/Experimental Setup: 'train Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B with thinking disabled on 8× NVIDIA H20 GPUs using a verl/FSDP GRPO stack, N=16 samples/prompt, max 30 turns. Dependency annotation uses Qwen3-32B at temperature 0... IAPO defaults: β+=0.05, c=0.25.'
Table 3 (Ablation): β+=0 yields 32.50 τ2 vs 42.18 default; β+=0.1 yields 33.96; c=0.5 yields 42.29 τ2 but UserBench drops to 17.78; Gemma4-31B annotator yields 40.90 τ2.
Annotator Stability: 'Six frozen annotators achieve 100% parse rate... mean edge-typed F1 0.87, source Jaccard 0.84, mean pairwise Cohen's κ=0.83'; m− Spearman ρ=0.96-1.00 (Table 4).
Main Results: 'IAPO lowers macro tool-call redundancy from GRPO's 46.00 to 29.74 (Appendix F)'; routing departs from flat credit ('86.5% of steps move by more than 10% from flat credit, Appendix E').
No code or data release statement appears anywhere in the provided document; only public benchmarks and the MUA-RL checkpoint (re-evaluated) are cited.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-agent RL methodology, squarely in scope: multi-turn service agents, GRPO-style training, tool use, and function calling (Abstract; Related Work). The core idea—routing a fixed trajectory-level advantage through a within-rollout, LLM-annotated typed influence-dependency graph instead of uniform GRPO credit—is a genuinely distinct angle versus cross-rollout grouping (GiGPO), reset/branch methods, or auxiliary critics (Introduction; Related Work), though influence-based credit assignment has older RL precedents (RUDDER, hindsight). Rigor is solid: a controlled GRPO baseline differing only in the advantage map (Experiments), two model scales, three seeds, OOD benchmarks, hyperparameter and annotator-swap ablations (Table 3), and cross-annotator stability audits (Table 4); proofs of mass conservation and sign preservation are stated (Properties, Appendix B). Deductions: no significance testing, the chosen defaults (β+=0.05, c=0.25) are the sweep optima with notable sensitivity (42.18 vs 33.96 for β+=0.1), and the method's quality hinges on a frozen Qwen3-32B annotator whose extraction rules could bias credit. Evidence strength is good but internal: detailed quantitative tables (Table 1: 42.18±2.55 vs 29.61±3.56 at 8B; Table 5 BFCL retention) with no code/data release statement in the document. Generalizability is supported by training only on τ²-Bench while improving UserBench/AgentChangeBench and flat BFCL (Main Results), but the approach presumes multi-turn interaction with observable tool/schema errors and a capable annotator model. Reproducibility is moderate: stack (verl/FSDP, 8×H20, N=16, temp-0 annotator) and defaults are given with full details claimed in Appendix F, but no artifact availability is stated.

primary_link.title: IAPO: Influence-Aware Policy Optimization for Credit Assignment in Multi-Turn Service Agents

recommendations.summary: Large Language Model (LLM) agents increasingly solve long-horizon tasks through multi-turn interactions with users and external tools. In these settings, relevant task information often unfolds over time rather than being fully specified at the initial prompt. Service agents make this challenge especially concrete: users may clarify or revise their goals, while tool responses provide information needed for subsequent decisions. Thus, a final reward alone cannot indicate which actions contributed
recommendations.summary_zh: 多輪服務代理的任務資訊隨對話逐步浮現：使用者會中途修改目標，工具回傳揭示所需狀態，僅憑最終獎勵難以判斷哪些動作促成任務完成。GRPO 等演算法把軌跡層級優勢平均套用到每個 token，無法區分中間動作的貢獻。論文提出 IAPO（影響感知策略最佳化），將完成的 rollout 表示為以可訓練動作為節點、帶正負號的影響依賴圖：支援使用邊記錄後續動作消費前序動作引出的資訊，失敗使用邊標記可觀察錯誤的傳播與回退；使用者與工具觀察僅作證據、不取得梯度信用。路由權重據此重新分配原軌跡優勢，並具質量守恆、符號保持與均勻回退等保證。實驗以 Qwen3-4B 與 Qwen3-8B 在 τ²-Bench 訓練，並於 τ²-Bench、UserBench 與 AgentChangeBench 驗證：8B 模型於 τ²-Bench 由 29.61% 提升至 42.18%，電信領域增益達 +18.19 個百分點，並優於 GRPO、GiGPO 與 InfoPO，BFCL-v4 Multi-Turn 的函式呼叫能力亦維持不變；消融實驗亦顯示兩類訊號皆有貢獻、標註模型可替換。限制在於依賴凍結標註模型（Qwen3-32B）抽取依賴圖，標註品質與超參數 β+、c 的設定影響成效，且驗證集中在服務型任務。此研究顯示，rollout 內已實現的依賴結構是稀疏獎勵下細粒度功勞分配的實用來源。

links.title: CatchBench: When Can an Agent Failure Be Caught?

evidence: Abstract: 'The release scores 72 entrants, from rule scanners and structural models to eleven LLM judges across nine model families (GPT, Claude, Gemini, Gemma, Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, Mistral, Nova), over 1187 declared configurations and 1162 recorded runs.'

Section 3.3: 'Sixteen comparison families are declared before scoring, and the contrasts inside each are adjusted by Holm's step-down procedure... all 118 reported contrasts are regenerated from the committed predictions.'
Section 5.4: 'The auditable lift over size (flat) is +0.141 on SWE-Gym (0.804 against 0.663). This is the paper's only effect that survives multiplicity correction.'

Section 4.3 Bar Verdicts: 'File-level Gold passes item 1... fails item 2... Named-value Gold v2 leaves items 1 to 3 undetermined... Thus both substrates remain mechanism diagnostics and carry no evidential weight.'

Appendix D.1: 'The injecagent harvester writes each roster as the user tool followed by the attacker tools... A rule that reads nothing but position... scores 1.000 F1 there' — a construction leak in the authors' own PRE corpus.
Reproducibility Statement: 'The scored board calls no model service: it reads committed prediction caches, so a third party reproduces every number in this paper without an API key.'
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly on-topic: a benchmark for auditing LLM-agent failures scored across PRE/LIVE/POST information states, entrants include 11 LLM judges (GPT, Claude, Gemini, Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, etc.), directly matching top-weight preferences for agents/tool use, LLMs, and LLM-as-judge evaluation. Novelty is solid rather than fundamental: the evidence-budget axis (three information states under one task-method interface) and a five-item admissibility bar for injected faults are new for agent auditing (Table 1 shows no prior benchmark covers all three states), but the fixed-data/many-method arena contract is inherited from ADBench/BOND. Rigor is exceptional: 16 pre-declared comparison families, 118 Holm-corrected paired contrasts, per-board floors, seed-stability analyses, and honest separation of 'separates' from 'unresolved' (47/118). The paper even documents and repairs its own harness defects (PyGOD batching bug, judge parser bug, injecagent declaration-order leak). Evidence is strong and internally consistent, with the headline SWE-Gym structural gain (+0.141 ROC-AUC, Section 5.4) the only effect surviving correction, and GPT-5.5's localization lead (0.452 vs 0.211) cleanly established; caveats include single-pass judge generations and small corpora that leave many contrasts unresolved. Generalizability is limited by domain split: structural signal holds on SWE-Gym but tau-bench remains an acknowledged open problem, and all three Gold-derived boards ship only as mechanism diagnostics after failing the authors' own admissibility bar. Reproducibility is outstanding: public repo, committed prediction caches allowing API-free rescoring, pinned corpus commits, CI checks, and documented PII redaction, though raw upstream traces must be fetched and judge regeneration needs credentials.

primary_link.title: CatchBench: When Can an Agent Failure Be Caught?

recommendations.summary: When can an agent failure be caught? An audit is usually limited by the record rather than by the method. CatchBench therefore puts one auditor's question to three information states: the declared configuration before a run (PRE), a growing prefix of its trace (LIVE), and the finished trace (POST). Prior benchmarks fix one of these states or vary the telemetry; to our knowledge none scores all three under one task-method interface. Each state admits different questions, so seven task contracts c
recommendations.summary_zh: 本論文提出 CatchBench，是首個在單一任務—方法介面下，跨三種資訊狀態評測 AI 代理稽核方法的基準：執行前的宣告設定（PRE）、執行中的軌跡前綴（LIVE）與執行後的完整軌跡（POST）。作者主張稽核成效受限於紀錄本身而非方法，故設計七項任務契約，涵蓋過度授權稽核、失敗早期預警、線上錯誤偵測、步驟定位、失敗偵測與原因歸因，形成九個計分板，收錄 1187 個宣告設定與 1162 筆執行紀錄，評測 72 個方法，包括規則掃描器、結構化偵測器與九個模型家族的十一個 LLM 評審。主要結果：118 個預先宣告的比較僅 47 個在 Holm 校正後可分離；GPT-5.5 在 Who&When 定位任務以 Top-1 0.452 領先所有非 LLM 方法；SWE-Gym 失敗偵測的結構特徵效應（0.804 對 0.663）是唯一通過校正者，而 tau-bench 的早期預警始終低於 0.70 警戒線。論文也揭露自身資料的缺陷：某語料來源保留宣告順位，一條只看位置的規則即達完美 F1，顯示分數反映語料建構方式而非推理能力；注入式 Gold 資料因留下可被偵測的建造痕跡，未通過五項可採納性檢驗，三個 Gold 計分板僅列為機制診斷。限制包括多數比較無法解析、標籤流程異質且部分仰賴 LLM 判讀、遺失接地與線上過期狀態偵測等問題仍未解。其價值在於證明基準分數須先公開標籤產生流程並檢驗捷徑才可解讀，並以預先宣告、無需模型呼叫即可重現的統計契約，取代單一排行榜式的結論。

links.title: From Inertia to Objectivity: Improving Deep Research Agents with Noise Isolation

evidence: Abstract: NIS-Agent achieves competitive performance while reducing token cost by 33% vs the smolagents DR baseline; code publicly available at github.com/PangSMPang/NIS-Agent
Section 3.2 / Appendix A.4: IBIS construction — 1,016 LLM-generated candidates filtered to 712, human annotation retains 245 Should Re-search + 209 Should Visit Page samples, Fleiss' kappa = 0.684
Section 6.2: switching Agentic to Observer Mode improves Should Re-search accuracy ~15–30% across models; GPT-4o collapses to 4.08% in Agentic Mode (Appendix B.1 Table 7)
Appendix A.5: paired flip analysis — 91.9% of flips point toward the inertia direction; 18 surface features fail to predict flips (AUC 0.498 direction, 0.492 occurrence)
Section 6.4 Table 4: GAIA/GPT-4o ablation — full NIS-Agent 61.82 vs w/o Filter 59.39 vs w/o Validation 56.96; Table 3: total tokens 219.8k → 147.3k (−33.0%)
Table 5: validation module transfers to math reasoning — AIME 2025 GPT-4.1 improves 35.3 → 68.7 vs CoT validation
Section 5 + Appendix D: NIS-8B trained on Qwen3-8B via SFT (4,293 examples) then GRPO (9,964 examples) with offline rubric generation (Claude Sonnet 4) and cheap online judge (qwen3-max)
Section 8 Limitations: no mechanistic investigation of the bias; generalization beyond information seeking and math is speculative; isolation filters can mistakenly discard relevant pages
Appendix C.4.2: full WebWalkerQA (680 queries) run with Claude-3.7-Sonnet yields 69.26% vs 68.50% on the 200-query subset, supporting subset reliability
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-agent research: diagnoses a newly named agentic failure mode ('inertia bias'), builds a controlled diagnostic benchmark (IBIS), proposes context-isolation interventions (NIS-Agent), and trains an 8B model via SFT+GRPO to internalize resistance. Hits high-weight preferences squarely (Agents & Tool Use, LLMs, Reasoning, RL/alignment, evaluation/benchmarks, RAG/grounding). Novelty is solid but context isolation/pruning is a known tool family; the contribution is the targeted debiasing framing plus controlled Agentic-vs-Observer measurement. Rigor is above average: paired conditions, Fleiss' kappa 0.684, ablations, token-cost analysis, AIME transfer, a subset-reliability check on full WebWalkerQA, and a paired flip analysis (AUC ~0.50 on surface features) that preempts the main confound. Evidence is strong across multiple benchmarks and backbones, though some baselines are self-reproduced, the noise analysis is manual and small-scale, and the 'inertia bias' construct is distinguished from confirmation bias mainly conceptually. Honest limitations (no mechanistic account, unverified generalization to other agent domains, isolation can discard relevant pages). Code release and detailed training/evaluation protocols support reproducibility, with some dependence on proprietary judges/teachers.

primary_link.title: From Inertia to Objectivity: Improving Deep Research Agents with Noise Isolation

recommendations.summary: Web search agents powered by Large Language Models (LLMs) show strong promise, but deep research tasks expose a recurring failure mode: once an agent has produced a query, plan, or intermediate conclusion, it becomes less objective when later judging the consequences of that same action. We term this phenomenon inertia bias. To make it measurable, we introduce the IBIS benchmark, which controls the search observations while varying whether the model is evaluating the outcome of its own prior act
recommendations.summary_zh: 本文探討 LLM 網路搜尋代理在深度研究任務中的系統性失敗機制:慣性偏誤(inertia bias)。一旦代理產生查詢、計畫或中間結論,之後評估該行動後果時便失去客觀性,傾向強化自己先前的選擇。作者建立 IBIS 基準,在相同搜尋結果下比較「自己發起行動」(Agentic Mode)與「外部資訊」(Observer Mode)兩種情境,發現模型普遍出現 15% 至 30% 的落差,證實此偏誤普遍存在。此偏誤會在兩個決策點放大雜訊:工作者層級的搜尋雜訊與管理者層級的脈絡雜訊。為此提出 NIS-Agent,於網頁篩選與答案驗證兩個脆弱環節導入情境隔離,使判斷脫離代理自身的行動歷史:過濾模組僅依任務狀態評估網頁並適時改寫查詢,驗證模組則重組推理鏈、逐項檢驗推論。在 GAIA、WebWalkerQA 等基準上,NIS-Agent 達到開源框架中的最佳表現,於 BrowseComp 亦具競爭力,並節省 33% token 成本;以 SFT 加 GRPO 訓練的 8B 開源模型 NIS-8B,在同框架下平均表現接近 GPT-4o。驗證模組附加於 ReAct 管線亦可大幅提升 AIME 數學推理成績,顯示方法可外推至深度研究之外。限制方面,作者僅將模型視為黑箱,未探究偏誤的機制根源;偏誤是否通用於程式碼或具身代理仍屬推測;隔離與驗證本身可能誤刪相關頁面或背書錯誤結論,高風險場景應保留人工把關。本文為代理系統的自我強化錯誤提供可量測的診斷基準與去偏介入方案,對建構更可靠的研究型代理極具參考價值。
recommendations.title: From Inertia to Objectivity: Improving Deep Research Agents with Noise Isolation
recommendations.title_zh: 從慣性到客觀:以雜訊隔離改進深度研究代理人

links.title: More Rejective, Not More Discriminative: The Unit of Verification in Pre-Execution LLM Oversight

evidence: Section 4.2 / Table 1: catch rises monotonically 0.765→0.970 while gold-clean FR rises 0.419→0.935; J peaks at L=2 (0.602) and collapses to 0.035 at L=8, with every judge peaking at L∈{1,2} in both domains.

Section 3.3: pre-registered direction-agnostic outcome map (RISING/DECAY/FLAT/INDETERMINATE) with a mandatory clean co-report; score-mode pass (Eq. 4-5) adds threshold-free AUC with per-length recalibration.

Section 4.3 / Appendix M: observation-provision intervention collapses retail FR climb (0.419→0.290 at L=8, slope difference 0.645, CI excludes 0) and recovers J(8) 0.035→0.490; AppWorld loses 38% of slope.

Appendix AF: minimum detectable effects 0.046-0.263 vs observed contrasts 0.075-0.567, design effects 1.00-1.48, and realized rejection rates at nominal 5% of .066/.054/.068 (item bootstrap), indicating calibrated inference.

Appendix AC: SHA-256 freeze manifest, append-only dated amendment chain, archived judgments, and byte-identical re-run of 44/45 analyses; closed judges regenerate from archived verdicts but floating model ids are disclosed as non-reproducible by re-query.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A controlled, pre-registered measurement study of a deployment parameter (the unit of verification) for LLM monitors in agent oversight. Topic alignment is strong with top-weighted preferences: LLM verifiers across six judges, tool-using agent oversight (Agents & Tool Use), AI control/trusted monitoring (AI Safety), and LLM-as-judge evaluation methodology. The twin-prefix framework with matched clean twins and the catch-minus-FR informedness co-report is a genuinely novel instrument, and the core finding (longer windows buy rejection, not discrimination; J peaks at L=1-2 in all six cells) plus the observation-deprivation mechanism via intervention are non-obvious contributions. Rigor is exceptionally high: direction-agnostic frozen outcome map, paired item/cluster bootstraps with exact McNemar, score-mode AUC separating threshold drift from ranking loss, position sweep, inert-padding and predicted-observation controls, three-way defer probe, LoRA-trained monitor control, held-out recipe validation, jackknife, and a power/design-effect appendix. Evidence is strong and quantitatively dense (e.g., catch 0.765→0.970 vs FR 0.419→0.935; J(8) recovery 0.035→0.490 under observation replay), though scoped to non-adaptive injected errors, zero-shot monitors, two domains, L≤8, and a small retail clean set (n=31, disclosed). Reproducibility is outstanding (SHA-256 manifests, archived judgments, append-only amendment chain, byte-identical re-run 44/45), with the disclosed caveat that closed-weight judge ids are floating. Score slightly below the component average reflects that generalizability is deliberately scoped and the subject is a niche oversight parameter rather than a broadly applicable LLM methodology.

primary_link.title: More Rejective, Not More Discriminative: The Unit of Verification in Pre-Execution LLM Oversight

Over-blocking forfeits usefulness and pressures deployers to disable it. Every protocol must fix a unit of verification: how many actions one call reviews. Existing designs take the unit as given; its effect on fallible monitors is unmeasured. Natural traces cannot isolate it: review length co-varies with error type and position. recommendations.summary_zh: 本文探討AI控制中的執行前監督：在工具型代理執行不可逆動作之前，由可能出錯的LLM監控器審核其計畫。每個協定都必須設定「驗證單位」——每次驗證呼叫審核幾個動作，但此參數對易錯監控器的影響從未被量化，自然軌跡又讓長度與錯誤型態混淆，單看偵測率也會誤導。作者提出雙生前綴框架：對每個黃金計畫注入一筆環境可接受的錯誤寫入，配上僅差該筆寫入的乾淨孿生前綴，於五種嵌套長度L∈{1,2,3,5,8}下成對評估，以預註冊的Youden informedness（J=偵測率−誤拒率）計分，並強制同步報告乾淨側誤拒率。在零售與AppWorld兩領域、六個評審模型（Llama-3.3-70B、Qwen2.5-14B/72B、DeepSeek-V4-Pro、Claude Opus 4.8、GPT-5.6 Sol）上，加長視窗雖提升偵測率，誤拒率卻同步攀升，J皆於L=1或2達到峰值；長視窗使零樣本監控器更傾向拒絕，而非更善區分。介入實驗指出主因是觀察剝奪：回放黃金觀察可將零售的J(8)由0.035回升至0.490。僅用短視窗訓練的LoRA監控器無法泛化到長視窗，而任何標籤盲策略（投票、路由、草稿訊號）皆未穩定勝過校準後的固定短單位。限制包括單一非自適應注入錯誤、僅兩領域且L≤8、零售乾淨樣本僅31筆。本文主張安全案例應明示驗證單位並共報乾淨序列，對可信監控的部署極具實務意義。

links.title: When "Do Not" Is Not Deny: Security Rules in CLAUDE.md vs Built-In Controls

evidence: Abstract & §I: 481 public CLAUDE.md files; only about 4–16% of retrieved security rules have a matching built-in control; strict adjudicated estimate 4.4% [2.6, 6.7]
§IV-B Table II: classifier precision 0.350, recall 1.000 on the matching-control judgment; annotator agreement 96.5% with Cohen's κ=0.89 (match) and 0.77 (security-relevant gate)
§III-E & §VI: blind 50-file audit puts rule-word extraction recall at 66.3% [48.8, 82.0], so rates apply only to retrieved rules
§IV-E Table VI: sampling-frame replication on Agent READMEs corpus gives 25.1% [20.8, 30.0], still a minority; same instrument, not independent confirmation

§III-D & Appendix A: post-hoc audit of frozen control reference found three documentation issues (additionalDirectories reversed, missing sandbox.credentials, imprecise network sandbox) with no label changes reported
Appendix D: releases frozen sampling frames, commit-pinned manifests, seed 20260813, frozen classifier prompt (Claude Sonnet 5), control-reference audit, and analysis scripts
llm_evaluation.rationale: Empirical usable-security measurement of LLM coding-agent instruction files: how often security rules written in CLAUDE.md have a matching built-in Claude Code control. Strongly aligned with Agents & Tool Use and AI Safety preferences (agent permission controls, tool-use enforcement, guardrails, agent misbehavior context), with secondary fit to Code & Programming and LLM topics; not a pure domain application. The research question (coverage of developer-written security rules by existing controls) is genuinely new relative to Agent READMEs, Cursorrules, ContextCov/Prose2Policy, and Michael & Roesner, though the method is standard corpus-mining plus LLM classification with human validation. Rigor is unusually high: stratified 180-item validation with inverse-probability weights, repository-clustered bootstrap CIs, two blind annotators (κ=0.89 match gate, 0.77 security gate) with adjudication, extraction-recall audit, duplication/concentration sensitivities, second-frame replication (25.1%), and a transparent post-hoc audit of the frozen control reference showing no label changes. Evidence is solid but the headline is a wide 4–16% range driven by the matching standard rather than sampling error, classifier precision for matches is low (0.350), and extraction recall (66.3% [48.8, 82.0]) restricts the denominator. Generalizability is honestly bounded to Claude Code at a freeze date and a capped, relevance-ranked GitHub frame; frame B reuses the same instrument. Reproducibility is excellent: frozen frames, commit-pinned manifests, seed, frozen prompt, control reference plus audit CSV, and analysis scripts released.

primary_link.title: When "Do Not" Is Not Deny: Security Rules in CLAUDE.md vs Built-In Controls

recommendations.summary: In CLAUDE.md, "do not" is a natural-language instruction that the model interprets. Claude Code's deny is a built-in control that blocks an action before the agent can take it. Both can express the same security goal, but they control the agent in different ways. We measure this gap in 481 public CLAUDE.md files. An LLM matched the extracted candidate rules against Claude Code's documented controls, and two security practitioners independently checked a sample without seeing the model's answers
recommendations.summary_zh: 論文量測一個可用性安全落差：開發者在 CLAUDE.md 以自然語言寫安全規則，但 Claude Code 只有 deny、ask 等 permission rule 與沙箱等內建控制能確定攔阻；兩者形式相同、強制力不同，檔案與工具都不標示何者真有控制支援。作者蒐集 481 個公開 CLAUDE.md，以規則詞抽出 4,661 個候選片段，用 LLM 分類器對照凍結的官方控制清單，判斷各片段是否為安全規則、有無免寫程式碼的內建控制；再由兩位安全實務者盲測 180 個分層樣本，以逆機率加權與儲存庫群集 bootstrap 校正。結果顯示，依配對標準寬嚴不同，僅約 4–16% 的已抽取安全規則有對應控制，最嚴格估計為 4.4%（95% CI：2.6–6.7%），其餘只能靠模型詮釋；破壞性命令與網路出口較常有控制，授權與個人資料最少（此排名屬探索性）。分類器 recall 高但 precision 僅 0.350，常把可比對的命令或路徑誤判為完整涵蓋；兩位標註者對配對判定高度一致（Cohen's κ=0.89）。抽取召回率為 66.3%，比率因此僅適用於被抽出的規則。限制：樣本取自 GitHub 程式碼搜尋、非隨機；研究僅測書面規則與文件記載的控制，未涵蓋團隊以 CI、hooks 等其他方式的防護或執行期可靠性。CLAUDE.md 因此是「只寫不回」的安全通道，對缺乏安全背景的新手風險最大，作者呼籲平台標示規則有無控制支援、把無法強制者列為建議，並使執行可被觀察。

links.title: Understanding Evolution Strategies for LLM Reasoning: Broader Reasoning Coverage than GRPO

evidence: Abstract & Section 3.2: ES improves average Pass@1/16/32 over base and exceeds GRPO on Pass@16/32; GRPO falls below base on Pass@16/32 in 15 of 18 Easy-Setting comparisons (Tables 2-3)

Section 3.1 & Appendix A: Lemma 1 gives E[JS]=sigma^2/2(1-1/N)tr(I_x)+O(sigma^4) (Eq. 9); Proposition 1 (Eqs. 12-14) requires an assumed KL transfer-error bound epsilon_succ that is not empirically verified
Section 4.2, Table 4: Full ES relative L2 drift is 40.7-44.1x GRPO; largest ES updates concentrate in LayerNorm/attention parameters while GRPO's top updates sit in embeddings/LM head
Appendix D, Tables 11-12: magnitude-thresholded ES retains Pass@1 with changes of -0.351 to +0.488 points at ~78% update sparsity, degrading only beyond ~92%
Section 5.1, Table 6: N=16 within 0.01 of N=64 reward for 1.5B/3B models but only N=32 for 0.5B at update 300, supporting decreasing population-size needs with scale

Section 5.2 & Appendix E, Table 13: two-point/antithetic subtraction fails to reduce variance for regenerated GSM8K rollouts (kappa_pair 1.99-2.78) though it works for fixed-batch objectives (0.16), explaining one-point preference

Appendix G, Tables 14-17: complete hyperparameters, evaluation settings, prompt templates, dataset provenance/licenses; GitHub repository link given in title-footnote; no seed repetitions or confidence intervals reported for main comparisons
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-methodology work directly matching high-weight preferences (LLM reasoning post-training, GRPO/RL comparison, CoT, scaling/efficiency). Contributions are analytical rather than a new method: theory linking ES population JS diversity to Pass@K, empirical demonstration that ES avoids GRPO-style entropy collapse and Pass@16/32 degradation, functional-sparsity analysis of ES updates, and hyperparameter/scaling study. Theory is correct but partly standard (AM-GM, Pinsker, Fisher expansions) and Proposition 1 relies on a transfer-error condition (Eq. 12) that is stated as testable but not directly measured. Empirics cover 4 models, two settings, held-out suites, and careful estimator diagnostics (Appendix E), but main RL/ES comparisons appear to be single runs with no variance or significance reporting, and some deltas (e.g., +0.07-0.8 points, Table 11) are small. Reproducibility is strong: GitHub link, full hyperparameters (Table 14), evaluation protocol (Table 15), prompts, and dataset licenses. Novelty limited by existing ES-for-LLM work (Qiu et al., ESSA, EGGROLL) that the paper builds on.

primary_link.title: Understanding Evolution Strategies for LLM Reasoning: Broader Reasoning Coverage than GRPO

recommendations.summary: Evolution Strategies (ES) have recently emerged as a memory-efficient post-training paradigm for LLM reasoning. However, the optimization behavior of ES remains understudied, making it hard to define its advantage scope compared to mainstream post-training paradigms (e.g., Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO)). By systematically investigating ES dynamics and mechanisms, this paper first identifies a performance advantage of ES over GRPO, theoretically and empirically showing that ES can lead to broader reasoning coverage, thereby better exploiting the reasoning capabilities of pretrained LLMs. Theoretically, we show that verifier-projected Jensen-Shannon diversity across the ES population is helpful to higher Pass@K performances. Empirically, unlike GRPO, which exhibits entropy collapse, ES improves Pass@1 while attaining higher Pass@K than GRPO. We further develop a sequential GRPO-ES training strategy that combines GRPO's strength in Pass@1 with ES's gains in Pass@K. Second, we find that despite substantial whole-model parameter drift, the task-performance gains of ES are only contributed to a sparse subset of larger-magnitude updates. This functional sparsity suggests that large parameter movement need not imply widespread functional change, and held-out evaluations further show that it does not necessarily lead to catastrophic forgetting. Finally, we study how hyperparameter design affects the effectiveness of ES, demonstrating that ES requires a smaller population size in a larger LLM. These findings position ES as a distinct reasoning post-training paradigm rather than a less effective, memory-efficient alternative to GRPO.
recommendations.summary_zh: 本論文系統性探討演化策略（Evolution Strategies, ES）作為大型語言模型（LLM）推理後訓練方法的最佳化行為，並與主流方法 GRPO 比較。作者圍繞三個研究問題：ES 是否呈現與 GRPO 相同的後訓練特性、ES 是否必然導致災難性遺忘，以及何種超參數與估計量設計能使 ES 有效且可擴展。理論上，論文證明 ES 群體間的 verifier 投影 Jensen–Shannon 多樣性有助於提升 Pass@K；實證上，與出現熵坍縮、Pass@K 下降的 GRPO 不同，ES 在改善 Pass@1 之餘仍維持較廣的推理覆蓋率，作者並提出 GRPO→ES 與 ES→GRPO 兩種序列混合訓練，兼取 GRPO 的 Pass@1 與 ES 的 Pass@K 優勢。關於遺忘，研究發現 ES 雖造成整體參數大幅漂移（與初始化的距離約為 GRPO 的四十倍），但效能增益主要來自少數幅度較大的更新，集中於 LayerNorm 與注意力參數，展現功能性稀疏性；held-out 評估顯示能力大致保留，大參數位移未必導致災難性遺忘。設計研究進一步指出 z-score 獎勵正規化是關鍵要素，two-point 估計量對推理任務無優勢，且模型越大所需群體規模越小。限制在於理論結果依賴局部近似與傳遞誤差預算等假設，遺忘結論限於特定訓練設定，跨任務持續學習情境仍待驗證。整體而言，本論文將 ES 定位為獨立的推理後訓練典範，而非只是節省 GPU 記憶體的 GRPO 替代方案。
recommendations.title: Understanding Evolution Strategies for LLM Reasoning: Broader Reasoning Coverage than GRPO
recommendations.title_zh: 理解演化策略在 LLM 推理中的角色：比 GRPO 更廣的推理覆蓋率

links.title: Candidate supply and answer selection shape the value of LLM judging in multi-agent systems

evidence: Abstract (p.1): combining answer frequency with judge evaluation 'raised accuracy from 63.82% to 70.82-70.95%' by rescuing outnumbered correct answers.
Results (p.4): open committee reached 42.20% accuracy at 10.73x token cost vs 41.06% for majority voting at 4.96x; oracle ceiling exceeded actual accuracy by 13.13-14.38 pp.

Results (p.6): judge rank AUC rises with availability, fitted half-rise midpoint pgen=14.7% (95% CI 14.3-15.1%, R2=0.900) over 15,336 questions, 67,163 pools, 823,988 pairs; fixed-composition 2C/6W control preserves the rise (m=12.2%, R2=0.887).
Results (pp.9-10): rationale-answer swap perturbation reduces rank AUC to 0.482 vs 0.684 unperturbed (+0.173, 95% CI 0.139-0.208) across 713 matched pools.

Results (p.12): first-ranked selection beats majority voting by +13.52 pp at k=2 but -0.34 pp (CI includes zero) at k=16; incremental judging cost escalates from US$0.10 to US$6.28 per 1,000 additional correct answers.

Methods/Software (pp.24-25): analysis code versioned at GitHub (release commit 7840cf3dbde77e61a1b4349ad3239669a7502431) and access-controlled Hugging Face archive with revision hash; seeds reported for all resampling procedures.

Extended Data Table 1 (pp.37-39): per-benchmark fit diagnostics; MuSR combinations frequently flagged low-R2/diagnostic, showing non-universal reliability boundaries across generators, judges, and tasks.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A general LLM-methods paper (not a domain application) squarely aligned with high-weight preferences: multi-agent LLM systems, LLM-as-judge evaluation, reasoning benchmarks, and test-time compute scaling. It decomposes multi-agent accuracy into candidate generation, judge recognition, and terminal selection, showing a 13-14 pp generation-retention gap (Methods, oracle upper bound, p.16) and that hybrid frequency+judge-rank selection lifts accuracy from 63.82% to 70.82-70.95% on 81,390 frozen pools (Abstract, p.1; Results, p.9). Rigor is exceptionally high: fixed-composition 2C/6W controls rule out displayed-ratio confounds (p.6), tie-breaking and odd/even pool-size sensitivities are run (p.12), rationale-answer swap perturbations isolate what the judge reads (+0.173 AUC, pp.9-10), bootstrap CIs with fixed seeds appear throughout, and low-R2 fits (e.g., MuSR) are honestly flagged in Extended Data Table 1. Novelty is moderate: it extends known results on self-consistency vs. debate and judge biases, but the availability-reliability sigmoid (half-rise 14.7%, R2=0.900, p.6) and the generation/selection attribution framework are fresh empirical contributions. Evidence is strong but tied to two closed preview APIs (DeepSeek-V4-Flash Preview, Mimo v2.5) and mostly multiple-choice verifiable tasks; open-ended and live-interaction settings are explicitly left open (Discussion, p.15). Reproducibility is strong: versioned GitHub code (commit 7840cf3) and a Hugging Face archive with revision hash (pp.24-25).
topics: reasoning benchmarks (MMLU-Pro, GPQA, MuSR, MedXpertQA, HLE)

primary_link.title: Candidate supply and answer selection shape the value of LLM judging in multi-agent systems

recommendations.summary: Multi-agent systems (MAS) sometimes already have the potential to answer correctly, but still report a wrong answer. Explaining this outcome is difficult because generation, communication and final answer-selection rules usually change simultaneously. We conceptualize multi-agent reasoning as an evolutionary pipeline of candidate generation, peer communication and terminal selection, wherein consensus without quality control can exhibit patterns of memetic drift. We study two questions: (1) when
recommendations.summary_zh: 多代理系統（MAS）有時明明已產生正確答案，最終卻回報錯誤結果。本文將多代理推理概念化為「候選生成、同儕溝通、終端選擇」三階段的演化式流程，指出在缺乏品質把關時，共識可能出現類似迷因漂移（memetic drift）與多數偏誤級聯的現象，使受歡迎的錯誤答案排擠少數正確答案。研究先以四種醫療推理協定檢視此瓶頸，再於 MMLU-Pro、GPQA、MedXpertQA、MuSR 共 15,336 題描繪 LLM 評審可信度（Humanity's Last Exam 另行分析），並以 16,278 題、81,390 個固定候選池進行離線重放實驗。三大發現：其一，正確答案常已存在於候選之中，系統卻仍輸出錯誤，形成 13.13–14.38 個百分點的「生成—保留缺口」；其二，評審可靠度並非模型的固定屬性，而隨任務、生成器與正確答案可用度（pgen）變化，低可用度時甚至低於隨機；其三，結合答案頻率與評審排序的混合選擇規則，將準確率由 63.82% 提升至 70.82–70.95%，主要來自拯救被多數錯誤淹沒的正確答案。成本分析顯示，評審在小候選池（k≤6）最具成本效益，池擴大後多數決優勢追平、評審效益遞減。限制在於離線重放隔離了動態互動中的接收者中介選擇與轉換過程。本研究為設計防止正確答案流失的多代理架構建立清晰的診斷基礎。
recommendations.title: Candidate supply and answer selection shape the value of LLM judging in multi-agent systems
recommendations.title_zh: 候選答案供給與答案選擇形塑 LLM 評審在多代理系統中的價值

links.title: Calibrated Enough to Know, Not Calibrated to Act: Fabricated Evidence Makes LLM Agents Commit to the Unknowable

evidence: Abstract: across 12 frontier models commitment rises from 6.5% to 54.0% as evidence escalates; fully fabricated panel lifts commitment from 24.5% to 36.8%, statistically indistinguishable from 37.6% with real data
§3.1: scrambled minus rich is +0.7pp with 90% case-clustered CI [-2.1, +3.1]; restricted to three responsive models the difference is +11.11pp, CI [+4.17, +18.06]
§3.3: three Claude models carry the effect while four models never commit and three always commit; Qwen3.7-plus output unparseable on 75.0% of rows
§5: committed-call AUROC 0.346 (CI [0.280, 0.413]) and Brier Skill Score -0.124 against climatology, while matched answerable controls are answered at 98.6-100% accuracy (0 of 864 declines)
§6.6: tense-balanced control with 48 answerable-future and 54 unknowable-present items; trained 3B declines 0% and 100% of these respectively, within-tense J +97/+100
§8: under the reasoning-suppressing frontier framing, ablation seed 1 commits on 48 of 48 unknowable items with a real probability, and answerable accuracy falls to 50.9-73.8%
§7: trained 3B commits 0.0% at all four evidence levels on the original 40 cases, but frontier baseline was sampled at temperature 0.3 vs. the trained model's greedy decoding
Limitations: weather is the weakest instrument (no sealed outcomes, ensemble rain probability carries real skill), effect rests on one developer's models, intervention tested at one 3B scale

Data and code availability: all raw cached generations, analysis scripts, pre-registration released at github.com/Pranav-1100/confidence-calibration-evaluation, archived at DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22043517
Table 3 note contains contradictory statements about how many checkpoints back 'independent runs' vs 'main recipe' ranges (six/seven vs three/four), an internal editing inconsistency
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strong in-scope LLM-agent safety paper: measures when agents act on aleatoric (unknowable) questions under authoritative-looking evidence, isolating presentation vs. information via fabricated panels, then fine-tunes the act/decline gate. Preference match is excellent (agents/tool use, AI safety, calibration/interpretability, LLMs, SFT/DPO training). Novelty is solid: the full-fabrication control answering the v1 confound, action-level (not stated-probability) measurement, and the failure-boundary analysis (reasoning slot required) go beyond the abstention and calibration literature, though adjacent concurrent work (AgentAbstain, Pal et al., Sun et al.) reaches similar localizations. Rigor is unusually careful (matched answerable controls, degenerate-strategy baselines, TOST equivalence, case-clustered bootstrap, tense-balanced and sports-overlap ablations, disclosed post-hoc choices), but is dented by single-sample cells, a temperature mismatch in the headline §7 comparison, editing residue (contradictory range counts under Table 3), and heavy reliance on heterogeneous per-family behavior. Evidence is abundant with sealed outcomes in equity/crypto, but the pivotal fabricated-vs-real equivalence is carried by three models from one developer, and weather lacks sealed outcomes (disclosed). Generalizability is limited: one 3B architecture at one scale, effect concentrated in one model family, and the paper itself flags scale fragility. Reproducibility is excellent: verbatim prompts, cached generations, scripts, pre-registration, and archived DOIs released.

primary_link.title: Calibrated Enough to Know, Not Calibrated to Act: Fabricated Evidence Makes LLM Agents Commit to the Unknowable

recommendations.summary: An LLM agent shown a professional-looking market panel commits to a directional call on a provably unpredictable question far more often than one asked the bare question: across 12 frontier models, commitment rises from 6.5% to 54.0% as evidence is escalated. It commits just as readily when every number on the panel is invented: fabricating the entire display, so nothing the model can see is true except the question itself, still lifts commitment from 24.5% to 36.8%, statistically indistinguisha
recommendations.summary_zh: 本論文研究 LLM 代理面對本質上不可預測問題時，在行動層次的校準失敗。作者以封存結果的短期股價方向、加密貨幣價格、體育賽事與天氣預報題目建構不可知性基準，檢驗證據呈現方式如何左右模型的承諾（commitment）行為。結果顯示，12 個前沿模型收到裸問題時僅 6.5% 選擇回答，附上專業技術指標面板後躍升至 54.0%。關鍵的因果控制實驗指出：將面板上六項技術指標全數換成捏造數值，甚至整個面板完全造假，承諾率仍與真實資料統計上無異（36.8% 對 37.6%），證明觸發行動的是權威包裝而非資訊本身。失敗被定位在行動閘門：同批模型對可回答的對照題近乎全對，也能標記題目不可知（90%），但該判斷未被用來抑制回答；陳述機率的 AUROC 僅 0.346，比氣候基準更差。訓練方面，僅用 540 個骰子、硬幣、罐子與計時器等合成案例微調 Qwen2.5-3B，即能把原始案例承諾率降至 0.0% 並轉移到未見領域；但閘門對提示結構脆弱，當輸出格式不留推理空間時即失效，某次消融訓練甚至在 48 題不可知題目上全數承諾並附機率。限制包括天氣域缺乏封存結果、效應集中於單一開發商的模型、訓練僅驗證 3B 規模、殘留詞彙線索未完全排除。本文提醒：代理評估應審計決策而非陳述機率，部署環境中的權威儀表板可能侵蝕模型拒答不可知問題的能力。
recommendations.title: Calibrated Enough to Know, Not Calibrated to Act: Fabricated Evidence Makes LLM Agents Commit to the Unknowable
recommendations.title_zh: 校準得足以知道，卻不足以據以行動：捏造的證據使 LLM 代理對不可知問題貿然承諾

links.title: TraceML: An Empirical Analysis of Human-Agent Planning in Machine Learning Development

evidence: Abstract: '4,465 human Kaggle trajectories across 134 competitions, seven of which are also worked by two agent scaffolds, giving 430 paired human and 207 agent trajectories', with release at https://huggingface.co/datasets/jerryyan/TraceML.
§4.2: 'Humans pivot on 25% of transitions, Codex on 9%, MLEvolve on 58%... matched humans average +0.089 and MLEvolve −0.008' — quantified pivot-quality asymmetry.

Appendix D.1, Table 11: 'Every headline gap survives every fairness treatment, and every interval excludes zero', using two-stage cluster bootstrap (B=4000) over competitions, fork-lineage clusters, and runs, plus a GEE regression (z=−3.5 Codex, −6.6 MLEvolve).
Appendix C.1, Table 10: 100-item human audit of intent labels agrees 81% (κ=0.68), with a label-free proxy (error-fixing edits 11.1% human vs 1.5% Codex) supporting the finding.

Appendix F.1, Table 18: harness improves 5/7 competitions, two within noise (commonlit 0.510→0.505/0.517; equity 0.675→0.670/0.680); Abl-B (cadence without content) lands at or below baseline everywhere, isolating prompt content as the driver.
Appendix G: explicit limitations—public-notebook observability bias, humans not budget-matched, intent inferred not observed, non-independent trajectory units—bounding the claims appropriately.
Appendix B.5: extraction toolkit applied to five scaffolds (Codex CLI, MLEvolve, AIDE, Claude Code, Gemini CLI), supporting limited cross-scaffold generalizability of the pipeline.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly preference-aligned: an empirical study of LLM agent scaffolds (Codex CLI, MLEvolve on a gpt-5.4-mini backend) for autonomous ML development, with a planning-prompt intervention and a new process-level evaluation resource, directly serving the Agents & Tool Use, LLM, Prompting, and Evaluation preferences. Novelty is solid: per Table 1 it is the only resource combining scored intermediate versions, full code, and task-matched human trajectories, and the behavioral findings (pivot asymmetry, absence of solution revisits, 'ensemble in name only') are new process-level characterizations. Rigor is strong: unit-alignment checks (§3.3, App B.3), fairness treatments with cluster-bootstrap CIs and a GEE robustness check (App D.1), human label audits (App C.1), and ablation arms separating prompt content from re-injection schedule (Table 18). Evidence is weakened by a small paired subset (7 competitions, 10 Codex and 3 MLEvolve runs in the twelve-hour scope, Table 6), unstable short runs acknowledged in Table 7, correlational feature-rank associations (App E.1), and large unexplained harness jumps (amex 0.023→0.781, ranzcr 0.545→0.877, Table 18) suggesting baseline failures. Generalizability is limited by Kaggle-specific practices and one backend; authors concede platform bias (App G). Reproducibility is excellent: public HF release of corpus, schema, labeler weights, and pipeline, plus full prompts in App F.2. Not out-of-scope; this is core language-agent methodology.

primary_link.title: TraceML: An Empirical Analysis of Human-Agent Planning in Machine Learning Development

recommendations.summary: Large language models write correct code for isolated problems but remain far weaker at autonomous machine-learning development, where an agent must revise data pipelines, models, and validation over hours of feedback, and on most competitions still finishes below strong human competitors. Outcome-based benchmarks record this gap but not its cause, because they grade the final submission and discard the development process behind it. We introduce TraceML, which pairs human and agent work on the
recommendations.summary_zh: 本文探討為何大型語言模型（LLM）代理在自主機器學習開發上仍普遍落後於人類專家。既有結果導向基準僅評分最終提交，無法解釋差距成因。作者建立 TraceML 資料集，以統一的版本層級標註架構記錄人類與代理在同一批 Kaggle 競賽上的開發過程：涵蓋 134 場競賽共 4,465 條人類軌跡，並在 7 場競賽上配對 Codex 與 MLEvolve 兩種代理框架（在 12 小時預算下，207 條代理軌跡對上 430 條人類軌跡），每個程式碼版本均附分數、時間戳，以及動作、意圖、編輯幅度與分數影響等標籤。分析顯示：人類專家會在資料處理、驗證、模型調整與模型整合（ensembling）間交替，並回頭重啟先前擱置的做法；Codex 陷入為集成成員重新加權與微調提交的窄迴圈，MLEvolve 則原地變異模型。人類在 25% 的轉換中改變方向（pivot），Codex 僅 9%，MLEvolve 雖達 58% 但損益相抵；代理幾乎從不重訪先前的解法，顯示其搜尋缺乏記憶。以人類實踐提煉的規劃提示詞能修正部分行為，並在 7 場競賽中的 5 場提升分數，但整體投入輪廓仍呈代理型態，顯示指令只能縮小可化約為指令的那部分差距。限制包括人類軌跡取自公開筆記本歷史、未必反映全部工作，標註屬推論而非觀察，且雙方設定未完全受控。此研究將「代理表現較差」轉為具體可測的行為缺口，指出記憶與控制機制是未來代理設計的關鍵方向。
recommendations.title: TraceML: An Empirical Analysis of Human-Agent Planning in Machine Learning Development
recommendations.title_zh: TraceML：機器學習開發中人類與代理規劃行為的實證分析

links.title: LLMs Can Design Near-Optimal OR Algorithms

evidence: Abstract/Section 1.1 and Table 1: gpt-5.6-sol is 'no worse' than the best existing method on every instance in six of ten classes at each level, with nested logit the main exception (mean revenue 1.2% lower)
Section 3.3/Table 3: on six exactly solvable short-lead-time instances, gpt-5.6-sol matches the DP optimum at level 1 and level 2, with all 95% CI half-widths below 0.05
Section 6.1/Table 7: zero-compute ablation shows level-2 algorithms remain within 0.4 points of full-budget results on the lead-time sweep, while level-1 policies degrade by 3.5-13%
Section 6.2: frozen level-2 artifacts are re-evaluated on new holdout instances ('no model is queried again'), including continuous-utility MMNL instances designed to remove the two-type structure
Section 6.3: stability study runs ten additional level-2 draws per class; 'five of 97 repeated draws fail under the evaluation protocol' and selected artifacts are shown not to be outliers
Section 5.4: authors caveat that all 628 released MMNL instances have only two distinct product-utility vectors, so exactness on the benchmark does not imply a general exact MMNL solver

Section 1.2: acknowledges contamination risk ('we also cannot rule out that benchmark-specific information... appeared in model training') and that generated algorithms resemble combinations of known OR structures
Appendix A: all code, prompts, and complete run records (queries, reasoning summaries, executed code, outputs, token usage) are released at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/llm-or-algorithms-F9F2
llm_evaluation.rationale: A centrally LLM-focused empirical capability study: four frontier models are evaluated on algorithm design for inventory, queueing, and assortment benchmarks using a minimal untuned prompt with a Python sandbox tool, directly matching LLM (2.5), Agents & Tool Use (2.5), Code & Programming (2.0), and prompting-preference areas; it is an LLM evaluation, not a pure domain application. The level-1 vs level-2 taxonomy (instance solution vs reusable algorithm) is a clean framing, though LLM-for-algorithm-design is a growing area (CO-Bench, HeuriGym cited in Section 1.3), so novelty is good but not exceptional. Rigor is high: exact DP evaluation where feasible (Table 3), simulator validation against published values (Appendix B.1), zero-compute ablation (Section 6.1), frozen-artifact holdouts (Section 6.2), and a repeated-draws stability study (Section 6.3). Evidence is strong with per-instance tables, CIs, and timing data, but limited to three OR domains; the authors themselves flag the two-type structure of the MMNL benchmark (Section 5.4) and possible contamination (Section 1.2), which caps generalizability. Reproducibility is excellent: full prompts, code, and all run records are released (Appendix A, anonymous.4open.science link).

primary_link.title: LLMs Can Design Near-Optimal OR Algorithms

recommendations.summary: We ask whether large language models (LLMs) can design effective algorithms for well-specified operations research (OR) problems. We study inventory control, queueing network control, and assortment optimization. We evaluate two levels of LLM use: at level 1, the model receives one problem instance and returns a solution for that instance; at level 2, it receives only the problem class description and broad parameter ranges, and returns an algorithm that maps instance parameters to solutions. Hu
recommendations.summary_zh: 本文探討大型語言模型（LLM）能否為定義明確的作業研究（OR）問題設計有效演算法。作者在三大經典領域實驗：存貨控制（含缺貨損失、雙源採購、多階層配送）、多類別排隊網路控制，以及品項組合（assortment）最佳化，合計 34 個存貨、13 個排隊與 3,393 個組合實例。研究設計兩種呼叫層級：Level 1 針對單一實例直接求解；Level 2 只給問題類別描述與參數範圍，由模型回傳可跨實例重複使用的演算法程式碼。每個結果僅用一次未調校的提示詞，並附 Python 沙盒與固定運算預算。結果顯示，最強模型 gpt-5.6-sol 在幾乎所有實例上追平或超越既有最佳方法，包括精確動態規劃與逐實例訓練的深度強化學習基準；Level 2 成效尤為關鍵，且即使移除查詢時運算、或改在新生成的新實例上測試，表現大多維持。四個模型在八個月內陸續推出，能力差距明顯，顯示此技術快速進步。產出演算法結構可解讀，如 capped base-stock 變形、小型動態規劃與壓力型排程規則。限制包括無法排除基準資料汙染、未提供近似保證、演算法多為已知方法的重組，且問題類別定義過寬會誘發通用策略失效。整體而言，在文獻豐富的定義明確問題上，前沿 LLM 已能以低成本產生可檢視的強健演算法，可作為演算法設計的經驗基準。
recommendations.title: LLMs Can Design Near-Optimal OR Algorithms
recommendations.title_zh: LLM 能設計近乎最佳的作業研究演算法

links.title: Selective Regenerative Decoding: Trajectory-Level Intervention for Inference-Time Reasoning

evidence: Abstract and §1: SRD routes candidates to discard/keep/refine only degraded suffixes 'without requiring a larger target model' with claimed 1.28-1.36x sample efficiency gain over rejection sampling.
§4.2: 'On MATH500 with LLaMA-3.1-8B, SRD achieves 0.544 accuracy at N=10 using only 2,166 output tokens, scaling to 0.640 at N=100 with 21,840 tokens (Table 2).'

§4.1: RSD (Liao et al. 2025) excluded from main comparison 'because it assumes access to a larger target model for regeneration'; baselines are Temperature Sampling, Best-of-N, and Speculative Rejection.
§4.3: measured p_H=0.525, p_M=0.148, ρ̂=1.0, giving efficiency gain 1.28; Appendix F Table 6 reports gains 1.28x-1.36x across N=10-30 on one model pair (Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B + AceMath-7B-RM).
Appendix G Table 7: coupled seeded-generation comparison shows Δ_n=+0.36 (N=10) to +1.29 (N=30) in mean R_max, with refinement success 78-100%.
§4.4.2 Table 4: Reroute (global) best on MATH500 (0.5444) while Self-compare best on GPQA (0.3243), showing refinement effectiveness depends on reward model calibration.
Limitations section: 'SRD currently relies on fixed routing thresholds and heuristic boundary selection' and effectiveness depends on reward model quality.
Appendix E: temperature 0.8, top-p 0.9, thresholds θ_low=0.3/θ_high=0.5, 8xA100 with vLLM; Appendix D provides prompt templates; no code or artifact release is mentioned.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A core LLM inference-time decoding paper squarely within the LLM and reasoning preferences: SRD routes reward-scored candidate trajectories to keep/refine/discard and regenerates only degraded suffixes, positioning itself between Best-of-N and speculative rejection (§1, §3). Novelty is moderate: the segment-level intervention without a larger target model is a genuine delta over BoN, speculative rejection, and RSD (§2, §4.1), but it is an incremental composition of known reward-guided search ideas. Rigor is mixed: theorems are stated with full proofs (Appendix C), but the efficiency-gain result is essentially a ratio of lower bounds, and quality improvement relies on a strong assumed stochastic dominance (Assumption 3.4) that nearly assumes the conclusion; some proofs contain minor sloppiness (e.g., Lemma C.2's (1-p)^N typo). Experiments are reasonably thorough: four benchmarks, ten generation-reward pairs (Table 1), threshold/policy/interval ablations (§4.4), runtime breakdown (Appendix B), and direct measurement of p_H, p_M, ρ̂ and R_max gaps (§4.3, Appendices F-G). Evidence supports token-efficiency claims, though main accuracy-compute results are largely in Figure 2 without confidence intervals, ρ̂=1.0 across all N is suspicious, and validation of the theory covers only one model/dataset pair. Generalizability is decent across math, science QA, multi-hop QA, and instruction following at 1.5B-8B scale, but fixed thresholds and reward-model dependence are acknowledged limitations. Reproducibility is fair: hyperparameters, prompts, hardware, and seeding are documented, but no code release is stated.

primary_link.title: Selective Regenerative Decoding: Trajectory-Level Intervention for Inference-Time Reasoning

recommendations.summary: Inference-time decoding methods improve LLM reasoning by exploring multiple candidate trajectories, yet treat each trajectory as atomic: either retaining it whole or discarding it irreversibly. This wastes computation on partially promising candidates whose high-quality prefixes are abandoned alongside degraded suffixes. We introduce Selective Regenerative Decoding (SRD), which routes each candidate to discard, keep, or refine only the degraded portion of the suffix while preserving the useful p
recommendations.summary_zh: 推論時期的解碼方法如 Best-of-N 與 speculative rejection，皆把候選軌跡視為不可分割的整體：前者生成多條完整軌跡後挑選最佳，後者提前終止低分前綴，因而浪費前段優質、後段劣化候選的運算。本文提出選擇性再生解碼（SRD），將流程分為生成、路由與再生三階段：先取樣多條候選，再依排名正規化的獎勵分數導向保留、精煉或捨棄；可搶救的候選僅以較高溫度取樣重寫劣化後綴，保留有用前綴，且不需更大的目標模型。理論上，在溫和假設下，SRD 相較拒絕取樣有 1.28 至 1.36 倍樣本效率增益（公式為 1+ρ·p_M/p_H，隨候選池擴大成長），並具終止保證與弱單調性，最佳軌跡的期望品質亦嚴格較高。實驗橫跨 MATH500、GPQA Diamond、HotpotQA 與 AlpacaEval 及多組生成—獎勵模型配對，顯示 SRD 能以明顯較少的生成 token 達到與 Best-of-N 相當的準確率，並在低運算情境勝過 speculative rejection。消融研究指出精煉成效取決於獎勵模型校準：獎勵穩定時全域重排較佳，雜訊較大時局部自我比較更穩健。限制包括固定路由門檻、啟發式邊界選擇，以及對獎勵模型品質與偏差的依賴；重寫機制也可能放大獎勵偏誤。整體而言，SRD 以段落層級介入開啟準確率—運算權衡的新區域，僅需生成與獎勵模型，可與 speculative decoding 等技術疊加。
recommendations.title: Selective Regenerative Decoding: Trajectory-Level Intervention for Inference-Time Reasoning

links.title: Puro-2B: Poor Lab's Qwen2-1.5B Trained on RTX 5090 within $5090

evidence: Abstract: best checkpoint trained at compute cost less than $6.9K and approaches Qwen2.5-1.5B under the report's evaluation protocol; full recipe, data, code, and weights released under Apache 2.0 at the HuggingFace thu-pacman collection.

Section 2.2: reproduction-cost boundary explicitly excludes data preprocessing, proxy experiments, ablations, post-training, evaluation, and labor, defining the headline cost as marginal accelerator cost only.

Section 3.2 / Figure 10(b): blockwise FP8 increases validation loss by 0.0031-0.0039 relative to BF16 across five ladder sizes, mapped to 98.0% BF16-equivalent compute retention, with 1.36x median throughput at 1.7B and 1.34x quality-adjusted net speedup.

Section 3.3.1: 170M BF16 diagnostic shows MuonH reaches final validation loss 3.029 versus 3.073 for ordinary-LR Muon, while effective-LR-aligned Muon reaches 3.030, supporting the effective-LR schedule interpretation.

Appendix D: matched scaling ladder fits a 1.19x compute-equivalent multiplier for complete MuonH vs tuned Muon, with leave-one-out range 1.17-1.28x, explicitly labeled a counterfactual quality-equivalent saving.

Section 5 / Tables 11-13: curriculum initialization beats uniform in all three repetitions for focused (+1.77pp) and scaled (+2.02pp) GSM8K SFT, and broad instruction SFT improves the 15-task macro-average by +1.59pp with 13 of 15 components improved.

Appendix A (Limitations): no corpus-wide contamination audit against benchmarks is provided; Chinese capability is not an optimization target; the model is overtrained (~700 tokens per parameter) and the scaling law is a fixed-2B, recipe-specific scale-down curve.

Appendix H.4: available evidence compares complete Phase 2 configurations rather than a factorial experiment over data ordering, constant-LR continuation, and checkpoint averaging, so no isolated component gain is assigned.

Section 4.3.2 / Table 6: cross-model reproduction costs are estimated via 6ND with an idealized 70% MFU H100-equivalent rate; the authors state this yields a cost lower bound for counterpart models in most cases, weakening the Pareto-frontier claim.

Section 1 artifact list: model weights (10 checkpoints), data manifests and materialized components, training code (Puro-Megatron), and data-processing code (Kaiyuan-Spark) are released under Apache 2.0, with exact averaging checkpoint IDs (222,100-222,569) and seeds specified in Appendix H.3.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM pretraining methodology paper squarely in scope (LLM, training/optimization, scaling, data recipe). Novelty is moderate: FP8 blockwise training follows DeepSeek-V3, MuonH and CMA are adopted from prior work, and proxy-based data selection is established; the genuinely new parts are the trillion-token open-recipe pretraining on consumer RTX 5090s with explicit cost accounting, the Puro Cost Scaling Law framing, and the effective-LR schedule analysis of MuonH. Rigor is unusually strong for a tech report: matched scaling ladders with leave-one-out fits (Appendix D), a controlled 170M diagnostic isolating effective LR (Section 3.3.1), repeated post-training runs, and candid scope statements (Appendix H.4 admits no factorial ablation; Appendix A admits no contamination audit). Evidence is solid internally but headline cost comparisons rest on estimated 6ND/70%-MFU lower bounds for competitors (Section 4.3.2/Table 6), the $4.4K > Qwen2-1.5B margin is only 0.4 points on Avg15, and the curriculum gain may be partly contamination-driven (acknowledged). Generalizability is bounded: the scaling law is explicitly recipe-specific and fixed-2B (Appendix A), though FP8/MuonH/CMA components transfer. Reproducibility is excellent: weights, 10 checkpoints, data manifests, training and data-processing code released under Apache 2.0 with seeds and exact checkpoint IDs; minor gaps include the EULA-restricted GDR driver modification and gated data components.

primary_link.title: Puro-2B: Poor Lab's Qwen2-1.5B Trained on RTX 5090 within $5090

recommendations.summary: Language model pretraining has become almost synonymous with prohibitive cost, placing it out of reach for much of the academic and open-source communities. Although strong open-source efforts already exist, including open-weight models and open-source training recipes, a cost-efficient, hardware-accessible, and open-source pretraining recipe has long been missing. Even at a small scale, training Llama-3.2-3B costs over \$1.5M, and reproducing SmolLM3-3B needs over \$700K. In this report, we pre
recommendations.summary_zh: 大型語言模型預訓練成本高昂，即使小規模模型的重現成本也常達數十萬美元以上，使學術界與開源社群難以研究完整訓練流程。本文提出一套兼顧成本、硬體可及性與開源可重現性的預訓練配方，於消費級 RTX 5090 叢集上從零訓練 Puro-2B 模型系列。核心方法包含：選擇單位價格運算效能較高的 RTX 5090，並修改驅動程式啟用 PCIe P2P 與 GPUDirect RDMA；採用 blockwise FP8 混合精度訓練，保留約 98% BF16 等效計算、輸送量提升 1.36 倍；引入以 Hyperball 約束權重矩陣半徑的 MuonH 最佳化器，使有效學習率排程得以明確控制；設計課程式資料排序，搭配固定學習率延續訓練與六個 checkpoint 的等權平均（CMA）；並以小型 proxy 模型實驗引導資料來源篩選與混合比例。兩階段合計訓練約 1.4T tokens，僅計加速器租用成本約 6.9K 美元；最佳模型在 15 項數學、程式、推理與知識基準上超越 Qwen2-1.5B 並逼近 Qwen2.5-1.5B。作者另擬合 Puro Cost Scaling Law，估計約 4.4K 美元即可達 Qwen2-1.5B 表現；後訓練案例亦顯示課程初始化在 GSM8K 與廣泛指令微調後仍維持優勢。限制包括未做全面性基準污染稽核、中文能力非最佳化目標、屬過度訓練的稠密模型，且 scaling law 僅適用於本配方之縮減情境。本工作證明可負擔的開放式預訓練今日已然切實可行。

links.title: Feedback That Backfires: Why Small Language Model Agents Repeat the Call They Just Watched Fail

evidence: Section 6.1, Table 3: corrective gain negative for all 6 checkpoints with CIs excluding zero (e.g., SmolLM2-135M G=-23.92 [-25.86,-22.09]; Qwen3-0.6B G=-21.50 [-25.07,-18.18])
Section 6.2 and Table 5: decomposition attributes most of the effect to the surface-form term (copy 21.69 vs sem 2.23 for SmolLM2-135M), supporting the 'harness not model' claim
Section 6.5, Table 6: CodeRepair (MBPP with real interpreter output) shows the same per-token effect (~-1.09 to -1.23 nats/token across 3 models), guarding against ToolShed-specific artifacts
Section 7, Table 7: 'do not repeat' instruction moves repetition the wrong way (+0.16 [+0.06,+0.27] for SmolLM2-135M) while abstraction moves it by an order of magnitude (-21.68 [-23.20,-20.14])
Section 7.1: controls include a fail_other placebo (-13.71 [-15.33,-12.20], reported as a conservative lower bound), abstract_min variant, and length-matched neutral observation (copy 14.50 vs 16.64)
Section 8.3, Table 8: rollouts with Qwen2.5-0.5B on 24 tasks; drop harness raises exact repeat rate 0.31 to 0.80, ban reduces it to 0.08, but task success does not improve (+0 [+0,+0])
Section 10/11: limitations stated plainly - ladder stops at 1.7B (hardware-bound), 18% of actions are prose-not-call at this scale, greedy-only rollouts, ToolShed is author-built

Section 9 and Appendix A: CPU-only reproduction (i7-6820HQ, PyTorch 2.4.0+cpu), base seed 20260808 with named sub-streams, measured Transformers version drift of 4.9e-5 nats, NaN-guard after a lost run
Abstract and Section 6.1: aggregate claims (0.06 to 0.54 repeat probability; 19% greedy exact repeats) arithmetically consistent with Table 4 per-model values
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core in-scope LLM-agent methodology: a controlled token-level measurement of whether appending failed tool calls/error messages to ReAct-style transcripts helps small LLMs (Agents & Tool Use and LLM preferences, high weight), plus MBPP program repair (Code & Programming). Novelty is solid but not maximal: repetition self-reinforcement, negative-instruction weakness, and context contamination are known (the paper's Table 1 positions itself honestly); the new contributions are the corrective-gain metric, the counterfactual copy/sem decomposition, and decomposition-derived interventions including the counterintuitive finding that clean restart is the worst harness. Rigor is strong for the study's scale: teacher-forced deterministic scoring, task-clustered bootstrap with Holm correction, fixed perturbation operators for byte-identical items across models, placebo and length-matched controls, cache-free re-scoring verification, and an explicit failure analysis (Sections 7.1, 10). Evidence is internally consistent across two environments (~-1.03 nats/token in both) with CIs excluding zero on 90-100% of items, but rollout confirmation is limited to one model on 24 tasks, and the interventions reduce repetition without improving task success (honestly reported in Section 8.3). Generalizability is the main limit: ladder stops at 1.7B, ToolShed is self-built, rollouts are greedy-only; the authors explicitly decline to extrapolate (Section 11). Reproducibility is exemplary: full code/data release, CPU-only pipeline, base seed with named sub-streams, pinned environments with measured version drift, and verbatim prompts (Appendices A, F).
topics: small language models (SmolLM2, Qwen2.5, Qwen3, Llama-3.2)

primary_link.title: Feedback That Backfires: Why Small Language Model Agents Repeat the Call They Just Watched Fail

recommendations.summary: Agent harnesses record a failed tool call and its error message in the transcript and ask the model to continue, on the assumption that the error is corrective information. We measure whether it is. Defining the corrective gain of a failure record as the change in log-probability of re-emitting the action that just failed, we find the gain is negative for every instruction-tuned model we tested (6 checkpoints, 135M-1.7B, 4 families) in two environments: simulated tool calling and MBPP program re
recommendations.summary_zh: 代理框架慣於把失敗的工具呼叫與錯誤訊息附加到對話紀錄，假設錯誤回饋具有矯正性。本文實測得到相反結論：作者定義「矯正增益」，即紀錄失敗前後重新產出該失敗動作之對數機率的變化，在六個指令微調模型（135M–1.7B、四個家族）與兩種環境（模擬工具呼叫 ToolShed，及含真實 Python 直譯器輸出的 MBPP 程式修復）中一律為負，約每動作 token −1.03 nats，且在九成以上個別項目成立；固定候選集合上，重複失敗呼叫的機率由 0.06 升至 0.54，貪婪解碼在失敗後有 19% 項目逐 token 重現失敗呼叫。透過反事實觀察（分別回報失敗、成功或僅中性確認）分解，83% 的損害來自失敗呼叫表面字串誘發的複製效應，而非模型讀不懂錯誤；語義項既小且在不同環境下正負號不一致，故問題出在框架而非模型。據此，以執行時期產生的失敗描述取代逐字呼叫可消除 76% 的反轉，於解碼器封鎖已失敗字串亦有效且近乎零成本；加註「不要重複」指令無效；而依先前文獻建議清空上下文重試，反而使逐字重複率自 31% 暴增至 80%，是所有框架中最差者。核心原則：失敗後的上下文必須異於失敗前，且差異不得正是失敗動作本身。限制包括僅測至 1.7B 模型、於 CPU 以 float32 執行、失敗動作由固定擾動算子合成，且兩項介入雖降低重複卻未提升任務成功率（主要失敗來源是模型能力上限）。此結果對以小型模型建構代理極具實務價值：廉價的框架層級修改即可避免卡死迴圈。

links.title: SCIT: Testing Causal Cache Carriers in Latent Chain-of-Thought Models

evidence: Abstract: 'counterfactual arithmetic transfers primarily through value-cache suffix trajectories rather than hidden states, keys, reusable answer slots, or single-token triggers' - core carrier claim.
Section 5.1 / Table 19: CODI-GPT2 late layers 8-9 value target win 0.875-0.908 vs 10-11 block 0.017-0.029 and nonlate 0.000-0.008, supporting middle-to-late value localization.

Table 21 (Sec 5.1): matched corruption drops CODI-GPT2 recipient target win to 0.211 (dLP 13.655); Table 58 shows Sim-CoT-GPT2 drops only to 0.606, correctly tiered as directional rather than full necessity.

Table 43 (Sec A.6): three newly trained CODI-style seeds pass clean competence but show only 0.049-0.138 late-8-9 sufficiency and 0.026-0.089 corruption drops - an honestly reported negative replication bounding the headline mechanism to the original checkpoint.

Table 16 (Sec A.3.5): 16 carrier-threshold settings and .70/.80/.90 competence gates leave 12/12 large-N carrier calls unchanged; exact ties occur in 0.063% of 855,200 score rows - robustness of reporting rules.

Table 44 (Sec A.7): 1B augmented cells show latent-tail KV 1.000/prefix 0.000 while 8B cells invert to prefix 1.000/latent 0.000, supporting the competence-gated carrier-shift map rather than a universal claim.

Appendix B: code, configs, generators, and artifact builder public at github.com/YIDING4869/scit-emnlp-2026, but 'not local model checkpoints or large generated JSONL outputs'; Sim-CoT-GPT2 is a local reproduction (Sec 4/Table 7), limiting exact replication.

Limitations section: all cells are synthetic tasks; 'Balls, books, and coins are lexical surface variants of one two-hop arithmetic diagnostic, not a broad benchmark suite', with no exact counterfactuals available for natural GSM8K-like data.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly on-preference work: mechanistic interpretability of latent chain-of-thought in LLMs (GPT-2, LLaMA3-1B/8B, Qwen3-4B), directly matching high-weight preferences for LLMs, reasoning/CoT, and interpretability. The SCIT protocol (cache-segment, K/V-component, hidden-state, semantic-source, decoded, and matched-corruption grid for carrier discovery) is a meaningful extension beyond standard activation patching/IIA, though built from established intervention logic. Internal rigor is unusually high: tiered claims, competence gates, threshold/tie audits, and honest no-call boundaries. Evidence is strong but the full sufficiency-and-necessity closure holds for a single checkpoint, and the authors' own seed audit (Table 43) shows new CODI seeds fail to reproduce the mechanism (0.049-0.138 late-8-9 sufficiency), so the 'mechanism' is path-specific rather than a property of the training recipe. Generalizability is explicitly and severely limited to synthetic lexical variants of one two-hop arithmetic program; the 1B latent-tail vs 8B prompt-prefix split is diagnostic, not universal. Code/configs are public but checkpoints and JSONL outputs are not, requiring retraining for exact reproduction.

primary_link.title: SCIT: Testing Causal Cache Carriers in Latent Chain-of-Thought Models

recommendations.summary: Latent chain-of-thought models move intermediate reasoning from emitted text into continuous states, improving compactness but hiding the causal object. We introduce SCIT, the Suffix Cache Interchange Test, a causal protocol that constructs exact source-recipient counterfactuals, patches declared cache segments, and identifies which transformer object carries the counterfactual computation. SCIT combines sufficiency tests with K/V component splits, hidden-state controls, semantic source controls
recommendations.summary_zh: 潛在思維鏈（latent chain-of-thought）模型將中間推理從輸出文字移入連續內部狀態，更緊湊卻也隱藏了因果對象：當模型不再寫出推理文字，反事實計算究竟由 Transformer 內部哪個物件承載？本文提出 SCIT（Suffix Cache Interchange Test）：先建構來源—接收者反事實算術題，於潛在推理過程中修補宣告的快取區段，並結合 K/V 元件切分、隱藏狀態對照、語意來源對照、解碼驗證與配對隨機破壞，逐一排除較簡單的解釋後才判定載體。結果顯示，在 CODI-GPT2 與 Sim-CoT 風格的 GPT-2 檢查點上，反事實算術主要透過 value-cache 字尾軌跡傳遞，而非當前隱藏向量、key 路由、可重用答案槽或單一 token：三個以上字尾位置即達 0.984–1.000 的目標勝率，CODI-GPT2 的中晚層 8–9 value 區塊具備完整的充分性與必要性證據（配對破壞使勝率降至 0.211），Sim-CoT 檢查點僅提供充分性與方向性必要性支持。跨規模校準發現載體型態會轉變：勝任的 8B 算術、實體查找、關係鏈與運算式/清單任務改走 prompt-prefix 或全快取 K/V，且提示狀態在潛在展開前即已充分；未過勝任門檻的實驗組合一律不做機制判定。限制在於任務皆為合成算術與少數可控診斷，並非廣泛基準；訓練路徑與種子敏感，新 CODI 種子無法重現晚期 value 載體；跨架構比較含混淆因子，不應視為規模定律。本研究的價值在於提供快取層級的因果診斷契約，把「潛在步驟是否重要」推進為「哪個物件承載計算」，為詮釋潛在推理模型建立更嚴謹的證據標準。
recommendations.title: SCIT: Testing Causal Cache Carriers in Latent Chain-of-Thought Models

links.title: Equal Ranking Quality, Different Decisions: Training Order-Consistent LLM Scorers

evidence: Abstract: five trained scorers within 0.010 nDCG@10 have retained sets overlapping only 0.66-0.84 under reordering; OC-SFT flips the reader's answer on 0.125 of permutation pairs vs 0.149-0.164 for other order-targeting objectives.

Section 4: OC-SFT loss is a relevance-anchor term plus lambda-weighted order-variance penalty over N=2 shuffled views of the same window, targeting the order residual delta_B; attenuation not invariance is explicitly stated.
Section 6.3 / Table 1: OC-SFT tau-PSI 0.083 vs 0.209 single-order distillation and retained-set Jaccard 0.835 vs 0.656 at essentially equal nDCG@10 (0.459 vs 0.449).
Table 10: mitigation baselines close 63-71% of the stability gap (EMA 71.4%, order-avg T=10 62.7%, DebiasFirst 64.3%) while OC-SFT is 100%, with quality columns unmarked due to seed spread.
Table 21: OC-SFT retained-set overlap gain over single-order distillation is positive in 196 of 198 base-collection cells across 11 dense bases plus the MoE on all 18 collections.

Appendix A (Scope and limitations): admits no chain-of-thought, English-only collections, recurring ArguAna cost, GPT-5.4 tie-break sensitivity raising flip to 0.200/0.851, and that PINE-style attention restriction breaks the readout rather than being untried.

Reproducibility Statement: releases tau-PSI implementation, evaluation harness, silver labels, LoRA adapters for 11 dense-base students, and full configs; public suite runs 60-90 hours on one L40S, with Legal-A/B proprietary and GPT-5.4 rows less reproducible.
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope LLM methodology paper: studies order/presentation dependence in LLM scorers (rerankers, reward models, multi-doc QA scorers) and trains it down with OC-SFT, a consistency penalty over shuffled views added to distillation, evaluated on Qwen3/Gemma/Granite bases with LoRA SFT. Preference relevance is high — LLM fine-tuning, LLM-judge/reward-model reliability, retrieval reranking, and inference serving are all core LLM topics, though it is not a reasoning or agentic paper. Novelty is moderate: the consistency-regularization device and permutation averaging (BSC, RankVicuna, DebiasFirst) are prior art, and the paper honestly positions its contribution as stabilizing continuous per-candidate scores at the threshold and measuring downstream consumer decisions rather than rankings — a genuine but incremental reframing plus a simple objective. Rigor is exceptional: matched hyperparameter tuning across variants, 3-seed replication, paired bootstrap CIs, partition/marker/first-stage/score-collapse controls, 12 bases including an MoE, cost accounting (Tables 10-12), and an unusually candid limitations appendix (ArguAna cost, GPT-5.4 tie-break sensitivity, marker-renaming transfer failure, attenuation-not-invariance). Evidence strongly supports the central claim that equal nDCG does not imply equal decisions and that OC-SFT leads decision stability at one serving permutation (Table 1: Jacc 0.835 vs 0.656; answer flip 0.125 vs 0.149-0.164), with the gain holding across 196/198 base-collection cells (Table 21) and beating K=10 BSC on two of three consumers at K=1 (Figure 4). Generalizability is good across three tasks, sizes 1.7B-32B, and first stages, but bounded: English-only, no chain-of-thought scorers, transfer to marker renaming fails, and proprietary legal collections enter primary means (public-16 reported alongside). Reproducibility is strong: code, silver labels, LoRA adapters, prompts, configs, and runtime estimates released, with only GPT-5.4 rows and Legal-A/B flagged as less reproducible.
topics: LLM scorers (rerankers, reward models, LLM judges)

primary_link.title: Equal Ranking Quality, Different Decisions: Training Order-Consistent LLM Scorers

recommendations.summary: Rerankers, reward models and multi-document QA scorers score candidate documents or responses in one LLM prompt, so each score depends on their order. However, equal ranking quality does not imply equal decisions: on passage reranking, five trained scorers within 0.010 nDCG@10 retain sets that overlap by only 0.66-0.84 when reordere
recommendations.summary_zh: 本論文研究 LLM 評分器（重排器、reward model、多文件問答評分器）在單一 prompt 中為多個候選評分時，分數會隨候選順序改變的「呈現依賴」現象。作者指出排名品質相同不等於決策相同：五個訓練後評分器在 nDCG@10 相差 0.010 以內，門檻保留集合重疊率僅 0.66 至 0.84，連 GPT-5.4 亦僅 0.707。作者提出 τ-PSI 量化順序不穩定性，並將分數分解為順序邊際與順序殘差。實驗顯示 round-robin 分窗與 logit 校準等 prompt 層面修正無法改善決策，因此提出 OC-SFT：以教師單次標註為相關性錨點，對兩個隨機排列視圖的學生分數施加順序變異懲罰，在權重中衰減順序依賴。在 18 個段落重排集合、12 個基礎模型（Qwen3、Gemma、Granite）與多文件 QA、回應排名任務上，OC-SFT 維持排名品質，τ-PSI 由 0.209 降至 0.083，保留集合重疊升至 0.835，讀者答案翻轉率降至 0.125，優於單一順序蒸餾與需十倍教師標註的順序平均蒸餾，單一排列的穩定性更勝過現成模型平均十次排列。限制包括：懲罰達到的是衰減而非完全的不變性、無法泛化至標記改名、需要訓練監督成本，且評估皆為英文集合、未涵蓋推理導向檢索。此研究對法律檢索等高風險應用至關重要，並主張比較評分器時應一併報告下游決策指標。

Evidence strength is good for headline endpoints (Figure 4, Figure 14) yet several rich analyses (Figure 10 trajectory, network backbones, Protein Realms pilot) are explicitly illustrative or single-seed. Generalizability is partially demonstrated via AshenRealm and Protein Realms transfers, though functional validity remains simulator-internal. Reproducibility posture is exceptional: released code, prompts, traces, SHA-256 manifests, deterministic replay, commit hashes, and documented provider-call audits.

Language-model agents offer a new substrate for this process, yet most multi-agent systems rely on direct conversation, predefined roles, or centralized workflows. recommendations.summary_zh: SwarmWorld 探討一個核心問題：在沒有預先指派角色、配方或工作流程的情況下，去中心化的語言模型代理能否在共享世界中自我組織，建造出具備實際功能的科技，並勝過同等算力的獨立平行搜尋？作者建構一個由確定性模擬器驅動的持久空間世界，代理可探索、採集資源、測試材料、建造持久性人工物並撰寫可執行控制器；關鍵設計是「提案與後果分離」，代理的宣稱一律由模擬器獨立檢驗，並在移除所有代理後，以八組未見過的擾動排程進行留置盲測。透過 50 至 200 個代理的族群規模研究與 3,200 tick 長期實驗，論文顯示：共享世界在留置韌性、組合韌性與經驗證發明數上普遍優於 best-of-N 獨立搜尋包絡，但最強的單一人工物仍可能由孤立搜尋取得。未指派角色的代理自發分化出以人工物為中心與移動探索兩類行為，並出現多人協作建造、跨代理程式分岔與可執行技術世系；約 95% 的首次技術採用始於物理觀察而非直接溝通，顯式文化機制僅在特定指標與時間尺度上帶來效益。限制包括每組僅四個配對世界種子、單一模型與提示設定，且材料功能皆為模擬器定義而非實驗驗證。整體而言，此研究確立了「有界群體優勢」：互動主要促進多樣而持久的技術生態累積，而非全面優越的單項發明，並為語言模型群體社會提供可證偽的評估架構。
