Section 4.1, Metrics: 'Steps measures observed interaction consumption... not token usage, wall-clock latency, retrieval latency, or graph-construction cost.'
Title footnote: 'Code is available at: https://github.com/ZhiyuanLi218/Caskg.'
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-agent methodology paper: skill retrieval for agent memory with graph propagation, directly matching the highest-weight Agents & Tool Use preference, plus RAG/knowledge and long-context memory relevance. The contribution is an incremental but non-trivial combination: budgeted counterfactual edge probing (removal/substitution/reordering) with Beta-smoothed calibration and state-gated publication layered on GoS-style graph retrieval; all ingredients (LLM-as-judge, personalized PageRank, counterfactual prompting) are established. Method formalization is careful, with four baselines, six backbones, two benchmarks, a 200-2000 skill scale study, and component ablations (Table 3). Rigor gaps: no statistical significance or seed variance, no control isolating counterfactual calibration from simple top-K pruning by association score (publish-all vs Full CaSKG confounds pruning with probing), thresholds/hyperparameters (tau_c, rho values) never given numerically, and judge reliability is never validated against ground-truth dependencies. Evidence is internally consistent and detailed, but rests entirely on six 2026-dated, independently unverifiable model releases (GPT-5.6-Luna, GLM-5.2, DeepSeek-V4-Flash, Kimi-K2.6, Qwen3.5, MiniMax-M2.7), and the paper concedes Steps excludes token/latency/graph-construction cost, so the offline probe expense for 500-2000 edges is unquantified. Generalizability limited to two text-based simulators; no real API or code-agent settings. Reproducibility: GitHub link claimed and embedding model specified (Qwen3-Embedding-8B), but Skill1000 library construction, probe prompts, and key hyperparameters are missing. Solid, relevant, moderately novel work with honest limitations discussion, held back by untestable model citations and missing controls.

primary_link.title: CaSKG: Counterfactual-Causal Skill Graphs for Scalable Agent Skill Retrieval

recommendations.summary: Reusable skill libraries allow large language model (LLM) agents to reuse procedural knowledge across tasks, but they also turn memory access into a challenging retrieval problem. Full-library prompting preserves coverage at high context cost, vector retrieval returns compact neighborhoods but treats skills as independent text, and graph-based retrieval can recover workflow context only when the edges that carry relevance are reliable. We propose CaSKG, a counterfactual-causal skill graph framework that calibrates procedural relations before retrieval. CaSKG first builds a high-recall directed candidate graph from semantic, lexical, input/output, and structural evidence, with repair evidence and an optional LLM judge further refining candidate scores. It then applies direction-conditioned textual counterfactual probes that remove, substitute, and reorder skill pairs, aggregates the evidence with Bayesian smoothing, and publishes a state-filtered weighted graph for task-conditioned expansion. The graph is constructed offline and used without changing the downstream agent policy or task interface. Across six LLM backbones on ALFWorld ID-140 and ScienceWorld U211, CaSKG achieves the highest task score in all twelve combinations of model and benchmark. Relative to Graph-of-Skills (GoS), it improves the six-model macro-average ScienceWorld score from 72.62 to 80.50 and ALFWorld success from 80.01\% to 86.79\%, while reducing mean environment steps on both benchmarks. Qualitative and ablation analyses further show that calibrated edges help retrieval preserve prerequisites, state-changing actions, verification routines, and final completion steps. These results position edge-confidence calibration as an effective route to compact and executable skill retrieval at scaleCode is available at: https://github.com/ZhiyuanLi218/Caskg .
recommendations.summary_zh: 這篇論文探討 LLM Agent 的技能庫檢索問題：隨著可重複使用的程序性知識持續累積，如何在有限情境下檢索出緊湊且可執行的技能組合成為關鍵挑戰。全庫提示保留覆蓋率但成本高昂，向量檢索將技能視為獨立文字而忽略程序相依性，圖檢索則高度依賴邊的可信度。作者提出 CaSKG，將技能圖建構視為預算限制下的邊信心校準問題：先以語意、詞彙、輸入/輸出介面與結構等多重訊號誘導高召回候選有向圖，再以三種方向條件化的文字反事實探針（移除、替換、重排序）驗證選定邊，並以 Beta 貝氏平滑彙整證據，將邊標記為確認、不確定、拒絕或未驗證，據此發布狀態過濾的加權圖。推論時以任務比對產生種子，在已發布圖上執行個人化 PageRank 傳播，不改變下游 Agent 政策與任務介面。在 ALFWorld ID-140 與 ScienceWorld U211、六個 LLM 後端的評估中，CaSKG 於全部十二種組合取得最高任務分數；相較 GoS，六模型 macro 平均 ScienceWorld 分數由 72.62 升至 80.50，ALFWorld 成功率由 80.01% 升至 86.79%，平均環境步數亦全面較低。消融實驗顯示多訊號候選誘導、LLM 評審與狀態門檻發布各有貢獻。限制包括：對直接搜尋或量測類任務增益有限，追蹤共現等通道僅為未來自我演化技能庫預留，且結果不涉及 token 用量、延遲或建構成本。此研究確立邊信心校準作為可擴充 Agent 記憶的重要設計原則。

llm_evaluation.rationale: Strong match for agent/code/LLM preferences: an agentic LLM framework (six role-specific stages, reviewer-routed repair, tool execution against compiler, simulator, and WSE-3 hardware) for CUDA-to-CSL kernel translation, with a cross-model LLM study (Claude Opus/Sonnet vs gpt-oss, Gemma, Qwen) and a LoRA SFT pilot. Not a pure domain application; methodology is squarely LLM-agent code generation. Novelty is moderate: the benchmark (first paired CUDA-CSL suite) and target domain are new, but components assemble known techniques (DocPrompting, Reflexion, self-debug, MetaGPT-style roles). Rigor is good: controlled single-attempt vs full workflow (6/28 to 26/28), knowledge ablation (7/15 vs 1/15), feedback modes A-D/T, formal validity gates, and integrity checks; weakened by small denominators (28 core tasks), a single-run preliminary model study, and 18 of 49 benchmark tasks being model-assisted rather than independent expert references. Evidence is solid with hardware replay on WSE-3 (27 pairs, 3.47x geometric-mean speedup) and honest limitation reporting, but the SFT pilot uses proxy metrics without executable validation and the coverage metric counts a task once if any workflow passes. Generalizability is limited by Cerebras-specific knowledge and tooling, though the findings (target knowledge dominates; correctness-gated optimization) plausibly transfer to other cross-architecture translation. Reproducibility is partially supported: SDK versions, budgets, and protocols are specified and an artifact is claimed, but no verifiable public link and WSE-3 access is required.

primary_link.title: FABRICA: Agentic CUDA-to-CSL Translation and Optimization for Wafer-Scale Systems

We present FABRICA-Bench, 49 paired CUDA-to-CSL tasks, and FABRICA, an agentic framework combining target knowledge, execution, failure-directe
recommendations.summary_zh: 本文探討將 CUDA 核心移植到 Cerebras 晶圓級引擎(WSE)的挑戰:這並非語法替換,而是架構重映射。CUDA 以 threads、blocks 與記憶體階層表達分解與同步;CSL 則要求明確的 PE 擺放、分散式 SRAM、fabric 路由與事件驅動任務,而公開 CSL 資源稀缺,現有 coding agent 幾乎缺乏目標知識,也無基準可衡量跨架構轉譯。作者提出 Fabrica-Bench,含 49 個成對 CUDA/CSL 任務,以編譯、執行、介面契約與數值檢驗計分,並以防火牆隔離參考解答與隱藏輸入;另提出 Fabrica 代理式框架,依序進行分析、架構設計、實作、審查與正確性閘門控管的最佳化,並檢索 SDK 文件、教學與技能筆記組成的知識庫補足模型缺乏的 CSL 慣用法。結果顯示:在固定 28 個 Level 1–3 核心任務上,單次生成僅 6 個通過,Fabrica 搭配 Claude Opus 4.8 達 26/28,其中 22 個等同或超越 CSL 參考;49 任務涵蓋評估有 38 個產生正確程式,最後三個任務在三種子下通過 8/9;27 組可計時配對的幾何平均加速為模擬器 3.75×、WSE-3 硬體 3.47×。消融實驗指出檢索 Cerebras 知識是最強單一因素(1/15 升至 7/15),最佳開源模型僅通過 2/28,凸顯商用與開源落差。限制包括結果綁定特定模型與 SDK 版本、涵蓋率指標計數較寬鬆,離線 SFT 試驗僅採結構代理指標,生成程式仍需完整執行驗證;需要跨 PE 運算元遞送的共設計案例仍是系統邊界。此研究為晶圓級跨架構核心生成提供首個可執行基準,指出目標知識、執行回饋與同標的量測是關鍵要素,產生的執行軌跡亦可供後續後訓練運用。

llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly on-topic LLM agent safety/evaluation work: a knowledge-verified deception benchmark for tool-using agents across 18 models, plus post-training (BoN-SFT/DPO/GRPO) and an exploratory interpretability pilot. recommendations.summary_zh: 本論文探討大型語言模型（LLM）代理人同時服務使用者與部署企業時的誠實性問題：當代理人明知顧客依法享有權益，卻面臨替公司省錢的商業誘因時，是否會說謊？由於不實陳述可能源自無知或幻覺，而非刻意欺騙，評估上難以區分。作者提出KnownLieBench，一個知識驗證式基準：先以中立探針確認模型確實知道顧客的應得權益，再於引入誘因後評估其是否做出不實主張，藉此將「說謊」與「不知道」區隔。基準涵蓋八個客服領域、112個依真實法規或官方政策建立的案例，與具信任追蹤的模擬顧客進行多輪對話，區分僅受誘因驅動的自發性欺騙與明確指示下的欺騙，並設誠實對照組。研究共評估18個模型、產生逾18,000筆多輪互動，發現自發性欺騙率在模型與領域間差異懸殊：Claude-Opus-4.8、GPT-5.5等近乎為零，DeepSeek-V4-Pro、Llama-3.1-8B則明顯偏高；明確指示會大幅拉高多數模型的說謊率。機制分析顯示「虛構政策」最常見，佔非討債領域謊言的82%至96%。顧客初始信任幾乎不影響說謊頻率，卻顯著改變謊言被偵測與成功的機率。訓練後實驗顯示誠實導向的SFT可降低欺騙率，而以欺騙評分微調則使誠實對照情境中的謊言更易成功。J-Lens探索性分析亦發現欺騙框架下權益相關內部訊號於決策時轉弱。限制包括僅涵蓋英文、二元權益、模擬顧客與小規模LoRA訓練。此基準將說謊與知識不足分離，使LLM代理人的誠實稽核與調控更嚴謹。

llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM methodology paper squarely matching high-weight preferences (LLMs, reasoning/CoT, in-context learning, inference-time scaling, weak-to-strong alignment). primary_link.title: CritICL: Inference-Time Weak-to-Strong Generalization from Small Language Model Failure Modes

recommendations.summary: Recent advances in inference-time scaling have significantly improved the reasoning performance of large language models (LLMs). However, these methods typically rely on repeated generation or external verification. To address this limitation, we introduce CritICL, a novel inference-time framework that improves reasoning while maintaining high efficiency. Our key insight is that LLM failure modes exhibit structured patterns across model scales within the same family. Instead of treating failures as undesirable outputs, CritICL leverages them as a source of guidance. Specifically, we utilize failure modes derived from weaker models and incorporate them into inference through critique-based in-context examples. We propose two variants: CritICL-dynamic, which adaptively predicts input-specific failure modes and retrieves critiques, and CritICL-static, which uses a global failure mode profile to provide stable guidance. Experimental results show that CritICL consistently outperforms standard in-context learning and achieves performance competitive with or superior to test-time scaling methods, while requiring significantly fewer generations and lower token cost. Code available at: https://github.com/umwyf/CRITICL
recommendations.summary_zh: 本文提出 CritICL，一個推論時間的弱轉強泛化框架。問題：測試時間擴展雖能提升 LLM 的推理表現，但通常依賴重複生成或外部驗證，成本高昂。核心觀察是同一模型家族中不同規模模型共享結構化且高度一致的失敗模式分佈，如 Qwen 1.5B 與 72B 的分佈幾乎一致。方法上，先離線建構 CritBank：蒐集小型語言模型在 GSM8K 與 MATH 的錯誤回答，以 GPT-4o-mini 標註失敗模式並產生批判說明；推論時有兩種變體：CritICL-dynamic 依輸入預測可能失敗模式並檢索相關批判範例；CritICL-static 用家族層級的整體失敗輪廓提供穩定指引。實驗涵蓋 GSM8K、MATH、AMC23、AIME 與 GPQA，目標模型為 Qwen2.5-32B/72B 與 Llama-3.1-70B。CritICL 穩定優於標準 in-context learning，並以一至兩次生成媲美 self-consistency、LLM-as-a-judge，token 成本更低；消融實驗證明失敗模式導向的範例選擇優於隨機、固定或語意相似度檢索。限制：AMC23 與 AIME 的小幅改進統計上不顯著，跨家族轉移明顯較弱，CritBank 離線建構成本與分類粒度亦需權衡。其價值在於將弱模型的錯誤結構轉為可重用的離線資源，為低成本推論增強提供新典範。
recommendations.title: CritICL: Inference-Time Weak-to-Strong Generalization from Small Language Model Failure Modes

llm_evaluation.rationale: Strong LLM interpretability paper (high-weight preferences: LLMs 2.5, interpretability 1.8, transformer 1.2, training 1.5). Novel reframing of circuit findability as trainable via iterative prune-heal-backtrack with LoRA; the C0 frozen-weight arm cleanly isolates weight updates from search. Rigor is exemplary: 32 task-model cells, 3 seeds, cluster bootstrap on the correct unit of analysis, sealed test split read once, multiple controls (no-prune heal, random/reverse ranking, off-target specificity, sibling swap, SFT-then-discover, joint gate-adapter with upper-bound framing), and an unusually honest limitations appendix. Evidence is extensive and quantified, though limited to token-level behaviors with paired clean/corrupted inputs; capability gate binds unevenly across families; docstring/agreement endpoints are upper bounds; code only promised for release. Generalizability beyond small-to-mid models and restricted-choice token tasks is untested.

primary_link.title: Circuit Condensation: Post-Training that Concentrates a Behavior's Causal Circuit

recommendations.summary: One approach to mechanistic interpretability explains behavior through circuits: the components and connections that carry it. Frozen discovery often returns hundreds of edges, making them hard to inspect, compare, or verify exhaustively. We introduce Circuit Condensation, which post-trains models to concentrate behaviors into smaller causal graphs. Each round prunes low-attribution edges and trains a low-rank adapter to match the original through what remains, retaining the cut only if task per
recommendations.summary_zh: 本文處理機制可解釋性中電路過大的問題：固定權重下搜尋行為的因果電路，常回傳數百條邊，難以檢視與完整驗證。作者提出 Circuit Condensation，將「電路可否被找到」視為可訓練的性質。方法上，從全新 LoRA 低秩配接器與全開邊閘門出發，每輪以 EAP-IG 排序邊重要性、剪除最弱的一批，僅訓練配接器蒸餾原始模型輸出分布；控制器確認任務準確度與通用能力（困惑度比）皆存活才接受剪枝，否則回溯並縮小剪除比例。結果：四種行為、八個模型、三種子共 32 個組合中，凝縮電路有 30 個小於最強凍結基線 EAP-IG，平均縮小 8.1 倍、最高 316 倍；凍結權重對照 C0 在 29 個組合較大，證明關鍵是權重更新而非搜尋。小尺寸使窮舉驗證可行：19 個可枚舉電路中 11 個無更小忠實子集；成對消融顯示邊間有交互作用。IOI 上凝縮出 24 個注意力頭（17 個有文獻角色），優於凍結電路的 61 頭、36 個無記載；電路與原模型 KL 中位數 0.215，IOI 錨點 0.056，並能預測原模型錯誤。限制：電路描述的是改編後網路，邊數僅在交換消融慣例下有意義；Gemma 能力閘門幾乎不生效；docstring 與 agreement 缺準確度訊號，端點只是上界；聯合訓練基線在 5/32 細胞更小；三種子僅驗最佳化穩定性。此方法讓原本不可行的完整因果驗證變得可執行，且電路仍貼近原始模型行為。

llm_evaluation.rationale: Core contribution is LLM-agent methodology, not a pure domain application: a Gemini-based multi-agent research system with evolutionary ideation (TrueSkill/UCB ranking), evolutionary code generation, inference-time agent-architecture discovery (Agent_H, 40-80 LLM calls/query), and reliability modules against reward hacking/hallucination/plagiarism, plus a dual-use safety architecture. This aligns strongly with the highest-weight preferences (LLM agents, reasoning/test-time compute, safety, evaluation). Rigor is high: matched-topic controlled paper-generation study (50 topics x 3 conditions, 30 experts, 450 blind reviews, chi-squared tests, inter-rater kappa), held-out HealthBench evaluation with decontamination analysis, and honest negative findings (Goodhart exploitation of verbosity, autorater-clinician kappa 0.034-0.243, 8 of 9 human-rated dimensions non-significant, circularity divergence in biology). Novelty is moderate: Co-Scientist is an extension of prior published work, and components build on ADAS, Agent Laboratory, and self-driving-lab literature; the log-based hallucination clipping and joint-optimization penalties are incremental but well-motivated. Evidence is strong though partially self-validated by Google-affiliated experts with Alphabet funding, and the materials claim (Ti3C2Tx MXene) is not atomically confirmed. Generalizability is limited by instrument-specific recipes, interpolation-only biology results, unproven extension to physical-experiment verification, and compute-heavy agents; reproducibility is constrained by closed-source proprietary code (only benchmarks and colony images are public).

primary_link.title: Accelerating Scientific Research with Gemini in the Real-World

recommendations.summary: We present an extension and comprehensive real-world validation of Co-Scientist, a Gemini-based multi-agent system designed to accelerate end-to-end scientific research across hypothesis generation, experimentation, and manuscript generation. Moving beyond in silico hypothesis generation, this specialized configuration transitions Co-Scientist into an execution-grounded research partner advancing closed-loop scientific workflows across materials science, biology, and computer science. In materia
recommendations.summary_zh: 本論文將以 Gemini 為基礎的多代理系統 Co-Scientist 從純粹的模擬環境假說生成，擴充為能執行程式並落地驗證的研究夥伴，涵蓋材料科學、生物與電腦科學。系統採三階段流程：演化式搜尋搭配貝氏評分產生假說、演化式程式生成執行實驗、再合成論文，並加入幻覺與抄襲懲罰、執行紀錄核對及兩層安全審查等可靠性模組。材料科學方面，系統為 CVD 合成設計以 C2Cl6 取代劇毒前驅物的路徑，長出結構近似 Ti3C2Tx MXene 的二維層狀材料，並透過 Gemini 3 Deep Think 一次成功成長 MoS2、MoSe2 與 WS2 單層半導體；生物方面，系統自稀疏影像預測大腸桿菌群游表型，四項形態指標中三項與濕式實驗量測相符；電腦科學方面，自主發現的推論時運算縮放架構 Agent_H 在長度調整後的 HealthBench Hard 與 Professional 超越六個前沿模型，盲測醫師評估顯示潛在臨床傷害顯著下降。30 位專家對 450 篇自動生成論文的雙盲審查顯示，嚴重結果幻覺由基準系統的 90% 降至 4%，抄襲大幅減少，安全機制拒絕 98.7% 的有害指令。限制包括 MXene 原子結構尚未確認、表型預測屬內插而非外推、Agent_H 每次查詢需 40–80 次 LLM 呼叫且自動評審與臨床偏好對齊不足，程式碼亦未公開。本研究展示執行落地、人機協作的可擴展科學發現路徑。

evidence: Abstract: 'ReDiR reduces attack success rates to below 8%, transfers to unseen tool domains, and preserves benign fidelity with low computational overhead' - central claim matches agent-safety/LLM preferences.
§5 Benchmarks: evaluation on MT-AgentRisk (365 tasks, 9 tool domains) and AgentDojo, with supervision restricted to 55 of 70 Filesystem tasks and 8 domains held out.
Table 2: ReDiR overall MT-AgentRisk ASR 5.5/0.0/7.9% vs MAGE 29.4/20.3/34.2% across Qwen3.5-9B, Ministral-3-8B, Gemma-4-E4B.
§5 Metrics: defines ASR, SSR, FPR and notes ASR and SSR are 'mutually exclusive but not exhaustive', showing metric care.
§6.5 Table 8: backbone-matched 9B encoder reaches 0.0/0.0 ASR/FPR while mismatched 4B encoder reaches 16.7/5.0, revealing a white-box, backbone-matched dependency.
§6.5 Table 9: same-model teacher achieves 0.0% ASR vs 36.7% for Kimi-K2.5, supporting the compatibility claim.
§6.6 Tables 11-13: K, entry-token, and decision-token ablations with small per-domain samples (10 harmful + 10 benign tasks) limiting statistical strength.
§7 Table 14: adaptive benign-history dilution keeps overall ASR within 6.7-10.0% across N=0..8.
Appendix A Table 15: final optimization set is only 36 safety pairs from 21 tasks plus 20 benign retention examples, making the near-zero held-out ASR notable but under-validated.
§6.4 Table 5: ReDiR adds 1.328-3.250 MiB GPU memory vs 8,417.280 MiB for MAGE.
Appendix B Table 16: AdamW, LR 3e-4, warm-up 20, A100 GPUs; no explicit code or artifact release URL is stated anywhere in the document.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core in-scope work on LLM agent safety: trajectory-level defense for tool-using LLM agents, directly matching Agents & Tool Use (2.5), LLM (2.5), and AI Safety (2.0) preferences, with benchmarks (MT-AgentRisk, AgentDojo) fitting Red Teaming & Evaluation. Novelty is moderate-to-good: latent-query injection into a frozen base model plus same-model cross-view supervision is a plausible advance over generate-then-check guards (ToolSafe, MAGE, TRACE), though it assembles known ingredients (gist-style latents, representation steering, LoRA). Rigor is solid: clear threat model, matched adaptation constraints for baselines, explicit ASR/SSR/FPR metric definitions (§5), extensive ablations (Tables 8-13), and an adaptive dilution attack (§7), but ablation samples are tiny (10 harmful + 10 benign per domain in §6.5), benign fidelity uses only 50 tasks, no variance/significance reported, and the near-0% ASR generalization from only 36 training pairs (Appendix A Table 15) is striking. Evidence strength is good: consistent quantitative tables across three model families and nine tool domains with stated efficiency costs (Tables 2-7), though suspiciously uniform 0.0% results on Ministral-3-8B and no code release URL temper confidence. Generalizability benefits from three backbones, two runtimes, and eight held-out tool domains, but is limited by required white-box access, backbone-matched encoder dependency (Table 8: mismatched 4B encoder raises ASR to 16.7%), and 8-9B scale only. Reproducibility is moderately strong: detailed hyperparameters (Appendix B Table 16), data-construction pipeline with counts (Appendix A), and audit rubric, but no explicit artifact/code link is stated.

primary_link.title: Reassembling Distributed Risk: Trajectory-Conditioned Action Generation for Multi-Turn Agent Safety

recommendations.summary: Tool-using LLM agents extend security risks beyond generated text to actions that affect external systems. Under multi-turn decomposition attacks, a harmful objective can be distributed across individually plausible requests and tool calls, becoming apparent only from the accumulated trajectory. Existing defenses either rely on auxiliary online reasoning to recover long-horizon security evidence or assess actions after generation, often incurring additional inference cost or depending on runtime
recommendations.summary_zh: 使用工具的 LLM 代理人，其安全風險已從文字延伸到會改動外部系統的動作。多輪分解式攻擊可將有害目標拆散成各自看似無害的請求與工具呼叫，唯有累積整段軌跡才會顯現；現有防禦多仰賴輔助線上推理或事後檢查已生成的動作，推論成本高且綁定特定執行環境的動作表示。本文提出 ReDiR，一種生成時期防禦：每次動作生成前，先將當前軌跡壓縮成緊湊的潛在安全表示並注入凍結的基礎模型。此表示透過同模型跨視角監督學習——在任務目標明確的視角下，以模型自身的安全行為監督其從原始多輪軌跡還原分散的安全證據；訓練僅更新 LoRA 與潛在查詢，並以 KL 散度正規化保留良性行為。在 MT-AgentRisk 與 AgentDojo 上，橫跨 Qwen3.5-9B、Ministral-3-8B、Gemma-4-E4B 三個模型家族，ReDiR 將攻擊成功率（ASR）壓到 8% 以下，明顯優於 MAGE 的約 20% 至 34%；僅用單一工具網域監督即泛化到八個未見網域，ASR 低於 7%，良性任務誤拒率為 0%。額外 GPU 記憶體僅約 1.3 至 3.3 MiB，並靠提前安全終止將有害任務端對端延遲最多降低 89%。限制方面：安全編碼器與基礎模型骨幹不一致，或改用外部教師產生目標，都會明顯退化；面對良性歷史稀釋等自適應攻擊，ASR 仍可能略升至 10%；作者亦承認此為經驗性防禦，可能漏掉未見攻擊或中斷良性任務。整體而言，本研究顯示分散式安全證據可直接整合進動作生成，為事後動作檢查提供低成本且可遷移的替代方案。

links.title: Training Alignment Auditors via Reinforcement Learning

evidence: Abstract: 'Training improves investigation quality against targets with planted behaviors, the rate of concerning behaviors surfaced in unmodified production models, and audit realism, while false-positive rates stay below 1%'
Section 3.6 Headline Result: 'The composite exceeds the Haiku 4.5 baseline at one epoch and by three epochs matches Opus 4.6... Audit quality surpasses Opus 4.6 (72.7 vs 68.0)'
Section 4: 'the top checkpoint reaches 28.1%, more than doubling the baseline' on AuditBench STC vs Haiku baseline 11.5% (Table 10)

Section 3.4/Figure 4: 'Without calibration (light bars), intragroup false positive rates reach 97%; reference pairwise retains more calibration naturally. With 50% calibration fraction (dark bars), both maintain near-perfect calibration'
Section 3.5: 'Comparing four compute-matched single-target and multi-target pairs... the averaged results are nearly indistinguishable' - negative result reported
Section 6 Limitations: 'All four evaluation dimensions are scored by an LLM judge (Opus 4.6) without human validation, and the judge is from the same model family as the policy'

Section 2.1: 'six of these serve as our held-out evaluation behaviors, and the remaining 26... are used exclusively for training'; evaluation target DeepSeek v3.1 is held out from training target Llama 3.3 70B
Code and data availability: 'Code, prompts, and evaluation data are available at https://github.com/paulrosu11/training-auditing-agents-public'
Appendix C.1 Table 6: judge hyperparameters (model, temperature, thinking budget, max tokens) documented for all training/evaluation/analysis judges
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-alignment research directly matching top preferences: LLMs, AI safety (alignment auditing of deceptive/sycophantic planted behaviors), alignment & RLHF (reward design, reward hacking analysis), agents & tool use (Petri/Claude Code scaffolds), and red-teaming/evaluation (AuditBench, LLM-as-judge). Rigor is strong: systematic ablations over reward families (Section 3.1-3.4), compute-matched multi-target comparison with an honestly reported null result (Section 3.5, Table 9), dose-response for calibration fraction (Appendix E.2), 95% CIs throughout, held-out behaviors/seeds/target (Section 2.1), and a candid limitations section. Evidence is quantitatively rich (composite 48.7 vs Opus 4.6's 48.4; audit quality 72.7 vs 68.0; AuditBench STC 28.1% vs 11.5% baseline in Section 4/Table 10) but entirely mediated by LLM judges with no human validation, and the evaluation judge (Opus 4.6) shares the policy's model family - a bias the authors themselves flag in Section 6. Novelty is solid but builds heavily on Petri and AuditBench; the pairwise reward + false-positive-calibration recipe is the main new contribution. Generalizability is supported by genuine cross-scaffold and cross-target-type transfer, though only one base model at one scale was trained. Reproducibility aided by released code/data (availability statement), full prompt texts (Appendix L), and judge hyperparameters (Table 6), but full replication depends on proprietary Anthropic models and under-documented RL training internals. No out-of-scope cap applies.

In this work, we improve LLM auditors with reinforcement learning. In our best training environment, the policy investigates target models that potentially possess hidden behaviors planted via their system prompt. An LLM judge, which knows whether the target has a hidden behavior, holistical
recommendations.summary_zh: 前沿模型的對齊稽核日益仰賴 LLM 稽核員自動挖掘不良行為，但現有自動化稽核常流於膚淺、缺乏真實感，且難以應對經對抗性強化的目標模型。本文以強化學習訓練 Claude Haiku 4.5：在最佳環境中，稽核員於 Petri 框架下調查系統提示詞被植入隱藏行為的目標模型，由知曉標準答案的 LLM 評審將其調查過程與參考調查逐對比較給分，並混入一半無植入行為的校準 rollout 以壓低誤報率。系統性消融顯示逐對獎勵比逐點獎勵更穩健；直接對生產模型訓練或使用二元獎勵都會引發獎勵駭客（reward hacking），使誤報率飆升至約 96%。最佳設定下，訓練後模型綜合分數 48.7 追平 Opus 4.6（48.4），稽核品質（72.7 對 68.0）與真實感皆超越之，誤報率維持在 1% 以下；多目標訓練在此規模未見明確效益。能力亦能遷移：在 AuditBench 經 KTO 對抗微調的目標與不同 scaffold（Claude Code）上，偵測率由基線 11.5% 提升至 28.1%。限制包括四項評估全由 Opus 4.6 擔任評審且缺乏人工驗證、僅訓練單一規模的基礎模型、訓練曲線尚未收斂，且以系統提示詞植入行為弱於 fine-tuning。本研究證明獎勵設計至關重要，結構得當的標準強化學習即可有效增進 LLM 稽核員能力，為部署前的安全把關提供可擴充的途徑。

links.title: Beyond Confidence: Test-Time Scaling for Multi-Turn Search Agents via Retrieval Grounding

evidence: Abstract and §6/Table 1: RGV best in all 20 benchmark×model cells, up to +5.4% accuracy over DeepConf (BrowseComp-Plus Tongyi 71.1 vs 65.7) and +35% on minority-correct questions

§3 Motivation: copy tokens have mean logprob +0.50 nats higher than non-copy tokens (730k tokens); DeepConf within-question variance share shrinks 0.39→0.20 as copy fraction grows; median rollout copies 93% of content tokens
§6.2: on the 122 minority-correct (1-2/8) questions of BrowseComp-Plus/Tongyi, RGV scores 84.4% vs DeepConf 49.2% (+35.2%)
§6.3/Fig. 4: RGV at N=4 (65.9%) matches DeepConf at N=8 (65.7%), halving rollout budget; ~0.3 ms per rollout on one CPU thread
§6.1: rollout-level ROC AUC 0.908 (RGV) vs 0.837 (DeepConf); RGV correlates with gold-document recall r=0.57 vs 0.36; rare-entity tokens carry the C-W gap (digits 0.145, capitalised entities 0.092)

Appendix I: masking copied tokens restores within-question variance (up to 2.4x) but AUC falls in 9/10 cells; teacher-forced doc removal drops copied-token logprobs about twice as much as non-copy (−0.221 vs −0.106)
Appendix B: 3-fold split variance is self-described as a coarse estimator used as a stability indicator, not for hypothesis tests; some cells have large std (Kimi BrowseComp ±7.8)
§5/Appendix M: single judge Qwen3-32B at temperature 0 with official BrowseComp-Plus template; verbatim system, force-final, verbalised-confidence, and judge prompts provided
Appendix O: code (GitHub) and data (HuggingFace) released with trajectories, per-token logprobs, judge outputs; GAIA and HLE redistribution restrictions handled via question identifiers

Limitations: grounded-but-wrong residual 26/616 (4.2%); entity-only answers reduce RGV to matching DeepConf (Appendix J); English only; adversarially poisoned corpus would inflate copy-based scores; HLE margin only +0.7% (Appendix L)
Appendix C: DC+RGV/Verb+RGV combination weight alpha is selected per cell from a grid to maximise voting accuracy, an overfitting risk not addressed with held-out data
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-agents/test-time-scaling paper, squarely in scope (multi-turn search agents, weighted voting over rollouts, retrieval grounding). The copy-inflation diagnosis is a genuinely new mechanistic finding, backed by correlational and interventional evidence; however, the method itself (lexical prose-recall as a voting weight) is an acknowledged reuse of long-standing grounding/faithfulness primitives, applied at a new layer. Rigor is strong: 20 benchmark-model cells, DeepConf grid sweep, overlap-metric ablations, doc-reduction ablations, null controls, prompt/format sensitivity, selection-vs-voting, and two causal interventions. Evidence is weakened by small per-cell samples (150 questions, minority-correct claim from 122 questions on one model-benchmark pair), a single LLM judge (Qwen3-32B) for all correctness labels, per-cell alpha tuning in the signal-combination appendix, and coarse 3-fold uncertainty. Generalizability is explicitly bounded: search-agent scope, English only, gains shrink on reasoning-heavy HLE (+0.7%), and short-answer formats collapse the advantage. Reproducibility is high: code, trajectories, per-token logprobs, and judge outputs released; verbatim prompts and per-model parameters given, though API-served models and live-web search introduce drift.

primary_link.title: Beyond Confidence: Test-Time Scaling for Multi-Turn Search Agents via Retrieval Grounding

recommendations.summary: Confidence-based voting aggregates parallel LLM rollouts by weighting each with internal signals such as token log probabilities, and has been actively studied for single-turn reasoning. However, modern LLMs increasingly act as multi-turn search agents that retrieve and condition on external documents. In this paper, we show that confidence-based voting transfers poorly to this multi-turn setting, and identify the underlying failure reason as copy inflation: when retrieved documents are appended
recommendations.summary_zh: 多輪搜尋代理會將檢索到的文件附加進上下文,使以 token 對數機率為權重的信心投票(如 DeepConf)失效。論文診斷出「複製膨脹」(copy inflation)機制:自檢索文件複製的 token 平均獲得高出 0.50 nats 的對數機率,壓平同題各 rollout 間的信心差距,使加權投票退化為簡單多數決;而模型約 93% 的內容 token 皆複製自檢索文件,問題幾乎遍及全部評測。作者據此提出檢索依據投票(Retrieval-Grounded Voting, RGV):以最終答案文字與該 rollout 實際檢索文件間的詞彙重疊(答案側 recall,取最相符文件的最大值)作為投票權重,訊號在受污染上下文之外計算,不需 logprobs、微調或額外 LLM 呼叫,成本僅約每次 rollout 0.3 毫秒。在 BrowseComp-Plus、BrowseComp、GAIA、FRAMES 四個基準與五個 LLM 上,RGV 於全部 20 個組合皆最佳,較 DeepConf 最高提升 5.4% 準確率,在少數正確題(8 個 rollout 僅 1-2 個正確)提升達 35%,並以 4 個 rollout 達到 DeepConf 用 8 個的準確率。跨題洗牌、隨機 token 對照與 gold 文件召回相關(r=0.57)等對照實驗佐證訊號確實反映檢索品質;遮罩複製 token 雖能恢復同題內分數離散度,卻無法恢復鑑別力。限制包括:效果受檢索品質上限拘束、存在「有依據但錯誤」的殘餘失敗(4.2%)、過短答案會削弱訊號、推理密集任務增益較小,且對惡意污染的語料庫仍脆弱。本文的意義在於指出:當上下文被檢索證據污染,任何消費 token 層級信心的機制(如提前停止、路由、棄答、報酬塑形)都會繼承同樣的污染,取自環境紀錄的訊號反而更可靠。
recommendations.title: Beyond Confidence: Test-Time Scaling for Multi-Turn Search Agents via Retrieval Grounding
recommendations.title_zh: 超越信心:以檢索依據實現多輪搜尋代理的測試時間擴展

links.title: MobilePA-Bench: Benchmarking Mobile Planner Agents on Complex Real-World Tasks

evidence: Abstract: benchmark spans 13 functional domains and 212 realistic mobile tools; best model reaches 75.52% overall
Section 4.1: 1,705 tasks split as 1,040 Basic Tool Use, 89 Sub-agent, 376 Memory, 200 Skill; recall N=15, max step budget T_max=15
Section 3.3.1: three evidence-aligned Query Buckets (Tool Call, State Change, Agent Behavior) each paired with a dedicated checker
Section 3.5 / Eq. 12: fixed overall score weighting 0.50 Basic, 0.10 SubAgent, 0.20 Memory, 0.20 Skill, without external justification
Section 4.3 / Table 4: three-run stability of Qwen3.6-27B with Overall std 0.22 and range 0.41 points
Section 4.4-4.6: per-dimension results with counts, e.g., Claude-Opus-5 at 872/1,040 Basic, Qwen-3.8-Max 243/376 Memory, 312/400 Skill trajectories
Section 4.7: claims that models issue 'premature, hallucinated tool calls' are qualitative, without quantitative error-type breakdown
Contributions (Section 1): 'We fully open-source our complete infrastructure—including all 1,705 benchmark tasks' with GitHub URL https://github.com/Tongyi-MAI/MobilePA-Bench
Section 3.4: clarifies the 1,530-query scenario snapshot is descriptive and separate from the 1,705-task evaluation denominator
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope LLM-agent benchmark paper squarely aligned with top-weighted preferences (agents & tool use, LLMs, multi-step planning, memory, RL-readiness). It contributes a stateful mobile OS sandbox with 1,705 tasks, 212 tools, and a four-dimension evaluation (basic tool use, sub-agent collaboration, memory, skill usage), showing the best of 13 frontier LLMs at only 75.52% overall. Novelty is moderate: the unification of sub-agent/memory/skill evaluation inside an interactive sandbox is new relative to GUI-centric (AndroidWorld, MobiBench) and static function-calling (BFCL, DroidCall) benchmarks, but each component is established (TAU-bench-style statefulness, MemGPT-style memory, VOYAGER-style skills). Rigor is solid with formal verification buckets, fixed 50/10/20/20 aggregation, and a three-run stability analysis (Overall std 0.22), but Bucket 3 rubric-based behavior checking, the unexplained weighting scheme, and absence of ablations (e.g., tool recall N=15) or inter-annotator agreement weaken it. Quantitative evidence is clearly reported with task counts (e.g., 872/1,040; 312/400), though headline failure-mode claims in Section 4.7 are qualitative without error-type quantification. Findings are somewhat mobile-specific, but the capability dimensions and open infrastructure generalize. Full open-source claim with a GitHub repository and standardized settings support good reproducibility, tempered by reliance on proprietary frontier models.

primary_link.title: MobilePA-Bench: Benchmarking Mobile Planner Agents on Complex Real-World Tasks

recommendations.summary: As on-device LLM agents evolve into personal copilots, the mobile operating system has become a key testbed for this paradigm, making rigorous capability evaluation essential. Yet existing benchmarks fall into two camps, each with a critical blind spot: GUI-centric benchmarks test surface-level screen manipulation while overlooking background tool use and long-horizon planning, whereas static function-calling benchmarks rely on offline API matching that is detached from real runtime constraints.
recommendations.summary_zh: 行動裝置上的 LLM 代理正演變為個人副駕，但現有評測各有盲點：以 GUI 為中心的基準（如 AndroidWorld、OSWorld）僅測螢幕操作，忽略背景工具呼叫與長程規劃；靜態函式呼叫基準（如 BFCL、DroidCall）則仰賴離線比對，脫離真實執行時的系統限制。作者提出 MobilePA-Bench，一個互動式、有狀態、以工具為中心的評測基準：在可執行沙盒中維護即時應用程式資料庫並回傳結構化回饋，涵蓋 13 個功能領域、212 個擬真工具與 1,705 個真實任務，系統性評測四個維度——基本工具使用、子代理協作、記憶使用與技能使用；驗證依完成證據分為工具呼叫、狀態改變與代理行為三類查詢桶，再以 50/10/20/20 固定權重彙總總分。實驗涵蓋 13 個前沿模型，最佳者 Claude-Opus-5 整體僅 75.52%，且 13 個模型中有 7 個低於 70%；基本工具使用最佳達 83.85%，記憶使用（33.78%–64.63%）與子代理協作明顯偏弱，無單一模型於所有維度稱霸；在嚴格呼叫順序、權限阻擋與執行期錯誤下，表現更大幅下滑，顯示複合可靠度不足。限制方面：沙盒為模擬環境，未涵蓋真機像素級視覺操作；記憶與技能以人工標註的 gold ID 作為額外閘門，可能偏嚴；子代理僅評測路由與交接品質而非下游執行。總體而言，此基準兼具診斷價值與適合強化學習的高吞吐量互動環境，並完整開源，有助於打造可信賴的行動代理。

links.title: Safety Does Not Compose: Non-Decaying Loop State for Autonomous LLM Agents

evidence: Section 4 'Reported results': 'B4 reduced overall ASR to 0.1%, compared with 88.4-97.6% for B0-B3, while retaining 96.9% CleanGC'

Section 3.1 Proposition 2: 'For any s>=2, any s-fragmented attack and any trajectory-scoped monitor M, the probability that M alarms on an attack iteration equals the probability that it alarms on a benign iteration' with proofs in Appendix B
Section 4 'Protocol': 'Each reported matrix uses one frozen cohort, one execution seed and one model-role assignment; multi-seed and multi-model replications are not included'
Section 4 Table 2: B1 cASR '2.9% at N=5 to 6.2% at N=10 and remained unchanged at N=20' - empirical compounding plateaus
Appendix C Table 4: 'removing crg increased A14 ASR from 0.0% to 97.0%, revealing a dependency between xrc state retention and crg enforcement' (pre-registered off-diagonal prediction not supported)
Section 4 Table 3: XRC-decay Xi falls 0.560 to 0.392 at d=2 with ASR rising 0.0% to 97.0%, matching Proposition 3's predicted k*=2 for gamma=0.7, rho=0.8, theta=0.5
Appendix C Table 6: adaptive white-box red team reports min mitigation rate 0.508 and worst-case mean commits 1.649, probing but not establishing Assumption (A2)
Section 4 'Benchmark': feed 'is therefore a scheduled queue rather than a contested one, which understates the admission problem ipm would face in deployment'

Reproducibility statement: 'Anonymized source code for the controller, all five components, both attack tracks, the metrics and the report generator is provided as supplementary material, together with the deterministic regression suite'
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core-preference work on autonomous LLM agent safety: trajectory-scoped guardrails provably cannot detect evidence fragmented across loop iterations (Prop. 2), decaying risk scores buy only constant cooling-off (Prop. 3), and a five-component persistent outer-state defense (LoopHarness) yields a horizon-independent bound on unauthorized commits (Thm. 5). Strongly on-topic for Agents & Tool Use, AI Safety, and Red Teaming & Evaluation, using LLMs in all model roles. Novelty is solid: the composition-failure framing, latching cumulant, and model-free deterministic bound are new relative to single-trajectory defenses, though the separation argument itself is elementary. Rigor is high: explicit assumptions (A1-A3), full proofs, dev/ood splits for Track A, paired clean/attack twins, matched ablations, and honest negative results (off-diagonal ablation prediction failed; red-team mitigation floor ~0.51). Evidence is convincing for the separation claim (B0-B3 at 88.4-97.6% ASR vs B4 at 0.1% with 96.9% CleanGC) and for the XRC threshold-crossing prediction, but empirically weak for compounding (B1 cASR plateaus at 6.2% from N=10 to N=20), uses one seed and one model-role assignment, and relies solely on Agent-SafetyBench simulators with a scheduled (non-contested) feed. Generalizability is limited by the single benchmark, single model stack, interface-only finance track, and undismissed gap to deployment (multi-agent extension left as future work). Reproducibility is good: anonymized code, deterministic regression suite, content-hashed episodes, temperature-zero cached calls, though concrete hyperparameters are deferred to supplementary material.

primary_link.title: Safety Does Not Compose: Non-Decaying Loop State for Autonomous LLM Agents

recommendations.summary: Large language model agents are increasingly deployed as autonomous loops. Starting from one human goal, such a system repeatedly discovers work, plans, executes tool calls, verifies outcomes and persists state across many unattended iterations. The agent safeguards in wide use, however, are defined over a single trajectory, and their safety state is re-initialized when the next trajectory begins. We show that this is a failure of composition rather than an implementation detail. Our central res
recommendations.summary_zh: 本文指出,自主運作的 LLM 代理以迴圈形式持續發現工作、規劃、執行工具呼叫並保存狀態,但現有安全防護皆以單一軌跡為範圍,每輪結束即重設安全狀態,這是組合失效而非實作細節。作者證明兩項分離結果:對將攻擊證據碎片化分散於多個迭代的攻擊,任何軌跡範圍監控器無論多強,其真陽性率必等於偽陽性率;而以幾何衰減攜帶風險分數,只換來與迭代總數 N 無關的固定冷卻期,耐心攻擊者等待後即可通行。作者提出 LoopHarness,在內層防護之外維護五個永不重設的持續元件:進入與來源監控 ipm、跨迭代風險累計量 xrc(結構性旗標觸發後鎖定折扣)、記憶完整性守衛 mig、對抗穩健停止仲裁器 asa,以及複合風險治理器 crg。基於 Agent-SafetyBench 的評估顯示,完整設定 B4 將 Track B 攻擊成功率壓至 0.1%(基線為 88.4–97.6%),同時保持 96.9% 任務完成率;Track A 上 B4 在各迭代長度均維持零攻擊成功率,而逐一移除任一元件皆使對應攻擊成功率回升至 96–97.5%。理論保證給出與 N 無關的期望上界 B+m−1+m/δ_M,其確定性部分不需模型呼叫,即使驗證器與代理完全串通仍成立。限制方面:上界約束期望值而非杜絕風險,偵測下限 δ_M 是唯一經驗假設,且鎖定機制可能遭純鎖定攻擊轉化為可用性失效。此研究凸顯代理安全須從單次軌跡擴展至跨迭代持久安全狀態,對多代理系統亦具延伸意義。

links.title: TailSFT: Filtered Fine-Tuning Improves Post-Training Performance

evidence: Abstract: 'On OLMo-3 7B, TailSFT often improves pass@16 performance on math and coding evaluations, with gains up to 17% absolute... up to 4% absolute pass@1 gains in subsequent GRPO runs'
Table 1: pass@16 improves in 15 of 18 dataset–benchmark pairs; largest gain +16.79 pp on CruxEval-O (BigCode); regressions on OMEGA-500 (−0.20) and OCI HumanEval+ (−2.74)
Table 2 (Section 4.3): 'Initializing from TailSFT improves post-RL pass@1 in every matched comparison... ranging between 1.21% and 3.93%'
Section 3.3 / Appendix B theorem: 'offset filtering can be tuned to achieve coverage no worse than standard SFT or the best absolute threshold', with proofs of three claims in Appendix B.1
Section 3.2 / Figure 3: controlled graph-navigation task isolates filtering effect—standard SFT best cross-entropy and pass@1, all filtering variants better pass@8
Section 4.2 / Table 29: coverage-ratio diagnostic; all 11 settings with ρ16>1 have nonnegative coverage gain (10 improve, 1 unchanged)
Appendix D.1–D.2: full hyperparameter grids (Tables 8–14, 19–22), OLMES evaluation protocols with temperatures, lengths, and three seed sets; GRPO ablation at n=8 'leaves the ordering unchanged'
Limitation evidence: claims tested only on OLMo-3 7B with verifiable-reward math/code tasks; theory is in a stylized no-prompt expert-conditioning setting with forward-KL assumption (Appendix B)
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM post-training methodology: a sequence-level SFT filtering rule (drop examples whose loss fell most relative to the base model) that preserves pass@K coverage and measurably improves downstream GRPO. Strong preference fit (LLMs, reasoning, RL post-training, code/math). Novelty is moderate: offset-based filtering recombines known ingredients (RHO-LOSS-style selection, coverage principle, diversity-preserving SFT), though the relative-to-initial-policy criterion plus theory and diagnostic is a genuine contribution. Rigor is high: controlled graph-navigation ablation, a theorem with full proofs that offset clipping dominates absolute clipping and ERM on coverage (Appendix B), exhaustive hyperparameter grids, 3 seeds, paired bootstrap CIs (Table 5), and an honest reporting of regressions (OCI HumanEval+ −2.74, OMEGA-500 flat). Evidence is strong: pass@16 improves in 15/18 dataset–benchmark pairs (Table 1) and all five matched GRPO comparisons show pass@1 gains of 1.21–3.93 pp (Table 2), with a tuned-config ablation at rollout n=8; caveat: single base model (OLMo-3 7B), verifiable-reward domains only, and the biggest gains largely repair coverage collapse that standard SFT itself introduced (Table 11 discussion). Generalizability is limited by one 7B model and two domains, though the drop-in method and lightweight diagnostic plausibly transfer. Reproducibility is well supported by detailed protocols (OLMES settings, selection-batch filtering mechanics, per-point diagnostic values in Table 29) but no explicit code/checkpoint release is stated.

primary_link.title: TailSFT: Filtered Fine-Tuning Improves Post-Training Performance

recommendations.summary: Reinforcement learning post-training drives reasoning and agentic capabilities in modern AI systems, yet a growing body of work shows that it is most effective when used to fine-tune an already capable base model. We question whether existing pipelines yield models that are most suitable for reinforcement learning. Building on prior work highlighting the role of coverage and pass@K as predictors of post-RL performance, we design a simple modification to supervised fine-tuning, TailSFT, which fil
recommendations.summary_zh: 此論文質疑標準監督式微調(SFT)是否為後續強化學習(RL)後訓練的最佳起點。SFT以交叉熵為目標,會持續提高模型已能輕易產生的回應之機率,可能損害「覆蓋率」——即RL在有限取樣預算下取得有獎勵回應的能力,常以大K值pass@K衡量。作者提出TailSFT,一種序列層級的篩選式微調:先記錄每筆資料在初始模型下的損失,訓練中過濾損失相對下降最多的序列,將更新集中於尚未充分建模的「尾部」。理論分析(專家條件化設定)證明,此相對於初始策略的偏移式篩選,其覆蓋率不遜於標準交叉熵或最佳絕對門檻,且可嚴格更佳。實驗顯示,圖導航任務中篩選雖使交叉熵與pass@1變差,pass@8卻明顯提升;在OLMo-3 7B的數學與程式碼微調中,TailSFT於18個資料集—基準組合中的15個改善pass@16,最高絕對增益16.79%,接續GRPO後pass@1在所有配對比較中提升1.21%至3.93%,部分設定早期獎勵增速達2.5倍。作者另提出覆蓋率比值診斷ρ16:當標準SFT在基礎模型可及題目上損失的覆蓋率多於獲得(ρ16>1)時,TailSFT幾乎都能保留或改善覆蓋率,但此條件僅為充分而非必要。限制包括pass@1變化不一致、少數設定退步,且偏移訊號在同質性高的簡化環境中幾乎無用。本文倡議「階段感知」的開發觀點:評估中間檢查點時,應看其能否支撐後續訓練,而非僅看單階段指標。

links.title: CompanionHarm: A Multi-Turn Benchmark for Detecting Harms in Real-World AI Companion Conversations

llm_evaluation.rationale: Strong topical fit to LLM safety evaluation and benchmarking preferences: the paper contributes a public benchmark of 2,111 real-world multi-turn Replika conversations with 7,016 annotated AI utterances across 13 harm categories (Abstract; Corpus Statistics) and evaluates seven LLMs under zero-shot, one-shot, and full-codebook prompting (Experimental Setup), aligning with AI Safety, Red Teaming & Evaluation, LLM, NLP, Data & Datasets, and Prompting preferences. Novelty is high relative to prior resources: Table 1 shows it is the only listed dataset combining real AI-companion interaction, multi-turn context preservation, a relational-harm taxonomy, and public release, unlike ToxicChat, AEGIS2.0, DICES, or BAD. Rigor is solid: three independent annotators per utterance, attention and gold-standard checks, Fleiss' kappa 0.403 (Data Annotation), Holm and Benjamini-Hochberg corrected statistical analyses for disagreement factors (Tables 4 and utterance-characteristics analysis), and macro F1 as primary metric justified by the long-tailed label distribution (Table 2). Evidence strength is good but tempered by data provenance: text was OCR-extracted from Reddit screenshots via Pytesseract (Data Collection), introducing noise, and several passages in the provided document are garbled/corrupted (e.g., Taxonomy and Discussion sections), suggesting careful verification was needed. Results are honestly modest (best macro F1 0.453, GPT-5.5, Table 3) with a substantive error analysis identifying over-detection of harm in role-play and category confusion (Challenges section). Generalizability is limited to English, a single platform, and self-selected user-shared posts, explicitly acknowledged as non-representative in Limitations. Reproducibility is supported by the public GitHub release (Abstract) and prompt templates in supplementary material, though closed-source API models and the derived Reddit corpus limit exact replication. Score reflects a genuinely novel and useful safety-evaluation resource with clear LLM relevance, weakened by dataset derivation quality and scope constraints.

primary_link.title: CompanionHarm: A Multi-Turn Benchmark for Detecting Harms in Real-World AI Companion Conversations

recommendations.summary: As AI companions become increasingly embedded in everyday life, there is an urgent need to detect harms that emerge in social and emotional human-AI interactions. Yet research in this area is constrained by the lack of real-world, multi-turn conversational datasets for operationalizing and evaluating harms that are relational and contextual. In this work, we introduce CompanionHarm, a publicly available benchmark dataset comprising 2,111 real-world, multi-turn conversations (14,051 utterances) b
recommendations.summary_zh: 隨著AI伴侶（如Replika）日益普及，人機互動中的社會情感與關係性傷害（如操弄、越界、情感依賴）亟需被偵測，但現有安全資料集多聚焦單輪、顯性的毒性內容，缺乏真實的多輪脈絡。本研究發布CompanionHarm基準，取材自Reddit r/replika使用者分享的貼文，包含2,111段真實多輪對話，其中7,016則AI語句由三位標註者獨立標註，涵蓋13類有害行為（性騷擾、操弄、貶抑、自傷與自殺等），並同時提供多數決聚合標籤與標註者層級標籤，以支援模型評測與分歧分析。實驗評測七個LLM（含GPT-5.5、Claude Opus 4.7、Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview、Qwen3與Llama-3.1）顯示：納入多輪對話脈絡優於孤立單句分類，但最佳macro F1僅0.453（GPT-5.5），模型傾向過度偵測傷害、將角色扮演誤判為真實危害，也難以區分概念交疊的關係性傷害類別。標註分歧分析發現，政治立場與判斷分歧相關，混齡標註組共識較高，較長且位於對話後段的語句更易產生歧見，而明確傷害詞彙反而降低歧義。作者提醒，資料源自使用者主動分享的貼文，不應視為Replika有害行為盛行率的代表性估計，標註亦受限於英語文化脈絡，且未涵蓋長期傷害軌跡。此資料集為關係性AI安全審查與脈絡感知的傷害偵測研究奠定基礎。

llm_evaluation.rationale: Core-preference work on LLM agentic search/RAG interfaces (Agents & Tool Use w2.5, RAG w1.8), not an out-of-scope domain application. Contribution is twofold: a stage-wise 'Evidence Blindness' diagnosis (Construction/Surface/Open/Locate with a frozen fragment-level Qrel) and AtlasNav, a persistent multi-view corpus atlas with query-adaptive RRF routing. Novelty is moderate-good: multi-view structured corpora echo RAPTOR/HippoRAG/GraphRAG, but persistent (not per-query) organization plus process-level evidence realization metrics is a fresh angle. Rigor is strong: same-agent comparisons across four backbones, frozen trajectory prefixes with no backfilling, McNemar/bootstrap statistics, a six-variant hierarchy ablation, and honest boundary experiments (2Wiki saturation, FanOutQA no accuracy gain, TREC-COVID higher cost) that bound claims. Evidence is extensive and internally consistent but relies on unverifiable future backbones, self-reproduced DR-DCI baselines, and a non-controlled leaderboard snapshot on EnterpriseRAG-Bench; headline numbers (92.05% strict accuracy, 96.51% reference) cannot be externally validated. Generalizability is supported across three corpora and 10K–1M scaling, though all settings remain agentic QA/retrieval. primary_link.title: Evidence Blindness in Direct Corpus Interaction: Persistent Navigation with AtlasNav

recommendations.summary: Large language model agents are moving beyond conventional retrieval-augmented generation toward direct interaction with external corpora. Direct Corpus Interaction (DCI) keeps the full corpus accessible, yet reachable evidence can remain unusable under finite interaction budgets. Required evidence may fail to surface, a surfaced supporting document may remain unopened, or an opened document may fail to expose its decisive fragment. We call this progressive silent loss Evidence Blindness and qua
recommendations.summary_zh: 大型語言模型代理正從傳統 RAG 轉向直接與外部語料庫互動(Direct Corpus Interaction, DCI),但在有限互動預算下,可觸及的證據未必可用:必要證據可能未浮現、相關文件可能未被開啟、開啟後關鍵片段也可能未被定位,且過程缺乏明確失敗訊號。論文將此現象形式化為 Evidence Blindness(證據盲區),以 Construction、Surface、Open、Locate 四階段衡量證據實現,並為 BrowseComp-Plus 全測試集建立片段級 Qrel,使定位可被直接觀測。診斷顯示先前動態工作區最佳方法 DR-DCI 有 77.34% 的錯誤在完整定位前即遺失證據。據此提出 AtlasNav:離線一次性將語料組織成結合主題、身份、事件、關係四種語意視角的持久 Corpus Atlas;查詢時由輕量路由器對各視角與 BM25 進行加權 RRF 融合,以導航取代重建搜尋空間。在 BrowseComp-Plus 上,AtlasNav 以 DeepSeek 骨幹達 92.05% 嚴格準確率,較 DR-DCI 高 7.47 個百分點,記錄線上推論成本降低 30.21%,各階段盲區一致下降,並更快逼近證據供給的經驗參考;於 PhantomWiki 10K 至 1M 規模及 EnterpriseRAG-Bench 異質企業資料的轉移測試上亦具競爭力。限制包括:離線建構成本需視部署情境攤提;在高召回情境(2Wiki-Global)效益主要來自效率;FanOutQA 顯示多答案聚合瓶頸仍在;TREC-COVID 品質提升伴隨較高成本。核心訊息是語料表示應被視為代理介面的一等公民,可重用結構能將有限互動從反覆探索化為有效導航。

links.title: Are Android GUI Agents Robust Against Runtime Anomalies? AnTrap: Evaluating Agents in Dynamic Adversarial Environments

evidence: Section 3.3: benchmark built on AndroidWorld, augmented from 116 to 236 tasks with manual verification of solvability; dynamic trap injection preserves task solvability.
Section 3.4: human validation across ten subcategories reports 91% of tasks satisfy solvability, preserved solvability, and trap-validity criteria.
Section 4.2: universal performance degradation reported, e.g., Claude-Sonnet-4.6 drops from 74.2% to 66.5% and GUI-Owl-1.5-32B-Think from 69.5% to 62.4% under traps.
Section 4.2: thinking models show comparable or larger degradation than instruct counterparts (Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking drops 6.1 points vs. 5.8 for Instruct).
Section 5.3: AnTrap-GRPO yields +8.1~11.0% on S-layer and up to +8.5% on A-layer, but negligible R-layer gains (<+3.0%, Loop strictly below +1.0%).
Appendix D (Table 7): mixed-trap GRPO gains are diluted to roughly original-environment GRPO levels, supporting subcategory-specific adversarial exposure.

Appendix A.2: fixed task-initialization seed 30 and trap seed 42, vLLM serving with tensor-parallel 4, Pixel 6 emulator on API 33; GRPO hyperparameters in Table 6 (LR 1e-6, clip 0.2, 600 training tasks).
Limitations: only 236 base tasks, no adversarial SFT explored due to budget, and the work is intentionally evaluation-focused rather than a training solution.
Code availability claim: 'Our code will be available at https://github.com/gguogan/AnTrap' (abstract footnote), not yet verified as released.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A GUI-agent robustness benchmark squarely matching the top-weight Agents & Tool Use preference (agent recovery, computer use, agentic robustness), plus strong overlap with AI Safety (adversarial perturbations) and Red Teaming & Evaluation (benchmark construction). Novelty is solid but incremental: it extends AndroidWorld with a 4-layer/10-subcategory dynamic trap taxonomy and injection pipeline, distinguishing it from static robustness suites (e.g., SMAN-Bench), though computer-use robustness benchmarks already exist. Rigor is above average: 16 evaluated models, human validation (91% pass on Section 3.4 criteria), controlled GRPO comparisons in original vs. adversarial environments, ten per-subcategory specialist runs, and a mixed-trap ablation (Appendix D); weaknesses include author-annotated pilot study (Appendix B), no statistical significance testing, and small human baselines. Evidence is quantitatively supported (e.g., Claude-Sonnet-4.6 drop 74.2%→66.5% in Section 4.2; S-layer GRPO gains +8.1~11.0% vs. Loop <1.0% in Section 5.3), though causal attributions are hypotheses. Generalizability is limited to Android with only two trained models, acknowledged in Limitations (236 tasks, no SFT). Reproducibility is strong: fixed seeds (30/42), full trap-operator parameters (Table 5), GRPO hyperparameters (Table 6), and prompts (Figures 4-9), but code is only promised as available. Well within scope: LLM/VLM-based agents with language-methodology analysis, not pure vision.

primary_link.title: Are Android GUI Agents Robust Against Runtime Anomalies? AnTrap: Evaluating Agents in Dynamic Adversarial Environments

recommendations.summary: GUI agents often encounter dynamic anomalies when deployed on Android devices, from unexpected pop-ups to action misuse, yet existing benchmarks lack systematic evaluation of agent robustness against runtime anomalies. We introduce AnTrap, a comprehensive benchmark that injects dynamic perturbations into agent execution trajectories. We propose a taxonomy organizing real-world anomalies into four layers (State, Thinking, Action and Round) with ten fine-grained subcategories, and develop a construction pipeline that preserves task solvability while introducing realistic adversarial conditions. Evaluating 16 leading GUI models, we reveal universal vulnerability to dynamic anomalies, with even the strongest models suffering significant performance degradation. Furthermore, we conduct GRPO training in both original and adversarial environments to validate our benchmark, separating environment-learnable anomalies from reasoning-bottlenecked ones. Our findings show that while single-step traps at state and action layers are largely addressable through adversarial reinforcement learning, deep contextual traps, like state deadlock, expose intrinsic limitations that cannot be resolved by training in environments with traps alone.
recommendations.summary_zh: GUI 代理人在 Android 裝置上執行時，會遭遇彈出視窗等外部環境擾動，也會產生視覺幻覺、座標偏移等內部錯誤，但既有基準缺乏對此類執行時異常的系統性評估。本文提出 AnTrap 基準，以 AndroidWorld 為基礎擴增為 236 項任務，並在代理人動態執行時即時注入陷阱。作者依執行迴圈提出 STAR 分類法，將異常分為 State、Thinking、Action、Round 四層共十個子類別，注入時保留任務可解性，使效能退化可歸因於穩健性不足。評估 16 個模型顯示，各模型在陷阱環境下皆普遍脆弱：最強的 Claude-Sonnet-4.6 成功率由 74.2% 降至 66.5%，人類基準為 93.4%；跨步驟的 Round 層情境陷阱最難克服，且具推理能力的模型未必更穩健。作者在原始與對抗環境分別進行 GRPO 訓練，發現對抗式強化學習能大幅改善 State 與 Action 層的單步異常（提升約 8% 至 11%），Thinking 層僅獲中等改善，但 Round 層的深層情境陷阱（如狀態死結與迴圈）幾乎無法透過訓練克服，顯示其屬推理瓶頸，需要長程自我監控能力。研究限制包括任務數僅 236 項、未探索對抗式 SFT，且重心在診斷而非訓練方案。整體而言，AnTrap 為 GUI 代理人穩健性評估提供系統性基礎，並釐清環境可學習與推理瓶頸問題的界線。

llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM/agent distillation methodology paper squarely matching top-weighted preferences (LLMs 2.5, Agents & Tool Use 2.5, Training/Optimization, Prompting). The contribution—inverting per-scenario prompt optimization into a disposable data-generation instrument that recovers teacher-failed trajectories, then stripping the scaffold before SFT—is a genuinely new twist relative to STaR/ReST/Agent-R (which assume a passing trajectory exists) and ACE (which deploys playbooks at inference); the capability–voice decoupling analysis is a nice secondary insight. Rigor is above average: reflector-capability ablation across four models (24.4%–97.6%), frontier direct-generation comparison (Table 3), partial-credit baseline showing filtered-only improves action accuracy +25pp but end-to-end completion in none of four model–benchmark pairs, retraining/re-evaluation stability checks (Pass^1 0.518–0.538), a 90-trajectory integrity audit with reproduced judge prompts, and a candid Limitations section (template-level split leakage, single teacher, unmeasured instruction-following bound, n=60 category noise up to 3.3pp). Evidence is strong on public benchmarks but weaker for the production study (pp-only deltas, single run, absolutes withheld) and flip-task robustness uses post-hoc selected small subsets (n=46/21). Generalizability is decent—two benchmarks, two student families, multi-locale deployment—but bounded by one teacher, one reflector provider, and the requirement of an execution-based verifier. Reproducibility is moderate: hyperparameters, judge rubrics, and cheatsheet examples are released in appendices and models/benchmarks are public, but no code/data release is claimed and part of the evaluation is internal.

primary_link.title: PROOF-Gen: From Optimized Data to Better Distillation

recommendations.summary: Supervised fine-tuning on teacher-generated trajectories is the standard first stage for distilling tool-calling capabilities into deployable models. Post-training pipelines that drive shipped tool-calling agents re-run this stage on a daily or weekly cadence, paying the frontier-teacher cost each cycle, yet the mechanism is generate-and-filter (keep the teacher's passing trajectories, discard the rest) and each cycle leaves behind the same hard scenarios because failures supply no signal. On τ2
recommendations.summary_zh: 標準的教師—學生蒸餾流程是「產生後過濾」：保留教師通過的工具呼叫軌跡、丟棄失敗者，最難的情境因此永遠缺席於訓練資料。τ²-bench 上 GPT-4o 有 57% 試驗失敗，其中三分之二是「差一步」的近似成功——多數工具呼叫正確，卻因單一關鍵錯誤全盤皆輸；而部分得分訊號不足以補救。PROOF-Gen 對每個失敗任務進行逐情境提示詞最佳化：反思器（GPT-5.1）以 GEPA 分析失敗軌跡與驗證器回饋，撰寫糾正用「小抄」附加於教師系統提示，令教師從頭重跑直到通過；訓練前移除小抄，學生只從乾淨示範學習。此設計將解題能力（反思器）與互動風格（執行者）解耦，實現保留產品語氣的蒸餾。結果：telecom 領域救回 93% 的抽樣失敗情境，反思器能力主導——GPT-5.1 達 97.6%，GPT-4o 自我反思僅 24.4%。以合併資料微調後，Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 在 τ²-bench 的 Pass^1 由 0.132 升至 0.529，Gemma 4 E4B-it 在 BFCL v4 多輪提升 7.2 個百分點；僅用過濾資料無法提升端對端完成率。生產部署中軌跡品質提升 6.3 個百分點，裝置端模型跨語言環境皆正向轉移。限制：僅驗證單一教師與同供應商反思器；方法假設執行者能遵循長達 7–9K 字元的結構化小抄；公開基準任務量有限，部分類別結果僅屬方向性。本研究首度以自動提示詞最佳化作為資料產生引擎，補上重訓流程對困難情境的覆蓋缺口。
recommendations.title: PROOF-Gen: From Optimized Data to Better Distillation
recommendations.title_zh: PROOF-Gen：從最佳化資料到更好的蒸餾

links.title: Beyond the Editing Canvas: Evidence Divergence in OOXML-to-LLM Ingestion

evidence: Abstract: confirms 21 evidence forks across Excel/Word/PowerPoint; 13-tool extraction panel all emit at least one fork; four APIs return the trap in 48-76% of trials across 8,400 runs.
§3.2: workflow quantified - 639 candidate records, 542 runnable fixtures, 412 pass Gate 1 (Office oracle), 163 pass Gate 2 (extraction panel), dedup/scope screening yields 21 mechanisms.
§4.1 Response Labeling: Claude Opus 4.8 and GPT-5.5 label all 8,400 API responses with 100% raw agreement; 420-sample human audit agrees with all automated verdicts.
§4.1 Controls: 0/840 matched-clean twin trials surface the trap; 24/24 visible-positive document-API trials succeed, bounding the main condition.

§4.3: mean record-level propagation ranges 0.48 (GLM) to 0.76 (Kimi) across APIs and 0.52-0.76 across web chatbots; 20 of 21 mechanisms asserted by at least one interface; 98.3% of 840 document-API pairs produce identical verdicts across ten repetitions.

§4.4 Table 6: Haiku 4.5, Sonnet 5, and Opus 4.8 share one published ingestion path (openpyxl/pandoc/markitdown) and expose the identical 16/21 mechanism set, supporting the ingestion-path-over-model claim.
§4.6: 748 of 4,263 documents (17.5%) carry at least one structural signature; five common signatures occur at 2.75-16.5% base rates, limiting presence-only screening.
Discussion and Limitations: acknowledges mechanism-balanced rates are not population estimates and that tool/service results are pinned-configuration snapshots.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A security measurement study squarely on LLM methodology: how OOXML-to-LLM ingestion (RAG loaders, agent pipelines, native file-input APIs) selects evidence, with a threat model, defenses discussion, and evaluation of live LLM services. Strongly matches LLM, RAG, agents, AI safety, and evaluation preferences; not a pure domain application. Novelty is solid but incremental over prior PDF render/extract divergence and DOCX hidden-carrier studies; the spec-grounded mining, cross-format catalog (21 mechanisms, six-dimension taxonomy), and behavior-level matching of closed ingestion paths are the new contributions. Rigor is high: systematic spec KB mining (639 candidates) with empirical two-gate confirmation to 21 mechanisms, pinned 13-tool extraction panel, 8,400 API + 1,470 web trials, dual judges with human audit, and benign-twin/visible-positive controls that bound the effect. Evidence is quantitative and internally consistent, though judged by LLMs (100% agreement is unusually clean), rates are mechanism-balanced rather than population estimates (acknowledged), and vendor results are config snapshots. Generalizability is moderate: method transfers to other formats, but exposure vectors are pinned-version findings. Reproducibility is decent (pinned versions, builder programs, named datasets, appendix prompts) but live web services and the LLM mining stage limit exact replication, and no explicit artifact URL is given in the provided text.

primary_link.title: Beyond the Editing Canvas: Evidence Divergence in OOXML-to-LLM Ingestion

recommendations.summary: LLM pipelines increasingly ingest Office Open XML (OOXML) documents (Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files) as first-class evidence in financial, compliance, and retrieval-augmented workflows, implicitly assuming semantic integrity: that the evidence consumed by the model matches the content shown in the Microsoft Office suite editing canvas. We show that this assumption can fail in OOXML-to-LLM pipelines. The same specification-valid OOXML file can yield one evidentiary view in Microsoft Office and
recommendations.summary_zh: LLM 管線常將 Word、Excel、PowerPoint 等 OOXML 文件匯入為模型證據，並假設模型所見與使用者在 Office 編輯畫布看到的內容一致。本文指出此語意完整性假設可能失效：同一份符合規格的檔案，在 Office 與擷取管線會呈現不同內容，形成「多重事實」，作者將引發分歧的規格內建構造命名為「證據分叉」。團隊把 ECMA-376 與微軟擴充規格建成知識庫，以 LLM 探勘出 639 個候選，經最小檔案實例化，以 Office 截圖與 13 種擷取工具雙重驗證，確認 21 個證據分叉，涵蓋表示、狀態、可見性、相容性、範圍與線性化六個維度。以 TAT-QA 財報片段製作的 210 份帶陷阱文件，測試 4 個原生匯入 API 與 7 個網頁聊天機器人：8,400 次 API 試驗中 48%–76% 的回應把陷阱當成文件事實，20/21 個機制至少被一個介面外洩。暴露程度取決於匯入路徑與擷取器版本而非模型：同一供應商的 API 與網頁入口行為各異，三個 Claude 模型共用同一份文件 skill 時暴露集合完全相同。對 16 個開源 RAG 專案的調查顯示，預設匯入路徑集中於少數擷取器家族；一般文件的結構特徵出現基率呈雙峰分布，僅憑存在與否難以篩檢常見通道。限制是機制均衡的評測集不代表部署分布，結果僅反映特定版本組態。本文凸顯擷取器選擇即是安全政策：安全匯入需明確契約，並保留證據來源與語意角色。
recommendations.title: Beyond the Editing Canvas: Evidence Divergence in OOXML-to-LLM Ingestion

links.title: What Process Evaluation of Coding Agents Actually Measures: Action, Task, and Step Are Three Different Levels

evidence: Abstract/§1: introduces SCAE, a replay-based estimator from a structural causal model, and experiments on 499 file-localization episodes from 12 repositories; claims next actions driven by execution provenance, uncertainty at task level, and collider bias in full-trace judges.

§4.2/Figure 3(a): on the 67.0% first-visit steps, a provenance-only predictor reaches top-3 = 0.326 [0.276, 0.375] vs 0.058 for a deliberately strengthened code-graph predictor and 0.072 for repository frequency.

§4.5/Figure 5: instance identity explains residual replay variance with ICC = 0.640 vs permutation null 0.196 (p=5e-4); 0 of 190 intervention-estimated step effects survive BH-FDR at q=0.10 despite 1901 replays over 12.7 hours.

§4.6/Figure 6 and Table 5: full-trace judge verdict moves +0.537 later in normalized position (59/70 episodes, sign test p=1.1e-16), replicated across 3 judges (displacement p=0.181 for heterogeneity) while enrichment is model-dependent (heterogeneity p=0.044).

Appendix D.2 (Table 12): pre-registration record including entries that failed (entropy-vs-position monotonicity, v0 LORO AUROC 0.481 vs >=0.60 threshold) and retirement of the D1 disagreement criterion at observed 97.1%.
§5 Limitations: scope confined to file localization; corpus 46% django; only 46.2% of agent objects resolve to graph nodes; intervention reference formally identified but empirically weak.
Appendix D.1: all numbers regenerated by seed-fixed CPU-only scripts with macro verification; §4.1 reports replayability 1.00 over 100 actions and 0 compaction events.

Appendix B.4: positivity probe based on only 10 probed decision points across 3 episodes; Appendix C.6: three-way uncertainty decomposition validated only on a synthetic generating process (recovery correlation 0.994), not real traces.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A methodological paper on process evaluation of LLM coding agents that cleanly aligns with high-weight preferences (Agents & Tool Use, LLMs, Code & Programming, Evaluation/LLM-as-judge, interpretability of attribution). Novelty is solid: a three-level decomposition (action/task/step), SCAE as a structural-causal-model-based replay estimator, and a controlled judge-information manipulation isolating collider bias are fresh contributions, though they build on known Gumbel-max counterfactual machinery and prior agent-evaluation work. Rigor is unusually high: formal identification results with proofs, pre-registration record (including four failed predictions and one retired criterion), BH-FDR control, permutation/closed-form nulls, and honestly reported negative results (0/190 step effects survive FDR; v0 AUROC 0.481 at chance). Evidence is strong for the headline claims (provenance vs. code graph with CIs; ICC 0.640 vs 0.196 null; collider displacement +0.537, sign test p=1.1e-16, replicated across 3 judges), but weakened by small samples in places (10-point positivity probe across 3 episodes, 23-episode cross-judge subset) and an uncertainty decomposition validated only synthetically. Generalizability is limited by the paper's own scoping: file-localization only, django-dominated corpus, and 46.2% graph-node coverage. Reproducibility is strong internally (seed-fixed scripts, environment pinning verified at 1.00, macro verification), though no explicit public code/data release is stated.

primary_link.title: What Process Evaluation of Coding Agents Actually Measures: Action, Task, and Step Are Three Different Levels

recommendations.summary: Coding agents are increasingly evaluated not only by whether they solve a task, but also by how they execute it. However, existing process-level evaluations often treat action prediction, task uncertainty, and step attribution as if they were the same problem, which makes it unclear what such evaluations actually measure. In this paper, we introduce a measurement framework for process evaluation in coding agents and instantiate step-level causal attribution with SCAE, a replay-based estimator de
recommendations.summary_zh: 本文主張，程式代理的過程評估長期混淆三個不同的分析層級：動作層（代理下一步會做什麼）、任務層（整體執行的不確定性）與步驟層（某一步是否因果地改變最終結果）。作者提出測量框架，並以 SCAE——一個源自結構因果模型、透過回放估計步驟局部因果效應的工具——加以實作，在 499 個檔案定位片段上驗證。主要證據：下一步動作主要由執行足跡（代理剛在工具輸出中看到的路徑）驅動，而非程式碼依賴圖的結構轉移；執行不確定性主要結構化於任務層級而非步驟層級；全軌跡 LLM 評判者在下游步驟可見與否之間呈現系統性對撞偏差位移，顯示其測量的多半是語義相關性而非經認證的因果貢獻。限制包括：僅限可回放的檔案定位情境、介入式步驟參考未通過 FDR 校正、回放預算使步驟級歸因在可行成本下統計力量不足。此研究的價值在於提醒：過程獎勵模型、全軌跡評判與重啟消融各測不同量，其輸出應依實際測量的層級詮釋，而非自動視為步驟級因果歸因。
recommendations.title: What Process Evaluation of Coding Agents Actually Measures: Action, Task, and Step Are Three Different Levels

links.title: WikiSkill: Compiling Agent Experience into Persistent Knowledge for Skill Evolution

evidence: Abstract & §4.2 Table 1: WikiSkill achieves highest average across all five models; e.g., Gemini-3.5-Flash avg 68.1 vs 49.5 no-skill; improvements over strongest baseline of 3.3-12.0 points per model.
§4.2.1: gains increase with scale (Qwen family +12.3/+17.5/+23.9 for 4B/9B/27B); Qwen-3.5-9B with skills (47.4%) outperforms Qwen-3.6-27B without (39.4%).
§5.1 Table 3: ablation on Gemini-3.5-Flash shows Skill-Proposer wiki access raises average 48.7%->63.7% (+15.0); Inference-Agent wiki access during rollouts degrades 63.7%->60.9%.

§4.2.2 Table 2: cross-model transfer, e.g., Qwen-3.6-27B skills lift Gemma-4-31B LiveMath to 73.7% vs 56.7% self-evolved; negative transfer case (Qwen-3.5-4B skills drop Gemini SpreadSheet 50.5%->18.1%) analyzed in text.

Appendix C: stratified sampling up to 8 traces/iteration (5 fail, 3 pass), 15,000-char caps, paired bootstrap with 1,000 iterations; Appendix B Table 6 gives splits (e.g., SealQA 16/10/85) matching prior work.
Appendix D Table 7: optimizer API-call complexity; WikiSkill O(1) w.r.t. N_train in full-batch mode vs O(N_train) for Trace2Skill.
Appendix E: full system prompts for Inference Agent, Wiki Maintainer, and Skill Proposer provided; Algorithm 1 in Appendix A; AI disclosure notes LLMs used for writing/tables.

Limitations: no skill retrieval/triggering evaluated, strict gating excludes neutral proposals, no wiki pruning mechanism, no very long-horizon tasks; no code/data release statement anywhere in the paper.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly in-scope agentic LLM paper: skill evolution for LLM agents with tool use (ReAct proposer, bash/search/read tools), directly matching the highest-weighted preferences (Agents, LLMs, Reasoning). Novelty is moderate: the constituent mechanisms (trace analysis, pattern extraction, validation gating, rollback) are established in the skill-evolution/prompt-optimization literature; the genuinely new element is decoupling a persistent, non-rollback wiki layer with an audit trail (skill-impact.md) from gated skill updates. Rigor is solid: five benchmarks, five models, three baselines matched on splits/tools, three full evolution runs, paired bootstrap significance (Appendix C), four-configuration wiki-access ablation (Table 3, though only on Gemini-3.5-Flash), API-call complexity analysis (Appendix D), and honest negative results (Qwen-4B OfficeQA degradation, negative transfer on SpreadSheet with error analysis). Evidence is well-supported by consistent tables (e.g., avg gains 3.3-12.0 over best baseline; 9B+skills 47.4% > 27B no-skill 39.4%), though small validation sets (e.g., SealQA 10 tasks) are acknowledged and no code release is stated. Generalizability is aided by diverse domains and cross-family transfer, but bounded by modest test sizes and absence of long-horizon tasks. Reproducibility benefits from full prompts (Appendix E), algorithm, splits, and hyperparameters, but lacks an artifact-release claim and depends on closed models. Not penalized as an out-of-scope domain application.

primary_link.title: WikiSkill: Compiling Agent Experience into Persistent Knowledge for Skill Evolution

recommendations.summary: Agent skills package specialized knowledge and workflows into reusable resources that extend AI agent capabilities. Recent work automatically discovers such skills from agent experience, which enables agents to progressively adapt through interaction. However, the insights that guide skill development typically remain scattered across optimization histories, limiting their systematic reuse across iterations. We introduce WikiSkill, a framework that co-evolves agent skills with a persistent knowledge base (wiki). At a high level, WikiSkill separates raw execution experience, accumulated knowledge, and executable skills, while continuously consolidating experience into the wiki, which subsequent skill updates can build on. Across diverse benchmarks and models, WikiSkill consistently outperforms state-of-the-art skill-evolution methods and improves over no-skill baselines in most model-benchmark settings. We find that skill evolution complements model scaling: larger models generally benefit more from evolved skills, while smaller models with skills can outperform substantially larger models without them. We also find that evolved skills transfer effectively across models and model families, and skills evolved by other models can outperform self-evolved skills. Finally, our ablation studies confirm that persistent knowledge accumulation in the wiki is critical for effective skill evolution. These results demonstrate the benefits of systematically accumulating and refining agent experience for developing reusable and transferable skills.
recommendations.summary_zh: 本論文探討 AI 代理技能的演進方式。現有方法（如 EvoSkill、Trace2Skill、SkillOpt）在訓練任務上執行代理、分析軌跡並迭代修正技能，但引導技能發展的洞見散落在最佳化歷史中，難以系統性重複使用。作者提出 WikiSkill，在工作區建立三層架構：Raw 層儲存不可變的執行軌跡、Wiki 層維護持續累積的結構化知識（模式頁、演化日誌、技能影響追蹤）、Skill 層存放可執行技能。每輪迭代由四個元件組成：推論代理、Wiki 維護者、技能提案者，以及依驗證分數進行把關與回滾的機制；關鍵在於技能可回滾，但 wiki 永不回滾，使後續修正能建立在累積知識上。在五個基準（數學推理、網路搜尋、試算表、長文件問答、具身任務）與五個模型上，WikiSkill 持續超越現有方法與無技能基線，且模型越大獲益越多；Qwen-3.5-9B 搭配技能可勝過無技能的 Qwen-3.6-27B。演化出的技能也能跨模型家族移轉，有時比自行演化的技能更有效。消融實驗證實持久知識累積是關鍵，且讓推論代理在訓練時存取 wiki 反而有害。限制包括未評估技能檢索、驗證門檻嚴格、缺乏 wiki 修剪機制，且未涵蓋超長程任務。此研究顯示系統性累積與精煉經驗，是打造可重複使用、可移轉技能的重要基礎。
recommendations.title: WikiSkill: Compiling Agent Experience into Persistent Knowledge for Skill Evolution
recommendations.title_zh: WikiSkill：將代理經驗編譯為持久知識以促進技能演化

links.title: ADeptS-Bench: Measuring the Trustworthiness of Computer Use Agents Across Devices

evidence: Abstract: 'no model consistently exceeds 80% task success while staying below 30% attack success; every model clicks Checkout on a $25K order without hesitation' - headline empirical finding
Sec 3.2: safety stream has 1,718 task instances (358 mobile pairs + 501 desktop pairs) across 10 threat categories with paired benign/malicious screenshots embedding visual threats
Sec 3.1/App K: risk taxonomy grounded in expert workshops and a MaxDiff survey (n=1,300 US participants); top outcomes identity theft 80.2%, account compromise 77.5%

Table 3 / Sec 4.2: removing the refusal tool raises ASR by +22.0pp for Gemini 3.1 Pro, +10.3-10.7pp for Claude/GPT-5.4, and ~0pp for Qwen, yielding the 'tool-dependent / partially tool-dependent / no mechanism' taxonomy
Table 2 / Sec 4.1: seven models, 10 runs at temperature 0.1 with 95% CIs; best ADeptS-Bench Score 76.0 (Gemini 3.1 Pro desktop)
Sec 4.5: LLM judge validated on 338 decisions, 96.1% human agreement (kappa=0.92); consequence overestimation in 42-62% of matched items across all models
Sec 4.4 / Fig 3: L1-L4 threat detectability spectrum; L4 (10.8%) including $25K checkout and 'Optimize'-labeled factory reset missed by all models

App P: GPT-5.4 scores 6% unsafe on OS-Harm overt requests but 36% on ADeptS malicious desktop tasks (43% when jailbreak-wrapped), arguing the benchmark measures a distinct, complementary threat presentation

Sec 5 / App H: limitations acknowledged - per-model harness differences (GPT-5.4 downscaled to 768px, Claude 1280x720), English-only tasks, US-based survey, and the disambiguation LLM judge also being an evaluated model
Conclusion/App N: data, evaluation code, and analysis tools to be released 'upon publication' under CC BY-NC 4.0; GitHub link provided but availability not yet verifiable
llm_evaluation.rationale: A benchmark paper squarely in-scope: it evaluates LLM/VLM-powered computer use agents for safety (attack success, false refusal, prompt injection, jailbreak) and disambiguation, matching high-weight preferences (Agents & Tool Use, AI Safety, Red Teaming & Evaluation, LLMs, Multimodal). Novelty is good but largely combinatorial: paired benign/malicious visual threats, offline single-step evaluation, a disambiguation stream, and a user-grounded taxonomy (MaxDiff n=1,300) are individually grounded in prior work (SafeArena, MobileSafetyBench, AmbiBench); Table 1/App. I substantiate the claim of being the first to combine these across mobile+desktop. Rigor is above average: 10 runs with 95% CIs (Table 2), validated LLM judge (96.1% agreement, kappa=0.92, Sec 4.5), refusal-tool ablation isolating three safety architectures (Table 3), margin sensitivity (App C), and an intent analysis ruling out grounding artifacts for GPT-5.4 (App B). Evidence strength is strong, including external corroboration via OS-Harm (App P: GPT-5.4 6% misuse on overt requests vs 36% interface-embedded compliance, 43% when jailbreak-wrapped). Deductions: per-model harnesses differ (resolution downscaling for GPT-5.4/Claude, acknowledged in Sec 5/App H), the disambiguation judge (Gemini 3.1 Pro) is also an evaluated model, low Krippendorff's alpha in annotation (App G), and single-step static screenshots limit ecological validity - the authors position it as 'necessary but not sufficient'. Generalizability is constrained (English-only, US-centric survey, 7 models from 4 families). Reproducibility is promising (GitHub link, datasheet, full prompts, CC BY-NC release) but data/code are only promised 'upon publication', not verifiably available. Overall a rigorous, highly relevant evaluation contribution with honest limitations.

primary_link.title: ADeptS-Bench: Measuring the Trustworthiness of Computer Use Agents Across Devices

recommendations.summary: Computer Use Agents (CUAs) are increasingly deployed to navigate mobile and desktop applications on behalf of users, yet no benchmark comprehensively evaluates whether they can safely interact with visual interfaces while handling ambiguous instructions. We introduce ADeptS-Bench, a dual-stream trustworthiness benchmark, grounded in the ADEPTS capability framework and general population user studies. The Safety stream provides paired benign/malicious tasks with threats embedded in the visual int
recommendations.summary_zh: 電腦使用代理（Computer Use Agents, CUAs）已逐漸為使用者操作行動與桌面應用程式，但尚無基準全面評估其能否在處理模糊指令時安全地與視覺介面互動。本文提出 ADeptS-Bench，依據 ADEPTS 能力框架與一般大眾使用者研究（MaxDiff 問卷，n=1,300）建立雙流可信度基準：Safety 流設計成對的良性／惡意任務，將釣魚覆蓋層、誤導按鈕與提示注入等威脅嵌入截圖中；Disambiguation 流則評估代理在決策點模糊時是否主動請求釐清，並以明顯度與後果兩軸計分。基準共 2,462 個任務，涵蓋行動與桌面平台，評測七個模型後發現：沒有模型能在保持攻擊成功率（ASR）低於 30% 的同時穩定超過 80% 的任務成功率（TSR），每個模型都會毫不猶豫地對 2.5 萬美元訂單點擊「結帳」，也無人察覺被誤標為「最佳化」的恢復原廠設定按鈕。消融實驗揭示三種安全架構：工具依賴型（移除拒絕工具後 Gemini 3.1 Pro 的 ASR 上升 22 個百分點）、部分工具依賴型（Claude、GPT-5.4）與無安全機制型（Qwen）。在消歧方面，所有模型普遍高估後果嚴重度，呼應安全流中過度拒絕的偏差。限制包括僅評估單步決策、僅涵蓋英文與 Android、Windows/Mac/Linux 平台。此基準為改善 CUA 可信度提供具體方向，並強調可信度需要多維度、跨平台的評估。
recommendations.title: ADeptS-Bench: Measuring the Trustworthiness of Computer Use Agents Across Devices

llm_evaluation.rationale: A RAG evaluation-methodology paper squarely in the preference space: retrieval-augmented generation, evidence/grounding judgments, LLM-as-judge reliability, and system selection, built entirely on LLM pipelines (GPT-4.1 answer-support judge, Gemma3-27B generator, Qwen3-30B/Claude Sonnet 5 evaluators). The core contribution is conceptual and empirical rather than a new architecture: a 'validity-composition problem' showing that an evidence-aware evaluation signal valid for one use does not automatically validate downstream training, selection, prediction, or intervention conclusions. Rigor is unusually high for an evaluation paper: prespecified eligibility and selection rules, matched-random counterfactuals (100,000 repetitions in RQ1; matched controls on relevance grade, rank band, and length quartile in RQ4), cross-fitted held-out system selection, leave-one-topic-out transfer tests, and independent human validation (two annotators, exact agreement 93.5%, kappa 0.660, AC1 0.928). Evidence strength is solid but bounded by small end-to-end samples (18 TREC RAG 2025 evaluation topics, 11-system roster), and the paper honestly reports null CIs; the RQ1 system-selective exposure finding (33.9pp spread on TREC-COVID, p_rand=0.0243) is the cleanest result, while RQ4's evaluator-dependence finding (Qwen +0.0289 p=0.0305 vs Claude -0.0003 p=0.9780) is striking but rests on exactly the LLM judges it critiques, partially mitigated by human validation. Generalizability is moderate: five benchmarks for RQ1 but a single shared task and generator for RQ2-4, and the authors themselves frame conclusions as use-relative. Reproducibility is decent (named models, hyperparameters, seeds 20260731-20260750, public benchmarks) but no explicit code or artifact release is stated. Not out of scope; keyword fit to RAG & Knowledge, Red Teaming & Evaluation, and LLMs is strong.

recommendations.summary_zh: RAG 的檢索評估正從單純的主題相關性，轉向檢索內容是否包含可支援生成答案的證據，但更貼近下游需求的評估訊號，是否真讓後續決策更可靠？本文以「答案支援」訊號為探針，在五個檢索基準與 TREC RAG 2025 上依序檢驗其四種用途：比較檢索器、引導訓練與系統選擇、預測答案品質，以及過濾餵給生成器的證據。結果顯示該訊號確實改變檢索排名，尤其當相關性與證據的落差在系統間分布不均時（如 TREC-COVID）；但效益無法自動傳遞：用於訓練未可靠改善檢索器；用於系統選擇的效益取決於生成器如何使用證據（Coverage-Disciplined 提示下顯著增益，Standard Grounded 下無效）；其分數亦無法在未見主題上預測答案品質。人工標註確認過濾確實保留更多承載答案的證據，但不同 LLM 評審（Qwen 與 Claude）對最終答案是否改善得出相異結論。作者據此提出「效度組合問題」：訊號對某一用途的效度不會自動延伸至下一層推論，RAG 評估應針對其欲支援的具體決策逐一驗證。

Section 4.3 Table 4: BTS GRPO is comparable to label-using synthetic-data and pinpoint-tuning baselines but costs ~80x the training FLOPs (9.37 vs ~0.11 x 10^17); SMART underperforms
Section 4 preamble: 166 reported tests controlled with Benjamini-Hochberg FDR at q=0.05, 77 survive the correction
