llm_evaluation.rationale: Directly on-topic: label-free RL post-training (GRPO) of LLMs to reduce sycophancy, a core LLM-alignment/AI-safety problem. Novel use of the Bayesian Truth Serum peer-prediction score as the reward, with three theorems proved and honest delimitation from Qiu et al. and test-time-RL agreement rewards. Rigor is high (explicit assumptions, full proofs, six-config reward ablation, five-base cross-model study, three supervised baselines, four peer-prediction mechanisms, Benjamini-Hochberg FDR control over 166 tests), but the key theory is asymptotic while training uses G=64, each experiment runs once with one seed, and one Phi-3 checkpoint was hand-selected using ground truth. Evidence is strong on the reference model (flip rate 23%→4%, accuracy 80%→93%) but weak/mixed on other bases for TF sycophancy, and the central ablation finding (prediction-score-only reward works nearly as well, contradicting the mechanism account) is unexplained; the 'surprise drives the effect' claim rests on four mechanisms on one dataset. Generalizability is limited to 3-4B models, synthetic binary true/false items, and a judge-free SYCON modification not comparable to upstream SYCON-Bench. Reproducibility is strong: pinned model revisions, seed 42, released code/datasets/configs and detailed hyperparameters, though hardware for two runs was unrecorded and kernels are not deterministic.

recommendations.summary: Large language models (LLMs) frequently exhibit \emph{sycophancy}: they adapt their answers to a user's stated beliefs or preferences instead of reporting what they hold to be true, which lowers factual accuracy and can amplify misinformation. This paper proposes a methodology for mitigating sycophancy that employs the Bayesian Truth Serum (BTS), a peer-prediction mechanism, as the reward in Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) to fine-tune an LLM. BTS pays an answer for being \emph{surpris
recommendations.summary_zh: 大型語言模型常出現諂媚行為：面對使用者表述的信念或壓力時，放棄自身判斷而附和。本文提出以貝葉斯真相遊戲作為 GRPO 的獎勵進行 RL fine-tuning：對同一問題取樣一群回應視為受訪者，獎勵「比受訪者自己預測更常見」的答案，全程不需標籤或偏好標註。理論上證明三項結果：預測報告會被精確引出；大群體極限下諂媚答案的期望獎勵嚴格低於誠實答案；即使整群事先協調答題規則，資訊分數也無法超過誠實回報。實驗上，參考模型在 true/false 基準的翻答案率由 23% 降至 4%，受壓力時正確率由 80% 升至 93%；表現優於 SMART，與使用標籤的合成資料 fine-tuning 及 pinpoint tuning 相當，但訓練計算量約為後者的八十倍，適合標籤稀缺情境。Peer Truth Serum 等支付稀有性溢價的機制同樣有效，暗示「驚訝度」是降低諂媚的關鍵。限制包括僅測試 3–4B 模型、單一種子、封閉式答案，且獎勵追隨模型自身信念而非真值，無法保證正確性。

llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly on-preference work on LLM agent memory/context management with a safety framing: type-blind compaction silently drops agent safety rules ('Compaction Cliff'), addressed by Knowledge Triage, which routes typed items through per-type retention policies across compaction, decomposition, and retrieval. Novelty is moderate-to-good: pinning safety-critical items verbatim is a simple core mechanism, but the typed rate-distortion framing, per-operator guarantees, and multi-round production-prompt quantification are a genuine contribution beyond prior typed-memory systems (MaRS, MemGPT) which lack per-type guarantees. Rigor is strong: 10 compaction baselines across 4 LLM families plus structural baselines (§4.3, Table 6), component-removal ablations, McNemar tests on three behavioral benchmarks (§4.5), inter-annotator agreement (κ=0.92 preserved/lost, §4.5), and a candid limitations section (self-referential classifier labels, κ=0.45 five-class, MaRS-FL reimplementation, non-token-matched retail comparison). Evidence is solid but not airtight: classifier evaluation uses gpt-5.4-mini labels as reference (§4.4), behavioral gains partly confounded by larger retained footprint (1,136 vs 669 tokens, §4.5), five-round decay tested on only two of four LLM families (§5), and the claimed formal proofs of §3.3 are only sketched in the visible text. Generalizability is supported by five public corpora, cross-domain benchmarks (retail/airline/medical), and a 396,934-item corpus, though public-GitHub sourcing and small behavioral sets (N=115/50/200) limit scope. Reproducibility is good: released HuggingFace dataset, classifier, and reference code (footnotes 1–2), though dependence on proprietary models (Sonnet 4.6, Opus 4.7, gpt-5.4 family) limits full replication.

We address it with Knowledge Triage, a framework that classifies each line of an agent's know
recommendations.summary_zh: 長期運作的 AI 代理中，安全規則與情節日誌爭奪相同的上下文 token 預算。本文發現所謂「壓縮斷崖」：Claude Code 的 /compact 在 Sonnet 4.6 上經一輪壓縮僅保留 53% 的安全規則，五輪後降至 10%。為此作者提出知識分診框架，將代理知識庫中的每一項分類為五種型別（約束、程序、信念、偏好、情節），並以三個確定性運算子分流：TypeCompact 依型別設定保真度就地壓縮、TypeDecompose 將過大主題分割並複製範圍內的安全規則、TypeRetrieve 在檢索時優先釘住適用規則。在五個公開語料上，TypeCompact 於每個壓縮比保留的安全規則是最強單次 LLM 壓縮器的 2–4 倍，五輪後仍有 96% 召回率；TypeDecompose 達到 0% 局部性違規；TypeRetrieve 達到 100% recall@50。下游行為基準（醫療合規、零售任務通過率、航空領域）證實工件層級的保留可轉化為更安全的代理行為。限制：語料取自公開 GitHub、安全保證完全依賴分類器召回率、分區複製開銷波動大。作者同時釋出包含 396,934 個代理知識工件的 AgentArtifactCorpus，對部署中的代理安全深具意義。

Appendix A.3: Inspect AI 0.3.241, vLLM 0.21.0, RDKit 2026.03.3, public Hugging Face checkpoints, and 'Redistributable frozen benchmark inputs and prompt templates accompany the paper', though 'restricted AMIE HPI input... are not redistributed'
llm_evaluation.rationale: An LLM evaluation-methodology paper squarely within scope: it evaluates four LLMs (Qwen3.6, GLM-4.7, DeepSeek-V4) across benchmark tasks including agentic repository repair, code bug finding, and retrieval-based evidence search, directly matching the LLM/evaluation/agents/code/RAG preference profile. Novelty is solid though not groundbreaking: VTC formalizes finite-budget coverage of distinct validated outcomes, well positioned against pass@k, NoveltyBench, HypoSpace, and Shypula et al., but the core idea (counting distinct useful outcomes across k draws) is a natural formalization. Rigor is strong: an unbiased subset-counting estimator (Appendix A.2, Eq. 3), 24 matched model-inference configurations, full per-configuration tables, a granularity sensitivity analysis (Appendix D.3), and 10,000-resample paired instance bootstrap for headline claims (Appendix D.5). Evidence for the central claims is quantitative and consistent: quality-based selection incurs 12.1% task-macro VTC regret with 10/25 Top-5 agreement, temperature raises VTC in 38/40 matched comparisons (36 with intervals above zero). Key weaknesses: VTC's usefulness hinges on heuristic task-specific outcome mappings (scaffolds, modified-function sets, UMLS CUIs) whose validity is asserted rather than human-validated; bootstrap covers instance resampling only, not generation stochasticity; only four models; medical/clinical and frozen-reference dependencies make absolute coverage reference-relative. Reproducibility is good: public GitHub link, pinned checkpoints, software versions, and redistributable frozen benchmark inputs, though AMIE clinical inputs are withheld. Generalizability of the metric requires constructing new deterministic mappings per task, which the authors honestly flag in Section 7.

primary_link.title: Evaluating Multiple LLM Generations with Validated Task Coverage

recommendations.summary: Many LLM applications are most useful when they provide several candidate outputs for comparison, validation, or combination. Predominant evaluation settings, however, still focus on individual outputs or reduce multiple samples to a single success or selected answer. This can miss whether the outputs include several genuinely different useful results. We introduce VTC-Bench, a five-domain benchmark for this setting, together with Validated Task Coverage (VTC) as its core evaluation quantity. Th
recommendations.summary_zh: 許多 LLM 應用需要提供多個候選輸出供比較或組合，但主流評測仍聚焦單一輸出品質，或把多次取樣縮減為單一成功事件（如 pass@k、self-consistency），無法衡量模型能否累積多個真正不同且有用的結果。本文提出 VTC-Bench 與 Validated Task Coverage（VTC）：統計 k 次嘗試後驗證通過且對應相異有用結果的數量。基準涵蓋五個領域——分子設計（以 Bemis–Murcko 骨架為單位）、軟體儲存庫修復（以通過測試的修改函式集合為單位）、程式錯誤查找（以行為錯誤類別為單位）、鑑別診斷（對映至 UMLS 概念）與證據搜尋（BRIGHT-Pro 推理面向），全部採自動驗證與確定性計分，不依賴模型裁判。針對四個模型與溫度、思考模式的 24 種組合實驗顯示：單次抽用品質最高的設定不必然擁有最佳覆蓋率，以品質選出的前五名平均相對覆蓋率損失達 12.1%；表面多樣性也無法可靠反映任務相關覆蓋率。提高溫度在 40 組配對比較中有 38 組提升覆蓋率，即使單次品質下降；思考模式與鏈結生成（明確要求多樣性）的效果則隨任務而異。限制在於 VTC 依賴任務特定的結果映射，且覆蓋率相對於凍結的參考目標。此工作證明有限候選集合本身即是值得直接評測的對象，能揭示傳統逐輸出評估看不到的行為差異。

llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-agent security paper squarely matching top preferences (agents, AI safety, red teaming, memory/RAG): it formalizes a single-shot memory injection attack on LLM agent memory systems with no store access, a clear threat model, and formal RSR/ASR metrics. Novelty is moderate rather than high: it builds on established GCG-style optimization and is differentiated from AgentPoison (direct store edit) and MINJA (multi-turn, trigger-keyed) mainly by single-shot budget, topic-conditioned anchor design, and Multi-GCG robustness to variable placement/context drift; Appendix D itself maps these deltas. Rigor is solid: 19 domains, 10 seeds, ~50 queries/domain (Sec. 4.1), ablations over anchor types and joint optimization (Tabs. 1,5), defense evaluation (App. A, Tab. 6), and a WildChat real-user check (App. C.2, Tab. 8). Evidence is generally supported by tables, though all-zero ASR baselines (Tab. 2), a crude fixed-string success criterion (App. E), a white-box backbone assumption (Sec. 3.2), and a small RSR aggregation inconsistency between Tab. 1 averages and Tab. 3 temper confidence. Limitations are candidly stated (App. B): reliance on white-box optimization and systems storing raw interaction text; cross-family transfer fails without concatenation (Tab. 5). Reproducibility is good: public code link, released corpora (944 conversations, 3096 pages, ~1900 queries), surrogate prompts, pseudocode (Algs. 1-4), and optimized commands (App. F), though some hyperparameters (T, W, K, m values) are not fully enumerated.

primary_link.title: InjecMEM: Memory Injection Attack on LLM Agent Memory Systems

recommendations.summary: Memory is becoming a default subsystem in deployed LLM agents to provide persistent personalization and continuity. This naturally prompts a question: will memory system introduce new vulnerabilities into agents? Thus we propose InjecMEM, a novel memory injection attack paradigm that requires only a single interaction (no read/edit access to memory store) to steer later responses of related queries toward a pre-specified output. Guided by the retrieval-then-generate mechanism of memory systems,
recommendations.summary_zh: 本文提出 InjecMEM，一種針對 LLM 代理記憶體系統的注入攻擊：攻擊者僅需一次互動、無需讀取或編輯記憶體儲存，即可使後續相關查詢的回應被導向預定輸出。攻擊由兩部分組成：一是與檢索器無關的錨點，含高召回的主題線索，使受污染紀錄持續被檢索；二是透過 Multi-GCG 梯度座標搜尋、在多個合成上下文與插入位置上平均最佳化的對抗指令，以對抗上下文漂移、位置變動與長提示稀釋。在 MemoryOS 與 MemGPT 上，攻擊達到最高 35.4% 的檢索成功率與 76.6% 的條件攻擊成功率，且在良性記憶漂移下持續有效，非目標查詢大致不受影響。轉移實驗顯示：家族內聯合最佳化可提升對未見變體（含微調版本）的轉移；跨家族則可靠簡單串接多條指令同時覆蓋。防禦評估顯示常見檢索期過濾器（LLM 評判、ProtectAI、PromptGuard）防護有限，困惑度過濾雖可完全阻擋攻擊但會誤擋 71.8% 良性頁面。限制：主要適用於儲存原始互動文字的系統，且指令最佳化仰賴對骨幹模型的白盒存取。此研究將記憶體系統確立為一個安全邊界。
recommendations.title: InjecMEM: Memory Injection Attack on LLM Agent Memory Systems
recommendations.title_zh: InjecMEM：針對 LLM 代理記憶體系統的記憶體注入攻擊

links.title: AsymSpec: Context-Asymmetric Speculative Decoding for Agentic LLMs

Table 1: AsymSpec reaches 64.0/66.8/48.4/63.5 on LongBench subsets and API-Bank vs Ceiling 64.9/76.5/55.0/66.1 at 0.23× FLOPs and 1.45× speedup
§6.2 Table 6: CDA gate alone lifts LongBench 45.0→52.8, δ-fusion to 59.7; SCD-style (t−b) δ-source collapses to 48.0, supporting the same-model (a−b) construction

llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM inference research directly aligned with agentic-LLM preferences: speculative decoding re-engineered for agentic pipelines with tool use, RAG-style compression, and end-to-end agent benchmarks (GAIA, SimpleQA via smolagents). Novelty is solid but incremental: it combines known ingredients (contrastive logit fusion from SCD, asymmetric speculation from RAPID/SpecSteer) into a new operating point (compressed verifier + full-context drafter) with a parameter-free JSD-based acceptance gate; the axiomatic derivation of the gate is a nice touch but thin. Rigor is strong: five baselines (§4.4), mechanism ablations isolating CDA vs δ-fusion vs δ-source (Table 6), K/γ/β/divergence/compressor/drafter-size sweeps (Tables 12, 14-18), cross-family portability (Table 10), and honest negative results (MultiChallenge inertness; VL-2B below Floor on file subset). Evidence is mostly convincing but has soft spots: the GAIA 'Ceiling' is a hybrid per-subset reference rather than a true full-context run (Table 4 caption), throughput table shows tuned-λ beating CDA by 25 tok/s attributed to 'measurement variance' (Table 11), MultiChallenge sweep is single-run (Table 21), and the ≈90%-recovery headline holds only for heavy-compression settings (0.78-0.80× FLOPs on GAIA/SimpleQA). primary_link.title: AsymSpec: Context-Asymmetric Speculative Decoding for Agentic LLMs

recommendations.summary: Agentic LLM pipelines face escalating inference costs as context accumulates across retrieval, tool use, and multi-turn interactions. To control latency, deployments routinely compress inputs, but this degrades task accuracy. Speculative decoding (SD) accelerates generation losslessly, yet it assumes the drafter and verifier share an identical context, preventing SD from resolving the accuracy-overhead trade-off. We propose AsymSpec, an asymmetric speculative decoding framework that breaks this
recommendations.summary_zh: 代理式 LLM 管線的脈絡隨檢索、工具呼叫與多輪互動不斷累積，部署時常壓縮輸入以控制延遲，但壓縮會損害準確率；投機解碼雖可無損加速，卻假設起草者與驗證者共享相同輸入，無法兼顧兩者。本文提出 AsymSpec：讓輕量起草者讀取完整輸入，大型驗證者僅處理壓縮視圖；透過同模型在完整與壓縮脈絡下 logits 之差的對比式 δ 融合，隔離脈絡增益並注入驗證者，再由無參數的脈絡散度接受閘門（CDA）依散度放寬接受門檻。實驗涵蓋四種代理能力與 GAIA、SimpleQA 端到端基準：平均達到全脈絡準確率約 90%，吞吐量提升 1.3–1.7 倍，文字任務計算量僅為 0.2–0.3 倍；增益隨壓縮嚴重度單調遞增，且可延伸至視覺–語言起草者搭配文字驗證者的跨模態設定。限制包括成效受限於壓縮視圖保留的資訊與起草者容量、需存取驗證者 logits，目前僅支援貪婪解碼。此法為長脈絡代理應用開闢「壓縮成本、近天花板品質」的新操作點。
recommendations.title: AsymSpec: Context-Asymmetric Speculative Decoding for Agentic LLMs
recommendations.title_zh: AsymSpec：面向代理式 LLM 的脈絡非對稱投機解碼

links.title: Repair or Resample? Rethinking Failure Debugging in LLM Multi-Agent Systems

evidence: Abstract: unguided reruns show low failure reproduction and repair rates ('only 67.97% and 6.90%'), and symptom-driven intervention repairs '20.15% of the failed cases (a 191.89% improvement to state-of-the-art repair methods)'
Sec. 5.2, Table 2: SymTrace Replay raises rep1 from 67.97% to 80.78% and rep3 from 41.42% to 52.43% over Unguided Full Rerun across 536 failures
Sec. 5.4, Table 4: Suspicious-Node Intervention achieves 20.15% total pass@1 vs Random-Node 3.73% and Last-Node 1.31%, best on all three MASs
Appendix C.4, Table 8: all 15 RQ3 paired comparisons have 95% CIs excluding zero and remain significant after Holm correction (p_H < 0.05)
Appendix B.4, Table 6: three-annotator Fleiss' kappa 0.622 (primary category) and 0.811 (node type); exact node agreement 73.88%
Appendix D.3: replay-fidelity audit reports 1,608/1,608 attempts with exact target IDs and 6,159/6,159 reused nodes matching source content hashes
Appendix C.2: all experiments use alias 'deepseek-v4-flash' at temperature 0.00 via an OpenAI-compatible endpoint with 'no confirmed upstream provider identity or server-side revision'
Sec. 5.4: 'Because target selection and repair guidance are evaluated jointly, the experiment does not attribute the full improvement to either component in isolation' (no component ablation)
Appendix F.5: selection coefficients and threshold 0.50 are 'manually specified heuristic design weights' with no validation-set optimization
Appendix H: 'The code and data supplement includes the complete source code of SymTrace and the complete SymFail dataset'
Sec. 6 (Discussion): limitations include benchmark-derived task coverage, LLM-judge evaluation with 'occasional errors', and single-model scope
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly in-scope methodological study on LLM multi-agent system debugging, squarely matching the high-weight agents and LLM preferences; not a pure domain application. Novelty is solid but incremental in parts: selective replay borrows classic record-replay debugging (Ronsse et al., Sec. 2.2) and applies it to MAS failure attribution, and the C1-C4 taxonomy derives from Cemri et al. (Sec. 4.3); the controlled prefix-reconstruction framing that separates causal repair from stochastic resampling is the genuinely new contribution. Rigor is high: 536 human-annotated failures across three MAS frameworks (Sec. 4.2), inter-annotator reliability reported (Fleiss' kappa 0.622 primary category, 0.811 node type, Appendix B.4), paired bootstrap and exact McNemar tests with Holm correction (Appendix C.3-C.4), node-level controls (Random/Last-Node, Table 4), a replay-fidelity audit with 1,608/1,608 prefix-exact attempts (Appendix D.3), and a quantified LLM-judge error audit with 6.96% sensitivity upper bound (Sec. 5.2). Evidence is credible: 20.15% pass@1 for Suspicious-Node vs 6.90% pass@3 for the strongest task-level baseline, with all 15 RQ3 comparisons significant after Holm correction (Table 8), and honest outcome-instability analysis showing 85/162 reruns of successful executions fail (Sec. 5.3). Weaknesses: single unverified model alias (deepseek-v4-flash, Appendix C.2), only web-agent benchmarks, no ablation separating symptom detection from repair guidance (admitted in Sec. 5.4), hand-set non-optimized scoring coefficients (Appendix F.5), and reliance on LLM-as-judge for the headline reproduction metric. Generalizability is moderate (three architectures but one model family and two benchmarks); reproducibility is good given released code/data (Appendix H), full prompts, hyperparameters, and seeds, though the unconfirmed endpoint identity limits exact replication.

primary_link.title: Repair or Resample? Rethinking Failure Debugging in LLM Multi-Agent Systems

recommendations.summary: As large language model (LLM)-based multi-agent systems (MASs) are increasingly applied to long-horizon complex tasks, their reliability has emerged as the core bottleneck hindering their real-world deployment. Existing MAS debugging and repair methods typically rely on rerunning and resampling the entire execution trajectory. However, a fundamental question remains to be answered: do these methods causally repair MAS failures or merely stochastically repair by leveraging the randomness of LLM s
recommendations.summary_zh: LLM 多代理系統的修復方法多仰賴重跑整條執行軌跡，但成功究竟源於因果修復，或只是 LLM 取樣隨機性帶來的運氣，長期缺乏嚴謹檢驗。本文提出 SymTrace：以事件依賴圖記錄模型與工具互動，重播時用錄製結果嚴格重建失敗節點之前的執行，再從介入點恢復即時執行，藉此可靠重現失敗並隔離介入效果；並建構含 536 條人工標註失敗軌跡的 SymFail 資料集，涵蓋 AG2、CrewAI、Magentic-One 三大框架與 WebArena-Verified Hard、AssistantBench 任務。大規模實驗發現：未引導的全量重跑僅 6.90% 修復率，自我反思與批評代理在相同預算下無顯著優勢；SymTrace 將單次失敗重現率由 67.97% 提升至 80.78%；以症狀驅動的 Suspicious-Node Intervention 僅用一次介入即達 20.15% 修復率，較最強任務級基準提升 191.89%，且在三個框架上均最佳。限制包括基準任務無法涵蓋真實世界失敗、LLM 評審可能誤判，以及僅測試單一模型。此研究確立「控制執行歷史、在地化介入」的 MAS 修復評估原則。
recommendations.title: Repair or Resample? Rethinking Failure Debugging in LLM Multi-Agent Systems
recommendations.title_zh: 修復還是重新取樣？反思 LLM 多代理系統的失敗除錯

links.title: Safety Hacking in Constrained Best-of-$N$ Inference-time Scaling

evidence: Abstract: defines safety hacking as selecting an output that passes the learned constraint but violates the true safety criterion; finite-N bounds governed by joint upper reward tails.
Theorem 4.1: finite-N bounds for CBoN hacking probability in terms of joint tails Ψ_A, Ψ_B; Theorem 4.2 gives asymptotic certainty under tail separation (Section 4).

Section 6.2: 714 test prompts from JailbreakBench/HarmBench/AdvBench; 256 samples per prompt from Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct (228,608 candidates), Llama-Guard-3-8B filter, beaver-7b-v1.0-reward ranking, HarmBench classifier as operational safety criterion, gpt-5-mini safety-aware reward.

Section 6.2 Reward-proxy ablation: Beaver CBoN hacking 9.1% (N=1) to 13.4% (N=256); Skywork decreases to 6.8%; unsafe-only term 1.6% under both, competitive term 11.7% -> 5.3%, attributing trend to reward ranking.
Appendix A.15: equal-tail control (σ_B=σ_A=0.2) drives hacking to zero by N=32 and no-false-positive control gives zero hacking, supporting the tail-amplification mechanism.
Section 7 Limitations: analysis restricted to fixed, non-adaptive i.i.d. candidate pipeline; explicitly excludes adaptive search, self-refinement, tree search, and agentic planning.
Appendix A: full proofs for Theorems 4.1/4.2/5.1, Corollary 4.3, Propositions 5.2/A.6/A.8-A.10, plus cPes pseudocode (Algorithm 1) and consistency result A.8.
Appendix B.2: ShieldGemma-2B alternative-filter sensitivity (12.1% -> 14.8% hacking, competitive term 0 -> 13.8%) reported as qualitative consistency rather than primary evidence.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Directly on LLM inference-time scaling safety: formalizes 'safety hacking' where reward maximization amplifies false acceptances of a learned safety filter in constrained Best-of-N. Strong match to LLM (Qwen2.5-7B experiments), AI Safety, Alignment (reward models, SafeRLHF lineage), and Red Teaming/Evaluation (JailbreakBench, HarmBench, Llama Guard, ShieldGemma) preferences. Theoretically substantive: finite-N tail bounds, asymptotic inevitability result, chi-square coverage-control theorem with proofs, plus a pessimistic sampling algorithm. Evidence is unusually careful: 228,608-candidate pool, permutation-averaged estimates with cross-prompt standard errors, a two-term finite-N decomposition, reward-proxy ablation (Beaver vs Skywork reversing the trend), and alternative-filter sensitivity. Deductions: formalization builds closely on existing reward-overoptimization and pessimistic BoN work; LLM evidence is limited to one generator model on adversarial prompts with modest effect sizes (9.1%->13.4%) and non-ground-truth operational criteria (HarmBench classifier, gpt-5-mini rubric); theory explicitly excludes adaptive/tree/agentic search, limiting scope; no explicit code release despite detailed model/checkpoint/rubric specifications.

primary_link.title: Safety Hacking in Constrained Best-of-$N$ Inference-time Scaling

recommendations.summary: Inference-time pipelines often sample multiple outputs, filter them with a learned safety model, and return the proxy-feasible output with the highest learned reward. We show that this composition creates a two-stage failure: an imperfect safety proxy first contaminates the feasible set with unsafe outputs, and reward maximization can then amplify this residual contamination. We define \emph{safety hacking} as selecting an output that passes the learned constraint but violates the true safety cr
recommendations.summary_zh: 受限 Best-of-N（CBoN）推論時運算先以習得的安全模型過濾取樣，再以獎勵模型挑選最高分輸出。本文定義「安全駭取」為選中通過習得安全約束但違反真實安全準則的輸出，並指出兩階段失效：不完美的安全代理先污染可行集，獎勵最大化再放大殘留污染。理論上，有限 N 界由代理可行集中安全與不安全輸出的聯合獎勵上尾主導：若不安全但可行者具有較重上尾，隨 N 增大安全駭取漸近趨於必然，即使誤接受質量與平均代理誤差皆趨於零。與代理可行參考分佈保持有界 χ² 散度的策略（如受限悲觀取樣 cPes）可獲得與 N 無關的駭取上界，但只能限制放大、無法修復污染。玩具與 LLM 實驗（Qwen2.5-7B、Llama Guard 過濾器、Beaver 獎勵代理）以有限 N 分解證實：競爭性不安全勝出項隨 N 上升，是駭取率成長的主因；改用 Skywork 獎勵代理可反轉此趨勢，凸顯獎勵尾行為的關鍵角色。限制：僅分析固定非自適應管線，未涵蓋自我精煉或樹搜尋等回饋式程序。結論指出安全的推論時縮放需同時控制進入可行集的污染與下游集中。

links.title: The Guard That Cried Wolf: How Scary Words Make Agent Guardrails Refuse Legitimate Actions

evidence: Abstract: 'we construct Cautious Bench... the first benchmark to make over-safety the construct for agent guardrails'; reports 756 Decidable benign/twin pairs (2,268 measured pairs across three name grades) and 40 Undecidable pairs.

Measurement section: seven guardrails evaluated — AgentDoG 1.5 fine-tuned on Qwen3.5-4B and Llama-3.1-8B, TS-Guard, R-Judge, ToolEmu safe-evaluator, PIGuard (out-of-scope probe), LlamaGuard (content-safety floor).

Table 1: FP rises from innocent to scary name on every execution-safety guard (AgentDoG-Qwen 63→82, TS-Guard 34→66, ToolEmu 32→45), while PIGuard and LlamaGuard stay near-flat, supporting name-attribution via the within-cell design.

Findings section: length-artifact control — 'on the 356 cells whose innocent and scary names differ by at most one character, refusal still rises... TS-Guard 32%→62%'; paired McNemar test cited for scary-vs-innocent rise.
Measurement section, refusal predicate: TS-Guard's hedged 'flagged' verdict counted as refusal; disclosed alternative scoring lowers its FP from 35% to 17% without changing rank or direction.

Limitations section: 'Each guardrail runs once per cell, so rates are point estimates and we claim the effect's direction and rank, not precise values'; guards are 'language-model-based, natural-language, English, single-principal, and synchronous'.

Ethics section: 'We release the generator, the authorization policy Π, the gate, and the recipes under an open license, and the corpus is regenerated by the released generator' — reproducibility claim without an explicit repository URL in the text.

Framework and Benchmark sections: build-time construction gate enforces four invariants (same-surface, contrast-observable, no label leakage, pre-action observability); faithfulness check backstopped by 'three security-domain human experts' as a corpus-level veto.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly on-preference: an LLM-agent guardrail evaluation benchmark touching Agents & Tool Use, AI Safety, and Red Teaming & Evaluation simultaneously. The core contribution — policy-derived (Π-relative) labels with a build-time derivation gate, benign/twin counterfactuals, and a within-cell name-grade manipulation isolating a 'name-superstition' effect — is a genuinely novel construct for execution-safety over-refusal, distinct from content-safety over-refusal suites (XSTest/OR-Bench) and harm benchmarks (AgentHarm/AgentDojo). Rigor is above average: four construction invariants, a faithfulness check with three expert vetoes, a disclosed and sensitivity-analyzed refusal predicate, a length-confound control (≤1-char name-difference subset), and a McNemar test. Evidence is solid but not airtight: single run per cell with no confidence intervals (acknowledged), one exploratory subset analysis left unresolved (ToolEmu removal subset), and the trace analysis is admitted to be unsystematic. Generalizability is bounded by design: seven LM-based guards, English, single-principal, synchronous, with the effect possibly family-specific. Reproducibility claims are strong (generator, policy, gate, recipes released; corpus regenerable) though no concrete artifact link appears in the text. No over-claiming; limitations section is candid and well-scoped.

primary_link.title: The Guard That Cried Wolf: How Scary Words Make Agent Guardrails Refuse Legitimate Actions

recommendations.summary: Agent guardrails are checks that approve or refuse each action before an LLM executes it. Sometimes they refuse requests that are genuinely safe. This over-safety blocks deployment when a guardrail refuses an authorized task. Evaluating over-safety is hard: at the boundary an authorized action resembles an unauthorized one, and the safe-versus-unsafe label is a choice of authorization policy, not fixed by the action alone. We argue it therefore requires a benchmark that does not yet exist, one t
recommendations.summary_zh: 防護欄會在 LLM 代理執行動作前決定放行或拒絕，但常因動作「看起來危險」而拒絕其實已獲授權的行為，此現象稱為過度安全，會侵蝕信任並阻礙部署。衡量過度安全很困難：授權動作在決策邊界上與未授權動作相似，安全與否取決於授權政策而非動作本身。本文建構 Cautious Bench，首個以此為構念的基準：每個樣本與標籤共同設計自明確的授權政策 Π，涵蓋角色、範圍、同意、前置條件、來源等十條授權軸；benign 與 twin 成對反事實僅在一處授權事實上不同，標籤由建構期閘門機械地從政策推導，並經忠實性檢查把關。基準渲染 756 個可判定配對，並在無害、原樣、驚悚三種物件名稱等級下測量七種防護欄。核心發現是名稱迷信效應：所有執行安全類防護欄在驚悚名稱下的誤拒率都高於無害名稱（如 AgentDoG-Qwen 63→82、TS-Guard 34→66），顯示其判決隨表面名稱而非授權脈絡移動；刪除類動作上也有此現象，40 個不可判定樣本則另行報告。限制在於所有受測防護欄皆為語言模型式、英文、單主體且同步，且僅測量決策邊界。此工作為防護欄提供了可答辯的過度安全標籤參照，並指出防護欄應善用授權脈絡而非表面線索。

llm_evaluation.rationale: Core-LLM interpretability/evaluation methodology paper: audits whether activation-steering effects (CAA on anti-sycophancy) are concept-specific, directly matching LLM (2.5), Interpretability (1.8), AI Safety (2.0) and Evaluation (1.8) preferences. Novelty is moderate: the framing builds on known steering-reliability critiques (its own Table 9 admits no single component is new), but the matched-KL functional budget, the construction diagnostic A (Section 5, Eq. 6), and quantified alignment leakage of sign-randomized comparators (sd cos .577, P(cos>=.5)=.253 in Table 2) are genuinely new measurements. Rigor is exceptional: preregistered frozen gates, Holm-corrected intersection-union tests, prospective positive controls showing the gate is passable (Table 1), exact seed replay validated to 1.7e-16, retained failures (Appendix E), judge calibration check (macro-F1 .562 fails, Table 7), and Gamma=1.10 sensitivity. Evidence is strong for the diagnostics (rho=.938 effect-cosine association, Table 4; A predicts leakage at r=.979 across 21 cells, Table 3) but the central alignment-effect profile is explicitly post-hoc, descriptive, and one behavior/layer/model (Section 8), and the 21-cell panel uses two related Qwen series rather than independent families. Generalizability is deliberately narrow per the paper's own scope statement. Reproducibility is outstanding: CPU-only scripts regenerate Tables 2-4 in under a minute from released seeds/hashes (Reproducibility statement).

primary_link.title: SteerCheck: Attribution Specificity and Alignment Leakage in Activation-Steering Audits

recommendations.summary: Activation steering can change behaviour without establishing that the effect is specific to the intended concept. We introduce SteerCheck, a preregistered attribution audit that matches off-target KL and separates mean, protected-tail, polarity, transfer, and semantic claims. Exact replay of 960 Qwen3-14B interventions reveals complementary limits of common controls: isotropic directions occupy a narrow near-orthogonal region, whereas sign-randomized same-construction directions often retain su
recommendations.summary_zh: 激活導引（activation steering）可在不改動模型權重下改變行為，但僅憑行為改變無法證明效果確實源自目標概念。本文提出 SteerCheck，一項預註冊的歸因審計：在匹配非目標 KL 的功能預算下，比較觀測向量與三族空對照——各向同性隨機方向、PCA 子空間方向與符號隨機化方向，並把均值、受保護尾部、極性、遷移與語義宣告分開檢驗。對 960 個 Qwen3-14B 干預的精確重放顯示兩種對照的互補侷限：各向同性方向落在近正交區域，而符號隨機化方向卻常保留大量目標對齊（餘弦標準差 .577，25.3% 的抽樣餘弦超過 .5），且族內效果與帶符號餘弦高度相關（Spearman ρ=.94）；作者導出診斷量 A 預測此對齊洩漏，並在 21 個儲存構造單元驗證（r=.979）。凍結的 Qwen 完整閘門仍為陰性：均值未通過符號隨機化比較，保護尾部三族皆未通過。前瞻性正向控制證明閘門可通過，但對 Γ=1.10 敏感性包絡脆弱。獨立資料上連續邊際僅在 Qwen 遷移，準確率皆不遷移；人工評分支持 DeepSeek 的事實修正而非 Qwen，自動裁判校準失敗（macro-F1 .562）。限制包括單一行為、單一層、兩個相關 Qwen 系列，且對齊-效果剖面為事後描述性分析。此工作使導引歸因審計的條件與混合結論可被稽核。

llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM reasoning-efficiency paper squarely within scope: test-time scaling, sliding-window attention kernels, and RL (GRPO) training on Qwen3 models. Preference relevance is high given strong coverage of LLMs, reasoning/CoT, transformer architecture, scaling/efficiency, and inference topics, though it touches none of the Japanese NLP, RAG, safety, or multimodal preferences. Novelty is moderate: the authors themselves note (Section 6) the method is essentially 'sliding window attention with global tokens' forming a prefix, closely related to StreamingLLM and Longformer; the main new contributions are the training-free application to reasoning traces and truncated backpropagation for long RL rollouts using the limited receptive field of stacked sliding windows (Section 2). Rigor is solid but not exceptional: evaluations use avg@64 on AIME25/GPQA/MATH500 with controlled temperature (Section 3), window-size sweeps, PE reset-vs-continue ablation (Appendix D), KL-divergence analysis of trainer multipliers (Figure 8), and baselines last-k/summary/vanilla sliding window with hyperparameter sweeps (Appendix G, Tables 2-3), but most headline comparisons live in figures and the model pool is narrow (Qwen3-1.7B, one 7B validation in Appendix E). Evidence strength is decent: Appendix C Table 1 gives concrete numbers (window 4096: AIME25 33.9 vs Full 34.2, tok/s at 32K 5479 vs 1477, supporting the 3x claim), yet key efficiency and ablation claims rest on figures and comparisons are deliberately restricted to bounded-cost, out-of-the-box alternatives (Limitations). Generalizability is reasonable - training-free applicability plus RL integration - but honest limitations (LiveCodeBench needs ≥16384 window, Figure 11; minimal gains for short generations, Figure 12; multi-turn/agentic failure modes) narrow the scope. Reproducibility is strong: simple method fully specified, hyperparameters and dataset filtering described (Appendix F), code released.

primary_link.title: Prefix Sliding for efficient test-time scaling

recommendations.summary: Test-time scaling uses extra test-time compute to improve performance, such as letting language models reason longer when solving a problem. As models keep the entire reasoning trace in memory via full attention, hard tasks that need long thinking can be prohibitively expensive. However, we find most intermediate reasoning tokens lose importance as the model continues reasoning. This calls into question whether retaining them is worth the cost. Based on this insight, we propose Prefix Sliding, which discards tokens during reasoning that are not part of the prefix or the window of the last few thousand tokens. The prefix has key instructions and tools available to the model, while the most recent tokens are the current reasoning the model is working on. This caps the total memory requirement regardless of how long the model reasons, allowing for efficient long-horizon test-time scaling. Without training, Prefix Sliding can make existing models 3x faster while maintaining performance. Training with Prefix Sliding using reinforcement learning can achieve better performance by enabling scaling to reasoning traces beyond a hundred thousand tokens. Ablations show Prefix Sliding outperforms summarizing intermediate tokens or vanilla sliding window. Our code is at https://github.com/Muennighoff/prefix-sliding
recommendations.summary_zh: 測試時擴展讓模型為難題思考更久，但全注意力須將整條推理軌跡留在記憶體，長推理成本隨生成長度增加而難以負擔。作者觀察到中間推理 token 的重要性快速衰減，而開頭前綴（系統指令、任務與工具資訊）與最近的 token 最為關鍵，據此提出 Prefix Sliding：推理時僅保留前綴與數千 token 的滑動視窗，捨棄其間的中間 token，使生成成本在達到上限後恆定，從而支援極長程的測試時擴展。此法無需訓練即可套用於既有模型，亦可配合 RL 訓練。結果顯示：不訓練時在相同思考時間下快約 3 倍且維持效能；搭配 RL 與截斷反向傳播，可將推理擴展至十萬 token 以上並提升獎勵；在 AIME25 等基準上優於摘要中間 token、僅保留最後 k 個 token 與純滑動視窗等替代方案。限制包括 LiveCodeBench 需更大視窗才能追上全注意力、短生成任務效益有限，以及代理式任務中大量讀取內容可能淹沒視窗、多輪使用者指令的處理方式仍待解決。
recommendations.title: Prefix Sliding for efficient test-time scaling
recommendations.title_zh: Prefix Sliding：高效率的測試時擴展

links.title: Beyond Vector Hiding: Breaking and Mitigating Shared-Direction Weight Obfuscation in TEE-Offloaded Large Language Models

evidence: Abstract: SpectralLeak surrogates achieve 87.98% mean accuracy versus 89.85% for victims across 12 task settings; LatticeLeak exactly reconstructs every protected fixed-point parameter in BERT-Base and GPT2-Base experiments.

Section 3 (Scope): the modular realization is 'constructed by this work and is not part of the released implementation,' instantiated in a defense-favorable manner from ArrowCloak's published modular security formulation.

Section 8.4: on the BERT anchor LatticeLeak exactly recovers all 72 protected tensors (82,944 rows, 84,934,656 coordinates) in 233.44 seconds including evaluation; reconstructed model retains 91.6284% victim accuracy.

Table 6 / Section 8.6: SpectralLeak recovers 99.606%-100% row correspondence on Qwen3-8B, Llama-3.1-8B, and Gemma-4-E2B with 96.22-96.56% accuracy without refinement, within 0.34 points of victims; ArrowMatch correspondence is only 9.080-9.151%.
Table 13: transferred LatticeLeak against 512x ButterflyCloak recovers 0/82,944 exact victim rows; 44 of 72 tensors reject all 16 public coordinate windows.
Section 8.5: full-BERT protection preserves 91.6284% accuracy while reducing PC1 energy to 0.13049% and raw correspondence to 0.11695%.
Table 5 (RQ2): field-wide mod-Q keys reduce PC1 alignment to 2.5012% and permutation recovery to 0.0808% versus 100% under small keys, isolating the arithmetic-suppression effect.
Section 1: acknowledges concurrent preprints MOSAIC and ArrowRevelio analyzing the same ArrowCloak target, with ArrowRevelio also SVD-based against the real-valued implementation.

Appendix H: explicitly states neither attack solves LWE and ButterflyCloak provides resistance to the evaluated attacks, not cryptographic indistinguishability; implementation is a correctness-oriented prototype without measured TEE latency.

Appendix G: checkpoint revision hashes, seed 42, fixed hyperparameters, PyTorch 2.13.0/Transformers 5.15.1 versions, and machine-readable manifests with SHA-256 checksums support reproduction; Appendix A notes coordinated disclosure and artifact release preparation.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A systems-security paper on protecting LLM weights in TEE-shielded partitioning: it breaks the ArrowCloak obfuscation scheme (real-valued SpectralLeak via PCA; modular LatticeLeak via lattice reduction) and proposes ButterflyCloak, a maximal-rank keyed butterfly mask. Preference relevance is solid: the target and evaluation are LLM-specific (Qwen3-8B, Llama-3.1-8B, Gemma-4-E2B, GPT2-XL), and the attack/defense framing fits AI Security, but the core contribution is matrix/lattice cryptanalysis rather than language-model methodology, so it is not a top-of-scale match. Novelty is good though tempered by acknowledged concurrent work (MOSAIC, ArrowRevelio) on the same target; the modular-variant attack and the rank-root-cause defense are the more original pieces. Rigor and evidence are strong: formal threat model, rank-2/3 ablations showing adaptive PCA defeats constant-rank masks, random-direction controls (Table 2), challenger-only exact-recovery audits (82,944/82,944 BERT rows, Tables 10-11), adaptive-PCA defense diagnostics (Tables 12-13, 15), and unusually honest scoping (modular target self-constructed per Section 3 Scope; no LWE-solution claim in Appendix H). Deductions: exact recovery depends on primitive-row and fixed-point conditions, defense resistance is only against the paper's own attacks, and only operation counts (no measured TEE latency) support the efficiency claim. Reproducibility is aided by checkpoint hashes, seeds, and software versions, but artifacts are not yet publicly released.

primary_link.title: Beyond Vector Hiding: Breaking and Mitigating Shared-Direction Weight Obfuscation in TEE-Offloaded Large Language Models

recommendations.summary: Trusted Execution Environment (TEE)-shielded partitioning of Large Language Models (LLMs) accelerates on-device inference by offloading obfuscated linear layers to an untrusted accelerator while retaining only a small correction inside the TEE. However, earlier lightweight obfuscation schemes preserved weight-vector directions and were broken by ArrowMatch. To defend against this attack, ArrowCloak injects scalar multiples of the same hidden direction into all weight vectors, enabling lightweigh
recommendations.summary_zh: 為保護部署在邊緣裝置的專有模型權重，TEE 屏蔽的模型分割會將混淆後的線性層卸載至不受信任的加速器，僅在 TEE 內保留輕量輸出校正。先前輕量混淆方案保留權重向量方向而被 ArrowMatch 破解；ArrowCloak 為此對所有權重向量注入同一隱藏方向，以維持 O(nℓ) 校正成本。本文指出此共享方向重用會在整個加速器可見矩陣留下秩一關係。針對發布的實數版本，作者提出 SpectralLeak，透過主成分分析估計並移除共享成分、恢復列對應後重建權重，在 12 個任務設定中代理模型平均達 87.98%，接近受害模型的 89.85%，並擴及 Qwen3-8B、Llama-3.1-8B 與 Gemma-4-E2B。對防禦有利的模 Q 形式，提出 LatticeLeak，利用 Construction A 格與 LLL 取消共享項，再透過重疊跨度交集隔離個別列，在 BERT-Base 與 GPT2-Base 上完全重建所有定點參數，且不需查詢、標籤或微調。歸因根因為秩一重用後，作者設計 ButterflyCloak：以金鑰化的最大秩蝶形遮罩取代共享方向，任務準確率不變，卻抑制兩類攻擊，TEE 校正僅 O(nℓ log n)，漸近低於稠密遮罩。限制在於此屬系統性緩解而非密碼學證明，且實作為原型。本研究揭示矩陣層級洩漏分析對權重保護的重要性。

llm_evaluation.rationale: Core transformer-architecture/efficiency paper for language models: recurrent depth (weight-tied core with prelude-shared-coda layout), GRU-style elementwise gating plus noise to prevent representational collapse, evaluated in isoFLOPs and isoParams regimes with latent-reasoning/test-time-compute framing. Strongly matches Transformer Architecture, Scaling & Efficiency, Inference & Serving, and LLM preferences; moderate match to Reasoning (framing only, no benchmark reasoning results). Novelty is incremental: prelude-shared-coda and depth sampling are adopted from Geiping et al. [9], and the contribution is the gate+noise modulation on a well-populated line (ALBERT, Universal Transformers, MoR, RRT, Ouro). Rigor is solid: matched-FLOP/param baselines trained from scratch at three scales, sequential component ablation, gate-bias/noise/temperature sweeps, downstream lm-eval-harness, and extensive Appendix E mechanistic analysis; but only 3 seeds at small scale (single seed elsewhere), GPT-2-scale training (~9.8B tokens), and a sequential rather than factorial ablation. Evidence claims are mostly supported and honestly reported (dense baseline still leads by 0.05-0.06 nats at medium/large at standard budget; RRT ties at small scale), with a disclosed confound in B.3 (dense trained with torch.compile, recurrent runs without). Generalizability is limited: GPT-2 family, 1024 context, dataset described only as 'a diverse dataset of text', and authors concede gate bias/noise may need re-tuning beyond GPT-2. Reproducibility is decent (full hyperparameter Table 5, forward-pass listing, seeds, hardware, public code) but weakened by the unnamed training corpus.

primary_link.title: Gated Recurrent Transformers: Expressive Depth through Recurrent Modulation

recommendations.summary: Scaling transformer language models creates an inherent tension between expressivity and memory efficiency. While unique weights across layers preserve functional specialization---from input-grounding to abstract refinement---they incur a substantial memory footprint. Conversely, standard depth-sharing enforces uniform transformations that collapse representational diversity and degrade modeling quality. We introduce Gated Recurrent Transformer, a recurrent depth transformer where fixed-depth prelude and coda blocks bracket a single shared core iterated R times. Inspired by gated recurrent neural networks, we employ a lightweight projection and an elementwise update gate---conditioned on the hidden state, the fixed prelude output, and noise resampled at every step---to modulate the recurrent update. This allows the model to specialize the input to the same few layers across recurrences, rather than requiring many unique layers to achieve functional diversity. Under an isoFLOPS constraint, a 3-layer Gated Recurrent Transformer matches the accuracy of a 12-layer GPT-2 Small baseline with similar training and inference FLOPs, and leads MoR and heavy-tail depth sampling in all nine scale-by-budget cells; at medium and large scale it approaches dense quality at the standard token budget and overtakes it at medium scale once that budget is doubled. Under an isoPARAMS constraint, deeper recurrence achieves a 2.76 validation loss versus 2.84 for a non-recurrent counterpart at matched parameter and data budget. Our results demonstrate that adaptive depth reuse is a principled strategy for trading parameters for quality: at large scale, 63% fewer parameters and 59% less peak decoding memory for a 10% increase in compiled generation latency.
recommendations.summary_zh: Transformer 的深度與參數量緊密耦合：每層權重各自獨立造成記憶體瓶頸，而全權重共享又會壓抑表達多樣性。本文提出閘控遞迴 Transformer（GRT）：固定深度的前奏與尾奏區塊之間，夾一個迭代 R 次的共享核心；受 GRU 啟發，以依據當前隱藏狀態、前奏輸出與逐步注入雜訊的輕量元素級閘門，調控每次遞迴的寫入幅度，使同一組權重在每步扮演不同角色。在 isoFLOPs 條件下，3 層 GRT 達到 12 層 GPT-2 Small 的準確率，於全部九個規模×預算組合領先 MoR 與 heavy-tail 深度取樣，中型與大型規模隨資料預算成長追平甚至超越稠密基準；isoParams 條件下驗證損失 2.76，優於非遞迴對照的 2.84。大型規模下以少 62% 參數與 59% 尖峰解碼記憶體，僅付出約 10% 編譯後生成延遲，並自然浮現推論期早退能力：僅執行一半遞迴步數仍保留約 92% 準確率。消融顯示元素級閘門是最大貢獻者。限制包括遞迴深度在推論時固定、閘門超參數可能需針對其他架構重調。

llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM safety/red-teaming paper with an interpretability-driven method: internal safety-neuron activations replace sparse response-level feedback in a coverage-guided fuzzer, hitting high-weight preferences (LLM, AI Safety, Red Teaming/Evaluation, Interpretability). The reframing of fuzzing feedback via a differentiable prefill-only SafetyOracle is a genuine new perspective, though components (MLP activation pooling, stability selection, MCTS-Explore scheduling, MLM mutation) are combinations of known techniques. Evaluation is unusually broad and quantitative: oracle validity (AUROC 0.969-0.999, Spearman -0.927 to -0.976), comparisons to GCG/AutoDAN/PAIR/LLM-Fuzzer across five source models, transfer to 14 targets including six proprietary APIs with 5-run variance, cross-dataset (HarmBench), VLM transfer, defense and detector studies, plus component and probe-model ablations. Weaknesses: key ablations are single-model (Section 6.1 on Llama-3.1-8B, 6.2 on GPT-OSS-20B); fuzzing uses only 100 StrongREJECT questions with no CIs on JDR; oracle trained on harmful/benign classification could bias ranking toward its own objective; dual-judge human adjudication protocol under-specified; no code/data release statement despite detailed hyperparameters. Score reflects strong topical fit and thorough evidence, tempered by incremental composition and missing release artifacts.

recommendations.summary: Safety evaluation is critical for assessing whether aligned Large Language Models (LLMs) remain robust against jailbreak attacks. Existing automated testing methods, however, largely rely on response-level feedback: each candidate prompt typically requires generating a target-model response to evaluate its attack effectiveness. This process is expensive and, more importantly, provides only sparse guidance on strongly aligned models, where most candidates are rejected with the same failure outcom
recommendations.summary_zh: LLM 安全評估的自動化模糊測試多依賴回應層回饋：每個候選提示都需生成回應再判定攻擊成效，成本高，且對強對齊模型而言回饋稀疏。本文提出 NeuronFuzz，以內部安全神經元啟動值作為連續執行回饋：先用模板不變的有害–良性配對與穩定性感知選取，找出少量安全神經元，訓練輕量 SafetyOracle 將其啟動值映射為可在 prefill 階段取得的連續安全警報分數，免去中間候選的回應生成；再利用分數對輸入的可微性，以梯度定位敏感模板位置，由遮罩語言模型生成語境相容的替換，同時保留有害載荷。在五個白盒來源模型上，越獄發現率達 76–100%，領先基準最多 48 個百分點，且平均每次發現只需 1 次回應生成；最佳化模板可零樣本遷移至開源與六個專有模型（平均 ASR 44.1%、top-5 EASR 60.0%），並延伸至視覺任務。防禦方面，SmoothLLM 可削弱但不消除其效果；SafetyOracle 亦可反向作為輸入端越獄偵測器。限制包括需白盒存取模型內部，以及在輸入防禦下效能下降。

llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-methodology paper: zero-data self-play for LLMs where a Bradley-Terry reward-model Judge co-evolves with adversarial Challenger/Solver roles via GRPO, directly matching high-weight preferences (LLMs, reasoning, alignment/RLHF, RL). Novelty is solid but incremental: the Challenger-Solver adversarial loop follows R-Zero and subtask amplification follows Christiano et al. (2018); the genuinely new mechanism is deriving judge-preference labels from structural asymmetries (role pairs, subtask-amplification pairs) rather than judge scores, avoiding circularity. primary_link.title: J-Zero: Unified Challenger--Solver--Judge Co-Evolution from Zero Data

recommendations.summary: Self-evolving language models have recently emerged as a promising path toward superintelligence, with the advantage of reducing the cost of human supervision. While considerable progress has been made in verifiable domains, self-evolution in unverifiable domains remains substantially less explored. We propose Judge co-adaptation from Zero data (J-Zero), a unified Challenger--Solver--Judge co-evolution framework that supports self-improvement across both domains. The Challenger and Solver co-evo
recommendations.summary_zh: 自演化語言模型在可驗證領域已有進展，但在無單一正解的不可驗證領域仍依賴固定的裁判模型，一旦求解者達到裁判的辨識上限，訓練便停滯。本文提出 J-Zero，讓挑戰者、求解者與裁判三方自零資料共同演化。挑戰者與求解者透過 GRPO 進行極小極大博弈：挑戰者以難度獎勵加上重複懲罰與格式檢查生成越來越難的任務，求解者學著在其上取得高分；任務選取採用分數離散度指標，挑出最具學習訊號的任務。裁判則以 Bradley–Terry 損失訓練，偏好對完全來自迴圈內的結構性不對稱：一是角色不對稱對（求解者的回答優於挑戰者的回答，因為後者只被訓練讓題目變難），二是子任務放大對（分而治之後重組的回答優於一次性回答），兩者標籤皆不依賴裁判自身分數。實驗以 Qwen3-4B 與 8B-Base 進行，J-Zero 在可驗證基準平均領先基線 4.2 分、不可驗證領域領先 8.0 分，並持續改善到第十輪，而 R-Zero 與 G-Zero 兩輪後即衰退。外部 LLM 評審驗證偏好標籤可靠，且裁判在 RM-Bench 上也有提升。限制為僅測試至 8B 模型、裁判為判別式獎勵模型。此工作顯示評估能力本身必須與策略一同演化，自改良才能持續。

llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM methodology paper squarely aligned with top-weight preferences (LLMs, RAG/knowledge, tool-use agents, multi-hop reasoning, RL post-training). The co-evolution idea—jointly RL-optimizing KB construction and QA reasoning with outcome rewards rather than treating construction as a static pipeline—is a genuine and useful angle beyond Search-R1-style search agents, though built from standard components (GRPO, triplet extraction, MiniLM retrieval). Rigor is solid: matched-budget Search-R1 reimplementation, four benchmarks with in-domain/out-of-domain split, KB-swap and fixed-KB ablations, zero-RL/SFT-necessity study, and honest reporting that KBevo-GRPO slightly trails Search-R1 on average EM (41.3 vs 42.4 at 1.7B; 46.6 vs 49.0 at 4B, Table 2) with the value proposition resting on controllability/editability (ConFiQA-MR edits, Sec 4.2). Evidence is tempered by three factors: a fixed frontier-model (Gemini) KB trained without co-evolution reaches 36.1 avg EM vs 35.6 for co-evolution (Table 3b), weakening the necessity claim; judge-based grounding/correctness metrics rely on Gemini-2.5-Flash with possible bias; no seed variance or significance testing. Analyses use an earlier checkpoint (top-k=1) acknowledged as non-comparable to main results (Appendix C checkpoint note). Generalizability is limited to 1.7B/4B Qwen3 on HotpotQA-trained settings with a required Gemini-generated SFT warm-start (zero-RL collapses, Fig 5; Limitation Sec 5), and PopQA single-hop underperforms Search-R1. Reproducibility is strong: code/models released, full hyperparameters (Table 5), prompts, and judge rubrics provided, though SFT data generation depends on a proprietary teacher.

primary_link.title: Co-Evolving Structured Knowledge and Reasoning in Language Models

recommendations.summary: Retrieval-augmented methods improve factual accuracy by grounding language models in external knowledge, but retrieving over unstructured text often introduces irrelevant context and offers limited control over the retrieved information. Structured knowledge bases offer a more controllable alternative, yet they are expensive to construct and often brittle to reason over. To address these limitations, we propose KBevo: a co-evolving framework that jointly learns to construct a structured knowledg
recommendations.summary_zh: 結構化知識庫雖比非結構化檢索更可控、可編輯，但建置昂貴，且知識建構與下游推理長期脫鉤。本文提出 KBevo 共同演化框架：單一策略分兩階段運作——先閱讀文件建構 三元組知識庫，問答時再透過查詢介面存取該 KB；兩階段以 GRPO 端到端聯合訓練，QA 結果獎勵直接回饋並塑造 KB 建構，使推理成效直接改善知識品質。在 HotpotQA、MuSiQue、2Wiki 與 PopQA 上，KBevo-GRPO 較 SFT 平均提升 5.1（1.7B）與 9.8（4B）點 EM，與重實作的 Search-R1 相當；相較 EDC、AutoSchemaKG 等靜態 KG 建構方法，其學到的 KB 在三元組品質與多跳答案可達性上皆顯著更佳。KB 可離線建置與直接編輯：在 ConFiQA-MR 反事實知識編輯情境下維持明顯優於 Search-R1 的表現。限制包括需 SFT 暖啟動、QA 獎勵僅涵蓋被檢索的三元組而無法保證整個 KB 的忠實性，以及潛在的獎勵駭取風險。

llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-methodology work squarely on high-weight preferences (LLMs, reasoning/CoT, RAG & knowledge, KV-cache memory). Contributions: RuleWorld, a 4.94M-rule / 3.37M-QA synthetic benchmark for reusable procedural rules with single-rule, parallel multi-rule, and multi-hop QA, and DynaRule, a KV-cache injection method adding confidence-layer identification (lowest attention entropy, layer 23 for Qwen2.5-7B) and Stacked Step-Level Attention Training with a learned <search> token. Novelty is solid but incremental: the injection mechanism builds directly on KBLaM and SR-KI, and the advance is step-wise retrieval supervision rather than a new architecture. Rigor is good overall — prompting, dense/BM25/hybrid RAG, IRCoT, ReAct, KBLaM and SR-KI baselines across 100–10K rules in FOL and NL, ablations (rule-removal collapse, gold-rule-only, held-out rules, iterative RAG, efficiency), and seed-level std/95% CIs (Appendix C.4). Weaknesses: evaluation uses only 10 samples per task type per seed (550 questions per setting, Appendix B), the benchmark is fully synthetic with LLM-merged questions, DynaRule is trained/evaluated end-to-end on a single base model (Qwen2.5-7B) on the authors' own benchmark, and cross-model work covers only confidence-layer identification. Quantitative claims are internally consistent (e.g., 19.88-point avg gain and 61.98-point Recall@1 gap at 10K rules match Tables 2 and 10), supporting above-average evidence strength. Code/dataset release plus detailed hyperparameters and prompts aid reproducibility.

primary_link.title: Beyond Factual Knowledge: Benchmarking and Learning Step-Level Procedural Rule Reasoning in Large Language Models

recommendations.summary: Large language models (LLMs) excel at text understanding and generation, yet still struggle to reliably understand and apply externally provided procedural rules at scale. To evaluate this capability, we introduce RuleWorld, a large-scale benchmark that reformulates rules as globally reusable abstract units rather than instance-specific facts. In RuleWorld, several scenarios, including single-rule, parallel multi-rule, and multi-hop reasoning, are settled for comprehensive evaluation. We further
recommendations.summary_zh: 現有基準多將程序性規則當成逐題提示，忽略規則作為可重複使用的共享知識本質。本文建立 RuleWorld：包含 494 萬條抽象、無常識依賴的程序性規則（一階邏輯與自然語言雙形式），衍生 337 萬個 QA 實例，涵蓋單規則、平行多規則與多跳推理共 11 個子任務。方法上提出 DynaRule：以預訓練句編碼器將規則對齊後注入 KV cache，先透過注意力熵辨識「信心層」，再以疊接步驟級注意力訓練，於推理步驟前插入特殊 <search> token 觸發規則重新注意與 KV cache 更新，使檢索成為內部可學習的逐步過程。實驗顯示現有 LLM（含 GPT-5.5、DeepSeek V3.2、Claude）在大量規則注入下劇烈退化，而 DynaRule 平均 QA 準確率提升最多 19 點，10K 規模下 Recall@1 超過 85%，領先最強基準逾 60 點。限制：僅以嵌入表示規則可能損失資訊、評估上限為 10K 規則、多跳仍受早期檢索錯誤傳播影響。此工作凸顯參數知識與顯式規則落地之間的落差，對政策遵循等程序性推理應用具有直接意義。

llm_evaluation.rationale: A core LLM fairness/bias paper tracing dialectal disparities across tokenization, pre-training gradients, post-training reward models, and inference-time representations of modern open LMs (Llama-3, Gemma-3, Qwen-3, plus GPT for reasoning). Strongly aligned with LLM (w2.5), AI Safety (w2.0), Alignment/RM analysis (w2.0), Interpretability probing (w1.8), and NLP/tokenization (w1.5); no Japanese-LLM content. Novelty is solid rather than exceptional: it synthesizes existing corpora (ReDial, ParallelAAVE, MultiVALUE) and prior component-level findings, but the pipeline-wide trace, the character-tokenization counterfactual, CountSketch gradient-geometry analysis (z=-2.64, dialect pairs less aligned than unrelated SAE documents), and the decoupling of isolated-token vs in-context RM preferences are genuinely new contributions. Rigor is high: Holm/Bonferroni-corrected Wilcoxon, McNemar, Friedman and Kendall's W tests, null baselines (character perturbations, translations, unrelated documents), correctness-confound checks (pooled r=-0.013), and honest reporting that AAVE gradient divergence sits within the character-noise range (Table 2) and that RM effect sizes are small (|d|<=0.25) and sign-flip by task. Evidence is quantitative and multi-modal but partly observational: authors admit no training ablations, no multi-seed runs, and English-only scope; the income correlation (Fig. 11) is speculative. Generalizability is limited to English dialects and mid-size open models, though methodology transfers. primary_link.title: The Dialect Tax: Dialectal Biases Persist throughout the Language Modeling Pipeline

recommendations.summary: Systematic dialectal performance gaps in language models (LMs) are well documented, but the source of these disparities within the modern language modeling pipeline remains unclear. Our study traces this "dialect tax" across the natural language processing pipeline. Using parallel English dialect corpora that hold meaning fixed while varying surface form, we first confirm that LMs recognize matched Standard American English (SAE) and dialectal texts as semantically equivalent. However, we discov
recommendations.summary_zh: 本文以英語平行方言語料（SAE 與 AAVE 等，語義固定而表面形式不同）系統性追蹤「方言稅」在語言建模管線各環節的分布。研究首先驗證模型確實將對應方言對視為語義等價，接著揭露：現代分詞器仍對方言文本產生更高的 fertility 與 token 長度；以字元級反事實分詞器繞過子詞切分，既無法消除輸入與輸出熵的不對稱，也無法縮小準確率落差，且方言身分仍可從隱藏狀態以高準確率線性解碼。預訓練階段：方言配對產生的梯度更新比兩份完全無關的 SAE 文件更為分歧，且 AAVE 輸入的交叉熵損失持續偏高，此損失落差與答對與否無關。後訓練階段：獎勵模型呈現情境相關的不穩定偏好——孤立方言專屬 token 反而得分更高，完整推理上下文中卻受到任務與模型相依的方言懲罰。限制：語料多為規則生成或社群文本、僅限開源模型、缺乏受控訓練消融。整體結論是方言偏見並非源自單一環節，而是在分詞、預訓練、後訓練與推論各步驟中累積，改善需要管線層級的整體介入。

llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope LLM methodology paper: defines verifiable, minimal provenance for black-box LLM data processing, with RAG and LLM-generated provenance as baselines, LLM-as-a-judge for equivalence, embedding/LLM rankers, and KV-cache cost optimization. Preference relevance is strong (LLM core, RAG/grounding/attribution, interpretability-adjacent, inference efficiency) though not centered on reasoning, agents, or alignment. Novelty is moderate-good: the verifiability-plus-minimality formalization and monotonicity connection to classical provenance are new, but the mechanics (relevance-ranked pruning plus greedy ablation refinement) are intuitive and adjacent to ContextCite-style ablation attribution. Rigor is solid — formal definitions, proofs (Thms 2-6), empirical validation of judge accuracy (Table 2), determinism (Table 4), and monotonicity prevalence (Table 3) — but the headline 'guaranteed 100% accuracy' metric is near-circular since the algorithm verifies reproduction by construction, and the guarantee is conditioned on a judge measured at only ~90-97% accuracy; true-provenance ground truth exists only for the two synthetic TableQA workloads. Evidence is detailed and internally consistent (size ratios 3.3-12%, cost ratios ~0.9-1.4, cross-model replication in Table 10, small 8-participant user study), generalizability is decent (bolt-on to any LLM, 7 workloads) with acknowledged limits for negation/aggregation tasks, ambiguous questions, and provenance-size-dependent cost. Reproducibility is good: code/artifact link, explicit prompts, and concrete setup (m=20, all-mpnet-base-v2, Mistral 7B ranker).

  existing heuristics (such as embedding similarity or directly asking an LLM) could provide some hints for where the answer was derived, they provide no guarantees
  that the answer can b
recommendations.summary_zh: LLM 廣泛用於資料萃取、清理與問答等資料處理任務，但其回覆如同黑箱，難以判斷答案從何而來、是否可信。現有啟發式（如嵌入相似度檢索或直接要求 LLM 指出相關句子）無法保證所提供的溯源足以重現答案：實驗顯示 RAG 檢索 10% 內文時重現率低於 0.8，gpt-4o 自我標註的溯源僅約 74% 可重現答案。本文提出可驗證溯源（verifiable provenance）概念：輸入文字的子序列，在同一 LLM 上能重現相同或語義等價的答案，並進一步要求最小性（移除任一句子即無法重現）。BLIP 是外掛式框架，採兩階段法：第一階段以四種策略（嵌入或 LLM 排序、自底向上或自頂向下掃描）積極縮小候選；第二階段以 sequential-greedy 或 exponential-greedy 精煉成最小溯源，每種組合皆有理論保證，並以 KV-cache 降低成本；另提供自適應策略與 top-k 相異最小溯源演算法。在七個資料集上，BLIP 重現率為 100%，比最佳基準高出逾 30%，成本與原始查詢相當；TableQA 工作負載中對真實溯源的完全恢復率超過 96%，使用者研究亦顯示其溯源被評為更實用。限制包括大型溯源的精煉成本、排序器品質的影響，以及需要 SQL 處理的邏輯運算任務不在範圍內。此工作將資料庫溯源概念帶入 LLM 資料處理，為人類驗證答案提供可靠且精簡的證據。

evidence: Abstract/§6.1: evaluation uses 602 HarmBench prompts, 2,000 WildJailbreak harmful prompts, and 250 XSTest safe prompts; ASR judged by Llama-Guard-3 first-token rule, FRR by WildGuard.
§6.3 Table 5: LMSM-Checkpoint reduces HarmBench ASR from 39.20% (Matched Disabled) to 3.32% and WildJailbreak from 41.90% to 7.35%, with XSTest FRR rising from 2.40% to 4.40%.

§6.2 Table 3: all 32 duplicate request pairs preserve action, category, intervention step, and threshold-crossing outcomes across 23 row movements and 32 slot reuses; Appendix B certifies 31/32 pairs via a conservative margin condition.

§6.4/Appendix D: Checkpoint retains 98.14% throughput at width 32 (1.86% overhead), Anytime 83.91% (16.09%); compiled-native vLLM is 5,543 tok/s vs. 2,684 matched eager-native, so eager execution dominates cost.
§6.3: external training-time rows (ThinkSafe Table 1) are reported values, not reruns in the LMSM serving path, and are treated as context rather than a matched experiment.

§8 Limitations: in-process trusted deployment on one H100, one active backend binding per policy, three actions (allow/terminate/refuse), and adaptive obfuscation can still defeat latent-space monitors.

Open Science: implementation and reproduction artifact at https://github.com/xiuyuz/LMSM with four deployment profiles, saved parameters, seeds, judge outputs, and table builders; third-party weights and benchmarks not redistributed.
Appendix A: each benchmark-policy cell comes from one fixed-seed generation run rather than an average over repeated generations.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly in-scope: an LLM runtime security framework (AI Safety, Red Teaming/Evaluation, Interpretability, Inference & Serving) that adapts Linux Security Modules' separation of mediation and policy to LLM serving, turning SAE/transcoder/probe evidence into enforced decisions at buffered-output release. Novelty is architectural rather than algorithmic — pluggable backend contract, request-keyed state under continuous batching, and a separate enforcement gate are a genuinely new framing vs. standalone guards (circuit breakers, HiddenDetect, vLLM Hook), but detection mechanisms are reused artifacts. Rigor is solid: explicit threat model, trust assumptions, security goals, matched baselines (Matched Disabled/Empty Extension), scheduler-churn validation, systems-overhead decomposition, and candid limitations (single GPU, eager execution, one binding per policy, adaptive obfuscation can defeat latent monitors per §3.2/§8). Evidence is quantitatively strong but rests on judge-based ASR/FRR, one fixed-seed run per cell (Appendix A), and unmatched external comparisons treated as context only (§6.3). Generalizability is constrained to a trusted in-process deployment, Qwen3-4B primary evaluation with a single-request Gemma/SAE case study, and per-deployment calibration. Reproducibility is well supported by a detailed Open Science artifact with profiles, saved parameters, seeds, and retained records.

llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM training-methodology paper: dynamic domain-mixture scheduling for multi-teacher on-policy distillation of an LLM student, matching LLM (2.5), Training & Optimization, and Scaling & Efficiency preferences, with secondary relevance via math/code/tool-use benchmarks. The contribution is a sensible but incremental heuristic (remaining-gap x descent-velocity composite signal, softmax-floor mapping, batch jitter); adaptive data-mixture/curriculum ideas are well explored and no comparison to alternative adaptive schedulers (e.g., bandit-style or DoReMi-like reweighting) is provided. Rigor is moderate: motivation experiments (Sec 2), four ablations (Table 1), a second model scale (Appendix D), and a theory appendix (Appendix E, acknowledged exponential-decay simplification) are present, but results are single-run with no seeds/error bars, and headline '97% vs 63% gap closure' relies on per-benchmark peak aggregation; the honest single-checkpoint comparison (Appendix C, Table 6) narrows this to 0.73 vs 0.48, still favorable but less dramatic. Evidence includes concrete tables and a throughput-overhead check (2.1%), yet gains on some benchmarks are small (+0.2 AIME25) and no code or data release is claimed anywhere. Generalizability is supported by two scales (35B-A3B and 4B) and a framework-agnostic data-path design, but only one model family, one training framework, and self-produced GRPO teachers. Reproducibility benefits from unusually detailed hyperparameter tables (Appendix B) but lacks released artifacts.

primary_link.title: D^3-MOPD: Adaptive Dynamic Domain ScheDuling for Efficient Multi-Teacher Distillation

recommendations.summary: Multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) distills several domain-expert teachers into a single student by minimizing per-domain reverse-KL divergence on the student's own rollouts. Existing approaches typically fix the per-domain data mixture before training, overlooking the fact that different domains converge at substantially different rates: some plateau early while others continue to improve throughout the training budget. A fixed mixture therefore wastes compute on fast-converging domains and undertrains slower-converging ones. To address this, we propose D^3-MOPD (Dynamic Domain ScheDuling for MOPD), a zero-overhead scheduler that repurposes the per-domain reverse-KL signal already produced during training to adapt the domain mixture online. Running asynchronously outside the training process, an off-process watcher periodically tracks each domain's KL trajectory, estimates remaining headroom and current improvement rate, and accordingly adjusts the domain sampling ratios without altering the core training loop. Our D^3-MOPD scales naturally to arbitrary numbers of domains, and the expected benefit grows as more domains introduce more diverse convergence patterns for the scheduler to exploit. On a Qwen3.6-35B-A3B student distilled from four domain-expert teachers, D^3-MOPD closes 97% of the average student-to-teacher performance gap, compared with 63% for vanilla MOPD, reaches the same peak performance with an approximately 3times reduction in rollout steps, and surpasses the specialist teachers on three of seven benchmarks.
recommendations.summary_zh: 多教師 on-policy 蒸餾（MOPD）將多個領域專家教師蒸餾到單一學生模型，透過在學生自身 rollout 上最小化各領域的 reverse-KL。現有做法通常在訓練前固定各領域資料混合，忽略不同領域收斂速率差異巨大：部分領域早早停滯，部分則持續進步，固定混合因此浪費算力並造成訓練不足。本文提出 D³-MOPD，一個零額外開銷的排程器：非同步的 off-process watcher 定期追蹤各領域 KL 軌跡，將「剩餘差距」與「下降速度」合成複合訊號，經溫度控制的 softmax 加每領域下限映射為新的取樣比例，再由分層資料來源套用，完全不修改核心訓練迴路。以 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 為學生、四位領域專家教師（數學、程式、指令遵循、工具使用）實驗：D³-MOPD 將學生與教師的平均效能差距縮小 97%（vanilla MOPD 僅 63%），以約 3 分之 1 的 rollout 步數（47 步 vs 143 步）達到基線峰值，並在七個基準中的三個超越專家教師。消融證實複合訊號、批次抖動與速度平滑各有貢獻；軌跡分析顯示排程器浮現隱式課程，把預算集中於仍在進步的領域。在 Qwen3.5-4B 學生上的複製實驗確認方法可跨規模泛化。限制在於指數衰減模型僅為簡化假設，理論分析屬設計依據而非必要條件。此方法將訓練迴路既有的 reverse-KL 訊號轉化為動態課程，同時提升峰值品質與訓練效率。

links.title: PLCBench: Can Autonomous LLM Agents Turn PLC Access into Sustained Physical Impact?

evidence: Abstract/Section 5.1: 240 valid real-PLC episodes from 4 PLCs x 4 workloads x 5 models x 3 seeds; 75/240 (31.3%) sustain physical objectives over 118.0 aggregate PLC-hours.

Section 5.2, Table 3: GPT 5.5 reaches impact in 38/48 episodes (79.2%, CI [66.7, 91.7]) with 16/16 cell coverage but all-three-repetition success in only 9/16 cells; 95% CIs are cluster-bootstrap over PLC-workload cells.

Section 5.3, Table 4: stagewise chain 191 discover, 142 read, 141 write, 137 manipulate, 115 disrupt, 75 impact; 98 episodes stop before a valid native read, concentrated on P3 (12/60 valid reads) and P4 (12/60 discoveries).

Section 5.5.2/Finding 4: richer process observation leaves early flags unchanged but raises conditional post-write impact from 38/86 (44.2%) to 57/89 (64.0%), framed as association, not causal treatment effect.

Section 4.1: one-time deployment admission requires closed-loop sanity check, full 3600-s zero-action stability baseline, and withheld reference script satisfying the complete sustained impact predicate, preventing broken testbed cells from counting as agent failures.

Section 3.2.2/Table 7: deterministic evaluator assigns six hidden flags from independent runner, communication-audit, hidden object-binding, and 10 Hz canonical process-trace evidence, excluding agent self-report and model-facing status tools.
Appendix A: generative AI disclosure states an LLM assisted drafting/restructuring while authors verified content and measurements were not synthesized.

Appendix N/Table 21-22 and Ethics Considerations: audit map maps claims to CSV artifact records with SHA-256 prefixes, but the artifact release is 'planned'/'will be made available' and raw successful command sequences and exact write values are withheld, limiting current external reproducibility.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly on-preference: a benchmark evaluating tool-using LLM agents (ReAct loop, canonical system prompt, deterministic context compaction) on autonomous cyber-to-physical attack capability, squarely matching Agents & Tool Use, AI Safety, Red Teaming & Evaluation, and LLM preferences. Not a pure domain application; language-model methodology is central. Novelty is solid: the paper plausibly claims the first real-PLC hardware-in-the-loop benchmark measuring sustained physical impact from autonomous agents, with a six-flag stagewise diagnostic going beyond digital-only cyber benchmarks, though it composes existing agent-benchmark and ICS-security lines. Rigor is strong: crossed 4x4x5x3 design (240 episodes), deployment admission with zero-action stability and withheld reference feasibility checks (Section 4.1, Table 9), cluster-bootstrap CIs (Table 3), two controlled ablations (SoftPLC shared protocol; richer observation), and explicitly acknowledged confounds (one controller per protocol, observation-association not causation). Evidence is internally consistent (98 pre-read stops = 49+49; 62 manipulated-but-not-impact = 137-75; 38/86=44.2% vs 57/89=64.0%), with complete per-cell flag tables in Appendices H-J. Generalizability is limited to laboratory HIL configurations with reduced-order process models and single instances per protocol; defenses are proposed but not evaluated. Reproducibility is well-designed (deterministic evaluator, reproduced prompts, SHA-256 manifests, Appendix N audit map) but artifacts are only 'planned' for separate release and raw successful trajectories are withheld for dual-use reasons, so full third-party reproduction is not yet demonstrable.

recommendations.summary_zh: 工業控制系統中，可程式邏輯控制器（PLC）連接網路運算與物理控制。使用工具的 LLM 代理構成新興攻擊威脅：能否把網路可達的 PLC 轉化為持續的負面物理影響？現有評估多止於軟體滲透或單一階段，可能誤判物理風險。本文提出 PLCBench，首個真實 PLC 的硬體在環（HIL）評測框架，結合廠商原生互動、商用 PLC 執行、閉迴路降階製程模擬與獨立結果驗證；確定性評估器依固定規則賦予六個隱藏診斷旗標，區分介面取得、製程相關操作與持續物理衝擊。框架實例化四款商用 PLC 與四種閉迴路工作負載，測試五個 LLM 家族共 240 個真實 PLC 回合，31.3%（75 回合）達成各自的物理目標。階段性分析顯示兩道障礙：98 回合在取得有效原生讀取前停止（Beckhoff 與三菱平台損失集中於此），62 回合雖完成製程相關寫入卻無法維持最終目標；更豐富的製程觀測使寫入後條件達成率由 44.2% 升至 64.0%，顯示介面摩擦與有限可觀測性並非持久的安全邊界。研究亦揭露各工作負載在保護邏輯上的防護缺口。基於雙重用途風險，作者劃定安全揭露的釋出邊界與僅軟體重現管線。此工作為網路到物理攻擊能力與防禦評估提供可重現基礎。

evidence: §4.1/Table 1: strict ordering GPT-5.2 > Claude Sonnet 4.6 > GLM-5 > DeepSeek-V3.2 recovered in all 10,000 bootstrap replicates from 950 order-stable of 1,200 folded cases; second judge (Doubao Seed 2.0 Pro) reproduces the identical ordering with 86.1% stable-comparison agreement (§4.1, Appendix E.5).

§4.2: single-field manipulation check—clean proposals win 40/40 ordered comparisons per corrupted dimension (grounding/metric/falsifiability) with target-score drops 1.73/2.00/1.95; subtle-corruption audit shows sham-equivalence gate passing (0 clean wins vs sham) with adjusted preferences 0.550/0.775/0.537 and CIs excluding zero.

§4.3: human calibration covers 20/200 neighborhoods, 90 real pairs, 3 annotators; 87.2% agreement (34/39) with judge on decisive stable cases and 11/12 naive-control detection, but Krippendorff's α=0.238 (winner selection) bounds validation strength.
§6 Limitations: single canonical judge per version, no execution of proposed tests, domain restricted to ML-adjacent literature, and benchmark-wide human validation explicitly not established.

Appendix B.3 and G.2: orientation defect in 65 reverse tasks disclosed and corrected; construction seed 20260620, bootstrap seeds documented, raw API responses archived, benchmark and audit artifacts released on GitHub.
llm_evaluation.rationale: An LLM evaluation-benchmark paper squarely within the curator's LLM/evaluation preferences: it measures whether frontier LLMs can produce falsifiable research proposals judged via LLM-as-judge with order-bias auditing. Novelty is real but compositional: the six-field falsifiable-test contract as the judged unit is new per their own survey (Table 2, Appendix F.2), while pairwise judging, position-bias folding, and human calibration are acknowledged established primitives. Rigor is unusually strong: 2,400 ordered judgments with order folding, Bradley-Terry plus Condorcet, pair-level and context-cluster bootstraps (Appendix C.3), a disjoint second judge replication (86.1% stable-case agreement, Appendix E.5), manipulation checks with sham contrast (40/40 clean wins; adjusted preferences with CIs excluding zero, §4.2), and candid disclosure of weaknesses (Krippendorff's α=0.238, 65.6% validator agreement, 3.9% naturalness leakage, orientation defect in 65 batch-1 tasks, Appendix B.3/D.3). Evidence is internally consistent (Table 3 head-to-head sums check out) and claims are appropriately bounded, but the headline ordering rests on a single closed-source LLM judge per version, human corroboration covers only 20/200 neighborhoods with 3 undergrad annotators, and modest inter-annotator agreement limits validation strength. Generalizability is constrained to ML-adjacent OpenReview literature with no cross-domain evidence. Reproducibility is good (frozen outputs, documented seeds, verbatim prompts, released repo) but dependent on closed preview APIs.

recommendations.summary_zh: 自由格式評審易受風格與位置影響，以未來論文當答案鍵則只獎勵單一已實現路徑。本文提出 Lit2Test 基準，以六欄位契約（文獻缺口、假說、最小實驗、決定性指標、支持結果、否證結果）為評測單元，要求每個構想預先承諾何種觀察會證明自己錯誤。基準由 200 個真實論文鄰域（800 篇論文）前瞻性構建、無答案鍵；四個前沿模型各產生一份提案，形成 1,200 個配對與 2,400 次雙向盲評。結果在所有 10,000 次 bootstrap 複製中皆恢復嚴格排序：GPT-5.2 > Claude Sonnet 4.6 > GLM-5 > DeepSeek-V3.2，250 個順序敏感案例被明確分離而非隱藏。診斷控制（渲染對照、單欄位操縱檢查、細微污染審計）顯示評審回應的是實質而非風格，分離主要來自測試與指標設計，否證性則如同准入門檻。三名標註者的分層人類校準以 87.2% 一致率佐證結論，但適度的標註者間一致度界定了宣稱範圍。此基準讓構想品質成為可由實驗判定的屬性，對可否證研究構想的評測深具意義。

links.title: PeakBench: Benchmarking Resource-Aware Tool Invocation in LLM Agents

evidence: Abstract: introduces PeakBench, 'a benchmark of executable multi-tool workflows with execution-grounded dependency annotations and measured resource profiles', with a two-part evaluation disentangling logical planning from physical scheduling; code link provided.

Decoupled Evaluation Protocol: Dimension I uses GED and Edge F1 against execution-grounded structure; Dimension II fixes verified structure and uses Scheduling Latency, CVA, and strict MRU (Eqs. 4-8).
Human Quality Audit: manual audit of ~100 sampled workflows, 'About 94% of the audited samples match the optimal structure', with ~4-5 min per workflow.
Table 2: GPT-5 best on Dimension I (GED 0.42, Edge F1 0.839); Baseline earliest-ready row shows SL 8.62s but CVA 5.865, supporting the resource-blind scheduling regime claim.
Table 4: RASC vs no-profile deltas show most models reduce CVA (e.g., GLM-5 -1.457) but DeepSeek-V4-Flash increases CVA (+0.034), evidencing model-dependence.

Appendix F.5 input ablation: duration-only context yields zero feasible-rate gain; CPU+memory profiles yield +12.7 feasible delta and 48.5% violation reduction, isolating capacity awareness as the mechanism.
Appendix C: 'We do not claim that the workflow set reproduces the full distribution of real user requests', limiting generalizability of the 300-workflow benchmark.
Appendix B: resource profiles measured from only three LLM-generated inputs per tool in an instrumented sandbox, with cold/warm-start distinction; a narrow sampling basis for the telemetry claims.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Directly on-topic for Agents & Tool Use and LLM evaluation: a benchmark for resource-aware tool invocation in LLM agents, evaluated on eight frontier API models. The decoupled protocol (logical dependency planning vs. physical scheduling under measured resource profiles) is a genuinely fresh evaluation angle relative to accuracy-centric tool benchmarks like ToolBench/API-Bank and the closest prior TPS-Bench, and the 'peak load' failure mode is well formalized (Eq. 1-9). Rigor is solid but not exhaustive: 300 workflows, a ~100-sample human audit (94% match), classical scheduling baselines, noise-robustness and input ablations, but no variance/significance reporting, single-run API evaluations, and resource profiles estimated from only three inputs per tool. Quantitative tables concretely support the headline claims (planning-scheduling decoupling with weak case-level correlations, Table 7; RASC gains that are model-dependent, with DeepSeek-V4-Flash increasing CVA, Table 4). Generalizability is capped by the synthetic, benchmark-seeded workflow distribution, which the authors explicitly do not claim reflects real user traffic. Code release and detailed protocol appendices (B, D, E) support reproducibility.

recommendations.summary_zh: LLM 代理日益透過多工具呼叫解決任務，平行執行對低延遲至關重要，但資源無知的盲目平行可能觸發資源溢出。現有代理基準多聚焦工具選擇、參數生成與序列執行下的端到端成功率，忽略有效平行化與資源受限排程。本文提出 PeakBench：300 個可執行的多工具工作流，具備以沙箱執行擾動標註的依賴與並發結構，以及實測的工具資源輪廓（CPU、記憶體、GPU、網路、磁碟 I/O），並以約 1.2K 個 MCP 工具建構。評測解耦為兩個維度：維度 I 要求代理作為依賴分析器恢復工作流的前置條件結構（以 GED 與 Edge F1 計分）；維度 II 提供已驗證結構，要求代理在有限機器容量下指派執行時間戳，以排程延遲、容量違規面積（CVA）與 strict MRU 計分，從而可歸因失敗來源。評測八個前沿模型顯示：強邏輯規劃不代表安全排程，案例層級相關性極弱；無資源資訊的模型常以保守延遲降低違規但拉高延遲。提出的 RASC 基線在排程前揭露資源後設資料，多數模型能藉此降低 CVA 並提升 strict MRU，接近最佳規則式排程器的違規水準，但效益因模型而異；消融顯示增益主要來自 CPU 與記憶體資訊，而非一般延遲感知。此基準為診斷資源感知代理行為提供了可測量、可歸因的測試場。

links.title: FaithSieve: Fine-Grained Evaluation of Math Proofs with Faithful Formal Evidence

evidence: Abstract: FaithSieve with GPT-5.4 backbone achieves 81.43% exact first-error accuracy on the 350-problem ProofLoc-Olympiad vs 72.29% for direct judging; 84.5% vs 75.0% on the 200-problem ProofLoc-University.
Section 5.2/Table 5: 'w/o local EdgeUnits' ablation drops GPT-5.4 to 60.86% exact / 72.29% binary, supporting the locality hypothesis.
Appendix E.2/Table 8: human calibration of the semantic gate on 135 statements reports 88.98% precision and 91.30% recall but 65.00% FPR (13 of 20 unfaithful statements accepted).
Appendix F.8/Table 17: recorded token cost is 137.22x (GPT-5.4) and 152.11x (Qwen3.5-9B) Direct@1 in a fixed 50-problem cost evaluation.
Appendix F.7/Table 18: same-backbone token-budget controls on BIG-Bench-200 show Direct Majority@241 at 51.0% exact and an NL-only decomposition agent at 55.5% vs FaithSieve at 61.0%.
Appendix F.7: University paired comparison vs Direct@5 and two-critics baseline gives 95% CI [+2.5,+14.5] and McNemar's p=0.00948.

Appendix G.1: authors state limitations on formal-validation cost/coverage and untested geometry/combinatorics; Appendix F.5 notes ablations are replay-style, reusing intermediate artifacts from the full pipeline.
Appendix D.1: ProofLoc-University textbook provenance (Munkres, Axler, Dummit & Foote, Tao, Rockafellar, Boyd & Vandenberghe) and GPT-4o proof generation with expert first-error annotation.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly matches high-weight preferences: LLM-based mathematical reasoning evaluation (Reasoning & CoT, LLMs), an agentic Formal Evaluation Agent driving Lean via MCP tools (Agents & Tool Use), and benchmark/evaluation methodology (Red Teaming & Evaluation). Research quality is solid: two expert-verified datasets with PhD-annotator adjudication, six-model direct-judge baselines, off-the-shelf PRM transfers, multi-sample and token-matched high-budget controls, component ablations isolating locality and the semantic gate, human audits of pipeline stages, Wilson CIs and McNemar's test. Novelty is moderate-high: proof-state-tree EdgeUnits, typed obligations, and faithfulness-gated Lean evidence form a meaningful advance over direct NL judging, though Lean-assisted proof evaluation builds on existing autoformalization and process-verification lines. Weaknesses: headline ~9-point exact gains are on self-constructed benchmarks with GPT-4o-generated proofs; replay-style ablations reuse intermediate artifacts; the semantic gate shows 65% FPR in human audit; cost is 137-152x direct judging; external validation limited to a 200-example BIG-Bench Mistake subset; no explicit code/data release despite detailed prompts and decoding configs. Domain coverage is confined to algebra/number theory and six university math domains; geometry and combinatorics are acknowledged as untested.

Existing evaluation approaches largely depend on model-based natural-language judgments, which often overlook local reasoning gaps. recommendations.summary_zh: 大型語言模型已能產生複雜的多步驟數學證明,但可靠判定其正確性並定位最早的邏輯錯誤仍是難題;現有方法多依賴自然語言判斷,容易忽略局部推理斷裂,而直接以 Lean 驗證非形式化文字又面臨局部性與語意忠實性兩大挑戰——證明器可能繞過局部瑕疵去證明過寬的目標,或驗證偏離原意的自動形式化陳述。FaithSieve 是一套 Lean 輔助框架:先將粗略步驟分解為證明狀態樹中的局部推理單元,抽取型別化的證明義務,再由形式化評估代理驗證;形式驗證須通過語意對齊評分把關,只有忠實保留脈絡、物件與邏輯形式的陳述才納入證據。作者建構兩個專家標註資料集:ProofLoc-Olympiad(350 題)與 ProofLoc-University(200 題)。以 GPT-5.4 為骨幹時,FaithSieve 在奧林匹亞資料集達 81.43% 的首錯精確定位準確率,優於直接判斷基線的 72.29%;在大學資料集亦達 84.5% 對 75.0%,消融實驗確認局部單元與語意閘門皆屬關鍵。限制包括代理式形式化的 token 成本高昂(約百倍以上)、幾何與組合等領域覆蓋不足。此工作顯示局部且忠實的形式化證據能顯著提升證明評估的可信度。
