links.title: STONIC: A Layered Measurement Contract for LLM Value Profiling

evidence: Abstract: 10 of 17 configurations preserve the endorsement-choice relation; all 17 eligible configurations prefer their own earlier answer (median effect 0.790); option position changes choice rate in every eligible configuration.

Section 3 (Measurement Contract): 35 configurations receive 5,144 situations from four banks across L1/L2/L3/L2* interfaces; 978,040 total requests; prespecified coverage (80% valid, 80 clusters), Holm-corrected aggregate, 3/4-bank direction, and leave-one-bank-out sign requirements.

Section 4 (Inference): 20,000 within-bank permutations for semantic nulls, 10,000 item-cluster bootstrap draws, Holm FWER .05 for predefined families, BH q=.05 exploratory; seeds 13/2026/20260817 yield identical corrected decisions.

Section 5 / Table 1: rating-predicts-choice supported for 10/17 estimable configurations (median +.228, all instruction-tuned); own-answer preference supported for 17 (range .508-.932); position sensitivity significant in 18/18 (median signed effect .0218); no configuration supports same-profile semantic transfer (median rho .73/.43/.50 diagnostic only).

Appendix K (Task-Local Human Validation): 200 L3 responses, three annotators per response, Fleiss kappa .415 presence / .403 four-state; FULCRA AUROC .893 on 91 matched rows, GPV->DeBERTa19 AUROC .784 with leave-one-bank-out F1 .629.

Section 7 (Limitations): banks do not represent all cultures/languages/deployment settings; strict parsing creates missing-not-at-random coverage especially for base models; hidden probes establish predictive information, not causality.

Appendix B/M (Reproducibility): byte-identical rebuild of request artifacts with SHA-256 digests; pinned vLLM 0.19.1 image, temperature 0, seed 13; model weights, raw generations, and hidden tensors are outside the arXiv source bundle.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A measurement-methodology paper squarely within LLM evaluation/alignment scope: it tests whether value profiles from ratings, counterbalanced choices, free text, and hidden states support a single claim across 35 LLM configurations and 5,144 situations. Preference relevance is high (LLM evaluation, alignment/safety measurement, probing, prompt/order sensitivity), not a pure domain application. Novelty is solid rather than groundbreaking: it builds on existing value benchmarks (ValuePortrait, FULCRA, Generative Psychometrics) but the layered measurement contract with prespecified eligibility gates and the L2* own-answer-preference test (median +0.790) are fresh contributions. Rigor is a standout: conjunctive cross-bank reporting criteria, A/B counterbalancing, Holm/BH correction, equal-bank weighting, leave-one-bank-out checks, seed sensitivity, and a 200-response three-annotator human audit (Fleiss kappa .415). Evidence strength is strong with complete per-configuration tables, CIs, and appropriately hedged claims (semantic transfer estimable but 0/35 meet all-bank coverage; hidden-state results framed as decodability, not causality). Generalizability is deliberately bounded by the authors (four non-representative banks, missing-not-at-random parse coverage, Schwartz-10 limits). Reproducibility is partially supported (fixed seeds, pinned vLLM runtime, SHA-256 request digests, prompt contracts) but raw generations/hidden tensors are excluded from the bundle, the code/data package availability is asserted rather than verifiable from the text, and several listed checkpoints (e.g., Qwen3.6, Gemma 4, GLM-4.7) cannot be independently confirmed, warranting modest deductions.

links.title: EMRB: A Multi-Level Benchmark for Evaluating LLM Reasoning over Raw Electromagnetic Signals

evidence: Abstract: 'Scores range from 24.1% to 78.9%, with the mean dropping from 84.9% on basic measurement to 21.2% on system design'; 'ReconPilot raises the overall score by 3.8 to 17.6 points and improves 13 of 15 backbone-level combinations tested.'

Section 6.3 / Table 1: oracle replay scores 100.0 at all five levels; union of 14 models reaches 98.8-99.8% at L1-L4 but only 53.2% at L5; ~1000-line classical DSP reference solver scores 75.7 on L5 versus best model 39.8.
Section 6.5 / Table 2: ReconPilot overall gains of +14.0 (DeepSeek V4 Flash), +17.6 (Gemini 3.5 Flash), +3.8 (GPT-5.5), with declines only where free-form already exceeded 91%.

Section 8 (Limitations): 'EMRB is a controlled synthetic benchmark covering 11 signal types, so its results do not establish model performance on real field measurements'; 'We have no human expert baseline.'

Appendix A (Distribution/Utility): dataset, generation scripts, verifiers, and harness released on GitHub under CC BY 4.0 (data) and MIT (code); seed-based pipeline 'can produce fresh, valid problems from unused seeds without manual authoring'.
Appendix F.2: rationale-content criteria total 11 of 100 L2 points (2.2% of benchmark), with bounded assertion-only exposure of at most 2.2 points stated explicitly.

Appendix J: audit of L5 extraction-filter sub-question shows 527 of 560 attempts score zero, decomposed into perceptual limit, constraint omission, and absent self-evaluation, with per-deficit counts (e.g., 390 merged-source reports).
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly on-topic LLM/agent evaluation work: a code-execution benchmark testing 14 LLMs on raw I/Q signal analysis, plus ReconPilot, a three-stage agent pipeline (fixed reconnaissance, guided analysis, self-verification). Not a pure domain application since it evaluates general-purpose LLMs with an agentic methodology rather than training domain encoders. Novelty is solid: schemaless raw physical-layer data as LLM benchmark input is genuinely new versus RadioML/DA-Bench-style predecessors, though ReconPilot scaffolding is a straightforward reconnaissance+verification design. Rigor is high: deterministic no-LLM-judge scoring, oracle replay (100.0 at all levels), union-of-models headroom analysis, a reference DSP solver for L5 (75.7 vs best model 39.8), stage ablation showing sub-additivity, and honest quantification of prompt-answerable L1 points. Evidence is detailed (per-model/per-level/per-type tables, 527/560-attempt failure audits, paired case studies), though single-run temperature-0 evaluations lack variance estimates. Generalizability is limited and candidly acknowledged: synthetic AWGN-only signals, 11 types, no hardware impairments, no human expert baseline. Reproducibility is excellent: seed-deterministic generation, released data/code/verifiers, versioned scorers, full prompts and rubrics in appendices, contamination-resistant seed expansion.

primary_link.title: EMRB: A Multi-Level Benchmark for Evaluating LLM Reasoning over Raw Electromagnetic Signals

recommendations.summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as code agents for scientific and engineering analysis, but their ability to analyze raw physical-layer measurements remains untested. We introduce \textbf{EMRB} (\textbf{E}lectro\textbf{m}agnetic \textbf{R}easoning \textbf{B}enchmark), which evaluates whether LLMs can analyze raw I/Q data by writing and running code. EMRB contains 200 problems across five difficulty levels and 27 question types, from signal detection to OFDM design, generated f
recommendations.summary_zh: LLM 日益作為程式碼代理從事科學與工程分析，但其分析原始物理層測量資料的能力尚未被系統評估。本文提出 EMRB，評估 LLM 能否撰寫並執行程式碼來分析原始 I/Q 電磁訊號。基準含 200 道題目、五個難度層級（基礎測量、訊號處理方法、通訊理論、多訊號分析、系統設計）、27 種題型，由 11 種訊號類型（數位調變、類比調變、OFDM、LFM 啁啾）以固定種子程式化生成，附已驗證的 ground truth。模型須在最多 15 回合的互動中以 Python 沙箱分析原始檔案，評分採確定性驗證器、無 LLM 裁判。評測 14 個 LLM 顯示分數介於 24.1% 到 78.9%，且由基礎測量的 84.9% 驟降至系統設計的 21.2%；瓶頸不在領域知識，而在多訊號場景下把每個測量值綁定到正確實體的能力，L5 的 560 次嘗試中有 527 次在萃取濾波器題得零分，可分解為感知極限、約束遺漏與缺乏自我評估三類。作者另提出 ReconPilot，以固定偵察、目標分析與自我驗證三階段分離場景發現與解題，在三個骨幹上提升總分 3.8 至 17.6 分。題庫可達性以 oracle 重放、模型聯集與參考解法器（L5 得 75.7 分）驗證。限制為僅涵蓋合成訊號與 AWGN 通道、無人類專家基線。此基準為原始訊號分析能力提供可重現、可擴充的驗收測試。

links.title: From Static to Dynamic: Benchmarking Real-World Code Review with MCR-Bench

evidence: Section 1 Abstract/Contributions: MCR-Bench is 'the first defect state-aware benchmark designed for realistic multi-round code review' with 2,269 tasks across five languages and cross-round state labels
Section 3.2.4: manual cross-validation by six developers with Cohen's kappa 0.87 between two primary annotators and third-annotator arbitration for disagreements
Section 5.3 / Table 4: pre-study shows LLM-Hit-Judge (GPT-5.2-pro) attains QWK 0.73 vs BLEU-4 0.27 and ROUGE-L 0.21, justifying its adoption as primary metric
Section 6.1.1 / Table 5: best overall defect-detection F1 is 0.551 (Claude Haiku 4.5); Qwen3 Max drops to 0.153 F1 on C#, supporting the 'limited overall capability' finding
Section 6.2 / Table 10: F1 degrades with interaction depth, e.g., Claude Haiku 4.5 from 0.6495 at R2 to 0.2857 at R10, evidencing cross-round memory limits
Section 6.3 / Table 11: FP errors dominated by State-Temporal Misalignment (32.5%) and FN by Cross-round Defect Forgetting (25.1%) from open coding by four programmers
Section 9 Data Availability: 'we have released our code and the experimental data at https://github.com/DeepSoftwareAnalytics/MCR-bench'
Section 7.2: threats acknowledge limited model count, consistency filtering excluding difficult instances, and exclusion of proprietary enterprise repositories
llm_evaluation.rationale: An in-scope LLM evaluation benchmark squarely hitting high-weight preferences: Code & Programming ('code review' is the core task, Section 1), Agents & Tool Use (PR-Agent agent-based baseline, Section 5.2), LLMs (7 mainstream models evaluated), and Red Teaming & Evaluation (LLM-Hit-Judge metric pre-study, Section 5.3). Novelty is genuine but benchmark-shaped: the multi-round, defect-lifecycle-state formulation (New/Open/Resolved/Reopened) is claimed as first of its kind (Table 3 comparison), though the LLM-annotation pipeline adapts cited prior practices. Rigor is strong: kappa 0.87 with three-annotator arbitration (Section 3.2.4), 3x consistency filtering, metric pre-study via QWK (Table 4), baselines, error taxonomy via open coding (Table 11), and a threats-to-validity section; deductions for LLM-generated ground truth creating potential circularity with LLM subjects, use of GPT-5.2-pro as sole judge while GPT-5.2 is an evaluated model, consistency filtering biasing toward easier instances (acknowledged in Section 7.2), and state accuracy conditioned only on true positives (Section 6.1.3). Evidence is rich and quantitative (Tables 5-12) with some interpretive claims from informal manual sampling. Generalizability is good across five languages but restricted to public, permissive-license repos (Section 7.2). Reproducibility supported by explicit public code/data release (Section 9).

recommendations.summary: In real-world software development, code review typically involves iterative interactions between developers and reviewers to improve software quality, making the process costly and time-consuming. Although recent work explores large language models (LLMs) for automated code review, most approaches oversimplify code review into a single-round, static decision task, which fails to capture the multi-round interactive nature and the complex problem-solving processes inherent in realistic review sce
recommendations.summary_zh: 真實世界的程式碼審查通常涉及開發者與審查者的多輪迭代，缺陷會隨程式修改而演進，但現有 LLM 審查方法多簡化為單輪靜態決策。本文提出 MCR-Bench，首個缺陷狀態感知的多輪程式碼審查基準，涵蓋 Python、Java、JavaScript、TypeScript 與 C#，共 2,269 個真實審查任務，每項皆附精細缺陷卡（描述、位置、類別、嚴重度）與跨輪生命週期狀態標籤（New、Open、Resolved、Reopened）。建構流程包含嚴格的儲存庫篩選、多輪互動過濾、以 LLM 為本的兩階段狀態感知標註管線（先局部偵測、後全域追蹤）、三次獨立執行的一致性過濾，以及人工交叉驗證（Cohen's kappa 0.87）。實驗評測七個主流 LLM 與 PR-Agent、Hybrid-Review 兩基線，發現整體表現有限（最佳 F1 略高於 0.55），缺陷狀態追蹤同樣吃力，且互動輪數越多效能越降；語義複雜或低顯著度的缺陷更易漏檢。錯誤分析歸納出偽陽性主因為狀態—時間錯位（32.5%）與過度審查，偽陰性主因為跨輪缺陷遺忘、長程依賴遺漏與語義盲區。限制包括受測模型數量有限、一致性過濾可能排除特難樣本，且企業級儲存庫情境未必涵蓋。此基準凸顯跨輪記憶與狀態追蹤是未來自動審查的關鍵方向。
recommendations.title: From Static to Dynamic: Benchmarking Real-World Code Review with MCR-Bench
recommendations.title_zh: 從靜態到動態：以 MCR-Bench 評測真實世界多輪程式碼審查

links.title: When Can Agents Safely Checkpoint, Fork, Restore, and Merge? Exact Checking for Execution Edits

evidence: Section I 'Contributions' (p.2): 'Lean mechanizes the finite checker and runtime invariant, and tests validate all six edit forms. The source code, Lean proofs, and executable tests are available in the public GitHub repository at https://github.com/eunomia-bpf/agent-check-restore-safety.'

Section VIII (p.13): 'Six Lean modules pass --trust=0'; 'All 19 paper-specific tests pass, together with 62 authorization and checker regression tests'; accepted instances with 2-128 results take '0.11 - 53.47 ms'.

Theorem 4, Necessary Record Information (p.12): 'If any one of the four parts is omitted wholesale while the others are retained, two records become indistinguishable even though the correct answer differs.'

Proposition 2 (p.11): output-sensitive bound O(D+nLambda+|Gcov|+VB log(2+VB)) and the caveat 'Exponential growth occurs only in explicitly emitted linearizations and pairs linking partial executions to required results.'
Section A-M (p.23): measurement protocol 'fresh CPython 3.12 process... median of five repetitions on a 16-vCPU AMD EPYC 7R12.'

AI Use Acknowledgment (p.24): OpenAI Codex 'used throughout the manuscript for initial prose drafting and revision, and in the executable artifact for code scaffolding and test generation... including definitions, assumptions, theorem statements, and proof structure.'
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strong on-topic match for Agents & Tool Use and AI Safety: the paper formalizes safe Checkpoint/Fork/Restore/Merge ('execution edits') in tool-using agent runtimes, deriving from a trusted execution record which edits are safe, with rejection proofs and an atomic rule update. It is not an LLM-methodology paper (the agent is an abstract untrusted principal; LLM agents appear only as motivating context and citations), so LLM/Japanese-LLM/reasoning preferences are not engaged. Novelty is substantial: prior recovery/synthesis work takes requirements as input, whereas this derives the complete safety condition, proves a largest safe execution set (Lemma 4), an information lower bound over four record parts (Theorem 4, Table II), and ideal-runtime weak bisimulation (Theorems 6-7). Rigor is high: full formal model, 17 lemmas and 7 theorems, Lean mechanization with --trust=0, and an output-sensitive complexity bound. Evidence is solid for the formal claims but the evaluation is synthetic (2-128 results, 19 paper tests + 62 regressions, millisecond timings) with no deployment on a real agent runtime, and worst-case behavior grows exponentially in emitted linearizations. Generalizability is tempered by strong assumptions: registered workflows, typed edit rules, signed policy authorities, finite registered call models. Reproducibility is good (public GitHub with Lean proofs and executable tests, described measurement protocol), though the disclosed use of Codex for refining definitions, theorem statements, and proof structure warrants some caution despite stated author verification.

primary_link.title: When Can Agents Safely Checkpoint, Fork, Restore, and Merge? Exact Checking for Execution Edits

recommendations.summary: Agent runtimes can Checkpoint an execution, Fork it, Restore a checkpoint, or Merge branches without restarting a task. We call these operations execution edits, with Checkpoint recording the current execution for later use and Fork, Restore, and Merge changing what the Agent will do next. An execution edit cannot undo an earlier authorization or a tool request already sent. An unsafe edit can therefore authorize the same tool action twice, discard a result the task still requires, or conflict w
recommendations.summary_zh: 本文研究代理執行期環境中的「執行編輯」操作：檢查點、分支、還原與合併。此類操作雖可支援探索與復原，卻可能重複授權同一工具動作、遺失任務仍需的結果，或與編輯前已發出的呼叫衝突。由於代理本身不可信任，執行期必須依賴執行紀錄判斷每次編輯必須保留的歷史授權與必要結果。作者提出精確檢查演算法：從執行紀錄列舉所有可行的完整執行方式，逐步剔除會使仍需結果無法完成的執行；若全數被剔除，則回傳可獨立驗證的拒絕證明，否則回傳最大的安全執行集合。論文涵蓋檢查點與六種分支、還原、合併形式，證明原子規則更新在多次編輯與重新啟動下仍維持安全，並以弱雙模擬證明執行期與理想原子機器的代理可見行為等價。資訊結果顯示工作流程結構、動作對應、授權進度與規則版本四個紀錄部分缺一不可。六個 Lean 模組完成形式化驗證，19 項論文特定測試與 2–128 結果規模的量測（接受案例 0.11–53.47 毫秒）支持可執行性。此工作為代理系統的分支與復原機制提供精確的安全條件與資訊下界，是代理執行期安全設計的重要基礎。
recommendations.title: When Can Agents Safely Checkpoint, Fork, Restore, and Merge? Exact Checking for Execution Edits
recommendations.title_zh: 代理程式何時能安全地執行檢查點、分支、還原與合併？執行編輯的精確檢查

links.title: Not All Eval-Awareness Is Equal: Capabilities Framing Predicts Compliance

evidence: Abstract: capabilities-framing predicts compliance with a +24 to +46 percentage-point gap over safety-framing on Qwen3-32B over FORTRESS across all tested steering conditions
Section 2 Validation: hand-grading blind to pipeline labels and condition; Stage 1-2 EA filter N=40 κ=0.80; Stage 3 cap-axis κ=0.80, safety-axis κ=0.81, 4-category κ=0.73
Section 3 Results: 10 of 11 prefills shift compliance in the predicted direction (sign-test p≈0.011); headline cap-vs-safety paired contrast 21.9pp, n_paired=52, p<0.0001
Appendix D.5 Table 9: drop-top-k robustness — headline contrast survives removal of the 21 most-influential of 52 prompts at p<0.001
Section 3 Figure 3b: OLMo-3-32B-Think replication of prefill experiment, directional trends hold including the 'generate such content' exception
Section 4 Limitations: steering-composition result is 'associational, not causal'; findings 'specific to Qwen3-32B'; single dataset limited to 55 prompts widening 95% CIs, especially HUA -0.6
Appendix D.6: subtractive design failed on Qwen3-32B — 66% of before-EA-sentence continuations regenerate same-flavor framing, 53% within the first sentence; confound transparently documented
Appendix C.2 Table (confusion matrices): LLM grader systematically under-calls the composite 'both' category, the largest residual disagreement source

Appendix A/D: full prompt-ID subsets, verbatim grader prompts, prefill list with provenance, and exact sampling seeds (73, 74) provided; Appendix E.1 references a released artifact but no explicit URL
Table 2: HUA -0.6 gap +23.6pp with wide CI [+3.6, +38.8] over 40 prompts
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM safety/interpretability work: decomposes verbalized eval-awareness in CoT into capabilities- vs safety-flavored framings that oppositely predict compliance on harmful-request rollouts. Strongly matches high-weight preferences (LLMs, AI safety, interpretability, red-teaming/evaluation, reasoning/CoT). Rigor is above average: ~27k graded rollouts, blinded hand-validation (κ=0.80 EA filter; 0.80-0.81 binary cap/safety axes, Section 2/Appendix C), paired prefill design with seed matching, sign-test p≈0.011, headline 21.9pp contrast p<0.0001 surviving drop-top-21-of-52 removal (Table 9), plus an OLMo-3-32B-Think directional replication (Fig. 3b). Novelty is moderate-good: extends retrospective cap/safety classification (Needham et al.) to in-the-moment reasoning and shows suppression steering reshapes framing composition non-uniformly, but builds directly on Aranguri & Bloom and Hua et al. Evidence is solid though the headline framing-compliance gap and steering-composition result are explicitly correlational (Section 4), one steering condition has a wide CI (+23.6 [+3.6,+38.8], Table 2), and the LLM grader under-calls the 'both' category (Appendix C). Generalizability is limited: single main model (Qwen3-32B), single dataset (55 highest-EA FORTRESS adversarial prompts), acknowledged in Section 4. Reproducibility is decent (prompt IDs, full grader prompts, prefill list, seeds in Appendices A/D, 'released artifact' mentioned in Appendix E.1) but no verifiable code/data URL.

primary_link.title: Not All Eval-Awareness Is Equal: Capabilities Framing Predicts Compliance

recommendations.summary: Steering interventions targeting eval-awareness, a model's recognition that it is being tested, are increasingly used in safety evaluation pipelines, where evaluation-awareness is treated as a single quantity to be suppressed. We show that verbalized eval-awareness in chain-of-thought can be identified as capabilities-flavored ("the user is testing my ability to follow instructions"), safety-flavored ("the user is testing my boundaries"), both, or neither: framings that predict compliance very d
recommendations.summary_zh: 評測意識指模型在推論中察覺自己正被測試，會使安全評估結果高估對齊程度。近年研究以對比激活引導向量壓抑此現象，並將其視為單一待壓抑量。本文證明語言化的評測意識在思維鏈中自發分解為能力框架（「使用者在測試我遵循指令的能力」）與安全框架（「使用者在測試我的界線」）兩種變體，兩者對順從行為的預測截然不同。作者在 Qwen3-32B 上以 FORTRESS 資料集的 55 個高評測意識提示、每提示 500 次取樣進行實驗，以三階段 LLM 評分管線分類，並以人工盲評驗證（kappa 0.80）。結果顯示在所有引導條件下，能力框架的順從率比安全框架高 24 至 46 個百分點。在無評測意識的軌跡上注入 CoT 前綴的因果實驗中，11 種前綴有 10 種朝預測方向移動（符號檢定 p≈0.011），旗艦對比為 21.9 個百分點，且方向性趨勢在 OLMo-3-32B 上重現。此外，HUA 向量引導會非均勻地重塑框架組成，壓抑率變動時安全相關成分未必跟著改變。限制包括僅測試單一模型家族、單一資料集，且部分結論屬關聯性而非因果。此研究呼籲安全評估應報告框架分布，而非僅報告總體壓抑率。
recommendations.title: Not All Eval-Awareness Is Equal: Capabilities Framing Predicts Compliance
recommendations.title_zh: 並非所有評測意識皆相同：能力框架預測順從行為

links.title: Scaling Model-Generated Distillation Data Can Make Latent Teacher Traits More Recoverable

evidence: Abstract: 'larger independent datasets make the teacher's induced trait stand out more clearly in the student's later behavior' - states the central scaling-recoverability claim.
Section 4.1: 'The number of targets with positive localization margin rises from 2/16 to 14/16 for animals over 1K-40K examples, and from 2/16 to 11/16 for plants over 10K-100K examples.'

Section 4.1 (Figure 2a fixed-step repeat control): 'increasing the unique-example count improves the readouts even though the total number of rows is unchanged', ruling out simple repeated-exposure explanations.
Section 4.3 (Figure 5b): LLM-judge unsafe rates rise 'from 2.0% to 33.7%' and human-judge rates 'from 3.3% to 38.0%' across the 300-prompt safety evaluation.

Appendix B.3 (Table 8): masking the first teacher-base divergence token weakens but does not remove the effect ('+1.10 at 10K to +7.10 at 60K' masked gap), showing scaling is not reducible to divergence tokens.
Appendix B.4 (Table 7): under fixed compute, carrier improvement changes only 0.984 to 1.172 while hidden-trait gap rises 2.033 to 7.409, supporting a landscape-alignment account.
Section 5.2 (Table 1): cross-model identity transfer shows all five induced identities become top-ranked, e.g. Qwen identity gap +4.42 at 20K to +7.78 at 150K.
Section 7 Limitations: 'Our experiments are controlled probes rather than full reproductions of industrial distillation pipelines', acknowledging scope limits.

Section 1 footnote 1: 'Anonymized code available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/hidden-transfer-scaling'; Appendix C.2 (Table 10) gives full LoRA/optimizer hyperparameters and seeds 1-3, supporting reproducibility.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A core-LLM paper on how scaling model-generated distillation data amplifies recovery of latent teacher traits, squarely relevant to LLM, alignment/safety, synthetic-data, and training preferences. Builds on known subliminal-learning and emergent-misalignment results, so the core phenomenon is not new, but the scaling dimension, localization margin metric, fixed-compute landscape decomposition, dual-trait interactions, and cross-model transfer tests are genuine additions. Rigor is strong: matched no-trait reference teachers, format-only and shuffled-pairing controls, unique-vs-repeated-exposure control, divergence-token masking, DoRA/OPD/rank ablations, three seeds, pre-specified closed candidate sets, and dual LLM+human judging. Evidence is quantitative and multi-axis but confined to contrived probes (number-only carriers, animal/plant preferences); cross-model effects are weaker and noisier, and the authors concede in Section 7 that these are controlled probes without a complete mitigation, capping generalizability. Reproducibility is very good: anonymized code, full hyperparameters (Table 10), prompt inventories, candidate sets, and judge prompts in appendices.

primary_link.title: Scaling Model-Generated Distillation Data Can Make Latent Teacher Traits More Recoverable

recommendations.summary: Scaling model-generated data is usually viewed as improving distillation: more examples should increase coverage, reduce noise, and produce stronger students. We show a second effect: larger datasets can make subtle teacher-specific signals easier to detect in the trained student, even when examples are off-task and never mention the trait. In a controlled setup inspired by subliminal learning, a teacher induced to express a target trait generates restricted off-task data, such as number-only co
recommendations.summary_zh: 擴增模型生成資料通常被視為改善蒸餾：樣本越多涵蓋越廣、雜訊越低、學生越強。本文揭示第二個效應：即使樣本與任務無關且從未提及目標特質，更大的資料集也會讓教師特定的隱藏訊號在學生身上更容易被偵測。受 subliminal learning 啟發，作者採用受控協定：先以系統提示或微調誘導教師表達目標特質，再讓其生成僅含數字等受限的離題資料並過濾明確線索；以相同配方訓練不同規模的學生，在獨立領域評估，並以配對的無特質對照組分離目標特定移轉。主要發現是更大的獨立資料集使誘導特質在學生後續行為中更突出：動物與植物偏好目標中，具正定位餘裕的特質數量隨規模由 2/16 增至 14/16 與 11/16；小規模時行為常落在相近吸引子（如虎誘導出獅子般的行為），規模放大後則趨向預期目標。LoRA 更新的幾何分析呈現平行趨勢；固定訓練步數的控制實驗排除了重複曝光的解釋。效應延伸到數學能力與「邪惡系統提示」的安全姿態（LLM 判定不安全率由 2.0% 升至 33.7%）、多重特質競爭與跨模型家族移轉。限制在於屬受控探針而非完整工業管線重現，且未提出完整緩解方案。此結果呼籲擴增生成資料應搭配特質感知的資料治理與部署規模的評估。

links.title: EviGraph: Towards Verifiable Evidence Construction for Information-Seeking Agents

evidence: Abstract: 'a Qwen3-8B EviGraph agent achieves 35.9% accuracy under a matched interaction budget, compared with 26.9% for the same dual-role architecture without reinforcement learning and 2.7% for a monolithic agent, while generating fewer tokens per rollout'.

Section 5.5 / Table 6: same-backbone ablation on BrowseComp-Plus under 'a 50-turn budget' — single-agent 2.7% (3.7 searches, 3245 tokens), dual-role no-RL 26.9% (12.9 searches, 1878 tokens), dual-role+RL 35.9% (13.2 searches, 1689 tokens); the paper concedes the first margin 'reflects role decomposition together with the resulting stopping behavior rather than role decomposition in isolation'.

Section 3.4: deterministic validator checks include '(i) the cited span occurs in the referenced observation' and canonical evidence signatures 'converting exact duplicates into zero-reward no-ops'; the reachability-invariant paragraph admits 'This does not prove that a source is true or that a span semantically entails a claim'.

Section 4.2: coverage shaping is potential-based 'gamma*Phi(G') - Phi(G)' citing Ng et al. [26]; a per-candidate-tag-polarity acceptance-bonus cap mitigates reward farming, with the caveat 'we do not claim they eliminate every possible exploit'.

Section 5.4 / Table 4: LiveVQA 78.0% with pretrained Qwen3-VL-8B 'without any additional fine-tuning'; the paper treats the 0.4-point margin over Vision-DeepResearch-30B-A3B (77.6%) as 'competitive with rather than superior to'.

Section 5.2: training details given (AdamW lr 1e-6, 1,200 steps, 8x H20 GPUs, N_r=8 rollouts, two-phase GRPO with no SFT cold-start); BrowseComp-Plus is a three-seed mean 'with standard deviation below 0.5 points' while 'the remaining benchmarks are evaluated once per configuration'; no code or model release statement appears anywhere in the document.

Section 5.3 / Table 3: EviGraph (Qwen3-32B) at 36.6% remains 'below the strongest closed and specialized systems' (Tongyi DeepResearch 44.5%), and the paper states the comparison is 'a parameter-efficient open-model result rather than a state-of-the-art claim'.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core language-agent methodology paper: agentic web search (Agents & Tool Use, 2.5), grounding/evidence and RAG (1.8), process-reward GRPO training (Alignment/RL), multi-step reasoning, with an LLM backbone (Qwen3). Novelty is solid but incremental: evidence graphs exist for verification (GEAR, MedCEG, AutoGraph-R1) and process-rewarded search agents exist (Search-R1, StepSearch); the contribution is the online span-anchored graph used jointly as working memory and dense reward source, with anti-reward-farming safeguards. Rigor is above average: matched 50-turn same-backbone ablation (2.7 -> 26.9 -> 35.9 on 830 questions, 3 seeds, std <0.5), token/search controls, hyperparameter tables, and unusually honest confound acknowledgment (the architecture gain is confounded with emergent search persistence; the 0.4-point LiveVQA margin is not claimed as superiority). Deductions: no direct measurement of evidence-graph quality (span fidelity/polarity precision) despite 'verifiability' being the headline claim; LLM-judge scoring throughout; most benchmarks evaluated once; possible compute asymmetry from the frozen verifier in the dual-role system is not fully analyzed. Evidence strength is good (multi-benchmark tables, training dynamics, error analysis) but rests on judge-based accuracy rather than grounded-quality metrics. Generalizability is demonstrated across 5 benchmarks, 8B/32B scales, and zero-shot multimodal transfer. Reproducibility is middling: detailed configs but no code/data/model release statement, reliance on Serper API, GPT-4.1 judge, and an unspecified 'DeepSeek-V4-Flash' scorer.

primary_link.title: EviGraph: Towards Verifiable Evidence Construction for Information-Seeking Agents

recommendations.summary: Agentic Web search can retrieve relevant information without establishing that the retrieved content actually supports the claims used in an answer. Existing agents typically keep search and evidence recording in a linear interaction trace and optimize primarily for final-answer correctness, providing limited supervision for intermediate grounding. We present EviGraph, a deep-search framework that separates search execution from evidence recording while using a shared policy for the trainable ro
recommendations.summary_zh: 代理式網頁搜尋能檢索相關資訊，卻未必能證明檢索內容確實支持答案所用的主張；現有代理把搜尋與證據記錄混在線性軌跡中，且主要最佳化最終答案正確性。本文提出 EviGraph，將代理搜尋重構為證據建構：以異質 DAG 圖將原子主張與答案候選透過逐字片段與極性標籤（support/conflict）的證據邊錨定到來源文件。架構分離搜尋執行與證據記錄，兩個可訓練角色共享同一策略模型：executor 規劃精簡查詢，證據提案角色決定 add/support 圖請求；凍結的證據驗證器檢查頁面並回傳極性標註的證據項目，確定性結構驗證器僅檢查語法與圖不變量，保證每條被記錄的信念皆可對實際觀察審計。圖同時作為持久工作記憶與密集過程獎勵來源，使 RL 能直接監督證據建構而非僅最終答案；設計包括勢函數差分獎勵、正則化證據簽章與每三元組接受獎勵上限以防獎勵鑽營。在 BrowseComp-Plus 上，Qwen3-8B 的 EviGraph 代理達 35.9% 準確率，高於同架構無 RL 的 26.9% 與單體代理的 2.7%，且每次 rollout 生成更少 token；在 BrowseComp、GAIA、XBench 與多模態 LiveVQA（78.0%）亦有增益。限制包括擴展至大型約束集需要候選剪枝與階層式圖摘要，且整體表現受凍結驗證器品質影響。此工作顯示顯式結構化證據記錄能實質改善代理式搜尋。
recommendations.title: EviGraph: Towards Verifiable Evidence Construction for Information-Seeking Agents
recommendations.title_zh: EviGraph:邁向資訊搜尋代理的可驗證證據建構

links.title: Consolidating RLVR Capabilities Across Domains: A Deep Dive into Fusion Paradigms

evidence: Section 4.2, Table 1: fusion paradigms average within 1.4 points but gap reaches 8.6 on a single benchmark; Merge/Mix RL trail experts by 4.9-9.2 points on IFBench
Section 5.1, Figure 3: layer-16 task-vector cosine similarity for math-science is 21.7 (4B) and 50.7 (8B) in units of 1e-3 vs at most 2.3 for pairs involving instruction following or agent

Appendix E, Table 6: five full-parameter merging methods (Average, TA, TIES, DARE-TA, SCE) plus four LoRA merges compared on both backbones; lambda sweep in Fig. 7 shows thinking-mode leakage rising to ~66% at lambda=1.0
Appendix B, Table 3: verl framework, GRPO/Sampled-Token OPD hyperparameters, LoRA rank 32 / alpha 64, 32 NVIDIA H20 GPUs
Appendix D: Qwen3-32B LLM-judge protocol with full grader prompts for held-out SimpleQA-Verified and AA-LCR evaluations
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM post-training methodology: a controlled comparison of three RLVR capability-consolidation paradigms (task-vector merging, mixed-domain GRPO, multi-teacher on-policy distillation) across Qwen3-4B/8B with shared experts and data. Strong preference fit (LLMs, RL/RLHF-adjacent, reasoning domains, agents/tool use, efficiency/cost analysis). Rigor is high: two scales, full-parameter and LoRA expert sets, merging-method and scaling-coefficient ablations including a thinking-mode-leakage confound check (Appendix E, Fig. 7), GPU-hour cost accounting, and held-out capability tests. Evidence is detailed and internally consistent, though statistical testing is thin (small AIME sets at mean@16), pass@k coverage analysis is math-only, and the corpus mixing ratio is fixed rather than swept despite the finding that proportions matter. Novelty is moderate: the unified three-way comparison and task-vector-geometry/transfer correlation are new, but all three paradigms and the reweighting-vs-expansion observation build on known methods and prior findings (explicitly credited to Yue et al. 2025 and Wang et al. 2026). Generalizability is limited to one model family and five chosen domains; reproducibility is good (verl, public datasets/benchmarks, full hyperparameters, claimed GitHub/HF releases) with placeholder links the only gap.

We organize three fusion paradigms by the artefacts they reuse: Merge combines expert task vectors, Mix RL pools their datasets, and multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) uses both. Because they have largely been studied in isolation, how they compare and how to
recommendations.summary_zh: 可驗證獎勵強化學習(RLVR)能提升大型語言模型在特定領域的能力,但涵蓋多領域通常需訓練多個領域專家再加以整合。本文依重複使用的產物將融合範式分為三類:Merge 合併專家任務向量、Mix RL 混合各領域資料集、MOPD(多教師同策略蒸餾)兩者兼用。作者在 Qwen3-4B 與 8B 骨幹上訓練數學、科學、程式編寫、指令遵循與代理工具使用五個領域專家,以相同實驗框架系統比較。結果顯示平均效能差異不超過 1.4 分,但單一基準差距可達 8.6 分;領域層級表現與任務向量幾何揭示的跨領域關係一致——數學、科學與程式互相增益,指令遵循與代理使用近乎正交。訓練動態也揭露各自限制:Mix RL 依賴領域資料比例、MOPD 受教師上限束縛、Merge 將五個專家更新壓縮為單一更新。三種方法均只提升單樣本準確率,於 pass@32 時與基礎模型已無明顯差異,顯示融合是重新加權既有解題路徑而非擴大可解範圍,且未損及保留能力。實務指引:專家已存在且重視低成本用 Merge;無專家時用 Mix RL 但需調整領域比例;重視保留各領域增益則用 MOPD。限制在於僅測試特定骨幹與基準組合。

evidence: Section 3.2-3.4: five specialized LLM modules; diagnostic LLM converts fine-grained solver statistics (root gap, node count, presolve) into 'verbal gradients' guiding crossover/mutation.
Section 4.2, Table 1: TSP FormuEvo 0.1410 SGM vs best baseline SCF 0.3079 (Easy); abstract claims up to 5.5x solver speedup.
Section 4.4, Table 3: removing Diagnosis or Memory degrades performance (e.g., TSP Hard 3.9469 -> 6.5207 without Diagnosis).
Appendix C.1, Table 6: paired Wilcoxon tests; BPP Easy p=2.82E-01 and QAP Easy p=4.44E-01 not significant, attributed to floor effect - honest negative reporting.
Appendix C.2, Tables 7-8: framework re-validated on COPT and SCIP, including FormuEvo-G transfer across solvers.
Section 4.5, Table 4: three backbone LLMs (GPT-5.4-mini, Claude-Sonnet-4.6, DeepSeek-V4-Flash) all beat best baselines, no single backbone dominates.
Section 4.3 / Fig. 4: distilled knowledge base transfers zero-shot to unseen problems and bootstraps smaller LLM (GPT-5.4-nano).
Appendix B: Algorithm 1 pseudocode and full operator prompts; code claimed at github.com/Xyz-yuanhf/formuevo.
Limitations section: framework restricted to static formulations; dynamic relaxation/decomposition methods (column generation, Benders) explicitly out of scope.
Section 3.2 Evaluation: correctness enforced by checking solved objective values against ground truth; failed candidates get one repair attempt, preserving membership in the valid formulation space.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A methodologically LLM-centric paper (not a pure domain application): FormuEvo uses five specialized LLM modules (generator, diagnostic, repair, reflector, distiller) as evolutionary operators over executable Gurobi modeling programs, squarely matching high-weight preferences for LLMs, code/program synthesis, and agentic tool orchestration. Novelty is moderate-to-good: LLM-guided evolutionary search is established (FunSearch, ReEvo, AlphaEvolve, EvoCut), but adapting it to holistic MIP formulation design, plus solver-statistics-as-verbal-gradients diagnosis and distillable structured memory, is a genuine contribution. Rigor is strong: five classical problems plus two novel tasks, expert and LLM baselines (ORLM, StepORLM, EvoCut), component ablations (Table 3), backbone ablations with API costs (Table 4), cross-solver transfer (Tables 7-8), public-benchmark generalization (Fig. 5), hyperparameter sensitivity (Table 9), and Wilcoxon significance tests with honestly reported non-significant Easy-level results (BPP 2.82E-01, QAP 4.44E-01, Appendix C.1). Evidence is quantitative and multi-axis, though evaluated largely on self-generated instance splits and correctness verified only by objective-value match (Section 3.2). Generalizability is well supported within optimization (multiple solvers, backbones, unseen problems, smaller models), but untested outside MIP. Reproducibility is aided by a public code link, full prompts (Appendix B), and detailed hyperparameters, but depends on proprietary LLM APIs and stochastic search. Limitations section honestly excludes decomposition-based methods.

primary_link.title: FormuEvo: LLM-Guided Evolution for Discovering Solver-Efficient Mixed-Integer Programming Formulations

recommendations.summary: Mixed-integer programming (MIP) lies at the core of operations research and industrial optimization. While large language models (LLMs) have recently shown promise in automated MIP modeling from natural language, they prioritize semantic correctness but overlook formulation strength, severely bottlenecking the efficiency of downstream solvers. We propose FormuEvo, an LLM-guided evolutionary framework for automated discovery of solver-efficient MIP formulations. FormuEvo frames MIP formulation de
recommendations.summary_zh: 混合整數規劃（MIP）的多種數學等價表述，其求解效率可能相差數個數量級。現有以 LLM 自動建模的方法著重語意正確性而忽略表述強度，使下游求解器效率受限。FormuEvo 將 MIP 表述設計視為在可執行程式構成的符號空間上的演化最佳化：以 LLM 驅動的交配、突變與修復操作，迭代生成、評估並挑選更強的候選表述。為避免盲目探索，本文導入求解器資訊診斷機制，將預解結果、鬆弛品質、分支規模等細粒度統計轉為可解讀的「口語梯度」，引導針對性改良；並以結構化記憶庫將經驗抽象為可重複使用的建模策略，支援零樣本遷移與小型模型增強。在 TSP、JSSP、BPP、CFLP、QAP 等線性與非線性基準及 NNV、IMO 等新穎任務上，FormuEvo 發現的表述大幅超越專家設計與現有 LLM 方法，加速求解器最高達 5.5 倍，蒸餾知識亦能有效跨問題與模型規模遷移；消融證實診斷與記憶皆為關鍵元件。限制在於僅針對靜態表述，尚未涵蓋欄位生成或 Benders 分解等動態方法，與分解式演算法的共同演化為未來方向。

links.title: Evaluating Confidence-Gated Retrieval with Matched Trajectory Replay

evidence: Abstract: calibration increases committed-answer accuracy by up to 41 pp across all six model-dataset pairs, but overall accuracy improves up to 15 pp on HotpotQA and falls up to 17 pp on MuSiQue
Table 1: Mistral MuSiQue Calibrated-Gated CA 45.5 vs Raw-Gated 15.9 with coverage dropping 99.7 to 7.3 and OA falling 15.9 to 3.3 at cost 0.26 to 2.92
Table 2 (RQ3): held-out ECE improves through depths 1-2 but calibrated ECE exceeds raw at depth 3 for all three models (e.g., Mistral 23.0 vs 15.4)
Section 4.1: isotonic map fit only on labeled depth-zero calibration records, pooled across datasets, frozen before final-test replay

Section 5 RQ5 / Table 3: 17.7% helpful vs 3.6% harmful retrieval transitions (net +14.1 pp), but the paper argues this aggregate effect does not establish confidence as a value-of-information estimate

Section 7 Limitations: benchmark-grounded evidence paths rather than a live retriever, LLM judge (gemini-2.5-flash-lite) used without human-validation study, zero cost assigned to abstention/escalation

Appendix A.4 and Table 5: open-weight checkpoints (mistralai/mistral-small-2603, openai/gpt-oss-120b, qwen/qwen3-235b-a22b-2507), deterministic 2:1 calibration-test splits (3,702/1,852 HotpotQA; 1,208/605 MuSiQue), full system and judge prompts in Appendices A.1/A.3, but no code release stated
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly in-scope: an evaluation methodology for confidence-gated retrieval in LLM agents, intersecting high-weight preferences (LLMs, agents, RAG, evaluation/calibration) without falling into any excluded category. The matched trajectory replay protocol is a genuinely useful controlled-attribution design, and the empirical findings are reported honestly (calibration improves committed-answer accuracy up to 41pp but can collapse coverage and reduce overall accuracy up to 17pp on MuSiQue; the frozen depth-0 map fails at retrieval depth 3). Rigor is above average: held-out calibration splits, frozen maps, a-priori thresholds, multiple baselines (parametric-only, Fixed RAG@k, adaptive proxy), budget sweeps, and explicit caveats that results reflect operating-point shifts rather than improved ranking. Evidence is extensive and internally consistent (Tables 1-3, transition-count arithmetic 7,371-4=7,367). Main weaknesses: novelty is incremental (isotonic calibration and adaptive retrieval are established; the contribution is the evaluation protocol and depth-wise transfer analysis), scope is narrow (two multi-hop QA datasets, three models, one deterministic evidence-plan construction rather than a live retriever), correctness relies on an unvalidated LLM judge, and no code release is stated despite detailed prompts/checkpoints in the appendix.

primary_link.title: Evaluating Confidence-Gated Retrieval with Matched Trajectory Replay

recommendations.summary: Interactive language-model agents use confidence signals to decide whether to answer immediately, retrieve additional evidence (from memory or external knowledge), or defer. Yet confidence is usually evaluated in isolation, without measuring the trajectory-level consequences of the actions it triggers. We propose matched trajectory replay, a controlled protocol for comparing confidence-to-action mappings. The protocol holds candidate answer states, evidence points, budgets, and action costs fixe
recommendations.summary_zh: 互動式語言模型代理常依信心訊號決定立即回答、檢索更多證據或延後處理,但信心校準通常被單獨評估,未衡量其觸發動作在軌跡層級的後果。本文提出匹配軌跡重播控制協定:固定候選答案狀態、證據點、預算與動作成本,僅改變提供給控制器的信心分數,以隔離信心到動作映射的效果。作者在 HotpotQA 與 MuSiQue 多跳問答上,以 Mistral、GPT-OSS-120B 與 Qwen3-235B 比較原始口語化信心與事後等張校準。結果顯示在相同數值承諾門檻下,校準改變了代理最終承諾回答的題目集合:六組模型—資料集配對中,已承諾答案準確率最多提升 41 個百分點,但覆蓋率下降、檢索使用增加;整體準確率在 HotpotQA 最多升 15 個百分點,在 MuSiQue 卻最多降 17 個百分點,反映控制器移往更選擇性的低風險操作點,而非答案品質或信心排序的改善。此外,於檢索前擬合的校準映射在深度一、二仍能改善保留集校準,但三個模型在深度三都劣於原始信心。平均而言額外證據有幫助,卻不代表信心能辨識哪些個別事件將受益於另一次檢索。作者結論:校準可使承諾風險可解讀,但無法估計下次檢索的預期效益,檢索需獨立的資訊價值或效用估計。限制包括使用基準固定的證據路徑而非即時檢索器,且僅涵蓋兩個資料集與三個模型。

links.title: Is Next-Chunk Reasoning RL Really Better than SFT? Revisiting Training Strategies under no-CoT Data

evidence: Abstract: Mixed SFT 'achieves a clearly higher post-RLVR performance ceiling than next-chunk reasoning RL while requiring over 60× less training compute', consistent across in-domain math and out-of-domain reasoning.
Table 1: survey of RPT, RLP, RMT, RLPT, PretrainZero showing all mark 'Mixed SFT' as ✗, supporting the claimed baseline gap.
Table 2: post-RLVR Mixed SFT reaches 87.50/85.73/70.42 on AIME24/25/26 and 9.24/60.98/75.84 on HLE/GPQA-Dia./MMLU-Pro, exceeding NTR (87.50/84.38/69.38) and NSR (85.52/80.92/72.19) averages.
Sec 3.3 / Fig 3: Mixed SFT has lowest pre-RLVR average (27.5) yet highest post-RLVR average (61.1), a 33.7-point gain vs 3.3–10.3 for other methods.
Sec 4 Observation 1 / Fig 5: high-entropy token pool shows no-reasoning accuracy ~0.48 throughout, implying the entropy filter admits locally predictable targets.
Table 3 and Appendix Table 8: inserting NTR or NSR between Mixed SFT and RLVR yields slightly lower post-RLVR scores (e.g., HMMT26 50.50/49.52 vs 51.52), ruling out a token-coverage confound.
Appendix G Table 9: entropy-controlled NTR scores lower than vanilla NTR on all nine benchmarks, supporting that collapse is not the cause of NTR's ceiling.
Appendix A Limitations: single fixed mixing ratio and math-only corpus/benchmarks; transfer to code, multilingual, or other domains untested.

Appendix B: full training details (Qwen3-30B-A3B-Base on H200s, lr 1e-6, GRPO, deduplication against eval benchmarks) and Table 5/6 hyperparameters and decoding configs; prompts in Appendix I; no code/data release statement found.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM post-training study on reasoning (CoT, RLVR/GRPO, SFT vs RL on no-CoT data), strongly matching LLM, reasoning/CoT, RL, and training preferences. The contribution is a corrective, well-controlled comparison rather than a new method: Mixed SFT is a simple but genuinely overlooked baseline (Table 1 confirms prior NCR works never compared against it). Rigor is solid: five strategies from one base model, shared RLVR stage, six in-domain plus three OOD benchmarks, ablations inserting NTR/NSR after Mixed SFT (Table 3/8), an entropy-controlled NTR variant (Appendix G), and a retention probe (Table 4). Evidence is extensive and internally consistent, though single-model, single-mixing-ratio, math-only, and without variance estimates. The mechanistic analysis (entropy filter admitting locally predictable tokens, template collapse) is plausible but interpretive. Reproducibility is aided by detailed hyperparameters, decoding configs, and prompts, but no code or data release is stated. Limitations (fixed ratio, math domain) are candidly acknowledged.

primary_link.title: Is Next-Chunk Reasoning RL Really Better than SFT? Revisiting Training Strategies under no-CoT Data

recommendations.summary: Recent work proposes next-chunk reasoning RL for leveraging no-CoT data---corpora such as worked solutions and textbook derivations that contain reasoning-rich content but lack explicit chain-of-thought annotations. The method trains a model to generate implicit reasoning traces and rewards them by their ability to predict the next chunk of text. While promising, existing evaluations primarily compare against conventional SFT baselines, leaving open whether the gains come from the RL formulation itself or from more effectively exposing the model to no-CoT data. We address this question with a controlled study of next-chunk reasoning RL and a simple but previously overlooked alternative: Mixed SFT, a single supervised fine-tuning stage that jointly trains on no-CoT and long-CoT data. Despite its simplicity, Mixed SFT achieves a clearly higher post-RLVR performance ceiling than next-chunk reasoning RL while requiring over 60 times less training compute. The advantage is consistent across in-domain mathematical reasoning and out-of-domain reasoning tasks. Moreover, we show that higher pre-RLVR accuracy does not necessarily translate into higher post-RLVR accuracy, highlighting the need to evaluate no-CoT training strategies in the context of the full post-training pipeline.
recommendations.summary_zh: 近期提出的「下一區塊推理 RL」利用無 CoT 資料（如解答範例、課本推導）訓練模型生成隱式推理，並以能否預測下一段文字作為獎勵。然而既有評估僅對照在無 CoT 資料上的單純 SFT，無法釐清成效來自 RL 形式本身，或僅是更有效地暴露於此類資料。本文從同一基礎模型出發，在相同 RLVR 預算下比較 NTR、NSR、序貫式 SFT、混合式 SFT 與純推理 SFT。結果顯示混合式 SFT——在單一階段同時訓練無 CoT 與長 CoT 資料——在領域內數學與領域外推理上達到最高的 RLVR 後天花板，運算量少逾 60 倍。分析指出 NTR 的熵過濾並未選出真正需要推理的 token，生成軌跡退化為局部補全，抑制熵崩潰亦無助提升；混合式 SFT 的前段低分僅為暫時的格式錯位，可由 RLVR 修復，而序貫式 SFT 的第二階段會覆寫先前吸收的無 CoT 知識，RLVR 無法復原。本文提醒：應以完整後訓練管線評估無 CoT 策略，前置準確率無法預測最終表現，對受運算限制的實務者而言，SFT 階段的資料組成比額外 RL 階段更重要。

links.title: ResiSpec: Enhancing Multi-Candidate Speculative Sampling via Residual Distribution Shaping

evidence: Abstract: proposes ResiSpec to mitigate Residual Drift in multi-candidate speculative decoding, claims up to 1.92x speedup over state-of-the-art multi-candidate methods with output exactness, and states code is available at github.com/Czzzk/Resispec.

Figure 1 (Limitation section): shows sequential candidate acceptance rates on CNN/DM with Llama-2-7B and Vicuna-7B targets and Llama-68M draft drop sharply after the first candidate at T in {0.6, 1.0}, motivating the Residual Drift claim.

Appendix Table 5: with depth fixed at 4, increasing candidates N from 1 to 8 raises EAL only from 1.89 to 2.76 while efficiency score eta drops from 0.280 to 0.070, quantifying scaling inefficiency of standard multi-candidate verification.

Method section, Algorithm 1 and Definitions 1-2: proxy distribution k(x)=p(x)-r(x)+s(x) with disjoint support constraint and Local Alignment k(x_i)=q(x_i); Proposition 1 (mass identity) and Proposition 2 (capacity bound Z <= min p/q) are stated with proofs in the main text.

Table 1 (Main Results): ResiSpec vs SpecInfer on Llama-2-7B with JF68M, 3-branch depth-5 tree, averaged over 200 runs, accepted length gains up to 1.86x and throughput gains up to 1.68x across CNN/DM, OpenWebText, C4 at T=1.0 and T=0.6.
Table 2 (Compatibility): ResiSpec as add-on improves Sequoia accepted length 3.07 to 4.32 (1.31x speedup) and EAGLE 3.12 to 3.85 (1.15x speedup) at T=1.0 under matched decoding settings.
Table 3 (Ablation): under comparable verification budgets, speedup over SpecInfer ranges from 1.92x (d7b2) to 1.17x (d3b11), with larger gains on deeper narrower trees.

Table 4 (Empirical Validation): KL divergence between ResiSpec sampling distribution and target model is on the order of 1e-10 to 1e-9 across datasets and temperatures, comparable to SpecInfer, attributed to floating-point noise.
Appendix A.1, Theorem 1: full proof that the marginal output distribution equals the target p(x) given Local Alignment, via acceptance-path and rejection-path decomposition.

Appendix C (Reproducibility Details): specifies Docker environment, CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES binding, fixed per-prompt seed schedule, deterministic cuDNN, dataset order, tree configs (d5b3, M=384 for Sequoia, total_token=60/depth=5 for EAGLE), and separation of profiling from throughput runs.

Appendix D, Table 6: ablation over four target-draft pairs (Llama-2-7B/JF68M, Sheared-LLaMA-2.7B with Sheared-LLaMA-1.3B, TinyLlama-1.1B, Tiny-Vicuna-1B) across two tree shapes, three datasets, and two temperatures, consistently favoring ResiSpec over SpecInfer.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A methods paper on LLM inference acceleration via speculative decoding, squarely within the LLM/efficiency/serving preference cluster (not a pure domain application, so the out-of-scope cap does not apply). The core contribution—formalizing 'Residual Drift' in multi-candidate verification and reshaping the rejection residual via a proxy distribution k(x) with a slack-mass budget—is a genuinely new angle on the verification side of tree speculation, though it builds on established speculative sampling machinery (SpecInfer, Sequoia, EAGLE). Rigor is solid: exactness is proven (Appendix A.1 Theorem 1), monotonicity of the shaping loss is proven (Appendix A.2 Theorem 2), and exactness is empirically corroborated via KL divergence on the order of 1e-10 (Table 4). Evidence is quantified and multi-configuration (Table 1: up to 1.86x accepted length and 1.68x throughput vs SpecInfer; Table 3: 1.92x on d7b2 under iso-compute; Table 6: many target-draft pairs), but the primary head-to-head baseline is only SpecInfer, with Sequoia/EAGLE shown only as add-ons (Table 2, EAGLE gain a modest 1.15x), and experiments use a single RTX 3090 with generic text corpora (no downstream tasks). Generalizability is supported across model pairs, temperatures, and tree shapes but untested on larger models or batched serving. Reproducibility is strong: public code link plus an unusually detailed Appendix C (Docker pinning, seed schedule, decoding configs, protocol separation of profiling vs throughput).

primary_link.title: ResiSpec: Enhancing Multi-Candidate Speculative Sampling via Residual Distribution Shaping

recommendations.summary: The efficiency of Large Language Model (LLM) serving is fundamentally limited by the sequential nature of autoregressive decoding. Speculative Decoding (SD) mitigates this by using a lightweight draft model to speculate future tokens, which are then validated by the LLM in a single parallel forward pass. To further boost efficiency, multi-candidate schemes propose diverse candidate sets to increase the likelihood of token acceptance. However, we show that these schemes are bottlenecked by Residu
recommendations.summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLM）的自迴歸解碼本質上逐詞元產生，效率受限於記憶體存取瓶頸。投機解碼（Speculative Decoding）以輕量草稿模型預測候選詞元，再由目標模型單次平行驗證，已成為無損加速的主流方法，而樹狀或多候選驗證更進一步擴大搜尋空間。本文指出此類方法的關鍵瓶頸為「殘差漂移」（Residual Drift）：當第一個候選被拒絕後，驗證準則轉向殘差分布，其質量集中於草稿模型的「盲區」，導致後續預先取樣的候選幾乎必然失效，迫使系統昂貴地重新取樣，邊際效益迅速遞減。作者提出 ResiSpec，在驗證階段引入輔助代理分布 k(x)，將拒絕後的殘差質量重新對齊至草稿模型的高密度區域，使既有候選在整段驗證鏈中持續可用。理論上，本文證明該塑形程序維持零偏差取樣，輸出分布與目標模型完全一致，實測 KL 散度僅約 10⁻¹⁰。實驗以 Llama-2-7B 為目標模型、Llama-68M 為草稿，在 CNN/DM、OpenWebText 與 C4 上，ResiSpec 相對 SpecInfer 將接受長度提升至多 1.86 倍、吞吐量提升至多 1.68 倍；作為外掛亦可增強 Sequoia（1.31 倍）與 EAGLE（1.15 倍），在較深且較窄的樹狀配置下最高達 1.92 倍加速。限制在於代理分布建構帶來少量分布層級的運算開銷，且成效依賴驗證階段的候選序列結構。整體而言，本文將多候選投機解碼的擴展瓶頸轉化為分布塑形問題，對高效 LLM 推論系統具直接價值。
recommendations.title: ResiSpec: Enhancing Multi-Candidate Speculative Sampling via Residual Distribution Shaping
recommendations.title_zh: ResiSpec：透過殘差分布塑形強化多候選投機取樣

links.title: Adaptive Triggering for Bias Correction in LLM Reasoning

evidence: Abstract: white-box signal improves ambiguous-item accuracy on all six open-weight models but reduces disambiguated accuracy on five; black-box triggering on gpt-4o-mini recovers most fixed-interval accuracy loss with substantially fewer interventions.

Section IV-C1 / Fig. 3 / Table II: on a 504-item gpt-4o-mini subsample, adaptive_bb reaches 90.1% vs. 82.9% disambiguated accuracy for fixed_interval (p=0.0003) at 0.60 vs. 1.00 interventions/item; independent-judge replication shows +6.75pp vs. fixed (95% CI [2.78, 10.71], p=0.0015).

Section III-D: authors explicitly state that without fixed-targeted or adaptive-generic conditions, 'the experimental design does not separately identify the causal effects of intervention timing and intervention content.'

Section IV-C2 / Table IV / Fig. 5: full nine-category complete-case analyses (N=13,070-15,686 per split) show e.g. Qwen-1.5B disambiguated 71.8%->55.4% (-15.6pp) under adaptive_wb; the matched-budget cadence sweep N in {2,3,5,8,10} shows adaptive selection is not merely a lower-firing fixed schedule.

Section V: limitations state experiments are restricted to BBQ with no generalization to other bias benchmarks, cultural contexts, or open-ended generation; detector calibration is validated on only one model; no comparison against trained reward models such as FRM.

Section IV-B and Conclusion: DS-Qwen-7B excluded from black-box analyses due to chat-template/judge token-budget failure (transparently reported); code and corrected BBQ label-matching logic released at github.com/clairekim59/adaptive-triggering.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM paper squarely matching top-weighted preferences: chain-of-thought reasoning, inference-time intervention, bias/fairness (AI Safety), LLM-as-judge, and prompting-based correction across seven open-weight models plus gpt-4o-mini; clearly in scope, no out-of-scope domain cap applies. Novelty is moderate: CUSUM-based triggering is adapted from prior sequential-monitoring work, but combining evidence-conditioned mid-generation bias correction with a black-box/white-box signal separation and per-detector held-out calibration is a new formulation, and the 'when vs. what' decomposition plus the documented white-box target mismatch are genuinely informative findings. Rigor is strong: fixed-interval baseline, matched-budget cadence sweep controlling firing rate (Fig. 5), independent-judge replication, McNemar exact tests with stratified bootstrap CIs, and unusually honest confound acknowledgment (Section III-D admits timing vs. content is not causally separated). Evidence is quantitative and replicated across model families (Table IV, N=13k-15k per split), though several analyses are single-run, one underpowered check is flagged, and DS-Qwen-7B black-box results are missing. Generalizability is the weak point: all experiments are on BBQ only, calibration validated on a single model, and no comparison to trained reward models. Reproducibility is good: code, corrected BBQ scoring logic, verbatim judge prompt, and precise model/decoding details are released.

primary_link.title: Adaptive Triggering for Bias Correction in LLM Reasoning

recommendations.summary: Chain-of-thought prompting can expose and amplify demographic stereotypes within an LLM's intermediate reasoning and create a failure mode that final-answer debiasing alone cannot address. Mitigating such bias during generation presents a fundamental timing problem: intervening too late allows biased reasoning to propagate, while unnecessarily intervening can disrupt otherwise correct reasoning. Existing approaches largely avoid this decision by either evaluating completed reasoning chains post
recommendations.summary_zh: 鏈式思考提示雖能提升表現,卻可能在中間推理步驟浮現並放大人口統計刻板印象;現有介入不是事後評估完整推理鏈,就是在固定步驟機械介入,無法判斷發展中的推理軌跡何時累積足夠證據值得修正。本文將此決策形式化為線上變化點偵測:每步的偏見風險訊號更新 CUSUM 統計量,當累積證據越過以保留資料校準的偵測器專屬門檻時,才注入針對性的情境修正。訊號有兩種:白盒訊號取自下個 token 機率對刻板印象一致選項與「資訊不足」選項的偏好差;黑盒訊號由 LLM 評審依文字評分,便於僅有 API 的部署。在 gpt-4o-mini 上,黑盒自適應觸發以遠少於固定排程的介入次數,挽回大部分在消歧情境失去的準確率,且換用獨立評審後結論仍成立;等預算的頻率掃描顯示自適應選擇並非只是介入較少的固定排程。然而跨六個開源權重模型,白盒訊號雖在全部六個模型提升模糊情境準確率,卻在五個上降低消歧情境準確率,因其無法區分無憑據的刻板印象依賴與正確的、恰與刻板印象一致的證據;偵測器校準也無法解決此目標錯配。介入另會在有限推理預算下增加未完成率。結論是有效的推論期偏見修正不僅取決於何時介入,更取決於用什麼證據觸發。

links.title: DEEPCHART: How Far are LLMs from Faithful Data-Science Chart Generation?

evidence: Abstract: 'expert-annotated benchmark of 1,482 task-conditioned chart-generation instances' with Extract–Reason–Visualize pipeline and GitHub release link.

Table 1: DeepChart uniquely combines ~220K-token/218-page real-document contexts, retrieval+reasoning requirements, and 'Stage-by-stage' evaluation vs. prior benchmarks capped at <128K with endpoint scoring.
Section 5.2: '(2) Visual faithfulness does not guarantee data faithfulness' — Ecosystem average VAS 0.447 vs F1_src 0.149 and F1_der 0.276; Academic F1_src 0.691 vs F1_der 0.236.
Section 5.3 / Table 4: Finance-Ultra-Long (50-instance subset) drops average VAS from 0.421 (Normal) to 0.269, F1_src 0.385→0.167, supporting 'larger context windows alone are insufficient'.

Appendix B.2: F1 matching uses 'relative error is no larger than 1e-4' with one-to-one matching that 'intentionally ignores JSON keys and nesting structure'; VAS judged by qwen3-vl-flash with temperature 0.
Appendix B.4: judge ablation across 6 pairs (accuracy 0.773–0.898, κ 0.415–0.755) and human alignment on 2,339 items (94.1% accuracy, κ=0.852, chart-level Pearson 0.939).

Appendix B.1: 'we set reasoning_effort to low' and truncate context prefix to 80% of context window — a potential capability confound; detailed execution parameters (timeouts, 120 DPI, chunk caps) are documented.
Limitations: value-level F1 'should be interpreted as approximate indicators of numerical faithfulness rather than full semantic equivalence'; expert verification prioritizes quality over scale.
Section 3.3: three-role QC (primary annotator, independent verifier, senior reviewer) with unverifiable instances discarded; no annotator-agreement statistics reported for construction.
llm_evaluation.rationale: An LLM-centric evaluation benchmark squarely within scope: it probes frontier LLMs (GPT-5.2, Claude 4.5 Opus, Gemini 3, DeepSeek-V3.2, Qwen3, Kimi-K2) on long-context evidence extraction (avg 220.6K tokens, max 1.2M), multi-hop quantitative reasoning, and executable chart-code generation, with a multimodal VLM protocol. The Extract-Reason-Visualize formulation with stage-by-stage intermediate references is a genuine advance over endpoint-only chart benchmarks (Table 1), and the 'hidden hallucination' framing is well motivated. Rigor is above average: expert QC roles (Sec 3.3), implementation details for value-level F1 (App B.2), a judge-model ablation and human-alignment validation for VAS (App B.4, κ=0.852, Pearson 0.939), and a documented representativeness check for the 50-instance Ultra-Long subset (App B.3). Key weaknesses: value-level matching ignores key/structure alignment, so semantically misassigned numbers can score well; reasoning_effort is set to 'low' (App B.1), a confound for a reasoning-heavy benchmark; results are single-run zero-shot with no variance estimates; rubric generation by Gemini 3 Pro is not itself human-validated. Claims are supported by concrete cross-model numbers (e.g., Ecosystem ER 0.782 vs VAS 0.447; Ultra-Long VAS 0.421→0.269), and prompts, parameters, and a GitHub release support reproduction, though proprietary-API dependence limits exactness.

primary_link.title: DEEPCHART: How Far are LLMs from Faithful Data-Science Chart Generation?

recommendations.summary: Faithful chart generation in real-world data-science workflows requires grounding visualizations in scattered evidence, computing chart-ready quantities, and rendering them accurately. Modern LLMs can produce visually plausible, instruction-compliant charts, yet data-level hallucinations remain difficult to detect in long, noisy, and multimodal contexts. To measure this gap, we introduce DEEPCHART, an expert-annotated benchmark of 1,482 task-conditioned chart-generation instances drawn from real
recommendations.summary_zh: 在真實資料科學工作流程中,忠實的圖表生成需從分散的證據擷取資料、計算圖表所需量,再準確繪製。現代大型語言模型雖能產出視覺可信的圖表,資料層級的幻覺卻難以在冗長嘈雜的多模態環境中偵測。本文提出 DeepChart,一個專家標註基準,含 1,482 個源自真實科學論文、財務申報與生態系報告的任務導向圖表生成實例,並將圖表生成形式化為 Extract–Reason–Visualize(ERV)管線,分階段評估來源資料擷取、衍生資料推理與圖表渲染,指標包括 F1_src、F1_der、視覺準確度分數 VAS 與執行率。對 GPT-5.2、Claude 4.5 Opus、Gemini 3 系列及多個開源模型的零樣本實驗顯示三大發現:可執行程式不保證視覺忠實(Ecosystem 平均執行率 0.782 但 VAS 僅 0.447);視覺可信不保證資料忠實,隱藏幻覺普遍存在;擷取良好不保證推理正確(Academic 的 F1_src 高但 F1_der 顯著偏低)。Finance-Ultra-Long 壓力測試中 VAS 自 0.421 降至 0.269,顯示僅靠加大上下文視窗不足,仍需可靠的證據定位與量化推理。限制包括領域範圍有限、值層級匹配僅為數值忠實性的近似指標,且為品質而犧牲規模。此基準凸顯證據定位與量化推理對忠實視覺化的重要性,並公開相關資源。
recommendations.title: DEEPCHART: How Far are LLMs from Faithful Data-Science Chart Generation?

links.title: Autonomous Mathematical Discovery in an Open-World Multi-Agent Environment

evidence: Section 3.1: 'all instances contain six research agents, two each powered by GPT-5.5, Claude Opus 4.8, and Gemini 3.1 Pro' and 'Most instances run for approximately 1,000-2,000 ticks, corresponding to roughly one to two weeks of continuous wall-clock operation.'

Section 2: 'The complete source code is openly available at https://github.com/dualverse-ai/station'; Section 3.2: 'All supporting proofs, verification artifacts, and raw agent dialogue are available at https://github.com/dualverse-ai/station_data_v2.'

Abstract/Section 3.2: five of 12 AlphaEvolve problems produced results novel relative to prior literature, including a new infinite family of finite-field Kakeya sets and 604-point kissing configurations in dimension 11 (Section 4.3).
Section 4.11: 'The Station reached only C6.2 <= 1.504473, worse than both AlphaEvolve and the current frontier' - honest reporting of underperformance versus baseline.

Section 5.5: three independent Station instances on the d=11 kissing-number problem all reached N=604, 'indicating that the improved lower bound is reproducible', with substantial path variance noted.
Section 4.13 (Discussion): first two Book Ramsey infinite families were autonomous discoveries, but the Yamada-Pott family 'required human expert involvement' since 'the agents did not connect them'.
Section 6: acknowledged limitations include 'Lack of expert intuition', 'Limited in-context learning', and 'Attractor traps'.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core contribution is an open-world multi-agent LLM environment (GPT-5.5, Claude Opus 4.8, Gemini 3.1 Pro researchers with coding assistants, archive papers, Question Room, holidays, multistart) applied to autonomous mathematical discovery, strongly matching the high-weight Agents & Tool Use, LLMs, and Reasoning preferences. Methodology novelty is moderate: the Station builds on the authors' prior v1 system (cited as [16]), with incremental mechanism additions, though the decentralized knowledge-accumulating design is distinctive versus pipeline agents. Rigor is high: careful comparisons against AlphaEvolve, HorizonMath, and a reconstructed pre-AlphaEvolve baseline (Appendix B), per-problem limitations, honest negative results (Sections 4.11-4.12 where the Station underperforms), and a reproducibility study (Section 5.5). Evidence strength benefits from released verification code and hedged novelty claims, though much self-verification remains. Generalizability is limited by the need for automated scorable evaluators; generality beyond math is asserted, not demonstrated here. Reproducibility is aided by open source and full dialogue release but depends on proprietary frontier models and 1-2 week runs with high variance.

primary_link.title: Autonomous Mathematical Discovery in an Open-World Multi-Agent Environment

recommendations.summary: We study autonomous mathematical discovery in the Station, an open-world multi-agent environment in which AI agents from different model families pursue a shared research goal without a central coordinator or scripted pipeline. Agents choose their own research directions, conduct experiments, collaborate, and build a shared scientific literature. Across 12 construction problems from the AlphaEvolve catalogue and two additional case studies, the Station obtained results novel relative to the prio
recommendations.summary_zh: 本文在「Station」開放世界多代理環境中研究 AI 的自主數學研究能力。該環境不設中央協調者，來自 GPT、Claude、Gemini 等模型家族的代理自行選擇研究方向、執行實驗、互通訊息並發表論文，累積為共享科學文獻。針對 AlphaEvolve 目錄的 12 個問題及兩個案例研究，Station 在五個問題上取得超越既有文獻的新結果：為 p≡3 (mod 4) 的質數證明新的有限體 Kakeya 集無窮族並改進 𝔽₃⁵ 的 53 點紀錄、建構三個精確的 11 維 604 點親吻組態、改進離散化 Kakeya 針與符號不確定性問題的上界，並將 Erdős 最小重疊問題的下界由 0.37912 提升至 0.380552。代理亦發現 Book Ramsey 數的新無窮族，並在一天內以純二元任務獨立重建雅可比猜想的七次反例。中繼分析顯示逾半數發現涉及跨模型家族協作，Claude 代理貢獻最多主要發現，假日與論文檔案機制最為關鍵。限制包括缺乏專家直覺、研究品味多樣性不足與吸引子陷阱。整體展示了開放自主環境可產出可解釋、可驗證且可累積的數學成果，為 AI 驅動的科學研究提供透明紀錄。

links.title: Narcissus: Program Synthesis Using Context-Aware LLM Approximations

evidence: Abstract: 'solves 40% of ARC tasks where the raw proposals solve 13%, all without a single LLM call during search' — headline claim consistent with Table 3 (DeepSeek-Reasoner synth-valid 13%) and full-ARC results (Figure 12).

Experimental Setup, Metrics and protocol: 'Our implementation, the cached LLM proposals, and all result data are available at https://github.com/Herb-AI/Narcissus/' plus 'experiments are implemented in Julia on top of the Herb.jl program synthesis library' — strong reproducibility.

Table 1 (SLIA, 70 tasks): Narcissus + Genetic (GPT-4o) 51.4 solved / 32.2% AUC vs Static + Genetic (GPT-4o) 32.2 / 18.2%, supporting the context-awareness claim; DeepSeek rows show Narcissus (32.6) matching Static on GPT-4o proposals.

RQ2, Table 2: ablation shows signal inversion — removing prefix alignment drops DeepSeek SLIA to 24.0/100 (full heuristic 45.8), while reuse dominates under GPT-4o (prefix-only 25.4 vs reuse-only 44.2) — good mechanistic evidence.

Results, Weak proposals (BV, DC): 'Narcissus solves 350 of 587 tasks, above unguided enumeration at 302, while the static priors collapse to 102 (BUS) and 57 (genetic)' — supports the regularization/no-pruning robustness claim.

Related Work, Learned search heuristics: 'Euphony (Lee et al. 2018) even conditions rule probabilities on surrounding structure' — calibrates novelty; the delta is task-specific LLM-derived context-awareness with no training.

Appendix D: signal weights swept over {0.5,1,5,10} on SLIA and fixed at 1 in every domain; genetic population swept over {10,50,100,1000} — documented but modest hyperparameter tuning, single-domain selection.

Experimental Setup, Metrics: 'means over five seeds' for genetic methods and per-task budget of 10^6 programs or 300 seconds — protocol transparency; however no statistical significance tests are reported for the smaller margins (e.g., ARGA 45.6 vs 43.0).
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly in-scope LLM-methodology paper: LLM proposals (GPT-4o, DeepSeek-V4-Flash, Haiku-4.5) compiled into a context-aware heuristic for grammar-constrained program synthesis, directly matching LLM, code/programming, and prompting preferences with no out-of-scope domain content. Novelty is solid but qualified: the paper itself concedes (Related Work) that Euphony already conditioned rule probabilities on surrounding structure pre-LLM; the novel combination is task-specific context-aware guidance from one-shot proposals with no LLM calls during search and no pruning of rules. Rigor is high: five domains, two backends, five baselines including augmented-BFS and re-prompting controls, a signal ablation (Table 2), per-size enumeration profiles (Figure 3), fixed hyperparameters selected on SLIA only (Appendix D), and 5-seed means for stochastic runs; missing significance testing and modest GPT-4o/ARGA margins (45.6 vs 43.0) are the main deductions. Evidence is well-quantified and internally consistent: Table 1 and AUC Tables 4-12 support 'beats static at every budget', Table 3 grounds the 13% vs 40% ARC claim, and the BV collapse of static priors (102 vs 350/587) substantiates the robustness claim. Generalizability is demonstrated across domains, backends, and proposal-quality regimes, with the worst case provably unguided search via the positive floor. Reproducibility is excellent: public code, cached proposals, and result data (GitHub link in Experimental Setup), full prompt templates in Appendix B, and documented hyperparameter sweeps.

primary_link.title: Narcissus: Program Synthesis Using Context-Aware LLM Approximations

recommendations.summary: Large language models (LLMs) excel at programming, but not when the task fixes the target language: prompted with a grammar rare in their training data, their programs usually break the grammar or fail the given specification. Enumerative synthesizers search the space of syntactically correct programs systematically guided by LLMs; the state of the art guides them by approximating LLM proposals into rule frequencies, which loses where each construct belongs and prunes every rule the proposals mi
recommendations.summary_zh: 大型語言模型擅長一般程式設計,但當任務限定罕見的目標語言時,產生的程式常違反文法或不符規格;列舉式合成器雖能系統性搜尋語法正確的程式空間,現有以 LLM 提案規則頻率導引的靜態先驗卻丟失「建構式屬於何處」的情境資訊,還會把提案遺漏的規則完全剪除,恰在提案出錯時鎖死搜尋。Narcissus 保留提案的語法樹結構,在候選程式的情境中為每次擴展評分:前綴對齊衡量同樣周邊結構的提案是否走相同規則、子程式重用獎勵提案反覆重建的片段、正則化項以提案規模為中心並保留正數下限,使任何規則都不會被剪除,錯誤提案只會延遲而非隱藏解答。流程包含解析修復提案、將重複片段挖掘為巨集規則以擴充文法,搜尋期間完全不再呼叫 LLM。跨五個領域與兩種搜尋後端,Narcissus 在所有預算下皆勝過靜態引導,並大幅超越讓 LLM 自我修錯的「重新提示」法;到達提案式程式的速度約快一個數量級,在 ARC 上解出 40% 任務而原始提案僅 13%,消融顯示何種訊號承重隨提案品質而反轉。限制為權重固定且各領域最適訊號不同。此方法展示情境感知近似如何讓錯誤提案轉化為可靠的搜尋引導。
recommendations.title: Narcissus: Program Synthesis Using Context-Aware LLM Approximations
recommendations.title_zh: Narcissus:運用情境感知 LLM 近似的程式合成

links.title: Localize-Then-Decide Guarantees for LLM Judgments

evidence: Abstract: proposes Localize-Then-Decide framework combining conformal shortlist localization with a calibrated confidence rule that abstains, restoring confidence-risk monotonicity for m>2 candidates.

Theorem 1.1 / Corollary 3.3: with probability ≥1-δ, P(LLM agrees with human | satisfied confidence) ≥ (1-ε)(1-α), where Corollary 3.3 explicitly requires an additional cross-stage monotonicity assumption beyond exchangeability.

Section 4.1: evaluation on TL;DR, Chatbot Arena, HH-RLHF, AlpacaEval with m∈{5,10,20}, ~3,000 instances per (dataset,m), nine judge models from Mistral-7B to GPT-OSS-120B, Simulated Annotators with K=5/N=5, and 1,000 random 50/50 calibration/test splits.

Section 4.3 (Table 2): two-stage variants reach GSR 90-97% vs 48-79% for matched single-stage counterparts at m=10 with target agreement 0.81; two-stage (KL margin) coverage 64-72% vs 50-58% for GPT-OSS-120B.
Appendix H.1 (Table 8): empirical validation that P(y∉S(x)|Δ≥λ) decreases monotonically with λ and stays below α=0.10 at λ=0 for six configurations.

Appendix H.3 (Table 10): component-wise KL-margin ablation showing renormalization removal drops GSR from 96.8% to 83.5%; Appendix H.2 (Table 9) shows variance-normalized single-stage baseline still trails two-stage (74.2% vs 96.8% GSR).

Limitations: guarantees require exchangeability (may loosen under distribution shift), confidence estimation needs N forward passes per instance, and scope restricted to preference-judgment rather than Likert or factuality settings.
Appendix D: multi-candidate instances constructed from pairwise preference data with pool augmentation by non-judge LLMs; no code or artifact availability statement appears anywhere in the document.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-methodology paper on certified LLM-as-a-judge agreement guarantees, strongly matching LLM (w2.5), evaluation/benchmark (w1.8), and partially alignment preferences; no Japanese NLP, agents, or code content. recommendations.summary_zh: 大型語言模型日益被用作評審,但要對其與人類判斷的一致性提供可靠保證並不容易。既有信心門檻方法能在成對比較下提供保證,前提是信心越高、與人類不一致的風險越低;然而候選回應數量增加時,機率質量被稀釋,此單調關係會崩壞。本文提出 Localize-Then-Decide 兩階段框架:第一階段以 conformal prediction 定位一個高機率涵蓋人類偏好回應的小型候選清單;第二階段以校準後的信心規則從清單中選出單一回應或棄權,提供 (1−ε)(1−α) 的高機率一致保證,恢復信心與不一致風險間的單調關係。實驗涵蓋 TL;DR、Chatbot Arena、HH-RLHF、AlpacaEval,m∈{5,10,20} 種候選數,以及 Llama、Qwen、GPT-OSS、DeepSeek 等評審模型;相較單階段基線,兩階段框架在保證成功率與覆蓋率皆大幅領先,並自然支援串接多個評審模型,讓弱模型處理簡單案例、困難案例升級至強模型,三層串接覆蓋率達 77–81% 且保證成功率超過 90%,最強模型僅需處理不到三成實例。限制包括需可交換性假設、模擬標註者的多次前向推播成本,以及僅適用於偏好判斷情境。此工作把可證明的評審保證從成對情境推廣到實務的多候選場景。

primary_link.title: Tunable Tool-Call Rates in LLM Agents via Representation Steering

recommendations.summary: Deciding whether to call a tool is a core competence of an LLM agent, and a costly one to get wrong: needless calls add latency, accrue cost, and may trigger irreversible side effects, while missing calls leave the model confidently wrong on questions it could only answer through tool-calls. Models manage this balance poorly, both over-using and under-using tools. Existing methods such as post-training and prompt engineering are expensive and difficult to modify at inference time. We show that w
recommendations.summary_zh: LLM agent 決定是否呼叫工具，直接影響成本與可靠性：過度呼叫增加延遲與風險，漏呼則讓模型在只能靠工具解答的問題上自信地答錯。現有做法如 fine-tuning 或提示工程成本高昂，且難以在推論時調整。本文證明，指令微調後的模型是否呼叫工具，可由殘差流中的單一線性方向控制：作者以差值平均法從模型自身的工具使用傾向訊號萃取該方向，無需任何訓練，並在推論時以強度 α 加回特定層，即可讓呼叫率由近 0% 單調上升至 90% 以上，且呼叫格式保持良構。該方向具三項特性：具知識選擇性，新增的呼叫集中於模型無法自行作答的長尾問題；具工具通用性，自多工具環境萃取的方向，對翻譯、天氣、SQL 等六個未見工具的抑制強度與各工具自身向量相當；且只改變「是否呼叫」，不干擾「選擇哪個工具」。結合實際工具執行，掃描 α 可描繪成本─準確率的 Pareto 前沿，使 PopQA 開放域問答準確率近乎翻倍（0.29 提升至 0.56），約每題 1.1 次搜尋。相同流程在涵蓋稠密、MoE 與多模態架構的五個模型上皆可重現。限制包括強正向引導可能破壞呼叫格式、方法無法提升工具執行品質，且推論型模型須先繞過推理段落才能讀取決策訊號。此方法為控制 agent 成本與可靠性提供輕量的推論時手段，兼具實用性與可遷移性。

primary_link.title: MMJailBench: A Factorized Benchmark for Disentangling Multimodal Jailbreak Vulnerabilities

recommendations.summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) are increasingly deployed in real-world applications, yet how different factors shape their jailbreak vulnerabilities remains poorly understood. Existing benchmarks often couple harmful intent, prompt framing, visual semantics, and instruction carrier within individual jailbreak instances, obscuring the specific sources of observed vulnerabilities. To address this limitation, we introduce MMJailBench, a factorized benchmark that systematically varies and
recommendations.summary_zh: 多模態大型語言模型已廣泛部署,但不同因素如何形塑其越獄脆弱性仍不清楚;現有基準常把有害意圖、提示框架、視覺語意與指令載體糾纏在單一實例中,難以歸因。MMJailBench 將越獄實例因子化為四個組成:有害意圖(272 項、九大危害領域)、六種提示框架、五種任務相關視覺語意與兩種指令載體(直接文字與影像內嵌文字),透過笛卡兒組合形成 16,320 個受控實例,並對 16 個開源與專有 MLLM 進行大規模評估。結果顯示各模型脆弱性高度異質,平均攻擊成功率從 GPT-5 的 2.17% 到 GLM-4.6V 的 78.38%;提示框架是變異的最大來源,故事、結構與學術框架普遍較易成功;任務相關視覺語意系統性削弱拒絕行為,授權文件等權威式線索增加最多(相對無圖提升 12.96 個百分點),顯示模型過度依賴視覺脈絡的表面正當性;而視覺化呈現的指令相較直接文字指令並未一致提升越獄成功率,載體效應取決於個別模型。對代表性開源模型的診斷分析亦在內部表徵與跨模態注意力中找到與權威線索相關的模式。此因子化設計使多模態安全對齊的弱點得以逐因子歸因,支援可重現、可擴充的越獄稽核。

llm_evaluation.rationale: A well-executed LLM unlearning robustness paper. It introduces FRAG, a training-free weight-selectivity predictor that outperforms global ℓ2 distance (Spearman -0.78 vs -0.36), and FRP, a pruning method that achieves lower post-attack ES across matched controls. The topic sits at the intersection of LLMs, AI safety, and interpretability but does not touch the highest-weighted preference areas (reasoning, agents, Japanese LLM). Experimental rigor is strong with four matched-control experiments, three benchmarks, four model families, and a direction-blind noise ablation. The method is conceptually simple (Wanda-style activation ratios + cosine similarity), which limits novelty, and the correlation analysis uses modest sample sizes (n=30). Code is available and implementation details are thorough.

primary_link.title: Distance Is Not Enough: Forget-Retain Alignment Gap Predicts LLM Relearning Robustness

recommendations.summary: Machine unlearning aims to make a model forget specific data, yet unlearned LLMs often fail to stay unlearned: brief fine-tuning can revive removed knowledge. Existing robustness predictors rely on global weight-space displacement, but distance alone can be misleading when random or destructive updates collapse performance. We argue that relearning robustness depends on update structure: robust unlearning should affect forget-critical weights while sparing retain-critical ones. We introduce the
recommendations.summary_zh: 機器遺忘旨在讓模型忘掉特定資料,但已遺忘的 LLM 常不持久:對良性資料短暫 fine-tuning 即可復原被移除的知識,形成再學習攻擊。既有穩健性預測器多依賴全域權重空間位移,然而距離本身可能誤導——隨機或破壞性更新同樣能產生大位移卻崩壞效能。本文主張再學習穩健性取決於更新結構:穩健的遺忘應集中於遺忘關鍵權重、同時避開保留關鍵權重。作者提出 Forget-Retain Alignment Gap(FRAG),一個免訓練的純量代理指標,以權重幅度與遺忘、保留資料上輸入通道的 activation 強度估計各權重重要性,再用餘弦相似度衡量更新與兩類關鍵權重的對齊差;並據同一原則提出 Forget-Retain Pruning(FRP),直接剪除遺忘重要、保留不重要且幅度夠大的權重。在 TOFU、WMDP-cyber、MUSE-News 與多個模型上,FRAG 與實際再學習穩健性的相關性(合併 Spearman ρ=-0.78)遠優於全域 ℓ2 距離(-0.36),排除以 FRAG 建構的檢查點後結論仍成立;FRP 在相同效用水準下,受攻擊後的遺忘恢復量僅為對照方法的幾分之一。限制包括對稠密型遺忘方法內部解析度有限,且目前僅為非結構化剪枝。此結果顯示「哪些權重移動」比「移動多遠」更能解釋穩健性。

Section 6.2.2: AgentHarm malicious score reduced 22.8 -> 3.4 but task completion drops 70.9 -> 52.8; paper admits no method achieves a clearly favorable trade-off there.

Appendix C.2 / Table 12: instruction-only nearest-neighbor p99 <= 0.885 against all benchmarks; Appendix B.2 / Table 11 shows tool-overlap-filtered retraining (2,814 examples) gives macro 80.9/81.1 vs 79.2/80.9, arguing against schema-overlap contamination.

Section 9 Limitations: acknowledges synthetic-data/annotation bias from teacher model, benchmark-limited evaluation (no open-ended ecosystems, multi-agent, or adaptive adversaries), and that the guard is not a formal safety guarantee.

Appendix F: full hyperparameters for SFT (AdamW, lr 2e-5, 2 epochs, seq 16,384) and RL (GRPO, lr 5e-7, lambda=2.0, deadband 0.02), 4x H200, ~8 GPU-hours; GitHub URLs given but no verified release statement.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly on-preference: LLM-agent guardrails, tool-call safety, prompt-injection defense, and RL-based (GRPO) calibration sit at the intersection of the highest-weighted topics (agents/tool use, LLMs, AI safety, alignment). Methodological novelty is moderate: step-level guarding exists (TS-Guard), synthetic agent-safety data exists (AuraGen), and Balance-GRPO is an incremental class-wise advantage reweighting on top of standard GRPO; the prefix-aligned contrastive branching with benign tool-reuse is the most original piece. Rigor and evidence are strong: five static benchmarks, three guarded-agent environments, ablations of both StepGen components and Balance-GRPO against simpler balancing strategies, a human-verified held-out set, repeated-evaluation variance reporting, an embedding-based leakage analysis plus a tool-overlap retraining control, and an honest error analysis of all 575 mistakes. Headline numbers are internally consistent (mean ASR 25.1/21.2 -> 1.2/9.3 = 77.3% reduction; utility drop 2.8). Weaknesses: repeats vary the evaluation, not training seeds; teacher-dependent synthetic supervision (GPT-5.4/GLM-5.1 on an internal endpoint) limits verification; AgentHarm trade-off is unfavorable and adaptive adversaries/multi-agent settings are untested; GitHub links are asserted but actual release of code/data/checkpoints is not verified in the document.

primary_link.title: StepGuard: Learning Step-Level Guardrails with Scalable Supervision and Safety-Utility Balancing

recommendations.summary: LLM-based agents can interact with external environments through tool invocation, but this capability also introduces security risks such as file modification, information leakage, and unauthorized actions. Existing guardrails often evaluate completed trajectories, leaving pre-execution monitoring of step-level actions underexplored. We propose StepGuard, a step-level guard model that can audit completed agent trajectories and check tool actions before they are executed. To train StepGuard, we i
recommendations.summary_zh: LLM agent 可透過工具呼叫與外部環境互動，但也帶來檔案修改、資訊洩漏等風險。現有防護欄多在軌跡完成後才評估，執行前的步階層級監控仍待補足，且常見防護偏差：部分模型過度封鎖良性動作，部分則漏放危險動作。本文提出步階層級防護模型 StepGuard，可在候選工具動作執行前審查，亦能稽核已完成軌跡。訓練分兩階段：其一為資料引擎 StepGen，以風險錨點建構前綴對齊的安全與不安全軌跡組，包含拒絕與風險意識兩種安全分支，以及重用相同工具的良性軌跡，避免模型把工具身分當成安全訊號；其二為 Balance-GRPO，依 rollout 批次中安全與不安全類的觀測準確率差距動態重加權優勢，縮小防護偏差而不改提示或原始獎勵。實驗顯示，4B 的 StepGuard 在五項靜態基準上取得開源權重防護模型的最佳平均成績，與 GPT-5.4 相當；部署於 AgentDojo 與 AgentDyn 時，相較無防護設定平均降低攻擊成功率（ASR）77.3%，效用僅下降 2.8 點。消融實驗證明 Balance-GRPO 將安全─不安全準確率差距自 13.0 降至 8.0，並提升受防護 agent 的效用至多 6.7 點。限制包括合成資料可能繼承教師模型的偏誤，且 AgentHarm 等高度對抗情境下的安全─效用權衡仍具挑戰。本文對可實際部署的 agent 安全防護具重要意義。
